(lemma relax_base (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (b0 int) (bd int))
  (requires (== (len s) (len d0))
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d0))) (== (idx s v) (idx d0 v))))
            (bounded d0 b0) (and (<= 0 b0) (<= b0 bd)))
  (ensures (pstate g d0 s -1 0 0 bd))
  (body
    (assert (mono d0 s))
    (assert (no_improve d0 s))
    (assert (prov g d0 s))
    (assert (cv_ok d0 s -1))
    (assert (done_part g d0 s 0 0))
    (assert (bounded s bd))))
(lemma upd_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (s1 (seq (option int))) (s2 (seq (option int))) (cv int) (a int) (b int) (bd int) (v0 int) (w0 int))
  (requires (pstate g d0 s1 cv a b bd)
            (edge_at g a b v0 w0)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len d0)))
            (is some (idx d0 a))
            (and (<= 0 v0) (< v0 (len s1)))
            (not (oleq (idx s1 v0) (+ (field (idx d0 a) value) w0)))
            (== (len s2) (len s1))
            (== (idx s2 v0) (some (+ (field (idx d0 a) value) w0)))
            (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len s1))) (!= t v0)) (== (idx s2 t) (idx s1 t))))
            (and (>= (+ (field (idx d0 a) value) w0) (neg bd)) (<= (+ (field (idx d0 a) value) w0) bd)))
  (ensures (pstate g d0 s2 v0 a (+ b 1) bd))
  (body
    (call from_intro g d0 a b v0 w0)
    (assert (mono d0 s1))
    (assert (prov g d0 s1))
    (assert (done_part g d0 s1 a b))
    (assert (bounded s1 bd))
    (assert (mono d0 s2))
    (assert (prov g d0 s2))
    (assert (improved (idx s2 v0) (idx d0 v0)))
    (assert (cv_ok d0 s2 v0))
    (assert (done_part g d0 s2 a (+ b 1)))
    (assert (bounded s2 bd))))
(lemma keep_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (cv int) (a int) (b int) (bd int) (v0 int) (w0 int))
  (requires (pstate g d0 s cv a b bd)
            (edge_at g a b v0 w0)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len d0)))
            (is some (idx d0 a))
            (and (<= 0 v0) (< v0 (len s)))
            (oleq (idx s v0) (+ (field (idx d0 a) value) w0)))
  (ensures (pstate g d0 s cv a (+ b 1) bd))
  (body
    (assert (done_part g d0 s a b))
    (assert (done_part g d0 s a (+ b 1)))))
(lemma next_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (cv int) (a int) (b int) (bd int))
  (requires (pstate g d0 s cv a b bd) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (>= b (len (idx g a))))
  (ensures (pstate g d0 s cv (+ a 1) 0 bd))
  (body
    (assert (done_part g d0 s a b))
    (assert (done_part g d0 s (+ a 1) 0))))
(lemma skip_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (cv int) (a int) (bd int))
  (requires (pstate g d0 s cv a 0 bd) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len d0))) (is none (idx d0 a)))
  (ensures (pstate g d0 s cv (+ a 1) 0 bd))
  (body
    (assert (done_part g d0 s a 0))
    (assert (done_part g d0 s (+ a 1) 0))))
(lemma relax_finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (cv int) (bd int))
  (requires (pstate g d0 s cv (len g) 0 bd) (== (len d0) (len g)))
  (ensures (round_ok g d0 s) (bounded s bd) (cv_ok d0 s cv))
  (body
    (assert (done_part g d0 s (len g) 0))
    (assert (relaxed g d0 s))))

(spec relax_all
  (params (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (pre (ref (slice (option i64)))) (k i64))
  (returns (nxt (vec (option i64))) (cv i64))
  (requires (targets_ok rows) (weights_ok rows) (== (len pre) (len rows))
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k 100000)) (bounded pre (* k 100000)))
  (ensures (round_ok rows pre nxt) (bounded nxt (* (+ k 1) 100000)) (cv_ok pre nxt cv))
  (effects alloc))
(def relax_all
  (body
    (let n i64 (len rows))
    (let-mut nxt (vec (option i64)) (seq-build n (fn (j) (idx pre j))))
    (let-mut cv i64 -1)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (call relax_base rows pre nxt (* k 100000) (* (+ k 1) 100000))
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (pstate rows pre nxt cv u 0 (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (match (idx pre u)
        (case (none) (call skip_row rows pre nxt cv u (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
        (case (some du)
          (block
            (assert (and (>= du (neg (* k 100000))) (<= du (* k 100000))))
            (let row_len i64 (len (idx rows u)))
            (let-mut i i64 0)
            (while (< i row_len)
              (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i row_len)))
              (invariant (pstate rows pre nxt cv u i (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
              (decreases (- row_len i))
              (let t i64 (get (idx (idx rows u) i) 0))
              (let w i64 (get (idx (idx rows u) i) 1))
              (assert (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
              (assert (and (>= w -100000) (<= w 100000)))
              (assert (edge_at rows u i t w))
              (let x i64 (+ du w))
              (let better bool (match (idx nxt t) (case (none) true) (case (some c) (< x c))))
              (if better
                (block
                  (ghost-let snap (seq (option int)) nxt)
                  (set-idx nxt t (some x))
                  (call upd_ok rows pre snap nxt cv u i (* (+ k 1) 100000) t w)
                  (set cv t))
                (call keep_ok rows pre nxt cv u i (* (+ k 1) 100000) t w))
              (set i (+ i 1)))
            (call next_row rows pre nxt cv u i (* (+ k 1) 100000)))))
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (call relax_finish rows pre nxt cv (* (+ k 1) 100000))
    (return nxt cv)))

(lemma base_low (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (is_walk g start p v) (<= (len p) 1) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d)))
            (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len d))) (== (idx d start) (some 0)))
  (ensures (oleq (idx d v) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== v start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0))))
(lemma state_base (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (e (seq (option int))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))) (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len e) (len g))
            (== (idx d start) (some 0))
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (!= v start)) (is none (idx d v))))
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (is none (idx e v)))))
  (ensures (st g start d e 0))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-lit start))
    (assert (== (len q) 1))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) start))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (is_walk g start q start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) 0))
    (assert (witnessed g start start 0))
    (assert (witnessed_len g start start 0 1))
    (assert (sound g start d))
    (forall ((p (seq int)) (v int)) (call base_low g start d p v))
    (assert (lower g start d 1))
    (assert (lower g start e 0))
    (assert (exact g start d e 1))
    (assert (relaxed g e d))))
(lemma sound_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (v int))
  (requires (sound g start d) (round_ok g d s) (unique_targets g)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx s v)))
  (ensures (witnessed g start v (field (idx s v) value)))
  (body
    (assert (prov g d s))
    (assert (mono d s))
    (if (improved (idx s v) (idx d v))
      (block
        (assert (from_edge g d v (field (idx s v) value)))
        (obtain ((u int) (i int) (w int))
          (and (edge_at g u i v w)
               (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d)))
                    (and (is some (idx d u)) (== (+ (field (idx d u) value) w) (field (idx s v) value))))))
        (assert (witnessed g start u (field (idx d u) value)))
        (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (is_walk g start q u) (== (path_weight g q) (field (idx d u) value))))
        (call edge_weight g u i v w)
        (call walk_push g start q u v)
        (assert (is_walk g start (concat q (seq-lit v)) v))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (concat q (seq-lit v))) (field (idx s v) value)))
        (assert (witnessed g start v (field (idx s v) value))))
      (block
        (assert (is some (idx d v)))
        (assert (oleq (idx s v) (field (idx d v) value)))
        (assert (== (field (idx s v) value) (field (idx d v) value)))
        (assert (witnessed g start v (field (idx d v) value)))))))
(lemma lower_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (m int) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (lower g start d m) (round_ok g d s) (unique_targets g) (== (len d) (len g)) (>= m 1)
            (is_walk g start p v) (<= (len p) (+ m 1)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))))
  (ensures (oleq (idx s v) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (assert (mono d s))
    (assert (relaxed g d s))
    (if (<= (len p) m)
      (block
        (assert (oleq (idx d v) (path_weight g p)))
        (assert (oleq (idx s v) (field (idx d v) value))))
      (block
        (call walk_pop g start p v)
        (ghost-let u int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call connected_edge g u v)
        (obtain ((i int)) (edge_at g u i v (get_edge_weight g u v)))
        (assert (is_walk g start q u))
        (assert (oleq (idx d u) (path_weight g q)))
        (assert (oleq (idx s v) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get_edge_weight g u v))))))))
(lemma exact_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (e (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (st g start d e k) (round_ok g d s) (unique_targets g)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))) (improved (idx s v) (idx d v)))
  (ensures (witnessed_len g start v (field (idx s v) value) (+ k 2)))
  (body
    (assert (prov g d s))
    (assert (relaxed g e d))
    (assert (exact g start d e (+ k 1)))
    (assert (from_edge g d v (field (idx s v) value)))
    (obtain ((u int) (i int) (w int))
      (and (edge_at g u i v w)
           (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d)))
                (and (is some (idx d u)) (== (+ (field (idx d u) value) w) (field (idx s v) value))))))
    (if (improved (idx d u) (idx e u))
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (is some (idx e u)))
        (assert (edge_at g u i v w))
        (assert (oleq (idx d v) (+ (field (idx e u) value) w)))
        (assert false)))
    (assert (witnessed_len g start u (field (idx d u) value) (+ k 1)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int)))
      (and (and (is_walk g start q u) (== (len q) (+ k 1))) (== (path_weight g q) (field (idx d u) value))))
    (call edge_weight g u i v w)
    (call walk_push g start q u v)
    (assert (is_walk g start (concat q (seq-lit v)) v))
    (assert (== (len (concat q (seq-lit v))) (+ k 2)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (concat q (seq-lit v))) (field (idx s v) value)))))
(lemma state_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (e (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires (st g start d e k) (round_ok g d s) (unique_targets g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (st g start s d (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (assert (sound g start d))
    (assert (lower g start d (+ k 1)))
    (assert (relaxed g d s))
    (forall ((v int)) (call sound_step g start d s v))
    (assert (sound g start s))
    (forall ((p (seq int)) (v int)) (call lower_step g start d s (+ k 1) p v))
    (assert (lower g start s (+ k 2)))
    (forall ((v int)) (call exact_step g start d e s k v))
    (assert (exact g start s d (+ k 2)))))

(lemma fix_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (lower g start d 1) (round_ok g d s) (no_improve d s) (unique_targets g)
            (== (len d) (len g)) (is_walk g start p v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))))
  (ensures (oleq (idx d v) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (assert (relaxed g d s))
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (assert (oleq (idx d v) (path_weight g p)))
      (block
        (call walk_pop g start p v)
        (ghost-let u int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call connected_edge g u v)
        (obtain ((i int)) (edge_at g u i v (get_edge_weight g u v)))
        (call fix_walk g start d s q u)
        (assert (oleq (idx d u) (path_weight g q)))
        (assert (oleq (idx s v) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get_edge_weight g u v))))
        (assert (not (improved (idx s v) (idx d v))))
        (assert (oleq (idx d v) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get_edge_weight g u v))))))))
(lemma fix_walk2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (lower g start d 1) (round_ok g d s) (no_improve d s) (unique_targets g)
            (== (len d) (len g)) (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))))
  (ensures (oleq (idx d v) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (assert (is_walk g start p v))
    (call fix_walk g start d s p v)))
(lemma fix_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (v int))
  (requires (sound g start d) (lower g start d 1) (round_ok g d s) (no_improve d s) (unique_targets g)
            (== (len d) (len g)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (match (idx d v)
             (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                            (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
             (case (some dval) (is_shortest_dist g start v dval))))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int))) (call fix_walk2 g start d s p v))
    (if (is some (idx d v))
      (block
        (assert (witnessed g start v (field (idx d v) value)))
        (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (is_walk g start q v) (== (path_weight g q) (field (idx d v) value))))
        (assert (is_path g q))
        (assert (and (== (idx q 0) start) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v)))
        (assert (is_shortest_dist g start v (field (idx d v) value))))
      (block))))
(lemma lower_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (m int))
  (requires (lower g start d m) (>= m 1))
  (ensures (lower g start d 1))
  (body (assert (lower g start d m))))
(lemma fix_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (e (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires (st g start d e k) (round_ok g d s) (no_improve d s) (unique_targets g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (match (idx d v)
          (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                         (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
          (case (some dval) (is_shortest_dist g start v dval))))))
  (body
    (assert (sound g start d))
    (call lower_one g start d (+ k 1))
    (forall ((v int)) (call fix_at g start d s v))))

(lemma pigeon (params (p (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (== (len p) (+ n 1))
            (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))) (and (<= 0 (idx p t)) (< (idx p t) n)))))
  (ensures (has_dup p))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 0)
      (assert (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let y int (idx p n))
        (if (exists ((r int)) (and (and (<= 0 r) (< r n)) (== (idx p r) y)))
          (block
            (obtain ((r0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 r0) (< r0 n)) (== (idx p r0) y)))
            (assert (== (idx p r0) (idx p n)))
            (assert (has_dup p)))
          (block
            (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build n (fn (t2) (if (== (idx p t2) (- n 1)) y (idx p t2)))))
            (assert (== (len q) n))
            (call pigeon q (- n 1))
            (assert (has_dup q))
            (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (and (< j (len q)) (== (idx q i) (idx q j)))))
            (assert (!= (idx p i) y))
            (assert (!= (idx p j) y))
            (assert (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
            (assert (has_dup p))))))))
(lemma rw_cong (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (off int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 a) (<= a b)) (< b (len q)))
            (and (>= (+ a off) 0) (< (+ b off) (len p)))
            (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (<= a t) (<= t b)) (== (idx q t) (idx p (+ t off))))))
  (ensures (== (rw g q a b) (rw g p (+ a off) (+ b off))))
  (decreases (- b a))
  (body
    (if (== a b)
      (block (assert (== (rw g q a b) 0)) (assert (== (rw g p (+ a off) (+ b off)) 0)))
      (block
        (call rw_cong g p q off a (- b 1))
        (assert (== (idx q (- b 1)) (idx p (+ (- b 1) off))))
        (assert (== (idx q b) (idx p (+ b off))))
        (assert (== (rw g q a b) (+ (rw g q a (- b 1)) (get_edge_weight g (idx q (- b 1)) (idx q b)))))
        (assert (== (rw g p (+ a off) (+ b off))
                    (+ (rw g p (+ a off) (+ (- b 1) off))
                       (get_edge_weight g (idx p (+ (- b 1) off)) (idx p (+ b off))))))))))
(lemma rw_add (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 a) (<= a b)) (and (<= b c) (< c (len p)))))
  (ensures (== (rw g p a c) (+ (rw g p a b) (rw g p b c))))
  (decreases (- c b))
  (body
    (if (== b c)
      (assert (== (rw g p b c) 0))
      (block
        (call rw_add g p a b (- c 1))
        (assert (== (rw g p a c) (+ (rw g p a (- c 1)) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- c 1)) (idx p c)))))
        (assert (== (rw g p b c) (+ (rw g p b (- c 1)) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- c 1)) (idx p c)))))))))
(lemma pw_rw (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (>= (len p) 1))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p) (rw g p 0 (- (len p) 1))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0)) (assert (== (rw g p 0 0) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) 1)))
        (call pw_rw g q)
        (call rw_cong g p q 0 0 (- (len q) 1))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g q) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
        (assert (== (rw g p 0 (- (len p) 1))
                    (+ (rw g p 0 (- (len p) 2)) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))))
(lemma cut_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (sub p i j)) (path_weight g (splice p i j)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let c (seq int) (sub p i j))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (splice p i j))
    (assert (== (len c) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) (- j i))))
    (call pw_rw g p)
    (call pw_rw g c)
    (call pw_rw g q)
    (call rw_add g p 0 i (- (len p) 1))
    (call rw_add g p i j (- (len p) 1))
    (call rw_add g q 0 i (- (len q) 1))
    (call rw_cong g p c i 0 (- j i))
    (call rw_cong g p q 0 0 i)
    (assert (== (idx q i) (idx p j)))
    (call rw_cong g p q (- j i) i (- (len q) 1))))
(lemma splice_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
            (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (len (splice p i j)) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (splice p i j) t) (idx (splice p i j) (+ t 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (splice p i j)) (- (len p) (- j i))))
    (if (< t i)
      (assert (connected g (idx p t) (idx p (+ t 1))))
      (if (== t i)
        (block
          (assert (connected g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
          (assert (== (idx (splice p i j) t) (idx p j)))
          (assert (== (idx (splice p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
        (assert (connected g (idx p (+ t (- j i))) (idx p (+ (+ t (- j i)) 1))))))))
(lemma cut_paths (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (p (seq int)) (v int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (is_walk g start p v) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))

(lemma relax_finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (cv int) (bd int))
  (requires (pstate g d0 s cv (len g) 0 bd) (== (len d0) (len g)))
  (ensures (round_ok g d0 s) (bounded s bd) (cv_ok d0 s cv))
  (body
    (assert (done_part g d0 s (len g) 0))
    (assert (relaxed g d0 s))))

(spec relax_all
  (params (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (pre (ref (slice (option i64)))) (k i64))
  (returns (nxt (vec (option i64))) (cv i64))
  (requires (targets_ok rows) (weights_ok rows) (== (len pre) (len rows))
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k 100000)) (bounded pre (* k 100000)))
  (ensures (round_ok rows pre nxt) (bounded nxt (* (+ k 1) 100000)) (cv_ok pre nxt cv))
  (effects alloc))
(def relax_all
  (body
    (let n i64 (len rows))
    (let-mut nxt (vec (option i64)) (seq-build n (fn (j) (idx pre j))))
    (let-mut cv i64 -1)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (call relax_base rows pre nxt (* k 100000) (* (+ k 1) 100000))
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (pstate rows pre nxt cv u 0 (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (match (idx pre u)
        (case (none) (call skip_row rows pre nxt cv u (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
        (case (some du)
          (block
            (assert (and (>= du (neg (* k 100000))) (<= du (* k 100000))))
            (let row_len i64 (len (idx rows u)))
            (let-mut i i64 0)
            (while (< i row_len)
              (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i row_len)))
              (invariant (pstate rows pre nxt cv u i (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
              (decreases (- row_len i))
              (let t i64 (get (idx (idx rows u) i) 0))
              (let w i64 (get (idx (idx rows u) i) 1))
              (assert (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
              (assert (and (>= w -100000) (<= w 100000)))
              (assert (edge_at rows u i t w))
              (let x i64 (+ du w))
              (let better bool (match (idx nxt t) (case (none) true) (case (some c) (< x c))))
              (if better
                (block
                  (ghost-let snap (seq (option int)) nxt)
                  (set-idx nxt t (some x))
                  (call upd_ok rows pre snap nxt cv u i (* (+ k 1) 100000) t w)
                  (set cv t))
                (call keep_ok rows pre nxt cv u i (* (+ k 1) 100000) t w))
              (set i (+ i 1)))
            (call next_row rows pre nxt cv u i (* (+ k 1) 100000)))))
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (call relax_finish rows pre nxt cv (* (+ k 1) 100000))
    (return nxt cv)))

(lemma base_low (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (is_walk g start p v) (<= (len p) 1) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d)))
            (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len d))) (== (idx d start) (some 0)))
  (ensures (oleq (idx d v) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== v start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0))))
(lemma state_base (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (e (seq (option int))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))) (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len e) (len g))
            (== (idx d start) (some 0))
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (!= v start)) (is none (idx d v))))
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (is none (idx e v)))))
  (ensures (st g start d e 0))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-lit start))
    (assert (== (len q) 1))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) start))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (is_walk g start q start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) 0))
    (assert (witnessed g start start 0))
    (assert (witnessed_len g start start 0 1))
    (assert (sound g start d))
    (forall ((p (seq int)) (v int)) (call base_low g start d p v))
    (assert (lower g start d 1))
    (assert (lower g start e 0))
    (assert (exact g start d e 1))
    (assert (relaxed g e d))))
(lemma sound_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (v int))
  (requires (sound g start d) (round_ok g d s) (unique_targets g)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx s v)))
  (ensures (witnessed g start v (field (idx s v) value)))
  (body
    (assert (prov g d s))
    (assert (mono d s))
    (if (improved (idx s v) (idx d v))
      (block
        (assert (from_edge g d v (field (idx s v) value)))
        (obtain ((u int) (i int) (w int))
          (and (edge_at g u i v w)
               (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d)))
                    (and (is some (idx d u)) (== (+ (field (idx d u) value) w) (field (idx s v) value))))))
        (assert (witnessed g start u (field (idx d u) value)))
        (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (is_walk g start q u) (== (path_weight g q) (field (idx d u) value))))
        (call edge_weight g u i v w)
        (call walk_push g start q u v)
        (assert (is_walk g start (concat q (seq-lit v)) v))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (concat q (seq-lit v))) (field (idx s v) value)))
        (assert (witnessed g start v (field (idx s v) value))))
      (block
        (assert (is some (idx d v)))
        (assert (oleq (idx s v) (field (idx d v) value)))
        (assert (== (field (idx s v) value) (field (idx d v) value)))
        (assert (witnessed g start v (field (idx d v) value)))))))
(lemma lower_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (m int) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (lower g start d m) (round_ok g d s) (unique_targets g) (== (len d) (len g)) (>= m 1)
            (is_walk g start p v) (<= (len p) (+ m 1)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))))
  (ensures (oleq (idx s v) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (assert (mono d s))
    (assert (relaxed g d s))
    (if (<= (len p) m)
      (block
        (assert (oleq (idx d v) (path_weight g p)))
        (assert (oleq (idx s v) (field (idx d v) value))))
      (block
        (call walk_pop g start p v)
        (ghost-let u int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call connected_edge g u v)
        (obtain ((i int)) (edge_at g u i v (get_edge_weight g u v)))
        (assert (is_walk g start q u))
        (assert (oleq (idx d u) (path_weight g q)))
        (assert (oleq (idx s v) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get_edge_weight g u v))))))))
(lemma exact_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (e (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (st g start d e k) (round_ok g d s) (unique_targets g)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))) (improved (idx s v) (idx d v)))
  (ensures (witnessed_len g start v (field (idx s v) value) (+ k 2)))
  (body
    (assert (prov g d s))
    (assert (relaxed g e d))
    (assert (exact g start d e (+ k 1)))
    (assert (from_edge g d v (field (idx s v) value)))
    (obtain ((u int) (i int) (w int))
      (and (edge_at g u i v w)
           (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d)))
                (and (is some (idx d u)) (== (+ (field (idx d u) value) w) (field (idx s v) value))))))
    (if (improved (idx d u) (idx e u))
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (is some (idx e u)))
        (assert (edge_at g u i v w))
        (assert (oleq (idx d v) (+ (field (idx e u) value) w)))
        (assert false)))
    (assert (witnessed_len g start u (field (idx d u) value) (+ k 1)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int)))
      (and (and (is_walk g start q u) (== (len q) (+ k 1))) (== (path_weight g q) (field (idx d u) value))))
    (call edge_weight g u i v w)
    (call walk_push g start q u v)
    (assert (is_walk g start (concat q (seq-lit v)) v))
    (assert (== (len (concat q (seq-lit v))) (+ k 2)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (concat q (seq-lit v))) (field (idx s v) value)))))
(lemma state_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (e (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires (st g start d e k) (round_ok g d s) (unique_targets g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (st g start s d (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (assert (sound g start d))
    (assert (lower g start d (+ k 1)))
    (assert (relaxed g d s))
    (forall ((v int)) (call sound_step g start d s v))
    (assert (sound g start s))
    (forall ((p (seq int)) (v int)) (call lower_step g start d s (+ k 1) p v))
    (assert (lower g start s (+ k 2)))
    (forall ((v int)) (call exact_step g start d e s k v))
    (assert (exact g start s d (+ k 2)))))

(lemma fix_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (lower g start d 1) (round_ok g d s) (no_improve d s) (unique_targets g)
            (== (len d) (len g)) (is_walk g start p v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))))
  (ensures (oleq (idx d v) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (assert (relaxed g d s))
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (assert (oleq (idx d v) (path_weight g p)))
      (block
        (call walk_pop g start p v)
        (ghost-let u int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call connected_edge g u v)
        (obtain ((i int)) (edge_at g u i v (get_edge_weight g u v)))
        (call fix_walk g start d s q u)
        (assert (oleq (idx d u) (path_weight g q)))
        (assert (oleq (idx s v) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get_edge_weight g u v))))
        (assert (not (improved (idx s v) (idx d v))))
        (assert (oleq (idx d v) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get_edge_weight g u v))))))))
(lemma fix_walk2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (lower g start d 1) (round_ok g d s) (no_improve d s) (unique_targets g)
            (== (len d) (len g)) (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))))
  (ensures (oleq (idx d v) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (assert (is_walk g start p v))
    (call fix_walk g start d s p v)))
(lemma fix_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (v int))
  (requires (sound g start d) (lower g start d 1) (round_ok g d s) (no_improve d s) (unique_targets g)
            (== (len d) (len g)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (match (idx d v)
             (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                            (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
             (case (some dval) (is_shortest_dist g start v dval))))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int))) (call fix_walk2 g start d s p v))
    (if (is some (idx d v))
      (block
        (assert (witnessed g start v (field (idx d v) value)))
        (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (is_walk g start q v) (== (path_weight g q) (field (idx d v) value))))
        (assert (is_path g q))
        (assert (and (== (idx q 0) start) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v)))
        (assert (is_shortest_dist g start v (field (idx d v) value))))
      (block))))
(lemma lower_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (m int))
  (requires (lower g start d m) (>= m 1))
  (ensures (lower g start d 1))
  (body (assert (lower g start d m))))
(lemma fix_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (e (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires (st g start d e k) (round_ok g d s) (no_improve d s) (unique_targets g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (match (idx d v)
          (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                         (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
          (case (some dval) (is_shortest_dist g start v dval))))))
  (body
    (assert (sound g start d))
    (call lower_one g start d (+ k 1))
    (forall ((v int)) (call fix_at g start d s v))))

(lemma pigeon (params (p (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (== (len p) (+ n 1))
            (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))) (and (<= 0 (idx p t)) (< (idx p t) n)))))
  (ensures (has_dup p))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 0)
      (assert (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let y int (idx p n))
        (if (exists ((r int)) (and (and (<= 0 r) (< r n)) (== (idx p r) y)))
          (block
            (obtain ((r0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 r0) (< r0 n)) (== (idx p r0) y)))
            (assert (== (idx p r0) (idx p n)))
            (assert (has_dup p)))
          (block
            (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build n (fn (t2) (if (== (idx p t2) (- n 1)) y (idx p t2)))))
            (assert (== (len q) n))
            (call pigeon q (- n 1))
            (assert (has_dup q))
            (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (and (< j (len q)) (== (idx q i) (idx q j)))))
            (assert (!= (idx p i) y))
            (assert (!= (idx p j) y))
            (assert (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
            (assert (has_dup p))))))))
(lemma rw_cong (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (off int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 a) (<= a b)) (< b (len q)))
            (and (>= (+ a off) 0) (< (+ b off) (len p)))
            (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (<= a t) (<= t b)) (== (idx q t) (idx p (+ t off))))))
  (ensures (== (rw g q a b) (rw g p (+ a off) (+ b off))))
  (decreases (- b a))
  (body
    (if (== a b)
      (block (assert (== (rw g q a b) 0)) (assert (== (rw g p (+ a off) (+ b off)) 0)))
      (block
        (call rw_cong g p q off a (- b 1))
        (assert (== (idx q (- b 1)) (idx p (+ (- b 1) off))))
        (assert (== (idx q b) (idx p (+ b off))))
        (assert (== (rw g q a b) (+ (rw g q a (- b 1)) (get_edge_weight g (idx q (- b 1)) (idx q b)))))
        (assert (== (rw g p (+ a off) (+ b off))
                    (+ (rw g p (+ a off) (+ (- b 1) off))
                       (get_edge_weight g (idx p (+ (- b 1) off)) (idx p (+ b off))))))))))
(lemma rw_add (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 a) (<= a b)) (and (<= b c) (< c (len p)))))
  (ensures (== (rw g p a c) (+ (rw g p a b) (rw g p b c))))
  (decreases (- c b))
  (body
    (if (== b c)
      (assert (== (rw g p b c) 0))
      (block
        (call rw_add g p a b (- c 1))
        (assert (== (rw g p a c) (+ (rw g p a (- c 1)) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- c 1)) (idx p c)))))
        (assert (== (rw g p b c) (+ (rw g p b (- c 1)) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- c 1)) (idx p c)))))))))
(lemma pw_rw (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (>= (len p) 1))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p) (rw g p 0 (- (len p) 1))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0)) (assert (== (rw g p 0 0) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) 1)))
        (call pw_rw g q)
        (call rw_cong g p q 0 0 (- (len q) 1))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g q) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
        (assert (== (rw g p 0 (- (len p) 1))
                    (+ (rw g p 0 (- (len p) 2)) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))))
(lemma cut_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (sub p i j)) (path_weight g (splice p i j)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let c (seq int) (sub p i j))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (splice p i j))
    (assert (== (len c) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) (- j i))))
    (call pw_rw g p)
    (call pw_rw g c)
    (call pw_rw g q)
    (call rw_add g p 0 i (- (len p) 1))
    (call rw_add g p i j (- (len p) 1))
    (call rw_add g q 0 i (- (len q) 1))
    (call rw_cong g p c i 0 (- j i))
    (call rw_cong g p q 0 0 i)
    (assert (== (idx q i) (idx p j)))
    (call rw_cong g p q (- j i) i (- (len q) 1))))
(lemma splice_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
            (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (len (splice p i j)) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (splice p i j) t) (idx (splice p i j) (+ t 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (splice p i j)) (- (len p) (- j i))))
    (if (< t i)
      (assert (connected g (idx p t) (idx p (+ t 1))))
      (if (== t i)
        (block
          (assert (connected g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
          (assert (== (idx (splice p i j) t) (idx p j)))
          (assert (== (idx (splice p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
        (assert (connected g (idx p (+ t (- j i))) (idx p (+ (+ t (- j i)) 1))))))))
(lemma cut_paths (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (p (seq int)) (v int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (is_walk g start p v) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (is_path g (sub p i j))
           (> (len (sub p i j)) 1)
           (== (idx (sub p i j) 0) (idx (sub p i j) (- (len (sub p i j)) 1)))
           (is_walk g start (splice p i j) v)
           (< (len (splice p i j)) (len p)))
  (body
    (ghost-let c (seq int) (sub p i j))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (splice p i j))
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (assert (== (len c) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx p i)))
    (assert (== (idx c (- j i)) (idx p j)))
    (assert (forall ((t0 int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 t0) (< t0 (- j i)))
          (connected g (idx p (+ i t0)) (idx p (+ (+ i t0) 1))))))
    (assert (is_path g c))
    (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) (- j i))))
    (forall ((t1 int)) (call splice_link g p i j t1))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) (idx p 0)))
    (if (== j (- (len p) 1))
      (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx p i)))
      (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
    (assert (is_walk g start q v))))
(lemma walk_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
            (unique_targets g) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p t)) (< (idx p t) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (< t (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (connected g (idx p t) (idx p (+ t 1))))
        (call connected_edge g (idx p t) (idx p (+ t 1))))
      (assert (== t (- (len p) 1))))))
(lemma neg_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (e (seq (option int))) (v int))
  (requires (st g start d e (len g)) (unique_targets g) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
            (improved (idx d v) (idx e v)))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (assert (exact g start d e (+ (len g) 1)))
    (assert (lower g start e (len g)))
    (assert (witnessed_len g start v (field (idx d v) value) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (is_walk g start p v) (== (len p) (+ (len g) 1)))
           (== (path_weight g p) (field (idx d v) value))))
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (forall ((t int)) (call walk_range g p v t))
    (call pigeon p (len g))
    (assert (has_dup p))
    (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (and (< j (len p)) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))))
    (call cut_paths g start p v i j)
    (call cut_weight g p i j)
    (if (>= (path_weight g (sub p i j)) 0)
      (block
        (assert (is_walk g start (splice p i j) v))
        (assert (oleq (idx e v) (path_weight g (splice p i j))))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (is_path g (sub p i j)))
    (assert (has_negative_cycle g))))

(def bellman_ford
  (body
    (match graph
      (case (weighted_graph rows)
        (block
          (assert (== (view graph) rows))
          (call wf_lift graph)
          (assert (== (size graph) (len rows)))
          (let n i64 (len rows))
          (let-mut cur (vec (option i64)) (seq-build n (fn (j) (if (== j start) (some 0) (none)))))
          (ghost-let-mut prv (seq (option int)) (seq-build (len rows) (fn (j2) (none))))
          (ghost-let-mut lastv int start)
          (let-mut k i64 0)
          (assert (== (idx cur start) (some 0)))
          (call state_base (view graph) start cur prv)

(lemma wf_row (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (to int) (i int) (j int))

(lemma weight_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (take p (+ i 1))) (path_weight g (drop p i)))))
  (decreases (len p))

        (assert (== (len t) (- (len p) i)))

        (assert (== (idx t (- (len t) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
        (assert (== (idx t (- (len t) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (call weight_split g q i)
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g q) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g t) (+ (path_weight g (drop q i)) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))))
(lemma pigeon (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (== (len s) (+ n 1))
    (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))) (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (< (idx s i) n)))))
  (ensures (exists ((a int)) (exists ((b int))
    (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (and (< b (len s)) (== (idx s a) (idx s b)))))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (idx s n)) (< (idx s n) n)))
    (ghost-let x int (idx s n))
    (if (exists ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c n)) (== (idx s c) x)))
      (block
        (obtain ((a1 int)) (and (and (<= 0 a1) (< a1 n)) (== (idx s a1) x)))
        (assert (== (idx s a1) (idx s n))))
      (block
        (assert (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (<= 0 z) (< z n)) (!= (idx s z) x))))
        (ghost-let t (seq int) (seq-build n (fn (y) (if (== (idx s y) (- n 1)) x (idx s y)))))
        (assert (== (len t) n))
        (assert (forall ((z2 int)) (=> (and (<= 0 z2) (< z2 n)) (and (<= 0 (idx t z2)) (< (idx t z2) (- n 1))))))
        (call pigeon t (- n 1))
        (obtain ((a2 int)) (exists ((b0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 a2) (< a2 b0)) (and (< b0 (len t)) (== (idx t a2) (idx t b0))))))
        (obtain ((b2 int)) (and (and (<= 0 a2) (< a2 b2)) (and (< b2 (len t)) (== (idx t a2) (idx t b2)))))
        (assert (!= (idx s a2) x))
        (assert (!= (idx s b2) x))
        (assert (== (idx s a2) (idx s b2)))))))

(lemma cyc_idx (params (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))

(lemma cut_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))) (== (idx p a) (idx p b))

(lemma cyc_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (- b a))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (cycle_of p a b) x) (idx (cycle_of p a b) (+ x 1))))

(lemma cut_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))) (== (idx p a) (idx p b)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (cut p a b)) (path_weight g (cycle_of p a b)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let pa (seq int) (take p (+ a 1)))
    (ghost-let md (seq int) (drop p a))
    (ghost-let tb (seq int) (drop p b))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (cut p a b))
    (call cut_idx p a b)
    (call weight_split g p a)
    (assert (== (len md) (- (len p) a)))
    (call weight_split g md (- b a))
    (assert (== (take md (+ (- b a) 1)) (cycle_of p a b)))
    (assert (== (drop md (- b a)) tb))
    (assert (< a (len r)))
    (call weight_split g r a)
    (assert (== (take r (+ a 1)) pa))
    (assert (== (drop r a) tb))))
(lemma cut_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (c int) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_walk g s c p) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))) (== (idx p a) (idx p b)))
  (ensures
    (is_walk g s c (cut p a b))
    (< (len (cut p a b)) (len p))
    (is_path g (cycle_of p a b))
    (> (len (cycle_of p a b)) 1)
    (== (idx (cycle_of p a b) 0) (idx (cycle_of p a b) (- (len (cycle_of p a b)) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (cut p a b)) (path_weight g (cycle_of p a b)))))

    (assert (is_path g p))
    (call cut_idx p a b)
    (forall ((x int)) (call cut_link g p a b x))

    (assert (== (idx (cut p a b) 0) s))
    (assert (== (idx (cut p a b) (- (len (cut p a b)) 1)) c))
    (assert (is_walk g s c (cut p a b)))
    (call cyc_idx p a b)
    (forall ((x int)) (call cyc_link g p a b x))
    (assert (is_path g (cycle_of p a b)))
    (assert (== (idx (cycle_of p a b) 0) (idx p a)))
    (assert (== (idx (cycle_of p a b) (- b a)) (idx p b)))
    (call cut_weight g p a b)))
(lemma neg_cycle (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (dist (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int))) (c int))
  (requires (good_graph g) (>= k 0) (== (+ k 1) (len g)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
    (layer g s k dist) (layer g s (+ k 1) next) (strict_at dist next c))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (assert (sound g s (+ k 1) next))
    (assert (complete g s k dist))
    (assert (witnessed g s (+ k 1) c (field (idx next c) value)))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (is_walk g s c p)
      (and (<= (len p) (+ (+ k 1) 1)) (== (path_weight g p) (field (idx next c) value)))))
    (if (<= (len p) (+ k 1))
      (block
        (assert (is some (idx dist c)))
        (assert (<= (field (idx dist c) value) (path_weight g p))))
      (block))
    (assert (== (len p) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (forall ((x int)) (call walk_in_range g s c p x))
    (call pigeon p (len g))
    (obtain ((a int)) (exists ((b0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b0)) (and (< b0 (len p)) (== (idx p a) (idx p b0))))))
    (obtain ((b int)) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (and (< b (len p)) (== (idx p a) (idx p b)))))
    (call cut_walk g s c p a b)
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (cut p a b))
    (ghost-let cy (seq int) (cycle_of p a b))
    (assert (<= (len r) (+ k 1)))
    (assert (is_walk g s c r))
    (assert (is some (idx dist c)))
    (assert (<= (field (idx dist c) value) (path_weight g r)))
    (assert (< (path_weight g cy) 0))
    (assert (has_negative_cycle g))))

(lemma edge_witness (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (dist (seq (option int))) (a int) (b int))

(lemma cut_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)) (not (has_negative_cycle g)))

(lemma shorten (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (p (seq int)))

  (decreases (len p))

          (call cut_len p i j)
          (call cut_weight g p i j)

          (assert (all_below (cut p i j) n))

          (call cut_ends p i j)

    (assert (== (view wg) (field wg adj)))
    (assert (wf (view wg)))))

(lemma weight_from_found (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row i) 0) v)
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row))) (!= j i)) (!= (get (idx row j) 0) v)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k i)))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v k) (get (idx row i) 1)))
  (decreases (- i k))
  (body
    (if (== k i)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v k) (get (idx row i) 1)))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row k) 0) v))
        (call weight_from_found row v i (+ k 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row v k) (weight_from row v (+ k 1))))))))

(lemma edge_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))

(lemma edge_facts (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (wf g) (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g))))
    (assert (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))) (!= j i)) (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v))))
    (call weight_from_found (idx g u) v i 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) (weight_from (idx g u) v 0)))))

(lemma weight_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (weights_non_negative g) (weights_and_size_bounded g) (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 w) (<= w 100000)))
  (body))

(lemma prefix_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2) (and (<= 0 i) (< (+ i 1) (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i) (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) i)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (+ i 1))
    (assert (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))))

(lemma prefix_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_at g p i))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))))

(lemma extend_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (y int) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat p (seq-lit y)) i) (idx (concat p (seq-lit y)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit y))
    (call law_len_unit y)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit y) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit y) (+ i 1))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
        (return))
      (block))
    (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (- (+ i 1) (len p)) 0))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit y) 0) y))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit y)) i) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit y)) (+ i 1)) y))))

(lemma take_concat_at (params (p (seq int)) (y int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures (== (idx (take (concat p (seq-lit y)) (len p)) i) (idx p i)))
  (body
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit y))
    (call law_len_unit y)
    (call law_idx_take (concat p (seq-lit y)) (len p) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit y) i)))

(lemma take_concat (params (p (seq int)) (y int))
  (ensures (== (take (concat p (seq-lit y)) (len p)) p))
  (body
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit y))
    (call law_len_unit y)
    (call law_len_nonneg p)
    (call law_len_take (concat p (seq-lit y)) (len p))
    (forall ((i int)) (call take_concat_at p y i))
    (call law_seq_ext (take (concat p (seq-lit y)) (len p)) p)))

(lemma extend_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (y int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit y)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit y)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit y)) (len p)) y)
    (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit y)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit y)))
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit y))
    (call law_len_unit y)
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (forall ((i int)) (call extend_at g p y i))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit y) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit y) (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit y) (len p))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit y) 0) y))
    (assert (== (- (len p) (len p)) 0))
    (assert (== (idx q (len p)) y))
    (call take_concat p y)
    (assert (== (- (len q) 1) (len p)))
    (assert (== (- (len q) 2) (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (take q (- (len q) 1)) p))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q)
                (+ (path_weight g (take q (- (len q) 1)))
                   (get_edge_weight g (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))))))

(lemma reach_base (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int))
  (ensures (reach g s s 0))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit s)
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit s) 0) s))
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit s)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit s)) 0))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit s) (- (len (seq-lit s)) 1)) s))))

(lemma reach_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (x int) (wx int) (y int) (w int))
  (requires (wf g) (reach g s x wx) (has_edge g x y w))
  (ensures (reach g s y (+ wx w)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (== (path_weight g p) wx)))
    (call edge_facts g x y w)
    (assert (connected g x y))
    (call extend_path g p y)
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit y)))
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit y))
    (call law_len_unit y)
    (assert (== (- (len q) 1) (len p)))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y))
    (assert (and (and (is_path g q) (and (== (idx q 0) s) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y)))
                 (== (path_weight g q) (+ wx w))))))

(lemma path_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (wf g)
    (== (len g) (len d))
    (start_zero d s)
    (closed_but g d vis -1)
    (all_done d vis)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) s))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len d)))
    (is some (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (<= (field (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) value) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (- (len p) 1) 0))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) s))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0))
        (return))
      (block))
    (call prefix_path g p)
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call path_bound g s d vis q)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (ghost-let x int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (ghost-let y int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (- (len q) 1) (- (len p) 2)))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) x))
    (assert (== (+ (- (len p) 2) 1) (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (+ (- (len p) 2) 1))))
    (assert (connected g x y))
    (obtain ((w int)) (has_edge g x y w))
    (call edge_facts g x y w)
    (assert (idx vis x))
    (assert (is some (idx d y)))
    (assert (<= (field (idx d y) value) (+ (field (idx d x) value) w)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g q) (get_edge_weight g x y))))))

(lemma finish_at (params (wg weighted_graph) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (b int) (v int))
  (requires
    (wf (view wg))
    (== (len d) (size wg))
    (oinv (view wg) s d vis b)
    (all_done d vis)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx d v)
      (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                     (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
      (case (some x) (is_shortest_dist (view wg) s v x))))
  (body
    (forall ((q (seq int))) (call path_bound (view wg) s d vis q))
    (match (idx d v)
      (case (none) (return))
      (case (some y)
        (block
          (assert (reach (view wg) s v y))
          (assert (is_shortest_dist (view wg) s v y))
          (return))))))

(lemma finish (params (wg weighted_graph) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (b int))
  (requires
    (wf (view wg))
    (== (len d) (size wg))
    (oinv (view wg) s d vis b)
    (all_done d vis))
  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (match (idx d v)
            (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                           (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
            (case (some x) (is_shortest_dist (view wg) s v x))))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call finish_at wg s d vis b v))))

(lemma init_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (b int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len d)))
    (== (len g) (len d))
    (== (len vis) (len d))
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len d))) (not (idx vis k))))
    (is some (idx d s))
    (== (field (idx d s) value) 0)
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len d))) (!= k s)) (is none (idx d k))))
    (>= b 0))
  (ensures (oinv g s d vis b))
  (body
    (call reach_base g s)
    (assert (start_zero d s))
    (assert (sound g s d b))
    (assert (closed_but g d vis -1))
    (assert (vis_some d vis))
    (assert (ordered d vis))))

(lemma sound_weaken (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (b0 int) (b int))
  (requires (sound g s d b0) (<= b0 b))
  (ensures (sound g s d b))
  (body))

(lemma mark_closed (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (vis0 (seq bool)) (vis1 (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires (closed_but g d vis0 -1) (marked vis0 vis1 u))
  (ensures (closed_but g d vis1 u))
  (body))

(lemma mark_vis_some (params (d (seq (option int))) (vis0 (seq bool)) (vis1 (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires (vis_some d vis0) (marked vis0 vis1 u) (is some (idx d u)))
  (ensures (vis_some d vis1))
  (body))

(lemma mark_below (params (d (seq (option int))) (vis0 (seq bool)) (vis1 (seq bool)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (ordered d vis0) (marked vis0 vis1 u) (not (idx vis0 u)) (is some (idx d u)) (== (field (idx d u) value) m))
  (ensures (below d vis1 m))
  (body))

(lemma mark_above (params (d (seq (option int))) (vis0 (seq bool)) (vis1 (seq bool)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (above d vis0 m) (marked vis0 vis1 u))
  (ensures (above d vis1 m))
  (body))

(lemma begin_round
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (vis0 (seq bool)) (vis1 (seq bool)) (b0 int) (b int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires
    (oinv g s d vis0 b0)
    (marked vis0 vis1 u)
    (== (len vis0) (len d))
    (not (idx vis0 u))
    (is some (idx d u))
    (== (field (idx d u) value) m)
    (above d vis0 m)
    (<= b0 b))
  (ensures
    (rinv g s d vis1 b u m 0)
    (and (<= 0 m) (<= m b0))
    (reach g s u m))
  (body
    (call mark_closed g d vis0 vis1 u)
    (call mark_vis_some d vis0 vis1 u)
    (call mark_below d vis0 vis1 u m)
    (call mark_above d vis0 vis1 u m)
    (call sound_weaken g s d b0 b)
    (assert (reach g s u m))
    (assert (and (<= 0 m) (<= m b0)))
    (assert (edges_done (idx g u) d m 0))))

(lemma upd_start (params (d (seq (option int))) (d2 (seq (option int))) (s int) (y int) (nv int))
  (requires
    (changed d d2 y nv)
    (start_zero d s)
    (>= nv 0)
    (or (is none (idx d y)) (< nv (field (idx d y) value))))
  (ensures (start_zero d2 s))
  (body
    (if (== s y) (return) (block))
    (assert (== (idx d2 s) (idx d s)))))

(lemma upd_sound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (d2 (seq (option int))) (b int) (y int) (nv int))
  (requires (changed d d2 y nv) (sound g s d b) (and (<= 0 nv) (<= nv b)) (reach g s y nv))
  (ensures (sound g s d2 b))
  (body))

(lemma upd_closed (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (d2 (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (u int) (y int) (nv int))
  (requires
    (changed d d2 y nv)
    (closed_but g d vis u)
    (not (idx vis y))
    (or (is none (idx d y)) (< nv (field (idx d y) value))))
  (ensures (closed_but g d2 vis u))
  (body))

(lemma upd_vis_some (params (d (seq (option int))) (d2 (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (y int) (nv int))
  (requires (changed d d2 y nv) (vis_some d vis) (not (idx vis y)))
  (ensures (vis_some d2 vis))
  (body))

(lemma upd_below (params (d (seq (option int))) (d2 (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (m int) (y int) (nv int))
  (requires (changed d d2 y nv) (below d vis m) (not (idx vis y)))
  (ensures (below d2 vis m))
  (body))

(lemma upd_above (params (d (seq (option int))) (d2 (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (m int) (y int) (nv int))
  (requires (changed d d2 y nv) (above d vis m) (>= nv m))
  (ensures (above d2 vis m))
  (body))

(lemma upd_edges_at
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (d (seq (option int))) (d2 (seq (option int))) (m int) (i int) (y int) (w int) (nv int) (k int))
  (requires
    (changed d d2 y nv)
    (edges_done row d m i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row i) 0) y)
    (== (get (idx row i) 1) w)
    (== nv (+ m w))
    (or (is none (idx d y)) (< nv (field (idx d y) value)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ i 1)))
    (and (<= 0 (get (idx row k) 0)) (< (get (idx row k) 0) (len d2))))
  (ensures
    (and (is some (idx d2 (get (idx row k) 0)))
         (<= (field (idx d2 (get (idx row k) 0)) value) (+ m (get (idx row k) 1)))))
  (body
    (if (== k i) (return) (block))
    (if (== (get (idx row k) 0) y) (return) (block))))

(lemma upd_edges
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (d (seq (option int))) (d2 (seq (option int))) (m int) (i int) (y int) (w int) (nv int))
  (requires
    (changed d d2 y nv)
    (edges_done row d m i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row i) 0) y)
    (== (get (idx row i) 1) w)
    (== nv (+ m w))
    (or (is none (idx d y)) (< nv (field (idx d y) value))))
  (ensures (edges_done row d2 m (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call upd_edges_at row d d2 m i y w nv k))))

(lemma relax_update
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (d2 (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (b int) (u int) (m int) (i int) (y int) (w int) (nv int))
  (requires
    (rinv g s d vis b u m i)
    (changed d d2 y nv)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) y)
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w)
    (== nv (+ m w))
    (and (>= m 0) (>= w 0))
    (<= nv b)
    (reach g s y nv)
    (not (idx vis y))
    (or (is none (idx d y)) (< nv (field (idx d y) value))))
  (ensures (rinv g s d2 vis b u m (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (assert (!= y u))
    (call upd_start d d2 s y nv)
    (call upd_sound g s d d2 b y nv)
    (call upd_closed g d d2 vis u y nv)
    (call upd_vis_some d d2 vis y nv)
    (call upd_below d d2 vis m y nv)
    (call upd_above d d2 vis m y nv)
    (call upd_edges (idx g u) d d2 m i y w nv)
    (assert (== (idx d2 u) (idx d u)))))

(lemma skip_at
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (d (seq (option int))) (m int) (i int) (y int) (w int) (k int))
  (requires
    (edges_done row d m i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row i) 0) y)
    (== (get (idx row i) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d)))
    (is some (idx d y))
    (<= (field (idx d y) value) (+ m w))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ i 1)))
    (and (<= 0 (get (idx row k) 0)) (< (get (idx row k) 0) (len d))))
  (ensures
    (and (is some (idx d (get (idx row k) 0)))
         (<= (field (idx d (get (idx row k) 0)) value) (+ m (get (idx row k) 1)))))
  (body
    (if (== k i) (return) (block))))

(lemma skip_edges
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (d (seq (option int))) (m int) (i int) (y int) (w int))
  (requires
    (edges_done row d m i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row i) 0) y)
    (== (get (idx row i) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d)))
    (is some (idx d y))
    (<= (field (idx d y) value) (+ m w)))
  (ensures (edges_done row d m (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call skip_at row d m i y w k))))

(lemma relax_skip
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (b int) (u int) (m int) (i int) (y int) (w int))
  (requires
    (rinv g s d vis b u m i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) y)
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w)
    (>= w 0)
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d)))
    (or (idx vis y) (and (is some (idx d y)) (<= (field (idx d y) value) (+ m w)))))
  (ensures (rinv g s d vis b u m (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (if (idx vis y)
      (block
        (assert (is some (idx d y)))
        (assert (<= (field (idx d y) value) m)))
      (block))
    (call skip_edges (idx g u) d m i y w)))

(lemma close_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (u int) (m int) (x int) (y int) (w int))
  (requires
    (== (len g) (len d))
    (closed_but g d vis u)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (edges_done (idx g u) d m (len (idx g u)))
    (is some (idx d u))
    (== (field (idx d u) value) m)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d)))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d)))
    (idx vis x)
    (has_edge g x y w))
  (ensures
    (and (is some (idx d x))
         (and (is some (idx d y))
              (<= (field (idx d y) value) (+ (field (idx d x) value) w)))))
  (body
    (if (!= x u) (return) (block))
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) k) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) k) 1) w))))
    (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) y))
    (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 1) w))
    (assert (is some (idx d y)))
    (assert (<= (field (idx d y) value) (+ m w)))))

(lemma end_round
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (b int) (u int) (m int) (i int))
  (requires (rinv g s d vis b u m i) (== i (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (oinv g s d vis b))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int) (w int)) (call close_at g d vis u m x y w))
