        (and
          (and
            (== (len ds) (len g))
            (== (len used) (len g)))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 round)
              (and
                (<= round (len g))
                (== (true_count used) round)))
            (and
              (forall ((v int))
                (=>
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                  (match (idx ds v)
                    (case (none) true)
                    (case (some candidate_distance)
                      (and
                        (and
                          (<= 0 candidate_distance)
                          (<= candidate_distance (* round 100000)))
                        (path_witness
                          g start v candidate_distance))))))
              (and
                (forall ((v int))
                  (=>
                    (and
                      (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                      (idx used v))
                    (match (idx ds v)
                      (case (none) false)
                      (case (some settled_distance)
                        (is_shortest_dist
                          g start v settled_distance)))))
                (frontier_ok g start ds used)))))))))

(ghost-fn scan_inv
  ((ds (seq (option int)))
   (used (seq bool))
   (limit int)
   (found bool)
   (best_v int)
   (best_d int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len used) (len ds))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 limit) (<= limit (len ds)))
        (if found
            (and
              (and (<= 0 best_v) (< best_v limit))
              (and
                (not (idx used best_v))
                (and
                  (== (idx ds best_v) (some best_d))
                  (forall ((v int))
                    (=>
                      (and
                        (and (<= 0 v) (< v limit))
                        (not (idx used v)))
                      (match (idx ds v)
                        (case (none) true)
                        (case (some scanned_distance)
                          (<= best_d scanned_distance))))))))
            (forall ((v int))
              (=>
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v limit))
                  (not (idx used v)))
                (is none (idx ds v)))))))))

(ghost-fn one_option_change
  ((before (seq (option int)))
   (after (seq (option int)))
   (at int)
   (value int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len before) (len after))
        (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (== (idx after at) (some value))
        (forall ((k int))
          (=>
            (and
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before)))
              (!= k at))
            (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn one_mark
  ((before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool)) (at int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len before) (len after))
        (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (not (idx before at))
        (and
          (idx after at)
          (and
            (forall ((k int))
              (=>
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before)))
                  (!= k at))
                (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))
            (==
              (true_count after)
              (+ (true_count before) 1))))))))

(ghost-fn relaxation_inv
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (start int)
   (base (seq (option int)))
   (cur (seq (option int)))
   (used (seq bool))
   (u int)
   (du int)
   (limit int)
   (round int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (view_well_formed g)
      (and
        (and
          (== (len base) (len g))
          (and
            (== (len cur) (len g))
            (== (len used) (len g))))
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (== (idx base u) (some du)))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 limit)
              (<= limit (len (idx g u))))
            (and
              (forall ((v int))
                (=>
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                  (match (idx cur v)
                    (case (none) true)
                    (case (some relaxed_distance)
                      (and
                        (and
                          (<= 0 relaxed_distance)
                          (<= relaxed_distance
                              (* (+ round 1) 100000)))
                        (path_witness
                          g start v relaxed_distance))))))
              (and
                (forall ((v int))
                  (=>
                    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                    (match (idx base v)
                      (case (none) true)
                      (case (some base_distance)
                        (match (idx cur v)
                          (case (none) false)
                          (case (some current_distance)
                            (<= current_distance base_distance)))))))
                (and
                  (forall ((v int))
                    (=>
                      (and
                        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                        (idx used v))
                      (== (idx cur v) (idx base v))))
                  (forall ((j int))
                    (=>
                      (and (<= 0 j) (< j limit))
                      (match
                        (idx cur (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))
                        (case (none) false)
                        (case (some edge_distance)
                          (<= edge_distance
                              (+ du
                                (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))))))))))))))))

(ghost-fn answer_ok
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (start int)
   (ds (seq (option int))))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len ds) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx ds v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (is_path g p)
                    (and
                      (== (idx p 0) start)
                      (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  false)))
            (case (some answer_distance)
              (is_shortest_dist
                g start v answer_distance))))))))

(lemma no_true_count
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (not (idx s i)))))
  (ensures (== (true_count s) 0))
  (body
    (assert (not (contains s true)))
    (assert (== (occurrences s true) 0))))

(lemma full_true_count
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (== (true_count s) (len s)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (idx s i))))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((i int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
          (idx s i))))))

(lemma singleton_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (v int))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (seq-lit v))
    (== (idx (seq-lit v) 0) v)
    (== (path_weight g (seq-lit v)) 0))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit v) 0) v))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit v)) 0))))

(lemma path_vertex_bounded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p i))
      (< (idx p i) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p i))
            (< (idx p i) (len g))))
        (block
          (assert
            (connected g (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
          (obtain ((edge_weight_value int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- i 1))
              (idx p i)
              edge_weight_value))
          (obtain ((edge_position int))
            (and
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (idx p (- i 1)))
                  (< (idx p (- i 1)) (len g)))
                (and
                  (<= 0 edge_position)
                  (< edge_position
                     (len (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))))))
              (and
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    0)
                  (idx p i))
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    1)
                  edge_weight_value))))
          (assert
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx p i))
              (< (idx p i) (len g))))))))

(lemma path_vertices_bounded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p i))
          (< (idx p i) (len g))))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_vertex_bounded g p start i))))

(lemma weight_from_position
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (position int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 position)
        (< position (len (idx g u))))
      (and (<= 0 i) (<= i position)))
    (==
      (get (idx (idx g u) position) 0)
      v)
    (==
      (get (idx (idx g u) position) 1)
      w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
  (decreases (- position i))
  (body
    (if (== i position)
        (assert
          (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
        (block
          (assert
            (!=
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v))
          (call weight_from_position
            g u v w position (+ i 1))
          (assert
            (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_weight_value
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((edge_position int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_position)
            (< edge_position (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 1) w))))
    (call weight_from_position
      g u v w edge_position 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma weight_from_nonnegative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
  (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) i))
  (body
    (if (== i (len (idx g u)))
        (assert
          (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
        (block
          (assert
            (has_edge
              g
              u
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
          (assert
            (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0))
          (if
            (==
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v)
            (assert
              (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
            (block
              (call weight_from_nonnegative
                g u v (+ i 1))
              (assert
                (>=
                  (weight_from (idx g u) v i)
                  0))))))))

(lemma path_prefix_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- k 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (take p k) i)
      (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_take p k i)
    (call law_idx_take p k (+ i 1))
    (assert
      (connected
        g
        (idx (take p k) i)
        (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k)))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_prefix_connection g p k i))
    (assert (is_path g (take p k)))))

(lemma prefix_step_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) (- k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p k))
          (get_edge_weight
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))))))

(lemma prefix_is_lighter
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p k))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (call path_prefix g p k)
    (if (== k (len p))
        (block
          (call law_take_all p)
          (assert (== (take p k) p)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call path_prefix g p (- (len p) 1))
          (call prefix_is_lighter
            g
            (take p (- (len p) 1))
            k)
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
          (obtain ((last_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))
              last_weight))
          (call weight_from_nonnegative
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            0)
          (assert
            (>=
              (get_edge_weight
                g
                (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              0))
          (assert
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight
                  g
                  (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                (get_edge_weight
                  g
                  (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              (path_weight g p)))))))

(lemma initial_frontier_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len ds) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (and
          (not (idx used v))
          (==
            (idx ds v)
            (if (== v start) (some 0) (none))))))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
  (body
    (assert (not (idx used start)))
    (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))))

(lemma initial_dijkstra_inv
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len ds) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (and
          (not (idx used v))
          (==
            (idx ds v)
            (if (== v start) (some 0) (none)))))))
  (ensures (dijkstra_inv g start ds used 0))
  (body
    (call no_true_count used)
    (call singleton_path g start)
    (assert (path_witness g start start 0))
    (assert (frontier_ok g start ds used))
    (assert (dijkstra_inv g start ds used 0))))

(lemma selected_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) du))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_bounded g p start)
    (assert (not (idx used u)))
    (if (not (idx used start))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
          (assert (<= du 0))
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p 1)
          (assert
            (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0))
          (assert (>= (path_weight g p) du)))
        (block
          (obtain ((k int))
            (and
              (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k))))))
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)))
          (obtain ((cross_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              cross_weight))
          (call edge_weight_value
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            cross_weight)
          (call path_prefix g p k)
          (call prefix_step_weight g p k)
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p (+ k 1))
          (match (idx ds (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none) (assert false))
            (case (some settled_prefix)
              (match (idx ds (idx p k))
                (case (none) (assert false))
                (case (some frontier_distance)
                  (block
                    (assert
                      (is_shortest_dist
                        g
                        start
                        (idx p (- k 1))
                        settled_prefix))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        settled_prefix
                        (path_weight g (take p k))))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        frontier_distance
                        (+ settled_prefix cross_weight)))
                    (assert (<= du frontier_distance))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        du
                        (path_weight
                          g
                          (take p (+ k 1)))))
                    (assert
                      (>= (path_weight g p) du)))))))))))

(lemma selected_is_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du))
  (ensures (is_shortest_dist g start u du))
  (body
    (assert (path_witness g start u du))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call selected_path_lower_bound
        g start ds used round u du p))
    (assert (is_shortest_dist g start u du))))

(lemma extend_path_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (len p))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)))))))

(lemma extend_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call extend_path_connection g p v i))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))))

(lemma extend_path_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (path_witness g start u du)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (path_witness g start v (+ du w)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) du)))
    (call edge_weight_value g u v w)
    (call extend_path g p v)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (path_witness g start v (+ du w)))))

(lemma relaxation_start
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (round int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (== (idx ds u) (some du)))
  (ensures
    (relaxation_inv
      g start ds ds used u du 0 round))
  (body
    (assert
      (relaxation_inv
        g start ds ds used u du 0 round))))

(lemma relaxation_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (j int)
    (round int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base before used u du j round)
    (< j (len (idx g u)))
    (not
      (idx used
        (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))
    (one_option_change
      before
      after
      (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
      (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))
  (ensures
    (relaxation_inv

                (and
                  (<= 0 (idx p (- i 1)))
                  (< (idx p (- i 1)) (len g)))
                (and
                  (<= 0 edge_position)
                  (< edge_position
                     (len (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))))))
              (and
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    0)
                  (idx p i))
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    1)
                  edge_weight_value))))
          (assert
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx p i))
              (< (idx p i) (len g))))))))

(lemma path_vertices_bounded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p i))
          (< (idx p i) (len g))))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_vertex_bounded g p start i))))

(lemma weight_from_position
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (position int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 position)
        (< position (len (idx g u))))
      (and (<= 0 i) (<= i position)))
    (==
      (get (idx (idx g u) position) 0)
      v)
    (==
      (get (idx (idx g u) position) 1)
      w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
  (decreases (- position i))
  (body
    (if (== i position)
        (assert
          (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
        (block
          (assert
            (!=
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v))
          (call weight_from_position
            g u v w position (+ i 1))
          (assert
            (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_weight_value
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((edge_position int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_position)
            (< edge_position (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 1) w))))
    (call weight_from_position
      g u v w edge_position 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma weight_from_nonnegative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
  (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) i))
  (body
    (if (== i (len (idx g u)))
        (assert
          (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
        (block
          (assert
            (has_edge
              g
              u
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
          (assert
            (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0))
          (if
            (==
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v)
            (assert
              (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
            (block
              (call weight_from_nonnegative
                g u v (+ i 1))
              (assert
                (>=
                  (weight_from (idx g u) v i)
                  0))))))))

(lemma path_prefix_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- k 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (take p k) i)
      (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_take p k i)
    (call law_idx_take p k (+ i 1))
    (assert
      (connected
        g
        (idx (take p k) i)
        (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k)))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_prefix_connection g p k i))
    (assert (is_path g (take p k)))))

(lemma prefix_step_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) (- k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p k))
          (get_edge_weight
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))))))

(lemma prefix_is_lighter
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p k))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (call path_prefix g p k)
    (if (== k (len p))
        (block
          (call law_take_all p)
          (assert (== (take p k) p)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call path_prefix g p (- (len p) 1))
          (call prefix_is_lighter
            g
            (take p (- (len p) 1))
            k)
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
          (obtain ((last_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))
              last_weight))
          (call weight_from_nonnegative
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            0)
          (assert
            (>=
              (get_edge_weight
                g
                (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              0))
          (assert
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight
                  g
                  (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                (get_edge_weight
                  g
                  (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              (path_weight g p)))))))

(lemma initial_frontier_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

    (ds (seq (option int)))

  (requires

    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (and
          (not (idx used v))
          (==
            (idx ds v)
            (if (== v start) (some 0) (none))))))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
  (body
    (assert (not (idx used start)))
    (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))))

(lemma initial_dijkstra_inv
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (requires

(lemma selected_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) du))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_bounded g p start)
    (assert (not (idx used u)))
    (if (not (idx used start))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
          (assert (<= du 0))
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p 1)
          (assert
            (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0))
          (assert (>= (path_weight g p) du)))
        (block
          (obtain ((k int))
            (and
              (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k))))))
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)))
          (obtain ((cross_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              cross_weight))
          (call edge_weight_value
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            cross_weight)
          (call path_prefix g p k)
          (call prefix_step_weight g p k)
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p (+ k 1))
          (match (idx ds (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none) (assert false))
            (case (some settled_prefix)
              (match (idx ds (idx p k))
                (case (none) (assert false))
                (case (some frontier_distance)
                  (block
                    (assert
                      (is_shortest_dist
                        g
                        start
                        (idx p (- k 1))
                        settled_prefix))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        settled_prefix
                        (path_weight g (take p k))))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        frontier_distance
                        (+ settled_prefix cross_weight)))
                    (assert (<= du frontier_distance))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        du
                        (path_weight
                          g
                          (take p (+ k 1)))))
                    (assert
                      (>= (path_weight g p) du)))))))))))

(lemma selected_is_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du))
  (ensures (is_shortest_dist g start u du))
  (body
    (assert (path_witness g start u du))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call selected_path_lower_bound
        g start ds used round u du p))
    (assert (is_shortest_dist g start u du))))

(lemma extend_path_connection

(lemma extend_path
  (params

(lemma extend_path_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (path_witness g start u du)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (path_witness g start v (+ du w)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) du)))
    (call edge_weight_value g u v w)
    (call extend_path g p v)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (path_witness g start v (+ du w)))))

(lemma relaxation_change

(lemma frontier_after_relax
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (cur (seq (option int)))
    (old_used (seq bool))
    (new_used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (round int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start base old_used round)
    (not (idx old_used u))
    (== (idx base u) (some du))
    (one_mark old_used new_used u)
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base cur old_used u du
      (len (idx g u)) round))
  (ensures
    (frontier_ok g start cur new_used))
  (body
    (assert
      (=>
        (not (idx new_used start))
        (== (idx cur start) (some 0))))
    (assert
      (forall ((x int) (y int) (w int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))))
            (and
              (and (idx new_used x)
                   (not (idx new_used y)))
              (has_edge g x y w)))
          (match (idx cur x)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some source_after)
              (match (idx cur y)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some target_after)
                  (<= target_after
                      (+ source_after w))))))))))
    (assert (frontier_ok g start cur new_used))))

(lemma relaxation_finishes
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (cur (seq (option int)))
    (old_used (seq bool))
    (new_used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (round int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start base old_used round)
    (not (idx old_used u))
    (== (idx base u) (some du))
    (is_shortest_dist g start u du)
    (one_mark old_used new_used u)
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base cur old_used u du
      (len (idx g u)) round))
  (ensures
    (dijkstra_inv
      g start cur new_used (+ round 1)))
  (body
    (call frontier_after_relax
      g start base cur old_used new_used u du round)
    (assert
      (== (true_count new_used) (+ round 1)))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
            (idx new_used v))
          (match (idx cur v)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some final_distance)
              (is_shortest_dist
                g start v final_distance))))))
    (assert
      (dijkstra_inv
        g start cur new_used (+ round 1)))))

(lemma no_path_to_none

  (body
    (assert (not (idx used v)))

    (if (not (idx used start))

        (block
          (obtain ((k int))

              (idx p k)

          (match (idx ds (idx p k))
            (case (none) (assert false))
            (case (some frontier_distance)

                (assert
                  (is none (idx ds (idx p k))))
                (assert false))))))))

(lemma final_vertex_all_used
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used (len g))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx ds v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some final_distance)
        (is_shortest_dist g start v final_distance))))

   (best_d int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len used) (len ds))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 limit) (<= limit (len ds)))
        (if found
            (and
              (and (<= 0 best_v) (< best_v limit))
              (and
                (not (idx used best_v))
                (and
                  (== (idx ds best_v) (some best_d))
                  (forall ((v int))
                    (=>
                      (and
                        (and (<= 0 v) (< v limit))
                        (not (idx used v)))
                      (match (idx ds v)
                        (case (none) true)
                        (case (some scanned_distance)
                          (<= best_d scanned_distance))))))))
            (forall ((v int))
              (=>
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v limit))
                  (not (idx used v)))
                (is none (idx ds v)))))))))

(ghost-fn one_option_change
  ((before (seq (option int)))
   (after (seq (option int)))
   (at int)
   (value int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len before) (len after))
        (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (== (idx after at) (some value))
        (forall ((k int))
          (=>
            (and
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before)))
              (!= k at))
            (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn one_mark
  ((before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool)) (at int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len before) (len after))
        (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (not (idx before at))
        (and
          (idx after at)
          (and
            (forall ((k int))
              (=>
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before)))
                  (!= k at))
                (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))
            (==
              (true_count after)
              (+ (true_count before) 1))))))))

(ghost-fn relaxation_inv
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (start int)
   (base (seq (option int)))
   (cur (seq (option int)))
   (used (seq bool))
   (u int)
   (du int)
   (limit int)
   (round int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (view_well_formed g)
      (and
        (and
          (== (len base) (len g))
          (and
            (== (len cur) (len g))
            (== (len used) (len g))))
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (== (idx base u) (some du)))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 limit)
              (<= limit (len (idx g u))))
            (and
              (forall ((v int))
                (=>
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                  (match (idx cur v)
                    (case (none) true)
                    (case (some relaxed_distance)
                      (and
                        (and
                          (<= 0 relaxed_distance)
                          (<= relaxed_distance
                              (* (+ round 1) 100000)))
                        (path_witness
                          g start v relaxed_distance))))))
              (and
                (forall ((v int))
                  (=>
                    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                    (match (idx base v)
                      (case (none) true)
                      (case (some base_distance)
                        (match (idx cur v)
                          (case (none) false)
                          (case (some current_distance)
                            (<= current_distance base_distance)))))))
                (and
                  (forall ((v int))
                    (=>
                      (and
                        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                        (idx used v))
                      (== (idx cur v) (idx base v))))
                  (forall ((j int))
                    (=>
                      (and (<= 0 j) (< j limit))
                      (match
                        (idx cur (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))
                        (case (none) false)
                        (case (some edge_distance)
                          (<= edge_distance
                              (+ du
                                (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))))))))))))))

(ghost-fn answer_ok
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (start int)
   (ds (seq (option int))))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len ds) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx ds v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (is_path g p)
                    (and
                      (== (idx p 0) start)
                      (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  false)))
            (case (some answer_distance)
              (is_shortest_dist
                g start v answer_distance))))))))

(lemma no_true_count

      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (not (idx s i)))))
  (ensures (== (true_count s) 0))
  (body
    (assert (not (contains s true)))
    (assert (== (occurrences s true) 0))))

(lemma full_true_count
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (== (true_count s) (len s)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (idx s i))))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((i int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))

(lemma singleton_path
  (params

  (ensures

(lemma path_vertex_bounded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p i))
      (< (idx p i) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p i))
            (< (idx p i) (len g))))
        (block
          (assert
            (connected g (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
          (obtain ((edge_weight_value int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- i 1))
              (idx p i)
              edge_weight_value))
          (obtain ((edge_position int))
            (and
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (idx p (- i 1)))
                  (< (idx p (- i 1)) (len g)))
                (and
                  (<= 0 edge_position)
                  (< edge_position
                     (len (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))))))
              (and
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    0)
                  (idx p i))
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    1)
                  edge_weight_value))))
          (assert
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx p i))
              (< (idx p i) (len g))))))))

(lemma path_vertices_bounded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p i))
          (< (idx p i) (len g))))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_vertex_bounded g p start i))))

(lemma weight_from_position
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (position int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 position)
        (< position (len (idx g u))))
      (and (<= 0 i) (<= i position)))
    (==
      (get (idx (idx g u) position) 0)
      v)
    (==
      (get (idx (idx g u) position) 1)
      w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
  (decreases (- position i))
  (body
    (if (== i position)
        (assert
          (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
        (block
          (assert
            (!=
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v))
          (call weight_from_position
            g u v w position (+ i 1))
          (assert
            (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_weight_value
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((edge_position int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_position)
            (< edge_position (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 1) w))))
    (call weight_from_position
      g u v w edge_position 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma weight_from_nonnegative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
  (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) i))
  (body
    (if (== i (len (idx g u)))
        (assert
          (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
        (block
          (assert
            (has_edge
              g
              u
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
          (assert
            (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0))
          (if
            (==
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v)
            (assert
              (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
            (block
              (call weight_from_nonnegative
                g u v (+ i 1))
              (assert
                (>=
                  (weight_from (idx g u) v i)
                  0))))))))

(lemma path_prefix_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- k 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (take p k) i)
      (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_take p k i)
    (call law_idx_take p k (+ i 1))
    (assert
      (connected
        g
        (idx (take p k) i)
        (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k)))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_prefix_connection g p k i))
    (assert (is_path g (take p k)))))

(lemma prefix_step_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) (- k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p k))
          (get_edge_weight
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))))))

(lemma prefix_is_lighter
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p k))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (call path_prefix g p k)
    (if (== k (len p))
        (block
          (call law_take_all p)
          (assert (== (take p k) p)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call path_prefix g p (- (len p) 1))
          (call prefix_is_lighter
            g
            (take p (- (len p) 1))
            k)
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
          (obtain ((last_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))
              last_weight))
          (call weight_from_nonnegative
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            0)
          (assert
            (>=
              (get_edge_weight
                g
                (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              0))
          (assert
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight
                  g
                  (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                (get_edge_weight
                  g
                  (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              (path_weight g p)))))))

(lemma initial_frontier_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len ds) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (and
          (not (idx used v))
          (==
            (idx ds v)
            (if (== v start) (some 0) (none))))))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
  (body
    (assert (not (idx used start)))
    (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))))

(lemma initial_dijkstra_inv
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len ds) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (and
          (not (idx used v))
          (==
            (idx ds v)
            (if (== v start) (some 0) (none)))))))
  (ensures (dijkstra_inv g start ds used 0))
  (body
    (call no_true_count used)
    (call singleton_path g start)
    (assert (path_witness g start start 0))
    (assert (frontier_ok g start ds used))
    (assert (dijkstra_inv g start ds used 0))))

(lemma selected_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) du))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_bounded g p start)
    (assert (not (idx used u)))
    (if (not (idx used start))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
          (assert (<= du 0))
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p 1)
          (assert
            (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0))
          (assert (>= (path_weight g p) du)))
        (block
          (obtain ((k int))
            (and
              (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k))))))
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)))
          (obtain ((cross_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              cross_weight))
          (call edge_weight_value
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            cross_weight)
          (call path_prefix g p k)
          (call prefix_step_weight g p k)
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p (+ k 1))
          (match (idx ds (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none) (assert false))
            (case (some settled_prefix)
              (match (idx ds (idx p k))
                (case (none) (assert false))
                (case (some frontier_distance)
                  (block
                    (assert
                      (is_shortest_dist
                        g
                        start
                        (idx p (- k 1))
                        settled_prefix))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        settled_prefix
                        (path_weight g (take p k))))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        frontier_distance
                        (+ settled_prefix cross_weight)))
                    (assert (<= du frontier_distance))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        du
                        (path_weight
                          g
                          (take p (+ k 1)))))
                    (assert
                      (>= (path_weight g p) du)))))))))))

(lemma selected_is_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du))
  (ensures (is_shortest_dist g start u du))
  (body
    (assert (path_witness g start u du))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call selected_path_lower_bound
        g start ds used round u du p))
    (assert (is_shortest_dist g start u du))))

(lemma extend_path_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)

      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (len p))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)

(lemma extend_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))

(lemma extend_path_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (path_witness g start u du)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (path_witness g start v (+ du w)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) du)))
    (call edge_weight_value g u v w)
    (call extend_path g p v)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (path_witness g start v (+ du w)))))

(lemma relaxation_start
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (round int))

    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))

    (relaxation_inv

  (body
    (assert
      (relaxation_inv
        g start ds ds used u du 0 round))))

(lemma relaxation_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (j int)
    (round int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base before used u du j round)
    (< j (len (idx g u)))
    (not
      (idx used
        (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))
    (one_option_change
      before
      after
      (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
      (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))
  (ensures
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base after used u du (+ j 1) round))
  (body
    (assert
      (has_edge
        g
        u
        (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
        (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))
    (call extend_path_witness
      g
      start
      u
      du
      (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
      (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))
    (assert
      (path_witness
        g
        start
        (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
        (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))
    (assert
      (relaxation_inv
        g start base after used u du (+ j 1) round))))

(lemma relaxation_skip
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (cur (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (j int)
    (round int)
    (old int))
  (requires
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base cur used u du j round)
    (< j (len (idx g u)))
    (==
      (idx cur (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))
      (some old))

      (call path_vertex_bounded g p start i))))

(lemma weight_from_position
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (position int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 position)
        (< position (len (idx g u))))
      (and (<= 0 i) (<= i position)))
    (==
      (get (idx (idx g u) position) 0)
      v)
    (==
      (get (idx (idx g u) position) 1)
      w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
  (decreases (- position i))
  (body
    (if (== i position)
        (assert
          (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
        (block
          (assert
            (!=
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v))
          (call weight_from_position
            g u v w position (+ i 1))
          (assert
            (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_weight_value
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((edge_position int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_position)
            (< edge_position (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 1) w))))
    (call weight_from_position
      g u v w edge_position 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma weight_from_nonnegative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
  (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) i))
  (body
    (if (== i (len (idx g u)))
        (assert
          (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
        (block
          (assert
            (has_edge
              g
              u
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
          (assert
            (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0))
          (if
            (==
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v)
            (assert
              (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
            (block
              (call weight_from_nonnegative
                g u v (+ i 1))
              (assert
                (>=
                  (weight_from (idx g u) v i)
                  0))))))))

(lemma path_prefix_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p)))

  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (take p k) i)
      (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_take p k i)
    (call law_idx_take p k (+ i 1))

      (connected
        g
        (idx (take p k) i)

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))

    (is_path g (take p k)))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_prefix_connection g p k i))

(lemma prefix_step_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) (- k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p k))
          (get_edge_weight
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))))))

(lemma prefix_is_lighter
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p k))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (call path_prefix g p k)
    (if (== k (len p))
        (block
          (call law_take_all p)
          (assert (== (take p k) p)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call path_prefix g p (- (len p) 1))
          (call prefix_is_lighter
            g
            (take p (- (len p) 1))
            k)
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
          (obtain ((last_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))
              last_weight))
          (call weight_from_nonnegative
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            0)
          (assert
            (>=
              (get_edge_weight
                g
                (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              0))
          (assert
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight
                  g
                  (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                (get_edge_weight
                  g
                  (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              (path_weight g p)))))))

(lemma initial_frontier_path
  (params

  (requires

    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (and
          (not (idx used v))
          (==
            (idx ds v)
            (if (== v start) (some 0) (none))))))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
  (body
    (assert (not (idx used start)))
    (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))))

(lemma initial_dijkstra_inv
  (params

(lemma selected_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) du))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_bounded g p start)
    (assert (not (idx used u)))
    (if (not (idx used start))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
          (assert (<= du 0))
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p 1)
          (assert
            (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0))
          (assert (>= (path_weight g p) du)))
        (block
          (obtain ((k int))
            (and
              (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k))))))
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)))
          (obtain ((cross_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              cross_weight))
          (call edge_weight_value
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            cross_weight)
          (call path_prefix g p k)
          (call prefix_step_weight g p k)
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p (+ k 1))
          (match (idx ds (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none) (assert false))
            (case (some settled_prefix)
              (match (idx ds (idx p k))
                (case (none) (assert false))
                (case (some frontier_distance)
                  (block
                    (assert
                      (is_shortest_dist
                        g
                        start
                        (idx p (- k 1))
                        settled_prefix))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        settled_prefix
                        (path_weight g (take p k))))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        frontier_distance
                        (+ settled_prefix cross_weight)))
                    (assert (<= du frontier_distance))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        du
                        (path_weight
                          g
                          (take p (+ k 1)))))
                    (assert
                      (>= (path_weight g p) du)))))))))))

(lemma selected_is_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (ensures (is_shortest_dist g start u du))
  (body
    (assert (path_witness g start u du))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))

    (assert (is_shortest_dist g start u du))))

(lemma extend_path_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)

(lemma frontier_after_relax
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (cur (seq (option int)))
    (old_used (seq bool))
    (new_used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (round int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start base old_used round)
    (not (idx old_used u))
    (== (idx base u) (some du))
    (one_mark old_used new_used u)
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base cur old_used u du
      (len (idx g u)) round))
  (ensures
    (frontier_ok g start cur new_used))
  (body
    (assert
      (=>
        (not (idx new_used start))
        (== (idx cur start) (some 0))))
    (assert
      (forall ((x int) (y int) (w int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))))
            (and
              (and (idx new_used x)
                   (not (idx new_used y)))
              (has_edge g x y w)))
          (match (idx cur x)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some source_after)
              (match (idx cur y)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some target_after)
                  (<= target_after
                      (+ source_after w))))))))))
    (assert (frontier_ok g start cur new_used))))

(lemma relaxation_finishes
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

    (base (seq (option int)))
    (cur (seq (option int)))
    (old_used (seq bool))

      g start base cur old_used u du

  (ensures
    (dijkstra_inv
      g start cur new_used (+ round 1)))
  (body
    (call frontier_after_relax

            (case (some final_distance)

                g start v final_distance))))))
    (assert
      (dijkstra_inv
        g start cur new_used (+ round 1)))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (view_well_formed (view graph)))
    (let-mut dist (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build n
        (fn (init_i)
          (if (== init_i start)
              (some 0)
              (none)))))
    (let-mut used (vec bool)
      (seq-build n
        (fn (used_i) false)))
