    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len ds))) (is some (idx ds x)))
        (<= (field (idx ds x) value) b)))))
(ghost-fn all_closed ((ds (seq (option int))) (fs (seq bool)) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x k)) (and (< x (len ds)) (< x (len fs)))) (is some (idx ds x)))
        (idx fs x)))))
(ghost-fn is_low ((ds (seq (option int))) (fs (seq bool)) (b int) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x k)) (and (< x (len ds)) (< x (len fs))))
             (and (not (idx fs x)) (is some (idx ds x))))
        (<= b (field (idx ds x) value))))))
(ghost-fn min_ok ((ds (seq (option int))) (fs (seq bool)) (u int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len fs) (len ds))
        (and (and (<= -1 u) (< u (len ds)))
             (if (< u 0)
                 (all_closed ds fs (len ds))
                 (and (not (idx fs u))
                      (and (is some (idx ds u))
                           (is_low ds fs (field (idx ds u) value) (len ds)))))))))
(ghost-fn improves ((ds0 (seq (option int))) (ds1 (seq (option int))) (lo int) (hi int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len ds1) (len ds0))
             (forall ((x int))
               (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len ds0)))
                   (improved (idx ds0 x) (idx ds1 x) lo hi))))))
(ghost-fn step_rel ((ds0 (seq (option int))) (ds1 (seq (option int))) (t int) (nd int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len ds1) (len ds0)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len ds0))))
        (and (forall ((j int))
               (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len ds0))) (!= j t))
                   (== (idx ds1 j) (idx ds0 j))))
        (and (improved (idx ds0 t) (idx ds1 t) nd nd)
             (settled (idx ds1 t) nd))))))
(ghost-fn row_relaxed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (ds (seq (option int))) (du int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((j int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
             (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j i)) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
        (edge_settled ds (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn mark_rel ((fs0 (seq bool)) (fs1 (seq bool)) (u int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len fs1) (len fs0))
        (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len fs0)))
        (and (idx fs1 u)
             (forall ((j int))
               (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len fs0))) (!= j u))
                   (== (idx fs1 j) (idx fs0 j)))))))))
(ghost-fn step_pre ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ds0 (seq (option int))) (ds1 (seq (option int))) (fs0 (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (hi int)) bool
  (body (and (and (and (== (len ds0) (len g)) (== (len fs0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
        (and (and (not (idx fs0 u)) (and (is some (idx ds0 u)) (== (field (idx ds0 u) value) du)))
        (and (improves ds0 ds1 du hi)
        (and (fin_some ds0 fs0)
        (and (ordered ds0 fs0)
        (and (closed g ds0 fs0)
        (and (is_low ds0 fs0 du (len ds0))
             (row_relaxed g u ds1 du (len (idx g u)))))))))))) 
(ghost-fn targets_valid ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))))))
(ghost-fn targets_unique ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int) (j int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
             (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))) (!= i j)))
        (!= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))))))
(ghost-fn undone_to ((fs (seq bool)) (i int)) int
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len fs))))
  (decreases i)
  (body (if (== i 0) 0 (+ (undone_to fs (- i 1)) (if (idx fs (- i 1)) 0 1)))))
(lemma wf_parts (params (wg weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed wg))
  (ensures (targets_valid (view wg)) (targets_unique (view wg)))
  (body (assert (== (view wg) (field wg adj)))))
(lemma weight_from_found (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (<= i k)) (< k (len row))
            (forall ((j int))
              (=> (and (and (<= i j) (< j (len row))) (!= j k))
                  (!= (get (idx row j) 0) (get (idx row k) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row (get (idx row k) 0) i) (get (idx row k) 1)))
  (decreases (- k i))
  (body
    (assert (== (weight_from row (get (idx row k) 0) i)
                (if (== (get (idx row i) 0) (get (idx row k) 0))
                    (get (idx row i) 1)
                    (weight_from row (get (idx row k) 0) (+ i 1)))))
    (if (< i k)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) (get (idx row k) 0)))
        (call weight_from_found row (+ i 1) k))
      (block))))
(lemma edge_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (targets_unique g) (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (call weight_from_found (idx g u) 0 i)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) (weight_from (idx g u) v 0)))))
(lemma extend_path_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (w int) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (has_edge g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i) (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
    (if (< (+ i 1) (len p))
      (assert (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== (- (+ i 1) (len p)) 0))
        (assert (== (idx (seq-lit v) 0) v))
        (assert (has_edge g (idx p i) v w))
        (assert (connected g (idx p i) v))))))
(lemma prefix_idx (params (p (seq int)) (v int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures (== (idx (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) i) (idx p i)))
  (body
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_idx_take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)))
(lemma extend_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (has_edge g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w) (targets_unique g))
  (ensures (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
           (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
           (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) v)
           (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (- (len q) 1) (len p)))
    (assert (== (- (len q) 2) (- (len p) 1)))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (len p))
    (assert (== (- (len p) (len p)) 0))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit v) 0) v))
    (assert (== (idx q (len p)) v))
    (forall ((i int)) (call extend_path_at g p v w i))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_idx p v i))
    (call law_len_take q (len p))
    (call law_seq_ext (take q (len p)) p)
    (assert (== (take q (- (len q) 1)) p))
    (call edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w)
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q)
                (+ (path_weight g (take q (- (len q) 1)))
                   (get_edge_weight g (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))))))
(lemma witnessed_extend (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (u int) (du int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (targets_unique g) (witnessed g start u du) (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures (witnessed g start v (+ du w)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
           (== (path_weight g p) du)))
    (call extend_path g p v w)
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (assert (== (- (len q) 1) (len p)))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) start))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (+ du w)))
    (assert (witnessed g start v (+ du w)))))
(lemma witness_start (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int))
  (ensures (witnessed g start start 0))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-lit start))
    (call law_len_unit start)
    (assert (== (len q) 1))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) start))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) 0))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) start))
    (assert (witnessed g start start 0))))
(lemma prefix_connected (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (- (len p) 1) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i) (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) i)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (+ i 1))
    (assert (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))))
(lemma is_path_prefix (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_connected g p i))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))))
(lemma path_lb (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (ds (seq (option int))) (fs (seq bool)) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (dij_inv g start ds fs) (all_closed ds fs (len ds)) (targets_unique g)
            (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures (edge_settled ds (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (assert (> (len p) 0))
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (start_ok start ds))
        (assert (== (- (len p) 1) 0))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let j int (- (len p) 2))
        (assert (== (+ j 1) (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
        (call is_path_prefix g p)
        (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
        (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) j)
        (assert (== (idx q 0) start))
        (call path_lb g start ds fs q)
        (assert (== (- (len q) 1) j))
        (assert (== (idx q j) (idx p j)))
        (assert (edge_settled ds (idx p j) (path_weight g q)))
        (assert (settled (idx ds (idx p j)) (path_weight g q)))
        (assert (connected g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
        (obtain ((w int)) (has_edge g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)) w))
        (call edge_weight g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)) w)
        (assert (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g q) (get_edge_weight g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))))
        (assert (idx fs (idx p j)))
        (assert (closed g ds fs))
        (assert (edge_settled ds (idx p (+ j 1)) (+ (field (idx ds (idx p j)) value) w)))
        (assert (settled (idx ds (idx p (+ j 1))) (+ (field (idx ds (idx p j)) value) w)))))))
(lemma lb_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (ds (seq (option int))) (fs (seq bool)) (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (dij_inv g start ds fs) (all_closed ds fs (len ds)) (targets_unique g)
            (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures (edge_settled ds v (path_weight g p)))
  (body (call path_lb g start ds fs p)))
(lemma final_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (ds (seq (option int))) (fs (seq bool)) (v int))
  (requires (dij_inv g start ds fs) (all_closed ds fs (len ds)) (targets_unique g)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (match (idx ds v)
             (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                            (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
             (case (some y) (is_shortest_dist g start v y))))
  (body
    (assert (sound g start ds))
    (forall ((p (seq int))) (call lb_at g start ds fs v p))
    (match (idx ds v)
      (case (none) (block))
      (case (some z)
        (block
          (assert (witnessed g start v z))
          (obtain ((q (seq int)))
            (and (and (is_path g q) (and (== (idx q 0) start) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v)))
                 (== (path_weight g q) z)))
          (assert (is_shortest_dist g start v z)))))))
(lemma final_thm (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (ds (seq (option int))) (fs (seq bool)))
  (requires (dij_inv g start ds fs) (all_closed ds fs (len ds)) (targets_unique g))
  (ensures (forall ((v int))
             (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                 (match (idx ds v)
                   (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                                  (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
                   (case (some y) (is_shortest_dist g start v y))))))
  (body (forall ((v int)) (call final_at g start ds fs v))))
(lemma improved_trans (params (o0 (option int)) (o1 (option int)) (o2 (option int)) (lo int) (hi int) (nd int))
  (requires (improved o0 o1 lo hi) (improved o1 o2 nd nd) (<= lo nd) (<= nd hi))
  (ensures (improved o0 o2 lo hi))
  (body))
(lemma sound_step_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int))) (t int) (nd int) (v int))
  (requires (step_rel before after t nd) (witnessed g start t nd) (sound g start before)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len after))) (is some (idx after v)))
  (ensures (witnessed g start v (field (idx after v) value)))
  (body
    (if (== v t)
      (block
        (assert (improved (idx before t) (idx after t) nd nd))
        (if (== (idx after t) (idx before t))
          (assert (witnessed g start t (field (idx before t) value)))
          (assert (== (field (idx after t) value) nd))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx after v) (idx before v)))
        (assert (witnessed g start v (field (idx before v) value)))))))
(lemma improves_step_at (params (ds0 (seq (option int))) (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int))) (t int) (nd int) (lo int) (hi int) (v int))
  (requires (improves ds0 before lo hi) (step_rel before after t nd) (<= lo nd) (<= nd hi)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len ds0))))
  (ensures (improved (idx ds0 v) (idx after v) lo hi))
  (body
    (assert (improved (idx ds0 v) (idx before v) lo hi))
    (if (== v t)
      (block
        (assert (improved (idx before t) (idx after t) nd nd))
        (call improved_trans (idx ds0 t) (idx before t) (idx after t) lo hi nd))
      (assert (== (idx after v) (idx before v))))))
(lemma row_step_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (du int) (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int))) (i int) (t int) (w int) (nd int) (j int))
  (requires (step_rel before after t nd) (== nd (+ du w))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) t) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w)
            (row_relaxed g u before du i)
            (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (+ i 1))) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (edge_settled after (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))
  (body
    (if (== j i)
      (assert (settled (idx after t) nd))
      (block
        (assert (edge_settled before (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))
        (if (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) t)
          (block
            (assert (improved (idx before t) (idx after t) nd nd))
            (assert (settled (idx before t) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))
            (assert (settled (idx after t) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))))
          (block
            (assert (== (idx after (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)) (idx before (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))))
            (assert (settled (idx before (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))))))))
(lemma relax_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (u int) (du int) (ds0 (seq (option int))) (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int))) (i int) (t int) (w int) (nd int))
  (requires (step_rel before after t nd) (== nd (+ du w)) (>= w 0) (<= w 100000)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) t) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w)
            (witnessed g start t nd) (sound g start before)
            (improves ds0 before du (+ du 100000)) (row_relaxed g u before du i))
  (ensures (sound g start after)
           (improves ds0 after du (+ du 100000))
           (row_relaxed g u after du (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call sound_step_at g start before after t nd v))
    (forall ((v int)) (call improves_step_at ds0 before after t nd du (+ du 100000) v))
    (forall ((j int)) (call row_step_at g u du before after i t w nd j))
    (assert (sound g start after))
    (assert (improves ds0 after du (+ du 100000)))
    (assert (row_relaxed g u after du (+ i 1)))))
(lemma row_settled (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (ds (seq (option int))) (du int) (y int) (w int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (row_relaxed g u ds du (len (idx g u))) (has_edge g u y w))
  (ensures (edge_settled ds y (+ du w)))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (edge_settled ds (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
(lemma frozen_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ds0 (seq (option int))) (ds1 (seq (option int))) (fs0 (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (hi int) (x int))
  (requires (step_pre g ds0 ds1 fs0 u du hi) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len ds0))) (idx fs0 x))
  (ensures (is some (idx ds1 x))
           (== (field (idx ds1 x) value) (field (idx ds0 x) value))
           (<= (field (idx ds1 x) value) du))
  (body
    (assert (is some (idx ds0 x)))
    (assert (<= (field (idx ds0 x) value) (field (idx ds0 u) value)))
    (assert (improved (idx ds0 x) (idx ds1 x) du hi))))
(lemma frozen_u (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ds0 (seq (option int))) (ds1 (seq (option int))) (fs0 (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (hi int))
  (requires (step_pre g ds0 ds1 fs0 u du hi))
  (ensures (is some (idx ds1 u)) (== (field (idx ds1 u) value) du))
  (body (assert (improved (idx ds0 u) (idx ds1 u) du hi))))
(lemma closed_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ds0 (seq (option int))) (ds1 (seq (option int))) (fs0 (seq bool)) (fs1 (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (hi int) (x int) (y int) (w int))
  (requires (step_pre g ds0 ds1 fs0 u du hi) (mark_rel fs0 fs1 u)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len ds1))) (idx fs1 x) (has_edge g x y w))
  (ensures (is some (idx ds1 x))
           (edge_settled ds1 y (+ (field (idx ds1 x) value) w)))
  (body
    (if (== x u)
      (block
        (call frozen_u g ds0 ds1 fs0 u du hi)
        (call row_settled g u ds1 du y w))
      (block
        (assert (idx fs0 x))
        (call frozen_at g ds0 ds1 fs0 u du hi x)
        (assert (closed g ds0 fs0))
        (assert (edge_settled ds0 y (+ (field (idx ds0 x) value) w)))
        (assert (improved (idx ds0 y) (idx ds1 y) du hi))
        (assert (settled (idx ds0 y) (+ (field (idx ds0 x) value) w)))
        (assert (settled (idx ds1 y) (+ (field (idx ds1 x) value) w)))))))
(lemma closed_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ds0 (seq (option int))) (ds1 (seq (option int))) (fs0 (seq bool)) (fs1 (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (hi int))
  (requires (step_pre g ds0 ds1 fs0 u du hi) (mark_rel fs0 fs1 u))
  (ensures (closed g ds1 fs1))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int) (w int)) (call closed_at g ds0 ds1 fs0 fs1 u du hi x y w))
    (assert (closed g ds1 fs1))))
(lemma fin_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ds0 (seq (option int))) (ds1 (seq (option int))) (fs0 (seq bool)) (fs1 (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (hi int) (x int))
  (requires (step_pre g ds0 ds1 fs0 u du hi) (mark_rel fs0 fs1 u)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len ds1))) (idx fs1 x))
  (ensures (is some (idx ds1 x)) (<= (field (idx ds1 x) value) du))

          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 1) w))))
    (call weight_from_position
      g u v w edge_position 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma weight_from_nonnegative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
  (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) i))
  (body
    (if (== i (len (idx g u)))
        (assert
          (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
        (block
          (assert
            (has_edge
              g
              u
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
          (assert
            (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0))
          (if
            (==
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v)
            (assert
              (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
            (block
              (call weight_from_nonnegative
                g u v (+ i 1))
              (assert
                (>=
                  (weight_from (idx g u) v i)
                  0))))))))

(lemma path_prefix_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- k 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (take p k) i)
      (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_take p k i)
    (call law_idx_take p k (+ i 1))
    (assert
      (connected
        g
        (idx (take p k) i)
        (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k)))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_prefix_connection g p k i))
    (assert (is_path g (take p k)))))

(lemma prefix_step_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) (- k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p k))
          (get_edge_weight
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))))))

(lemma prefix_is_lighter
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p k))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (call path_prefix g p k)
    (if (== k (len p))
        (block
          (call law_take_all p)
          (assert (== (take p k) p)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call path_prefix g p (- (len p) 1))
          (call prefix_is_lighter
            g
            (take p (- (len p) 1))
            k)
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
          (obtain ((last_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))
              last_weight))
          (call weight_from_nonnegative
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            0)
          (assert
            (>=
              (get_edge_weight
                g
                (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              0))
          (assert
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight
                  g
                  (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                (get_edge_weight
                  g
                  (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              (path_weight g p)))))))

(lemma initial_frontier_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len ds) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (and
          (not (idx used v))
          (==
            (idx ds v)
            (if (== v start) (some 0) (none))))))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
  (body
    (assert (not (idx used start)))
    (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))))

(lemma initial_dijkstra_inv
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len ds) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (and
          (not (idx used v))
          (==
            (idx ds v)
            (if (== v start) (some 0) (none)))))))
  (ensures (dijkstra_inv g start ds used 0))
  (body
    (call no_true_count used)
    (call singleton_path g start)
    (assert (path_witness g start start 0))
    (assert (frontier_ok g start ds used))

(lemma selected_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) du))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_bounded g p start)
    (assert (not (idx used u)))
    (if (not (idx used start))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
          (assert (<= du 0))
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p 1)
          (assert
            (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0))
          (assert (>= (path_weight g p) du)))
        (block
          (obtain ((k int))
            (and
              (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k))))))
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)))
          (obtain ((cross_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              cross_weight))
          (call edge_weight_value
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            cross_weight)
          (call path_prefix g p k)
          (call prefix_step_weight g p k)
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p (+ k 1))
          (match (idx ds (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none) (assert false))
            (case (some settled_prefix)
              (match (idx ds (idx p k))
                (case (none) (assert false))
                (case (some frontier_distance)
                  (block
                    (assert
                      (is_shortest_dist
                        g
                        start
                        (idx p (- k 1))
                        settled_prefix))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        settled_prefix
                        (path_weight g (take p k))))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        frontier_distance
                        (+ settled_prefix cross_weight)))
                    (assert (<= du frontier_distance))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        du
                        (path_weight
                          g
                          (take p (+ k 1)))))
                    (assert
                      (>= (path_weight g p) du)))))))))))

(lemma selected_is_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du))
  (ensures (is_shortest_dist g start u du))
  (body
    (assert (path_witness g start u du))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call selected_path_lower_bound
        g start ds used round u du p))
    (assert (is_shortest_dist g start u du))))

(lemma extend_path_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)

  (ensures

  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)

    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))

(lemma extend_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

(lemma extend_path_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (path_witness g start u du)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (path_witness g start v (+ du w)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) du)))
    (call edge_weight_value g u v w)
    (call extend_path g p v)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (path_witness g start v (+ du w)))))

(lemma relaxation_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (j int)
    (round int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base before used u du j round)
    (< j (len (idx g u)))
    (not
      (idx used
        (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))
    (one_option_change
      before
      after
      (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
      (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))
  (ensures
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base after used u du (+ j 1) round))
  (body
    (assert
      (has_edge
        g
        u
        (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)

    (call extend_path_witness
      g
      start
      u
      du
      (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
      (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))
    (assert
      (path_witness
        g
        start
        (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)

    (assert
      (relaxation_inv

  (params

(lemma frontier_after_relax
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (cur (seq (option int)))
    (old_used (seq bool))
    (new_used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (round int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start base old_used round)
    (not (idx old_used u))
    (== (idx base u) (some du))
    (one_mark old_used new_used u)
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base cur old_used u du
      (len (idx g u)) round))
  (ensures
    (frontier_ok g start cur new_used))
  (body
    (assert
      (=>
        (not (idx new_used start))
        (== (idx cur start) (some 0))))
    (assert
      (forall ((x int) (y int) (w int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))))
            (and
              (and (idx new_used x)
                   (not (idx new_used y)))
              (has_edge g x y w)))
          (match (idx cur x)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some source_after)
              (match (idx cur y)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some target_after)
                  (<= target_after
                      (+ source_after w)))))))))
    (assert (frontier_ok g start cur new_used))))

(lemma relaxation_finishes
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (cur (seq (option int)))
    (old_used (seq bool))
    (new_used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (round int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start base old_used round)
    (not (idx old_used u))
    (== (idx base u) (some du))
    (is_shortest_dist g start u du)
    (one_mark old_used new_used u)
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base cur old_used u du
      (len (idx g u)) round))
  (ensures
    (dijkstra_inv
      g start cur new_used (+ round 1)))
  (body
    (call frontier_after_relax
      g start base cur old_used new_used u du round)
    (assert
      (== (true_count new_used) (+ round 1)))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
            (idx new_used v))
          (match (idx cur v)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some final_distance)
              (is_shortest_dist
                g start v final_distance))))))
    (assert
      (dijkstra_inv
        g start cur new_used (+ round 1)))))

(lemma no_path_to_none
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

    (ds (seq (option int)))

  (ensures false)
  (body
    (assert (not (idx used v)))

    (if (not (idx used start))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
          (assert (is none (idx ds start)))

        (block
          (obtain ((k int))

          (match (idx ds (idx p k))
            (case (none) (assert false))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (view_well_formed (view graph)))
    (let-mut dist (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build n
        (fn (init_i)
          (if (== init_i start)
              (some 0)
              (none)))))
    (let-mut used (vec bool)
      (seq-build n
        (fn (used_i) false)))
    (call initial_dijkstra_inv
      (view graph) start dist used)
    (let-mut rounds i64 0)
    (while (< rounds n)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 rounds) (<= rounds n)))
      (invariant
        (dijkstra_inv
          (view graph) start dist used rounds))
      (decreases (- n rounds))
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut best_v i64 0)
      (let-mut best_d i64 0)
      (let-mut scan_i i64 0)
      (while (< scan_i n)
        (invariant
          (scan_inv
            dist used scan_i found best_v best_d))
        (decreases (- n scan_i))
        (if (not (idx used scan_i))
            (match (idx dist scan_i)
              (case (none) (block))
              (case (some cur_d)
                (if
                  (or (not found) (< cur_d best_d))
                  (block
                    (set found true)
                    (set best_v scan_i)
                    (set best_d cur_d))
                  (block))))
            (block))
        (set scan_i (+ scan_i 1)))
      (if found
          (block
            (call selected_is_shortest
              (view graph)
              start
              dist
              used
              rounds
              best_v
              best_d)
            (ghost-let base_dist
              (seq (option int))
              dist)
            (ghost-let base_used
              (seq bool)
              used)
            (set-idx used best_v true)
            (assert
              (one_mark base_used used best_v))
            (call relaxation_start
              (view graph)
              start
              base_dist
              base_used
              best_v
              best_d
              rounds)
            (let row_len i64
              (len
                (idx

      (== (len ds) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx ds v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (is_path g p)
                    (and
                      (== (idx p 0) start)
                      (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  false)))
            (case (some answer_distance)
              (is_shortest_dist
                g start v answer_distance))))))))

(lemma no_true_count
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (not (idx s i)))))
  (ensures (== (true_count s) 0))
  (body
    (assert (not (contains s true)))
    (assert (== (occurrences s true) 0))))

(lemma full_true_count
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (== (true_count s) (len s)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (idx s i))))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((i int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
          (idx s i))))))

(lemma singleton_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (ensures

(lemma path_vertex_bounded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p i))
      (< (idx p i) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p i))
            (< (idx p i) (len g))))
        (block
          (assert
            (connected g (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
          (obtain ((path_edge_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- i 1))
              (idx p i)
              path_edge_weight))
          (obtain ((edge_position int))
            (and
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (idx p (- i 1)))
                  (< (idx p (- i 1)) (len g)))
                (and
                  (<= 0 edge_position)
                  (< edge_position
                     (len (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))))))
              (and
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    0)
                  (idx p i))
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    1)
                  path_edge_weight))))
          (assert
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx p i))
              (< (idx p i) (len g))))))))

(lemma path_vertices_bounded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p i))
          (< (idx p i) (len g))))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_vertex_bounded g p start i))))

(lemma weight_from_position
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (position int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 position)
        (< position (len (idx g u))))
      (and (<= 0 i) (<= i position)))
    (==
      (get (idx (idx g u) position) 0)
      v)
    (==
      (get (idx (idx g u) position) 1)
      w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
  (decreases (- position i))
  (body
    (if (== i position)
        (assert
          (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
        (block
          (assert
            (!=
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v))
          (call weight_from_position
            g u v w position (+ i 1))
          (assert
            (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_weight_value
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((edge_position int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_position)
            (< edge_position (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 1) w))))
    (call weight_from_position
      g u v w edge_position 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma weight_from_nonnegative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
  (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) i))
  (body
    (if (== i (len (idx g u)))
        (assert
          (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
        (block
          (assert
            (has_edge
              g
              u
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
          (assert
            (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0))
          (if
            (==
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v)
            (assert
              (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
            (block
              (call weight_from_nonnegative
                g u v (+ i 1))
              (assert
                (>=
                  (weight_from (idx g u) v i)
                  0))))))))

(lemma path_prefix_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- k 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (take p k) i)
      (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_take p k i)
    (call law_idx_take p k (+ i 1))
    (assert
      (connected
        g
        (idx (take p k) i)
        (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k)))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_prefix_connection g p k i))
    (assert (is_path g (take p k)))))

(lemma prefix_step_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) (- k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p k))
          (get_edge_weight
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))))))

(lemma prefix_is_lighter
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p k))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (call path_prefix g p k)
    (if (== k (len p))
        (block
          (call law_take_all p)
          (assert (== (take p k) p)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call path_prefix g p (- (len p) 1))
          (call prefix_is_lighter
            g
            (take p (- (len p) 1))
            k)
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
          (obtain ((last_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))
              last_weight))
          (call weight_from_nonnegative
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            0)
          (assert
            (>=
              (get_edge_weight
                g
                (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              0))
          (assert
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight
                  g
                  (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                (get_edge_weight
                  g
                  (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              (path_weight g p)))))))

(lemma initial_frontier_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len ds) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (and
          (not (idx used v))
          (==
            (idx ds v)
            (if (== v start) (some 0) (none))))))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
  (body
    (assert (not (idx used start)))
    (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))))

(lemma initial_dijkstra_inv
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len ds) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (and
          (not (idx used v))
          (==
            (idx ds v)
            (if (== v start) (some 0) (none)))))))
  (ensures (dijkstra_inv g start ds used 0))
  (body
    (call no_true_count used)
    (call singleton_path g start)
    (assert (path_witness g start start 0))
    (assert (frontier_ok g start ds used))
    (assert (dijkstra_inv g start ds used 0))))

(lemma selected_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) du))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_bounded g p start)
    (assert (not (idx used u)))
    (if (not (idx used start))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
          (assert (<= du 0))
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p 1)
          (assert
            (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0))
          (assert (>= (path_weight g p) du)))
        (block
          (obtain ((k int))
            (and
              (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k))))))
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)))
          (obtain ((cross_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              cross_weight))
          (call edge_weight_value
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            cross_weight)
          (call path_prefix g p k)
          (call prefix_step_weight g p k)
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p (+ k 1))
          (match (idx ds (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none) (assert false))
            (case (some settled_prefix)
              (match (idx ds (idx p k))
                (case (none) (assert false))
                (case (some frontier_distance)
                  (block
                    (assert
                      (is_shortest_dist
                        g
                        start
                        (idx p (- k 1))
                        settled_prefix))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        settled_prefix
                        (path_weight g (take p k))))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        frontier_distance
                        (+ settled_prefix cross_weight)))
                    (assert (<= du frontier_distance))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        du
                        (path_weight
                          g
                          (take p (+ k 1)))))
                    (assert
                      (>= (path_weight g p) du)))))))))))

(lemma selected_is_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du))
  (ensures (is_shortest_dist g start u du))
  (body
    (assert (path_witness g start u du))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call selected_path_lower_bound
        g start ds used round u du p))
    (assert (is_shortest_dist g start u du))))

(lemma extend_path_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (len p))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)))))))

(lemma extend_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call extend_path_connection g p v i))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))))

(lemma extend_path_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (path_witness g start u du)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (path_witness g start v (+ du w)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) du)))
    (call edge_weight_value g u v w)
    (call extend_path g p v)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (path_witness g start v (+ du w)))))

(lemma relaxation_start
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

    (assert
      (relaxation_inv

(lemma relaxation_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (j int)
    (round int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base before used u du j round)
    (< j (len (idx g u)))
    (not
      (idx used
        (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))
    (one_option_change
      before
      after
      (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
      (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))
  (ensures
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base after used u du (+ j 1) round))
  (body
    (assert
      (has_edge
        g
        u
        (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
        (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))
    (call extend_path_witness
      g
      start
      u
      du
      (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
      (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))
    (assert
      (path_witness
        g
        start
        (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
        (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))
    (assert
      (relaxation_inv
        g start base after used u du (+ j 1) round))))

(lemma relaxation_skip
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (cur (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (j int)
    (round int)
    (old int))
  (requires
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base cur used u du j round)
    (< j (len (idx g u)))
    (==
      (idx cur (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))
      (some old))
    (<=
      old
      (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))
  (ensures
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base cur used u du (+ j 1) round))
  (body
    (assert
      (relaxation_inv
        g start base cur used u du (+ j 1) round))))

(lemma frontier_after_relax
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (cur (seq (option int)))
    (old_used (seq bool))
    (new_used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (round int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start base old_used round)
    (not (idx old_used u))
    (== (idx base u) (some du))
    (one_mark old_used new_used u)
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base cur old_used u du
      (len (idx g u)) round))
  (ensures
    (frontier_ok g start cur new_used))
  (body
    (assert
      (=>
        (not (idx new_used start))
        (== (idx cur start) (some 0))))
    (assert
      (forall ((x int) (y int) (w int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))))
            (and
              (and (idx new_used x)
                   (not (idx new_used y)))
              (has_edge g x y w)))
          (match (idx cur x)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some source_after)
              (match (idx cur y)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some target_after)
                  (<= target_after
                      (+ source_after w)))))))))
    (assert (frontier_ok g start cur new_used))))

(lemma relaxation_finishes
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (cur (seq (option int)))
    (old_used (seq bool))
    (new_used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (round int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start base old_used round)
    (not (idx old_used u))
    (== (idx base u) (some du))
    (is_shortest_dist g start u du)
    (one_mark old_used new_used u)
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base cur old_used u du
      (len (idx g u)) round))
  (ensures
    (dijkstra_inv
      g start cur new_used (+ round 1)))
  (body
    (call frontier_after_relax
      g start base cur old_used new_used u du round)
    (assert
      (== (true_count new_used) (+ round 1)))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
            (idx new_used v))
          (match (idx cur v)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some final_distance)
              (is_shortest_dist
                g start v final_distance))))))
    (assert
      (dijkstra_inv
        g start cur new_used (+ round 1)))))

(lemma no_path_to_none
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) false 0 0)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (== (idx ds v) (none))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (assert (not (idx used v)))
    (call path_vertices_bounded g p start)
    (if (not (idx used start))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
          (assert (is none (idx ds start)))
          (assert false))
        (block
          (obtain ((k int))
            (and
              (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k))))))
          (assert
            (connected
              g
