                      (case (none) false)
                      (case (some target_distance)
                        (<= target_distance
                            (+ source_distance w))))))))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_inv
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (start int)
   (ds (seq (option int)))
   (used (seq bool))
   (round int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (weights_non_negative g)
      (and
        (weights_and_size_bounded g)
        (and
          (and
            (== (len ds) (len g))
            (== (len used) (len g)))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 round)
              (and
                (<= round (len g))
                (== (true_count used) round)))
            (and
              (forall ((v int))
                (=>
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                  (match (idx ds v)
                    (case (none) true)
                    (case (some candidate_distance)
                      (and
                        (and
                          (<= 0 candidate_distance)
                          (<= candidate_distance (* round 100000)))
                        (path_witness
                          g start v candidate_distance))))))
              (and
                (forall ((v int))
                  (=>
                    (and
                      (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                      (idx used v))
                    (match (idx ds v)
                      (case (none) false)
                      (case (some settled_distance)
                        (is_shortest_dist
                          g start v settled_distance)))))
                (frontier_ok g start ds used)))))))))

(ghost-fn scan_inv
  ((ds (seq (option int)))
   (used (seq bool))
   (limit int)
   (found bool)
   (best_v int)
   (best_d int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len used) (len ds))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 limit) (<= limit (len ds)))
        (if found
            (and
              (and (<= 0 best_v) (< best_v limit))
              (and
                (not (idx used best_v))
                (and
                  (== (idx ds best_v) (some best_d))
                  (forall ((v int))
                    (=>
                      (and
                        (and (<= 0 v) (< v limit))
                        (not (idx used v)))
                      (match (idx ds v)
                        (case (none) true)
                        (case (some scanned_distance)
                          (<= best_d scanned_distance))))))))
            (forall ((v int))
              (=>
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v limit))
                  (not (idx used v)))
                (is none (idx ds v)))))))))

(ghost-fn one_option_change
  ((before (seq (option int)))
   (after (seq (option int)))
   (at int)
   (value int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len before) (len after))
        (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (== (idx after at) (some value))
        (forall ((k int))
          (=>
            (and
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before)))
              (!= k at))
            (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn one_mark
  ((before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool)) (at int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len before) (len after))
        (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (not (idx before at))
        (and
          (idx after at)
          (and
            (forall ((k int))
              (=>
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before)))
                  (!= k at))
                (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))
            (==
              (true_count after)
              (+ (true_count before) 1))))))))

(ghost-fn relaxation_inv
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (start int)
   (base (seq (option int)))
   (cur (seq (option int)))
   (used (seq bool))
   (u int)
   (du int)
   (limit int)
   (round int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (view_well_formed g)
      (and
        (and
          (== (len base) (len g))
          (and
            (== (len cur) (len g))
            (== (len used) (len g))))
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (== (idx base u) (some du)))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 limit)
              (<= limit (len (idx g u))))
            (and
              (forall ((v int))
                (=>
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                  (match (idx cur v)
                    (case (none) true)
                    (case (some relaxed_distance)
                      (and
                        (and
                          (<= 0 relaxed_distance)
                          (<= relaxed_distance
                              (* (+ round 1) 100000)))
                        (path_witness
                          g start v relaxed_distance))))))
              (and
                (forall ((v int))
                  (=>
                    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                    (match (idx base v)
                      (case (none) true)
                      (case (some base_distance)
                        (match (idx cur v)
                          (case (none) false)
                          (case (some current_distance)
                            (<= current_distance base_distance)))))))
                (and
                  (forall ((v int))
                    (=>
                      (and
                        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                        (idx used v))
                      (== (idx cur v) (idx base v))))
                  (forall ((j int))
                    (=>
                      (and (<= 0 j) (< j limit))
                      (match
                        (idx cur (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))
                        (case (none) false)
                        (case (some edge_distance)
                          (<= edge_distance
                              (+ du
                                (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))))))))))))))

(ghost-fn answer_ok
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (start int)
   (ds (seq (option int))))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len ds) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx ds v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (is_path g p)
                    (and
                      (== (idx p 0) start)
                      (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  false)))
            (case (some answer_distance)
              (is_shortest_dist
                g start v answer_distance))))))))

(lemma no_true_count
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (not (idx s i)))))
  (ensures (== (true_count s) 0))
  (body
    (assert (not (contains s true)))
    (assert (== (occurrences s true) 0))))

(lemma full_true_count
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (== (true_count s) (len s)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (idx s i))))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((i int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
          (idx s i))))))

(lemma singleton_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (v int))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (seq-lit v))
    (== (idx (seq-lit v) 0) v)
    (== (path_weight g (seq-lit v)) 0))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit v) 0) v))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit v)) 0))))

(lemma path_vertex_bounded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p i))
      (< (idx p i) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p i))
            (< (idx p i) (len g))))
        (block
          (assert
            (connected g (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
          (obtain ((path_edge_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- i 1))
              (idx p i)
              path_edge_weight))
          (obtain ((edge_position int))
            (and
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (idx p (- i 1)))
                  (< (idx p (- i 1)) (len g)))
                (and
                  (<= 0 edge_position)
                  (< edge_position
                     (len (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))))))
              (and
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    0)
                  (idx p i))
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    1)
                  path_edge_weight))))
          (assert
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx p i))
              (< (idx p i) (len g))))))))

(lemma path_vertices_bounded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p i))
          (< (idx p i) (len g))))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_vertex_bounded g p start i))))

(lemma weight_from_position
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (position int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 position)
        (< position (len (idx g u))))
      (and (<= 0 i) (<= i position)))
    (==
      (get (idx (idx g u) position) 0)
      v)
    (==
      (get (idx (idx g u) position) 1)
      w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
  (decreases (- position i))
  (body
    (if (== i position)
        (assert
          (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
        (block
          (assert
            (!=
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v))
          (call weight_from_position
            g u v w position (+ i 1))
          (assert
            (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_weight_value
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((edge_position int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_position)
            (< edge_position (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 1) w))))
    (call weight_from_position
      g u v w edge_position 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma weight_from_nonnegative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
  (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) i))
  (body
    (if (== i (len (idx g u)))
        (assert
          (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
        (block
          (assert
            (has_edge
              g
              u
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
          (assert
            (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0))
          (if
            (==
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v)
            (assert
              (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
            (block
              (call weight_from_nonnegative
                g u v (+ i 1))
              (assert
                (>=
                  (weight_from (idx g u) v i)
                  0))))))))

(lemma path_prefix_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- k 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (take p k) i)
      (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_take p k i)
    (call law_idx_take p k (+ i 1))
    (assert
      (connected
        g
        (idx (take p k) i)
        (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k)))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_prefix_connection g p k i))
    (assert (is_path g (take p k)))))

(lemma prefix_step_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) (- k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p k))
          (get_edge_weight
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))))))

(lemma prefix_is_lighter
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p k))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (call path_prefix g p k)
    (if (== k (len p))
        (block
          (call law_take_all p)
          (assert (== (take p k) p)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call path_prefix g p (- (len p) 1))
          (call prefix_is_lighter
            g
            (take p (- (len p) 1))
            k)
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
          (obtain ((last_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))
              last_weight))
          (call weight_from_nonnegative
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            0)
          (assert
            (>=
              (get_edge_weight
                g
                (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              0))
          (assert
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight
                  g
                  (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                (get_edge_weight
                  g
                  (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              (path_weight g p)))))))

(lemma initial_frontier_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len ds) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (and
          (not (idx used v))
          (==
            (idx ds v)
            (if (== v start) (some 0) (none))))))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
  (body
    (assert (not (idx used start)))
    (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))))

(lemma initial_dijkstra_inv
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len ds) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (and
          (not (idx used v))
          (==
            (idx ds v)
            (if (== v start) (some 0) (none)))))))
  (ensures (dijkstra_inv g start ds used 0))
  (body
    (call no_true_count used)
    (call singleton_path g start)
    (assert (path_witness g start start 0))
    (assert (frontier_ok g start ds used))
    (assert (dijkstra_inv g start ds used 0))))

(lemma selected_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) du))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_bounded g p start)
    (assert (not (idx used u)))
    (if (not (idx used start))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
          (assert (<= du 0))
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p 1)
          (assert
            (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0))
          (assert (>= (path_weight g p) du)))
        (block
          (obtain ((k int))
            (and
              (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k))))))
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)))
          (obtain ((cross_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              cross_weight))
          (call edge_weight_value
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            cross_weight)
          (call path_prefix g p k)
          (call prefix_step_weight g p k)
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p (+ k 1))
          (match (idx ds (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none) (assert false))
            (case (some settled_prefix)
              (match (idx ds (idx p k))
                (case (none) (assert false))
                (case (some frontier_distance)
                  (block
                    (assert
                      (is_shortest_dist
                        g
                        start
                        (idx p (- k 1))
                        settled_prefix))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        settled_prefix
                        (path_weight g (take p k))))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        frontier_distance
                        (+ settled_prefix cross_weight)))
                    (assert (<= du frontier_distance))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        du
                        (path_weight
                          g
                          (take p (+ k 1)))))
                    (assert
                      (>= (path_weight g p) du)))))))))))

(lemma selected_is_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du))
  (ensures (is_shortest_dist g start u du))
  (body
    (assert (path_witness g start u du))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call selected_path_lower_bound
        g start ds used round u du p))
    (assert (is_shortest_dist g start u du))))

(lemma extend_path_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (len p))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
        (assert
          (connected
            g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)))))))

(lemma extend_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call extend_path_connection g p v i))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))))

(lemma extend_path_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (path_witness g start u du)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (path_witness g start v (+ du w)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) du)))
    (call edge_weight_value g u v w)
    (call extend_path g p v)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (path_witness g start v (+ du w)))))

(lemma relaxation_start
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (round int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (== (idx ds u) (some du)))
  (ensures
    (relaxation_inv
      g start ds ds used u du 0 round))
  (body
    (assert
      (relaxation_inv
        g start ds ds used u du 0 round))))

(lemma relaxation_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (j int)
    (round int))
  (requires

(lemma selected_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) du))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_bounded g p start)
    (assert (not (idx used u)))
    (if (not (idx used start))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
          (assert (<= du 0))
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p 1)
          (assert
            (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0))
          (assert (>= (path_weight g p) du)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call crossing_from used p 0)
          (obtain ((k int))
            (and
              (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k))))))
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)))
          (obtain ((cross_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              cross_weight))
          (call edge_weight_value
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            cross_weight)
          (call path_prefix g p k)
          (call prefix_step_weight g p k)
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p (+ k 1))
          (match (idx ds (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none) (assert false))
            (case (some settled_prefix)
              (match (idx ds (idx p k))
                (case (none) (assert false))
                (case (some frontier_distance)
                  (block
                    (assert
                      (is_shortest_dist
                        g
                        start
                        (idx p (- k 1))
                        settled_prefix))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        settled_prefix
                        (path_weight g (take p k))))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        frontier_distance
                        (+ settled_prefix cross_weight)))
                    (assert (<= du frontier_distance))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        du
                        (path_weight
                          g
                          (take p (+ k 1)))))
                    (assert
                      (>= (path_weight g p) du)))))))))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (view_well_formed (view graph)))
    (let-mut dist (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build n
        (fn (init_i)
          (if (== init_i start)
              (some 0)
              (none)))))
    (let-mut used (vec bool)
      (seq-build n
        (fn (used_i) false)))
    (call initial_dijkstra_inv
      (view graph) start dist used)
    (let-mut rounds i64 0)
    (while (< rounds n)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 rounds) (<= rounds n)))
      (invariant
        (dijkstra_inv
          (view graph) start dist used rounds))
      (decreases (- n rounds))
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut best_v i64 0)
      (let-mut best_d i64 0)
      (let-mut scan_i i64 0)
      (while (< scan_i n)
        (invariant
          (scan_inv
            dist used scan_i found best_v best_d))
        (decreases (- n scan_i))
        (if (idx used scan_i)

(lemma prefix_step_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) (- k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (assert
      (==

(lemma prefix_is_lighter
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p k))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (call path_prefix g p k)
    (if (== k (len p))
        (block
          (call law_take_all p)
          (assert (== (take p k) p)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call path_prefix g p (- (len p) 1))
          (call prefix_is_lighter
            g
            (take p (- (len p) 1))
            k)
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
          (obtain ((last_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))
              last_weight))
          (call weight_from_nonnegative
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            0)
          (assert
            (>=
              (get_edge_weight
                g
                (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              0))
          (assert
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight
                  g
                  (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                (get_edge_weight
                  g
                  (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              (path_weight g p)))))))

(lemma selected_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) du))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_bounded g p start)
    (assert (not (idx used u)))
    (if (not (idx used start))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
          (assert (<= du 0))
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p 1)
          (assert
            (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0))
          (assert (>= (path_weight g p) du)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call crossing_from used p 0)
          (obtain ((k int))
            (and
              (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k))))))
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)))
          (obtain ((cross_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              cross_weight))
          (call edge_weight_value
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            cross_weight)
          (call path_prefix g p k)
          (call prefix_step_weight g p k)
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p (+ k 1))
          (match (idx ds (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none) (assert false))
            (case (some settled_prefix)
              (match (idx ds (idx p k))
                (case (none) (assert false))
                (case (some frontier_distance)
                  (block
                    (assert
                      (is_shortest_dist
                        g
                        start
                        (idx p (- k 1))
                        settled_prefix))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        settled_prefix
                        (path_weight g (take p k))))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        frontier_distance
                        (+ settled_prefix cross_weight)))
                    (assert (<= du frontier_distance))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        du
                        (path_weight
                          g
                          (take p (+ k 1)))))
                    (assert
                      (>= (path_weight g p) du)))))))))))

    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p i))
      (< (idx p i) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p i))
            (< (idx p i) (len g))))
        (block
          (assert
            (connected g (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
          (obtain ((path_edge_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- i 1))
              (idx p i)
              path_edge_weight))
          (obtain ((edge_position int))
            (and
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (idx p (- i 1)))
                  (< (idx p (- i 1)) (len g)))
                (and
                  (<= 0 edge_position)
                  (< edge_position
                     (len (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))))))
              (and
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    0)
                  (idx p i))
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    1)
                  path_edge_weight))))
          (assert
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx p i))
              (< (idx p i) (len g))))))))

(lemma crossing_from
  (params
    (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int))
  (requires
    (> (len p) 1)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p k))
          (< (idx p k) (len used)))))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (len p) 1)))
    (idx used (idx p i))
    (not (idx used (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((k int))
      (and
        (and (< i k) (< k (len p)))
        (and
          (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
          (not (idx used (idx p k)))))))
  (decreases (- (len p) i))
  (body
    (if (not (idx used (idx p (+ i 1))))
        (assert
          (exists ((k int))
            (and
              (and (< i k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k)))))))
        (block
          (assert (< (+ i 1) (- (len p) 1)))
          (call crossing_from used p (+ i 1))
          (assert
            (exists ((k int))
              (and
                (and (< i k) (< k (len p)))
                (and
                  (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                  (not (idx used (idx p k))))))))))))

(lemma weight_from_position
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (position int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 position)
        (< position (len (idx g u))))
      (and (<= 0 i) (<= i position)))
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) position) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) position) 1) w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
  (decreases (- position i))
  (body
    (if (== i position)
        (assert
          (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
        (block
          (assert
            (!=
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v))
          (call weight_from_position
            g u v w position (+ i 1))
          (assert
            (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))))))

        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 0) v)

(lemma prefix_step_weight
  (params

      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) (- k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)

      (==

(lemma prefix_is_lighter
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p k))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (call path_prefix g p k)
    (if (== k (len p))
        (block
          (call law_take_all p)
          (assert (== (take p k) p)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call path_prefix g p (- (len p) 1))
          (call prefix_is_lighter
            g
            (take p (- (len p) 1))
            k)
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
          (obtain ((last_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))
              last_weight))
          (call weight_from_nonnegative
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            0)
          (assert
            (>=
              (get_edge_weight
                g
                (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              0))
          (assert
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight
                  g
                  (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                (get_edge_weight
                  g
                  (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              (path_weight g p)))))))

(lemma selected_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) du))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_bounded g p start)
    (assert (not (idx used u)))
    (if (not (idx used start))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
          (assert (<= du 0))
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p 1)
          (assert
            (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0))
          (assert (>= (path_weight g p) du)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call crossing_from used p 0)
          (obtain ((k int))
            (and
              (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k))))))
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)))
          (obtain ((cross_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              cross_weight))
          (call edge_weight_value
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            cross_weight)
          (call path_prefix g p k)
          (call prefix_step_weight g p k)
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p (+ k 1))
          (match (idx ds (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none) (assert false))
            (case (some settled_prefix)
              (match (idx ds (idx p k))
                (case (none) (assert false))
                (case (some frontier_distance)
                  (block
                    (assert
                      (is_shortest_dist
                        g
                        start
                        (idx p (- k 1))
                        settled_prefix))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        settled_prefix
                        (path_weight g (take p k))))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        frontier_distance
                        (+ settled_prefix cross_weight)))
                    (assert (<= du frontier_distance))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        du
                        (path_weight
                          g
                          (take p (+ k 1)))))
                    (assert
                      (>= (path_weight g p) du)))))))))))

(lemma selected_is_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int))
  (requires

    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du))
  (ensures (is_shortest_dist g start u du))
  (body
    (assert (path_witness g start u du))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call selected_path_lower_bound

    (assert (is_shortest_dist g start u du))))

(lemma extend_path_witness

                    g start v relaxed_distance))))
            (and
              (match (idx base v)
                (case (none) true)
                (case (some base_distance)
                  (match (idx after v)
                    (case (none) false)

                      (<= current_distance base_distance)))))
              (=>
                (idx used v)
                (== (idx after v) (idx base v)))))))
      (assert
        (and
          (match (idx after v)
            (case (none) true)
            (case (some relaxed_distance)

                (path_witness
                  g start v relaxed_distance))))
          (and
            (match (idx base v)

                  (case (none) false)

  (body
    (and
      (== (len ds) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx ds v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (is_path g p)
                    (and
                      (== (idx p 0) start)
                      (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  false)))
            (case (some answer_distance)
              (is_shortest_dist
                g start v answer_distance))))))))

(lemma true_count_bound
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (true_count s))
      (<= (true_count s) (len s))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (true_count s))
            (<= (true_count s) (len s))))
        (block
          (call true_count_bound
            (take s (- (len s) 1)))
          (assert
            (and
              (<= 0 (true_count s))
              (<= (true_count s) (len s))))))))

(lemma no_true_count
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (not (idx s i)))))
  (ensures (== (true_count s) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
        (assert (== (true_count s) 0))
        (block
          (call no_true_count
            (take s (- (len s) 1)))
          (assert (not (last s)))
          (assert (== (true_count s) 0))))))

(lemma full_true_count
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (== (true_count s) (len s)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (idx s i))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
        (assert
          (forall ((i int))
            (=>
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
              (idx s i))))
        (block
          (call true_count_bound
            (take s (- (len s) 1)))
          (assert (last s))
          (assert
            (==
              (true_count (take s (- (len s) 1)))
              (- (len s) 1)))
          (call full_true_count
            (take s (- (len s) 1)))
          (assert
            (forall ((i int))
              (=>
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
                (idx s i))))))))

(lemma mark_count
  (params
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (at int))
  (requires
    (== (len before) (len after))
    (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before)))
    (not (idx before at))
    (idx after at)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before)))
          (!= k at))
        (== (idx after k) (idx before k)))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (true_count after)
      (+ (true_count before) 1)))
  (decreases (len before))
  (body
    (if (== at (- (len before) 1))
        (block
          (assert
            (==
              (take before (- (len before) 1))
              (take after (- (len after) 1))))
          (assert (not (last before)))
          (assert (last after))
          (assert
            (==
              (true_count after)
              (+ (true_count before) 1))))
        (block
          (assert (< at (- (len before) 1)))
          (assert (== (last after) (last before)))
          (call mark_count
            (take before (- (len before) 1))
            (take after (- (len after) 1))
            at)
          (assert
            (==
              (true_count after)
              (+ (true_count before) 1)))))))

(lemma path_vertex_bounded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p i))
      (< (idx p i) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p i))
            (< (idx p i) (len g))))
        (block
          (assert
            (connected g (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
          (obtain ((path_edge_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- i 1))
              (idx p i)
              path_edge_weight))
          (obtain ((edge_position int))
            (and
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (idx p (- i 1)))
                  (< (idx p (- i 1)) (len g)))
                (and
                  (<= 0 edge_position)
                  (< edge_position
                     (len (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))))))
              (and
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    0)
                  (idx p i))
                (==
                  (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- i 1)))
                      edge_position)
                    1)
                  path_edge_weight))))
          (assert
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx p i))
              (< (idx p i) (len g))))))))

(lemma path_vertices_bounded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (start int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p i))
          (< (idx p i) (len g))))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_vertex_bounded g p start i))))

(lemma crossing_from
  (params
    (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int))
  (requires
    (> (len p) 1)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p k))
          (< (idx p k) (len used)))))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (len p) 1)))
    (idx used (idx p i))
    (not (idx used (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((k int))
      (and
        (and (< i k) (< k (len p)))
        (and
          (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
          (not (idx used (idx p k)))))))
  (decreases (- (len p) i))
  (body
    (if (not (idx used (idx p (+ i 1))))
        (assert
          (exists ((k int))
            (and
              (and (< i k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k)))))))
        (block
          (assert (< (+ i 1) (- (len p) 1)))
          (call crossing_from used p (+ i 1))
          (assert
            (exists ((k int))
              (and
                (and (< i k) (< k (len p)))
                (and
                  (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                  (not (idx used (idx p k))))))))))))

(lemma weight_from_position
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (position int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 position)
        (< position (len (idx g u))))
      (and (<= 0 i) (<= i position)))
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) position) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) position) 1) w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
  (decreases (- position i))
  (body
    (if (== i position)
        (assert
          (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))
        (block
          (assert
            (!=
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v))
          (call weight_from_position
            g u v w position (+ i 1))
          (assert
            (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_weight_value
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((edge_position int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_position)
            (< edge_position (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 1) w))))
    (call weight_from_position
      g u v w edge_position 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma weight_from_nonnegative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
  (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) i))
  (body
    (if (== i (len (idx g u)))
        (assert
          (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
        (block
          (assert
            (has_edge
              g
              u
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
          (assert
            (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0))
          (if
            (==
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              v)
            (assert
              (>= (weight_from (idx g u) v i) 0))
            (block
              (call weight_from_nonnegative
                g u v (+ i 1))
              (assert
                (>=
                  (weight_from (idx g u) v i)
                  0))))))))

(lemma path_prefix_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- k 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (take p k) i)
      (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_take p k i)
    (call law_idx_take p k (+ i 1))
    (assert
      (connected
        g
        (idx (take p k) i)
        (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k)))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (forall ((i int))
      (call path_prefix_connection g p k i))
    (assert (is_path g (take p k)))))

(lemma prefix_step_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) (- k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p k))
          (get_edge_weight
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))))))

(lemma prefix_is_lighter
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k))
    (<=
      (path_weight g (take p k))
      (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (call path_prefix g p k)
    (if (== k (len p))
        (block
          (call law_take_all p)
          (assert (== (take p k) p)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call path_prefix g p (- (len p) 1))
          (call prefix_is_lighter
            g
            (take p (- (len p) 1))
            k)
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
          (obtain ((last_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- (len p) 2))
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))
              last_weight))
          (call weight_from_nonnegative
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            0)
          (assert
            (>=
              (get_edge_weight
                g
                (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              0))
          (assert
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight
                  g
                  (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                (get_edge_weight
                  g
                  (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
          (assert
            (<=
              (path_weight g (take p k))
              (path_weight g p)))))))

(lemma initial_dijkstra_inv
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len ds) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (and
          (not (idx used v))
          (==
            (idx ds v)
            (if (== v start) (some 0) (none)))))))
  (ensures (dijkstra_inv g start ds used 0))
  (body
    (call no_true_count used)
    (call singleton_path g start)
    (assert (path_witness g start start 0))
    (assert (frontier_ok g start ds used))
    (assert (dijkstra_inv g start ds used 0))))

(lemma selected_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) du))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_bounded g p start)
    (assert (not (idx used u)))
    (if (not (idx used start))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx ds start) (some 0)))
          (assert (<= du 0))
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p 1)
          (assert
            (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0))
          (assert (>= (path_weight g p) du)))
        (block
          (assert (> (len p) 1))
          (call crossing_from used p 0)
          (obtain ((k int))
            (and
              (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p)))
              (and
                (idx used (idx p (- k 1)))
                (not (idx used (idx p k))))))
          (assert
            (connected
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)))
          (obtain ((cross_weight int))
            (has_edge
              g
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              cross_weight))
          (call edge_weight_value
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            cross_weight)
          (call path_prefix g p k)
          (call prefix_step_weight g p k)
          (call prefix_is_lighter g p (+ k 1))
          (match (idx ds (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none) (assert false))
            (case (some settled_prefix)
              (match (idx ds (idx p k))
                (case (none) (assert false))
                (case (some frontier_distance)
                  (block
                    (assert
                      (is_shortest_dist
                        g
                        start
                        (idx p (- k 1))
                        settled_prefix))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        settled_prefix
                        (path_weight g (take p k))))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        frontier_distance
                        (+ settled_prefix cross_weight)))
                    (assert (<= du frontier_distance))
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        du
                        (path_weight
                          g
                          (take p (+ k 1)))))
                    (assert
                      (>= (path_weight g p) du)))))))))))

(lemma selected_is_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (ds (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (round int)
    (u int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start ds used round)
    (scan_inv ds used (len g) true u du))
  (ensures (is_shortest_dist g start u du))
  (body
    (assert (path_witness g start u du))
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call selected_path_lower_bound
        g start ds used round u du p))
    (assert (is_shortest_dist g start u du))))

  (params

(lemma extend_path_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (view_well_formed g)
    (path_witness g start u du)

  (ensures
    (path_witness g start v (+ du w)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) du)))

    (call extend_path g p v)

          (concat p (seq-lit v))

        v))

        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))

    (assert

  (params

(lemma relaxation_change_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (base (seq (option int)))
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int)
    (j int)
    (round int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (relaxation_inv
      g start base before used u du j round)
    (< j (len (idx g u)))
    (not
      (idx used
        (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))
    (one_option_change
      before
      after
      (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
      (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))

(def bfs
  (body

    (assert (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (== (idx st0 x) -1))))
    (assert (forall ((x int)) (not (mem st0 x))))
    (call cnt_none st0 n)
    (set-idx st s 0)
    (assert (upd1 st0 st s 0))
    (call cnt_upd st0 st s 0 n)
    (push qu s)
    (assert (and (== (len qu) 1) (== (idx qu 0) s)))
    (assert (tree_ok r st pr s n))
    (assert (q_ok st qu n 1))
    (assert (closed_upto r st n 0))
    (let-mut qh i64 0)
    (let-mut qt i64 1)
    (while (< qh qt)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 qh) (<= qh qt)))
      (invariant (<= qt n))
      (invariant (tree_ok r st pr s n))
      (invariant (q_ok st qu n qt))
      (invariant (closed_upto r st n qh))
      (decreases (- n qh))
      (let u i64 (idx qu qh))
      (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
      (assert (== (idx st u) qh))
      (let-mut v i64 0)
      (while (< v n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 qh) (< qh qt)))
        (invariant (<= qt n))
        (invariant (tree_ok r st pr s n))
        (invariant (q_ok st qu n qt))
        (invariant (closed_upto r st n qh))
        (invariant (== (idx st u) qh))
        (invariant (row_done r st u v))
        (decreases (- n v))
        (assert (== (get_flow r u v) (idx (idx r u) v)))
        (if (and (< (idx st v) 0) (> (idx (idx r u) v) 0))
          (block
            (ghost-let st_a (seq int) st)
            (ghost-let pr_a (seq int) pr)
            (ghost-let qu_a (seq int) qu)
            (set-idx st v qt)
            (set-idx pr v u)
            (push qu v)
            (assert (upd1 st_a st v qt))
            (assert (upd1 pr_a pr v u))
            (assert (qpush qu_a qu v))
            (call disc_tree r st_a st pr_a pr s n v u qt)
            (call disc_q st_a st qu_a qu n v qt)
            (call closed_grow r st_a st n qh v qt)
            (call row_grow r st_a st u v qt)
            (assert (!= u v))
            (assert (== (idx st u) qh))
            (set qt (+ qt 1)))
          (block
            (assert (=> (> (get_flow r u v) 0) (mem st v)))
            (call row_skip r st u v)))
        (set v (+ v 1)))
      (call closed_next r st qu n qh qt u)
      (set qh (+ qh 1)))
    (assert (== qh qt))
    (call closed_end r st qu n qt)
    (return st pr)))

          (block
            (let ((o3 (vec i64)) (q3 (vec i64)) (p3 (vec i64)) (e3 (vec i64)))

            (set par p3)

            (call done_fwd_mono ga f oprev2 ord u du)
            (call done_back_mono f oprev2 ord u w))

(lemma edge_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int)) (s int) (x int) (lim int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (y int))
  (requires (edges_below g f o par pe s lim) (tree_ok o par s) (differs f f2 a b d)
            (== (len par) (len o)) (== (len pe) (len o))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (== lim (idx o x))
            (or (and (== a (idx par x)) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b (idx par x))))

  (ensures (edge_ok g f2 (idx par y) y (idx pe y)))

    (call tree_at o par s y)

    (assert (!= y x))

(lemma walk_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (x int) (val int) (p int) (e int) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (== (len o) (len g)) (== (len par) (len g)) (== (len pe) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (!= x s) (>= (idx o x) 0)
            (walk_inv g f o par pe s t x val (idx o x))
            (tree_ok o par s)
            (== p (idx par x)) (== e (idx pe x))
            (mat f2 (len g)) (differs f f2 a b d)
            (or (and (>= e 0) (and (== a p) (and (== b x) (== d 1))))
                (and (< e 0) (and (== a x) (and (== b p) (== d -1))))))
  (ensures (walk_inv g f2 o par pe s t p val (idx o p)))
  (body
    (call tree_at o par s x)
    (assert (flow_like g f))
    (assert (edges_below g f o par pe s (idx o x)))
    (assert (edge_ok g f p x e))
    (if (>= e 0)
      (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call like_fwd_at g f f2 p x e u v))
      (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call like_bwd_at g f f2 p x e u v)))
    (assert (flow_like g f2))
    (forall ((u int)) (call bal_at g f f2 a b d u))

    (assert (walk_bal g f2 s t p))
    (forall ((y int)) (call edge_keep g f f2 o par pe s x (idx o x) a b d y))
    (assert (edges_below g f2 o par pe s (idx o p)))))

    (assert (not (vis o0 s)))

    (assert (vis o s))
