  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (and (<= 0 (get_flow f x y)) (<= (get_flow f x y) 100000)))))
(ghost-fn gf_rel ((f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (== (get_flow f2 x y) (+ (get_flow f1 x y) (if (and (== x a) (== y b)) d 0))))))
(ghost-fn delta ((f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (square f1 n) (square f2 n))
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i n)) (and (<= 0 j) (< j n)))
          (== (idx (idx f2 i) j) (+ (idx (idx f1 i) j) (if (and (== i a) (== j b)) d 0))))))))
(ghost-fn untouched ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (k int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len pos) n) (and (and (square f0 n) (square fl n))
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
               (and (<= (idx pos a) k) (<= (idx pos b) k)))
          (== (idx (idx fl a) b) (idx (idx f0 a) b))))))))
(ghost-fn path_ok ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len pos) n) (== (len par) n))
    (and (forall ((a int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (== (idx pos a) 0)) (== a s)))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (> (idx pos v) 0))
            (and (and (<= 0 (idx par v)) (< (idx par v) n))
              (and (>= (idx pos (idx par v)) 0)
                (and (< (idx pos (idx par v)) (idx pos v))
                  (res cap f (idx par v) v))))))))))
(ghost-fn bfs_core ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (s int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len pos) n) (== (len par) n))
    (and (and (> (len queue) 0) (== (idx queue 0) s))
      (and (forall ((i int))
             (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len queue)))
                 (and (and (<= 0 (idx queue i)) (< (idx queue i) n)) (== (idx pos (idx queue i)) i))))
        (and (forall ((a int))
               (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (>= (idx pos a) 0))
                   (and (< (idx pos a) (len queue)) (== (idx queue (idx pos a)) a))))
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (> (idx pos v) 0))
                (and (and (<= 0 (idx par v)) (< (idx par v) n))
                  (and (>= (idx pos (idx par v)) 0)
                    (and (< (idx pos (idx par v)) (idx pos v))
                      (res cap f (idx par v) v))))))))))))
(ghost-fn proc_closed ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (k int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (and (vis pos a) (and (< (idx pos a) k) (res cap f a b))))
        (vis pos b)))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((p (seq int)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (cnt p (- m 1)) (if (vis p (- m 1)) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn adj_member ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int)) bool (decreases k)
  (body (if (or (<= k 0) (or (< u 0) (>= u (len g)))) false
    (if (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u)))
      (or (adj_member g u (- k 1) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v))
      (adj_member g u (- k 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn masksum ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0
    (+ (masksum g f u k (- m 1)) (if (adj_member g u k (- m 1)) (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn w_in ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (if (vis p v) (get_flow f u v) 0)))
(ghost-fn rw ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (rw f p u (- b 1)) (w_in f p u (- b 1))))))
(ghost-fn cl ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (a int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (cl f p v (- a 1)) (w_in f p (- a 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn dr ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (dr f p (- a 1) b) (rw f p (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn dc ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (dc f p a (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) a)))))
(ghost-fn asum ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (asum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (rowsum f (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn bsum ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (bsum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (colsum f (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn wt ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (- (if (vis p u) (get_flow f u v) 0) (w_in f p u v))))
(ghost-fn rowt ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (rowt f p u (- b 1)) (wt f p u (- b 1))))))
(ghost-fn tott ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (tott f p (- a 1) n) (rowt f p (- a 1) n)))))
(ghost-fn cut_hyp ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int)) bool
  (body (and (and (wf_g g) (cap_rel g cap))
    (and (and (mat_ok cap f (len g)) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
        (and (!= s t) (and (vis p s) (and (not (vis p t)) (closed cap f p (len g))))))))))

(lemma cnt_le (params (p (seq int)) (m int)) (requires (>= m 0)) (ensures (<= (cnt p m) m)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call cnt_le p (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma cnt_zero (params (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((u int)) (not (vis p u))))
  (ensures (== (cnt p m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call cnt_zero p (- m 1)) (assert (not (vis p (- m 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma cnt_mark (params (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (not (vis p1 x)) (vis p2 x) (forall ((u int)) (=> (!= u x) (== (vis p2 u) (vis p1 u)))))
  (ensures (== (cnt p2 m) (+ (cnt p1 m) (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x m)) 1 0)))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call cnt_mark p1 p2 x (- m 1))
      (if (!= (- m 1) x) (assert (== (vis p2 (- m 1)) (vis p1 (- m 1)))) (block)))
    (block))))

(lemma hc_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma cap_get (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (rows_done g cap (len g)) (has_capacity g x y z))
  (ensures (== (get_flow cap x y) z))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) z))))
    (assert (== (get_flow cap x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))

(lemma member_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (< i (- k 1)) (call member_intro g u i (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma member_absent (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v))))
  (ensures (not (adj_member g u k v))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call member_absent g u (- k 1) v) (block))))
(lemma fresh_target (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (not (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (body
    (assert (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
      (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)))))
    (call member_absent g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
(lemma edge_member (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (call member_intro g u i (len (idx g u)))))
(lemma masksum_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0)) (ensures (== (masksum g f u 0 m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call masksum_zero g f u (- m 1)) (assert (not (adj_member g u 0 (- m 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma masksum_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0)
    (not (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (ensures (== (masksum g f u (+ k 1) m)
    (+ (masksum g f u k m)
       (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) m))
         (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call masksum_step g f u k (- m 1))
      (assert (== (adj_member g u (+ k 1) (- m 1))
        (or (adj_member g u k (- m 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (- m 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma sum_mask (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) (masksum g f u k (len g)))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call sum_mask g f u (- k 1))
      (call fresh_target g u (- k 1))
      (call masksum_step g f u (- k 1) (len g))
      (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g))))
      (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)
        (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))))
    (call masksum_zero g f u (len g)))))
(lemma mask_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g)))
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
      (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (masksum g f u (len (idx g u)) m) (rowsum f u m))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call mask_row g f u (- m 1))
      (assert (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1)) (== (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma edge_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))
  (body (if (> (get_flow f u v) 0)
    (block
      (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))))
      (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
      (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
      (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))
      (call edge_member g u v c))
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
(lemma in_col (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k) (colsum f u k))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call in_col g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma net_e (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures
    (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rowsum f u (len g)))
    (== (total_flow_in g f u) (colsum f u (len g)))
    (== (- (total_flow_out g f u) (total_flow_in g f u)) (net f u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call edge_zero g f u v))
    (call mask_row g f u (len g))
    (call sum_mask g f u (len (idx g u)))
    (call in_col g f u (len g))))

(lemma dc_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0)) (ensures (== (dc f p 0 b) 0)) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (call dc_zero f p (- b 1)) (assert (== (cl f p (- b 1) 0) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma dc_step (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f p (+ a 1) b) (+ (dc f p a b) (rw f p a b)))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call dc_step f p a (- b 1))
      (assert (== (dc f p (+ a 1) b) (+ (dc f p (+ a 1) (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) (+ a 1)))))
      (assert (== (cl f p (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (cl f p (- b 1) a) (w_in f p a (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (rw f p a b) (+ (rw f p a (- b 1)) (w_in f p a (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (dc f p a b) (+ (dc f p a (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) a)))))
    (block))))
(lemma swap_sum (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dr f p a b) (dc f p a b))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call swap_sum f p (- a 1) b)
      (call dc_step f p (- a 1) b)
      (assert (== (dr f p a b) (+ (dr f p (- a 1) b) (rw f p (- a 1) b)))))
    (call dc_zero f p b))))
(lemma cl_col (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (cl f p v a) (if (vis p v) (colsum f v a) 0))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call cl_col f p v (- a 1))
      (assert (== (w_in f p (- a 1) v) (if (vis p v) (get_flow f (- a 1) v) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma dc_bsum (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (b int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f p n b) (bsum f p b n))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (call dc_bsum f p n (- b 1)) (call cl_col f p (- b 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma rowt_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt f p u b) (- (if (vis p u) (rowsum f u b) 0) (rw f p u b)))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_eq f p u (- b 1))
      (assert (== (wt f p u (- b 1))
        (- (if (vis p u) (get_flow f u (- b 1)) 0) (w_in f p u (- b 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma tott_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tott f p a n) (- (asum f p a n) (dr f p a n)))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call tott_eq f p (- a 1) n) (call rowt_eq f p (- a 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma total_identity (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tott f p n n) (- (asum f p n n) (bsum f p n n))))
  (body (call tott_eq f p n n) (call swap_sum f p n n) (call dc_bsum f p n n)))
(lemma ab_net (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (mat_cons f s t n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (!= s t) (vis p s) (not (vis p t)))
  (ensures (== (- (asum f p a n) (bsum f p a n)) (if (< s a) (net f s n) 0))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call ab_net f p s t n (- a 1))
      (assert (== (asum f p a n) (+ (asum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (rowsum f (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (bsum f p a n) (+ (bsum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (colsum f (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (net f s n) (- (rowsum f s n) (colsum f s n))))
      (if (and (!= (- a 1) s) (!= (- a 1) t))
        (assert (== (net f (- a 1) n) 0))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma val_tw (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
    (!= s t) (vis p s) (not (vis p t)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (tott h p (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (nonneg_f h))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (forall ((u int)) (call net_e g h u))
    (assert (mat_cons h s t (len g)))
    (call net_e g h s)
    (call ab_net h p s t (len g) (len g))
    (call total_identity h p (len g))
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (net h s (len g))))))
(lemma rowt_mono (params (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0) (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v b)) (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))))
  (ensures (<= (rowt h p u b) (rowt f p u b))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_mono f h p u (- b 1))
      (assert (<= (wt h p u (- b 1)) (wt f p u (- b 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma tott_mono (params (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0)
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u a)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))))
  (ensures (<= (tott h p a n) (tott f p a n))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call tott_mono f h p (- a 1) n) (call rowt_mono f h p (- a 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma wt_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cut_hyp g cap f p s t) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_f h)
    (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))))
  (ensures (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))
  (body
    (assert (>= (get_flow h u v) 0))
    (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) 0))
    (if (and (vis p u) (not (vis p v)))
      (block
        (assert (not (res cap f u v)))
        (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
          (block
            (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))))
            (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u)))))
            (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))
            (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
            (assert (== (get_flow cap u v) c)))
          (block)))
      (if (and (not (vis p u)) (vis p v))
        (assert (not (res cap f v u)))
        (block)))))
(lemma le_other (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cut_hyp g cap f p s t) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g h s)))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (nonneg_f h))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call wt_mono g cap f h p s t u v))

    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))))
        (or (== (get_flow cap x y) 0) (has_capacity g x y (get_flow cap x y)))))))
(ghost-fn cap_rel ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (and (square cap (len g)) (and (cap_sound g cap)
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (c int)) (=> (has_capacity g u v c) (== (get_flow cap u v) c)))))))
(ghost-fn cap_bnd ((cap (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (and (<= 0 (get_flow cap x y)) (<= (get_flow cap x y) 100000)))))
(ghost-fn rows_done ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (m int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (j int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x m)) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
        (== (get_flow cap x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))))
(ghost-fn nonneg_f ((f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
        (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn zero_f ((f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (== (get_flow f x y) 0))))
(ghost-fn flow_bnd ((f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (and (<= 0 (get_flow f x y)) (<= (get_flow f x y) 100000)))))
(ghost-fn gf_rel ((f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (== (get_flow f2 x y) (+ (get_flow f1 x y) (if (and (== x a) (== y b)) d 0))))))
(ghost-fn delta ((f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (square f1 n) (square f2 n))
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i n)) (and (<= 0 j) (< j n)))
          (== (idx (idx f2 i) j) (+ (idx (idx f1 i) j) (if (and (== i a) (== j b)) d 0))))))))
(ghost-fn untouched ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (k int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len pos) n) (and (and (square f0 n) (square fl n))
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
               (and (<= (idx pos a) k) (<= (idx pos b) k)))
          (== (idx (idx fl a) b) (idx (idx f0 a) b))))))))
(ghost-fn path_ok ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len pos) n) (== (len par) n))
    (and (forall ((a int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (== (idx pos a) 0)) (== a s)))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (> (idx pos v) 0))
            (and (and (<= 0 (idx par v)) (< (idx par v) n))
              (and (>= (idx pos (idx par v)) 0)
                (and (< (idx pos (idx par v)) (idx pos v))
                  (res cap f (idx par v) v))))))))))
(ghost-fn bfs_core ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (s int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len pos) n) (== (len par) n))
    (and (and (> (len queue) 0) (== (idx queue 0) s))
      (and (forall ((i int))
             (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len queue)))
                 (and (and (<= 0 (idx queue i)) (< (idx queue i) n)) (== (idx pos (idx queue i)) i))))
        (and (forall ((a int))
               (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (>= (idx pos a) 0))
                   (and (< (idx pos a) (len queue)) (== (idx queue (idx pos a)) a))))
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (> (idx pos v) 0))
                (and (and (<= 0 (idx par v)) (< (idx par v) n))
                  (and (>= (idx pos (idx par v)) 0)
                    (and (< (idx pos (idx par v)) (idx pos v))
                      (res cap f (idx par v) v))))))))))))
(ghost-fn proc_closed ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (k int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (and (vis pos a) (and (< (idx pos a) k) (res cap f a b))))
        (vis pos b)))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((p (seq int)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (cnt p (- m 1)) (if (vis p (- m 1)) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn adj_member ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int)) bool (decreases k)
  (body (if (or (<= k 0) (or (< u 0) (>= u (len g)))) false
    (if (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u)))
      (or (adj_member g u (- k 1) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v))
      (adj_member g u (- k 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn masksum ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0
    (+ (masksum g f u k (- m 1)) (if (adj_member g u k (- m 1)) (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn w_in ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (if (vis p v) (get_flow f u v) 0)))
(ghost-fn rw ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (rw f p u (- b 1)) (w_in f p u (- b 1))))))
(ghost-fn cl ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (a int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (cl f p v (- a 1)) (w_in f p (- a 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn dr ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (dr f p (- a 1) b) (rw f p (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn dc ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (dc f p a (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) a)))))
(ghost-fn asum ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (asum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (rowsum f (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn bsum ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (bsum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (colsum f (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn wt ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (- (if (vis p u) (get_flow f u v) 0) (w_in f p u v))))
(ghost-fn rowt ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (rowt f p u (- b 1)) (wt f p u (- b 1))))))
(ghost-fn tott ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (tott f p (- a 1) n) (rowt f p (- a 1) n)))))
(ghost-fn cut_hyp ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int)) bool
  (body (and (and (wf_g g) (cap_rel g cap))
    (and (and (mat_ok cap f (len g)) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
        (and (!= s t) (and (vis p s) (and (not (vis p t)) (closed cap f p (len g))))))))))

(lemma cnt_le (params (p (seq int)) (m int)) (requires (>= m 0)) (ensures (<= (cnt p m) m)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call cnt_le p (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma cnt_zero (params (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((u int)) (not (vis p u))))
  (ensures (== (cnt p m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call cnt_zero p (- m 1)) (assert (not (vis p (- m 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma cnt_mark (params (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (not (vis p1 x)) (vis p2 x) (forall ((u int)) (=> (!= u x) (== (vis p2 u) (vis p1 u)))))
  (ensures (== (cnt p2 m) (+ (cnt p1 m) (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x m)) 1 0)))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call cnt_mark p1 p2 x (- m 1))
      (if (!= (- m 1) x) (assert (== (vis p2 (- m 1)) (vis p1 (- m 1)))) (block)))
    (block))))

(lemma hc_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma cap_get (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (rows_done g cap (len g)) (has_capacity g x y z))
  (ensures (== (get_flow cap x y) z))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) z))))
    (assert (== (get_flow cap x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))

(lemma member_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (< i (- k 1)) (call member_intro g u i (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma member_absent (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v))))
  (ensures (not (adj_member g u k v))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call member_absent g u (- k 1) v) (block))))
(lemma fresh_target (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (not (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (body
    (assert (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
      (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)))))
    (call member_absent g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
(lemma edge_member (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (call member_intro g u i (len (idx g u)))))
(lemma masksum_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0)) (ensures (== (masksum g f u 0 m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call masksum_zero g f u (- m 1)) (assert (not (adj_member g u 0 (- m 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma masksum_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0)
    (not (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (ensures (== (masksum g f u (+ k 1) m)
    (+ (masksum g f u k m)
       (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) m))
         (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call masksum_step g f u k (- m 1))
      (assert (== (adj_member g u (+ k 1) (- m 1))
        (or (adj_member g u k (- m 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (- m 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma sum_mask (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) (masksum g f u k (len g)))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call sum_mask g f u (- k 1))
      (call fresh_target g u (- k 1))
      (call masksum_step g f u (- k 1) (len g))
      (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g))))
      (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)
        (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))))
    (call masksum_zero g f u (len g)))))
(lemma mask_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g)))
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
      (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (masksum g f u (len (idx g u)) m) (rowsum f u m))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call mask_row g f u (- m 1))
      (assert (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1)) (== (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma edge_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))
  (body (if (> (get_flow f u v) 0)
    (block
      (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))))
      (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
      (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
      (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))
      (call edge_member g u v c))
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
(lemma in_col (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k) (colsum f u k))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call in_col g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma net_e (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures
    (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rowsum f u (len g)))
    (== (total_flow_in g f u) (colsum f u (len g)))
    (== (- (total_flow_out g f u) (total_flow_in g f u)) (net f u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call edge_zero g f u v))
    (call mask_row g f u (len g))
    (call sum_mask g f u (len (idx g u)))
    (call in_col g f u (len g))))

(lemma dc_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0)) (ensures (== (dc f p 0 b) 0)) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (call dc_zero f p (- b 1)) (assert (== (cl f p (- b 1) 0) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma dc_step (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f p (+ a 1) b) (+ (dc f p a b) (rw f p a b)))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call dc_step f p a (- b 1))
      (assert (== (dc f p (+ a 1) b) (+ (dc f p (+ a 1) (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) (+ a 1)))))
      (assert (== (cl f p (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (cl f p (- b 1) a) (w_in f p a (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (rw f p a b) (+ (rw f p a (- b 1)) (w_in f p a (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (dc f p a b) (+ (dc f p a (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) a)))))
    (block))))
(lemma swap_sum (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dr f p a b) (dc f p a b))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call swap_sum f p (- a 1) b)
      (call dc_step f p (- a 1) b)
      (assert (== (dr f p a b) (+ (dr f p (- a 1) b) (rw f p (- a 1) b)))))
    (call dc_zero f p b))))
(lemma cl_col (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (cl f p v a) (if (vis p v) (colsum f v a) 0))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call cl_col f p v (- a 1))
      (assert (== (w_in f p (- a 1) v) (if (vis p v) (get_flow f (- a 1) v) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma dc_bsum (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (b int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f p n b) (bsum f p b n))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (call dc_bsum f p n (- b 1)) (call cl_col f p (- b 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma rowt_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt f p u b) (- (if (vis p u) (rowsum f u b) 0) (rw f p u b)))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_eq f p u (- b 1))
      (assert (== (wt f p u (- b 1))
        (- (if (vis p u) (get_flow f u (- b 1)) 0) (w_in f p u (- b 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma tott_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tott f p a n) (- (asum f p a n) (dr f p a n)))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call tott_eq f p (- a 1) n) (call rowt_eq f p (- a 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma total_identity (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tott f p n n) (- (asum f p n n) (bsum f p n n))))
  (body (call tott_eq f p n n) (call swap_sum f p n n) (call dc_bsum f p n n)))
(lemma ab_net (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (mat_cons f s t n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (!= s t) (vis p s) (not (vis p t)))
  (ensures (== (- (asum f p a n) (bsum f p a n)) (if (< s a) (net f s n) 0))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call ab_net f p s t n (- a 1))
      (assert (== (asum f p a n) (+ (asum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (rowsum f (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (bsum f p a n) (+ (bsum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (colsum f (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (net f s n) (- (rowsum f s n) (colsum f s n))))
      (if (and (!= (- a 1) s) (!= (- a 1) t))
        (assert (== (net f (- a 1) n) 0))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma val_tw (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
    (!= s t) (vis p s) (not (vis p t)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (tott h p (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (nonneg_f h))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (forall ((u int)) (call net_e g h u))
    (assert (mat_cons h s t (len g)))
    (call net_e g h s)
    (call ab_net h p s t (len g) (len g))
    (call total_identity h p (len g))
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (net h s (len g))))))
(lemma rowt_mono (params (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0) (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v b)) (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))))
  (ensures (<= (rowt h p u b) (rowt f p u b))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_mono f h p u (- b 1))
      (assert (<= (wt h p u (- b 1)) (wt f p u (- b 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma tott_mono (params (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0)
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u a)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))))
  (ensures (<= (tott h p a n) (tott f p a n))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call tott_mono f h p (- a 1) n) (call rowt_mono f h p (- a 1) n))
    (block))))

  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (>= (idx o x) 0))))
(ghost-fn vis_mono ((o (seq int)) (o2 (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (vis o y) (vis o2 y)))))
(ghost-fn updated ((o (seq int)) (o2 (seq int)) (x int) (kv int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o)))
        (and (== (len o2) (len o))
        (and (== (idx o2 x) kv)
             (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (!= y x)) (== (idx o2 y) (idx o y)))))))))
(ghost-fn all_neg ((o (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (< (idx o y) 0)))))
(ghost-fn vcount ((o (seq int)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (vcount o (- m 1)) (if (vis o (- m 1)) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn edge_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p int) (x int) (e int)) bool
  (body (if (>= e 0)
    (and (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g)))
    (and (< e (len (idx g p)))
    (and (== (get (idx (idx g p) e) 0) x)
         (< (get_flow f p x) (get (idx (idx g p) e) 1)))))
    (> (get_flow f x p) 0))))
(ghost-fn tree_ok ((o (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (and (vis o s)
    (forall ((y int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len par)) (and (!= y s) (>= (idx o y) 0))))
          (and (and (<= 0 (idx par y)) (< (idx par y) (len o)))
               (and (>= (idx o (idx par y)) 0) (< (idx o (idx par y)) (idx o y)))))))))
(ghost-fn edges_all ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len par)) (< y (len pe))))
             (and (!= y s) (>= (idx o y) 0)))
        (edge_ok g f (idx par y) y (idx pe y))))))
(ghost-fn edges_below ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int)) (s int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len par)) (< y (len pe))))
             (and (!= y s) (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (<= (idx o y) lim))))
        (edge_ok g f (idx par y) y (idx pe y))))))
(ghost-fn done_fwd ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((i int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (or (vis o (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
            (>= (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn done_back ((f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w k)) (not (vis o w))) (<= (get_flow f w u) 0)))))
(ghost-fn done_node ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (done_fwd g f o u (len (idx g u))) (done_back f o u (len g))))))
(ghost-fn cut_closed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int)) (=> (vis o u) (done_node g f o u)))))
(ghost-fn q_ok ((o (seq int)) (q (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (idx q k)) (< (idx q k) (len o))) (== (idx o (idx q k)) k))))))
(ghost-fn o_ok ((o (seq int)) (q (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (>= (idx o y) 0))
        (and (< (idx o y) (len q)) (== (idx q (idx o y)) y))))))
(ghost-fn processed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (head int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (< (idx o y) head)))
        (done_node g f o y)))))
(ghost-fn bfs_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int)) (s int) (head int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len o) (len g))
        (and (== (len par) (len g))
        (and (== (len pe) (len g))
        (and (and (<= 0 head) (<= head (len q)))
        (and (q_ok o q)
        (and (o_ok o q)
        (and (tree_ok o par s)
        (and (edges_all g f o par pe s)
        (and (== (len q) (vcount o (len o)))
        (and (<= (len q) (len o))
             (processed g f o head)))))))))))))
(ghost-fn walk_bal ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
        (== (bal g f u) (if (== u x) -1 0))))))
(ghost-fn walk_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (x int) (val int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (and (mat f (len g))
        (and (flow_like g f)
        (and (walk_bal g f s t x)
        (and (== (bal g f s) (- (if (== x s) -1 0) val))
             (edges_below g f o par pe s lim)))))))
(ghost-fn tin ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int)) bool
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (requires (<= k (len (idx g u))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) false
          (or (tin g u (- k 1) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v)))))
(ghost-fn rest ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int)) int
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (requires (<= k (len (idx g u))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0
          (+ (rest g h u k (- m 1)) (if (tin g u k (- m 1)) 0 (get_flow h u (- m 1)))))))
(ghost-fn cross ((h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (- (if (vis o u) (get_flow h u v) 0) (if (vis o v) (get_flow h u v) 0))))
(ghost-fn xrow ((h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (xrow h o u (- b 1)) (cross h o u (- b 1))))))
(ghost-fn xall ((h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (xall h o (- a 1) b) (xrow h o (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn yrow ((h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (yrow h o u (- b 1)) (if (vis o (- b 1)) (get_flow h u (- b 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn rs ((h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (rs h o (- a 1) b) (if (vis o (- a 1)) (row h (- a 1) b) 0)))))
(ghost-fn cs ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0
          (+ (cs g h o a (- b 1)) (if (vis o (- b 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) a) 0)))))

(lemma wf_view (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires (well_formed cg))
  (ensures (wfg (view cg)))
  (body (assert (== (view cg) (field cg adj)))))
(lemma tgt_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g))))
  (body))
(lemma cap_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma tin_hit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (<= k (len (idx g u))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)))
  (ensures (tin g u k (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (== i (- k 1)) (block) (call tin_hit g u (- k 1) i))))
(lemma tin_miss (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j k)) (< k (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (not (tin g u j (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (<= j 0) (block)
    (block
      (call tin_miss g u (- j 1) k)
      (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- j 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)))))))
(lemma rest_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (rest g h u 0 m) (row h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block)
    (block
      (call rest_zero g h u (- m 1))
      (assert (not (tin g u 0 (- m 1))))))))
(lemma rest_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (rest g h u k m)
               (+ (rest g h u (+ k 1) m)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) m))
                      (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block)
    (block
      (call rest_step g h u k (- m 1))
      (call tin_miss g u k k)
      (assert (== (tin g u (+ k 1) (- m 1))
                  (or (tin g u k (- m 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (- m 1)))))))))
(lemma rest_total (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (rest g h u k (len g))) (rest g h u 0 (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (== k 0) (block)
    (block
      (call rest_total g h u (- k 1))
      (call rest_step g h u (- k 1) (len g))
      (call tgt_range g u (- k 1))))))
(lemma final_entry (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_like g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (or (tin g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (like_at g h u v))
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (get_flow h u v) c)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
        (call tin_hit g u (len (idx g u)) i))
      (block))))
(lemma rest_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (flow_like g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (rest g h u (len (idx g u)) m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block)
    (block
      (call rest_final g h u (- m 1))
      (call final_entry g h u (- m 1))))))
(lemma out_is_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (flow_like g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (row h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call rest_total g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (call rest_final g h u (len g))
    (call rest_zero g h u (len g))))
(lemma valid_like_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (like_at g h u v))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u)))))
      (block
        (assert (>= (idx (idx h u) v) 0))
        (assert (=> (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0)
                    (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c))))))
      (block))))
(lemma valid_like (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (flow_like g h))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call valid_like_at g h s t u v))))
(lemma valid_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (flow_like g h) (is_conserved g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (len g)) (row h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call out_is_row g h u)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (total_flow_out g h u)))))
(lemma valid_cons (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfg g) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (mcons g h s t))
  (body
    (call valid_like g h s t)
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (forall ((u int)) (call valid_cons_at g h s t u))))
(lemma like_idx (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_like g f) (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
           (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))
  (body (assert (like_at g f u v))))
(lemma cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (flow_like g f) (mcons g f s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u)))
  (body
    (call out_is_row g f u)
    (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u (len g)) (row f u (len g))))))
(lemma inv_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (wfg g) (flow_inv g f s t val) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val))
  (body
    (assert (flow_like g f))
    (assert (mcons g f s t))
    (forall ((u int)) (call cons_at g f s t u))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call like_idx g f u v))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (call out_is_row g f s)))
(lemma xrow_eq (params (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (xrow h o u b) (- (if (vis o u) (row h u b) 0) (yrow h o u b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) (block)
    (block
      (call xrow_eq h o u (- b 1))
      (assert (== (cross h o u (- b 1))
                  (- (if (vis o u) (get_flow h u (- b 1)) 0) (if (vis o (- b 1)) (get_flow h u (- b 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma cs_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (b int))
  (ensures (== (cs g h o 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) (block)
    (block
      (call cs_zero g h o (- b 1))
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) 0) 0))))))
(lemma cs_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (cs g h o (+ a 1) b) (+ (cs g h o a b) (yrow h o a b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) (block)
    (block
      (call cs_step g h o a (- b 1))
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) (+ a 1))
                  (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) a) (get_flow h a (- b 1)))))))))
(lemma xall_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (xall h o a b) (- (rs h o a b) (cs g h o a b))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (== a 0)
    (call cs_zero g h o b)
    (block
      (call xall_eq g h o (- a 1) b)
      (call cs_step g h o (- a 1) b)
      (call xrow_eq h o (- a 1) b)))))
(lemma net_val (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (b int))
  (requires (mcons g h s t) (vis o s) (not (vis o t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (<= b (len g)))
  (ensures (== (- (rs h o b (len g)) (cs g h o (len g) b))
               (if (< s b) (- (row h s (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h s (len g))) 0)))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) (block)
    (block
      (call net_val g h o s t (- b 1))
      (if (vis o (- b 1))
        (if (== (- b 1) s) (block)
          (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) (len g)) (row h (- b 1) (len g)))))
        (block))))))
(lemma cross_le_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_like g f) (flow_like g h) (cut_closed g f o)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (cross h o u v) (cross f o u v)))
  (body
    (assert (like_at g f u v))
    (assert (like_at g h u v))
    (if (and (vis o u) (not (vis o v)))
      (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
        (block
          (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (get_flow h u v) c)))
          (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                                 (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
          (assert (done_node g f o u))
          (assert (done_fwd g f o u (len (idx g u))))
          (assert (or (vis o (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                      (>= (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
        (block))
      (if (and (vis o v) (not (vis o u)))
        (block
          (assert (done_node g f o v))
          (assert (done_back f o v (len g)))
          (assert (<= (get_flow f u v) 0)))
        (block)))))
(lemma xrow_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (flow_like g f) (flow_like g h) (cut_closed g f o)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (<= b (len g)))
  (ensures (<= (xrow h o u b) (xrow f o u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) (block)
    (block
      (call xrow_le g f h o u (- b 1))
      (call cross_le_at g f h o u (- b 1))))))
(lemma xall_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int))
  (requires (flow_like g f) (flow_like g h) (cut_closed g f o) (<= a (len g)))
  (ensures (<= (xall h o a (len g)) (xall f o a (len g))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) (block)
    (block
      (call xall_le g f h o (- a 1))
      (call xrow_le g f h o (- a 1) (len g))))))
(lemma le_other (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (wfg g) (flow_inv g f s t val) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (cut_closed g f o) (vis o s) (not (vis o t)) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g h s)))
  (body
    (call valid_like g h s t)
    (call valid_cons g h s t)
    (call out_is_row g h s)
    (assert (flow_like g f))
    (assert (mcons g f s t))
    (call out_is_row g f s)
    (call xall_eq g h o (len g) (len g))
    (call xall_eq g f o (len g) (len g))
    (call net_val g h o s t (len g))
    (call net_val g f o s t (len g))
    (call xall_le g f h o (len g))))
(lemma max_cert (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (wfg g) (flow_inv g f s t val) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (cut_closed g f o) (vis o s) (not (vis o t)))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val))
  (body
    (call inv_valid g f s t val)
    (forall ((h (seq (seq int)))) (call le_other g f h o s t val))))
(lemma flow_exists (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (w (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (val int))

(lemma edge_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int)) (s int) (x int) (lim int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (y int))
  (requires (edges_below g f o par pe s lim) (tree_ok o par s) (differs f f2 a b d)
            (== (len par) (len o)) (== (len pe) (len o))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (== lim (idx o x))
            (or (and (== a (idx par x)) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b (idx par x))))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (!= y s) (>= (idx o y) 0) (< (idx o y) (idx o x)))
  (ensures (edge_ok g f2 (idx par y) y (idx pe y)))

    (call tree_at o par s y)

    (assert (!= y x))

(lemma walk_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (x int) (val int) (p int) (e int) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (== (len o) (len g)) (== (len par) (len g)) (== (len pe) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (!= x s) (>= (idx o x) 0)
            (walk_inv g f o par pe s t x val (idx o x))
            (tree_ok o par s)
            (== p (idx par x)) (== e (idx pe x))
            (mat f2 (len g)) (differs f f2 a b d)
            (or (and (>= e 0) (and (== a p) (and (== b x) (== d 1))))

    (if (>= e 0)

  (requires (bfs_inv g f o q par pe s head)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (not (vis o x))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< head (len q))

      (and (forall ((i int))
             (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len queue)))
                 (and (and (<= 0 (idx queue i)) (< (idx queue i) n)) (== (idx pos (idx queue i)) i))))
        (and (forall ((a int))
               (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (>= (idx pos a) 0))
                   (and (< (idx pos a) (len queue)) (== (idx queue (idx pos a)) a))))
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (> (idx pos v) 0))
                (and (and (<= 0 (idx par v)) (< (idx par v) n))
                  (and (>= (idx pos (idx par v)) 0)
                    (and (< (idx pos (idx par v)) (idx pos v))
                      (res cap f (idx par v) v))))))))))))
(ghost-fn proc_closed ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (k int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (and (vis pos a) (and (< (idx pos a) k) (res cap f a b))))
        (vis pos b)))))
(ghost-fn scanned ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (forall ((b int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b v)) (res cap f u b)) (vis p b)))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((p (seq int)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (cnt p (- m 1)) (if (vis p (- m 1)) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn adj_member ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int)) bool (decreases k)
  (body (if (or (<= k 0) (or (< u 0) (>= u (len g)))) false
    (if (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u)))
      (or (adj_member g u (- k 1) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v))
      (adj_member g u (- k 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn masksum ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0
    (+ (masksum g f u k (- m 1)) (if (adj_member g u k (- m 1)) (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn w_in ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (if (vis p v) (get_flow f u v) 0)))
(ghost-fn rw ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (rw f p u (- b 1)) (w_in f p u (- b 1))))))
(ghost-fn cl ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (a int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (cl f p v (- a 1)) (w_in f p (- a 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn dr ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (dr f p (- a 1) b) (rw f p (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn dc ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (dc f p a (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) a)))))
(ghost-fn asum ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (asum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (rowsum f (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn bsum ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (bsum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (colsum f (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn wt ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (- (if (vis p u) (get_flow f u v) 0) (w_in f p u v))))
(ghost-fn rowt ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (rowt f p u (- b 1)) (wt f p u (- b 1))))))
(ghost-fn tott ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (tott f p (- a 1) n) (rowt f p (- a 1) n)))))
(ghost-fn cut_hyp ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int)) bool
  (body (and (and (wf_g g) (cap_rel g cap))
    (and (and (mat_ok cap f (len g)) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
        (and (!= s t) (and (vis p s) (and (not (vis p t)) (closed cap f p (len g))))))))))

(lemma cnt_le (params (p (seq int)) (m int)) (requires (>= m 0)) (ensures (<= (cnt p m) m)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call cnt_le p (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma cnt_zero (params (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((u int)) (not (vis p u))))
  (ensures (== (cnt p m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call cnt_zero p (- m 1)) (assert (not (vis p (- m 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma cnt_mark (params (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (not (vis p1 x)) (vis p2 x) (forall ((u int)) (=> (!= u x) (== (vis p2 u) (vis p1 u)))))
  (ensures (== (cnt p2 m) (+ (cnt p1 m) (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x m)) 1 0)))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call cnt_mark p1 p2 x (- m 1))
      (if (!= (- m 1) x) (assert (== (vis p2 (- m 1)) (vis p1 (- m 1)))) (block)))
    (block))))

(lemma scan_skip (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (scanned cap f p u v) (or (vis p v) (not (res cap f u v))))
  (ensures (scanned cap f p u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma scan_grow (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (scanned cap f p1 u v) (forall ((b int)) (=> (vis p1 b) (vis p2 b))) (vis p2 v))
  (ensures (scanned cap f p2 u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma core_inj (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (bfs_core cap f pos par queue s n) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (== (idx queue k) u))
  (ensures (forall ((a int)) (=> (and (vis pos a) (== (idx pos a) k)) (== a u))))
  (body))
(lemma close_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (proc_closed cap f p k n) (scanned cap f p u n)
    (forall ((a int)) (=> (and (vis p a) (== (idx p a) k)) (== a u))))
  (ensures (proc_closed cap f p (+ k 1) n))
  (body))

(lemma hc_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma cap_get (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (rows_done g cap (len g)) (has_capacity g x y z))
  (ensures (== (get_flow cap x y) z))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) z))))
    (assert (== (get_flow cap x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))

(lemma member_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (< i (- k 1)) (call member_intro g u i (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma member_absent (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v))))
  (ensures (not (adj_member g u k v))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call member_absent g u (- k 1) v) (block))))
(lemma fresh_target (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (not (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (body
    (assert (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
      (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)))))
    (call member_absent g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
(lemma edge_member (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (call member_intro g u i (len (idx g u)))))
(lemma masksum_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0)) (ensures (== (masksum g f u 0 m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call masksum_zero g f u (- m 1)) (assert (not (adj_member g u 0 (- m 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma masksum_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0)
    (not (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (ensures (== (masksum g f u (+ k 1) m)
    (+ (masksum g f u k m)
       (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) m))
         (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call masksum_step g f u k (- m 1))
      (assert (== (adj_member g u (+ k 1) (- m 1))
        (or (adj_member g u k (- m 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (- m 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma sum_mask (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) (masksum g f u k (len g)))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call sum_mask g f u (- k 1))
      (call fresh_target g u (- k 1))
      (call masksum_step g f u (- k 1) (len g))
      (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g))))
      (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)
        (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))))
    (call masksum_zero g f u (len g)))))
(lemma mask_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g)))
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
      (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (masksum g f u (len (idx g u)) m) (rowsum f u m))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call mask_row g f u (- m 1))
      (assert (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1)) (== (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma edge_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))
  (body (if (> (get_flow f u v) 0)
    (block
      (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))))
      (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
      (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
      (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))
      (call edge_member g u v c))
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
(lemma in_col (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k) (colsum f u k))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call in_col g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma net_e (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures
    (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rowsum f u (len g)))
    (== (total_flow_in g f u) (colsum f u (len g)))
    (== (- (total_flow_out g f u) (total_flow_in g f u)) (net f u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call edge_zero g f u v))
    (call mask_row g f u (len g))
    (call sum_mask g f u (len (idx g u)))
    (call in_col g f u (len g))))

(lemma dc_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0)) (ensures (== (dc f p 0 b) 0)) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (call dc_zero f p (- b 1)) (assert (== (cl f p (- b 1) 0) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma dc_step (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f p (+ a 1) b) (+ (dc f p a b) (rw f p a b)))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call dc_step f p a (- b 1))
      (assert (== (dc f p (+ a 1) b) (+ (dc f p (+ a 1) (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) (+ a 1)))))
      (assert (== (cl f p (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (cl f p (- b 1) a) (w_in f p a (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (rw f p a b) (+ (rw f p a (- b 1)) (w_in f p a (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (dc f p a b) (+ (dc f p a (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) a)))))
    (block))))
(lemma swap_sum (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dr f p a b) (dc f p a b))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call swap_sum f p (- a 1) b)
      (call dc_step f p (- a 1) b)
      (assert (== (dr f p a b) (+ (dr f p (- a 1) b) (rw f p (- a 1) b)))))
    (call dc_zero f p b))))
(lemma cl_col (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (cl f p v a) (if (vis p v) (colsum f v a) 0))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call cl_col f p v (- a 1))
      (assert (== (w_in f p (- a 1) v) (if (vis p v) (get_flow f (- a 1) v) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma dc_bsum (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (b int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f p n b) (bsum f p b n))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (call dc_bsum f p n (- b 1)) (call cl_col f p (- b 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma rowt_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt f p u b) (- (if (vis p u) (rowsum f u b) 0) (rw f p u b)))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_eq f p u (- b 1))
      (assert (== (wt f p u (- b 1))
        (- (if (vis p u) (get_flow f u (- b 1)) 0) (w_in f p u (- b 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma tott_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tott f p a n) (- (asum f p a n) (dr f p a n)))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call tott_eq f p (- a 1) n) (call rowt_eq f p (- a 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma total_identity (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tott f p n n) (- (asum f p n n) (bsum f p n n))))
  (body (call tott_eq f p n n) (call swap_sum f p n n) (call dc_bsum f p n n)))
(lemma ab_net (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (mat_cons f s t n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (!= s t) (vis p s) (not (vis p t)))
  (ensures (== (- (asum f p a n) (bsum f p a n)) (if (< s a) (net f s n) 0))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call ab_net f p s t n (- a 1))
      (assert (== (asum f p a n) (+ (asum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (rowsum f (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (bsum f p a n) (+ (bsum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (colsum f (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (net f s n) (- (rowsum f s n) (colsum f s n))))
      (if (and (!= (- a 1) s) (!= (- a 1) t))
        (assert (== (net f (- a 1) n) 0))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma val_tw (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
    (!= s t) (vis p s) (not (vis p t)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (tott h p (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (nonneg_f h))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (forall ((u int)) (call net_e g h u))
    (assert (mat_cons h s t (len g)))
    (call net_e g h s)
    (call ab_net h p s t (len g) (len g))
    (call total_identity h p (len g))
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (net h s (len g))))))
(lemma rowt_mono (params (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0) (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v b)) (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))))
  (ensures (<= (rowt h p u b) (rowt f p u b))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_mono f h p u (- b 1))
      (assert (<= (wt h p u (- b 1)) (wt f p u (- b 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma tott_mono (params (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0)
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u a)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))))
  (ensures (<= (tott h p a n) (tott f p a n))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call tott_mono f h p (- a 1) n) (call rowt_mono f h p (- a 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma wt_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cut_hyp g cap f p s t) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_f h)
    (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))))
  (ensures (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))
  (body
    (assert (>= (get_flow h u v) 0))
    (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) 0))
    (if (and (vis p u) (not (vis p v)))
      (block
        (assert (not (res cap f u v)))
        (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
          (block
            (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))))
            (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u)))))
            (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))
            (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
            (assert (== (get_flow cap u v) c)))
          (block)))
      (if (and (not (vis p u)) (vis p v))
        (assert (not (res cap f v u)))
        (block)))))
(lemma le_other (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cut_hyp g cap f p s t) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g h s)))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (nonneg_f h))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call wt_mono g cap f h p s t u v))
    (call tott_mono f h p (len g) (len g))
    (call val_tw g f p s t)
    (call val_tw g h p s t)))
(lemma final_max (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (cut_hyp g cap f p s t))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (forall ((h (seq (seq int)))) (call le_other g cap f p s t h))
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))
(lemma resp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
