  (body (and (square cap (len g)) (and (cap_sound g cap)
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (c int)) (=> (has_capacity g u v c) (== (get_flow cap u v) c)))))))
(ghost-fn cap_bnd ((cap (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (and (<= 0 (get_flow cap x y)) (<= (get_flow cap x y) 100000)))))
(ghost-fn rows_done ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (m int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (j int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x m)) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
        (== (get_flow cap x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))))
(ghost-fn nonneg_f ((f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
        (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn zero_f ((f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (== (get_flow f x y) 0))))
(ghost-fn flow_bnd ((f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (and (<= 0 (get_flow f x y)) (<= (get_flow f x y) 100000)))))
(ghost-fn gf_rel ((f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (== (get_flow f2 x y) (+ (get_flow f1 x y) (if (and (== x a) (== y b)) d 0))))))
(ghost-fn delta ((f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (square f1 n) (square f2 n))
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i n)) (and (<= 0 j) (< j n)))
          (== (idx (idx f2 i) j) (+ (idx (idx f1 i) j) (if (and (== i a) (== j b)) d 0))))))))
(ghost-fn untouched ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (k int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len pos) n) (and (and (square f0 n) (square fl n))
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
               (and (<= (idx pos a) k) (<= (idx pos b) k)))
          (== (idx (idx fl a) b) (idx (idx f0 a) b))))))))
(ghost-fn path_ok ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len pos) n) (== (len par) n))
    (and (forall ((a int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (== (idx pos a) 0)) (== a s)))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (> (idx pos v) 0))
            (and (and (<= 0 (idx par v)) (< (idx par v) n))
              (and (>= (idx pos (idx par v)) 0)
                (and (< (idx pos (idx par v)) (idx pos v))
                  (res cap f (idx par v) v))))))))))
(ghost-fn bfs_core ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (s int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len pos) n) (== (len par) n))
    (and (and (> (len queue) 0) (== (idx queue 0) s))
      (and (forall ((i int))
             (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len queue)))
                 (and (and (<= 0 (idx queue i)) (< (idx queue i) n)) (== (idx pos (idx queue i)) i))))
        (and (forall ((a int))
               (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (>= (idx pos a) 0))
                   (and (< (idx pos a) (len queue)) (== (idx queue (idx pos a)) a))))
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (> (idx pos v) 0))
                (and (and (<= 0 (idx par v)) (< (idx par v) n))
                  (and (>= (idx pos (idx par v)) 0)
                    (and (< (idx pos (idx par v)) (idx pos v))
                      (res cap f (idx par v) v))))))))))))
(ghost-fn proc_closed ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (k int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (and (vis pos a) (and (< (idx pos a) k) (res cap f a b))))
        (vis pos b)))))
(ghost-fn scanned ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (forall ((b int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b v)) (res cap f u b)) (vis p b)))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((p (seq int)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (cnt p (- m 1)) (if (vis p (- m 1)) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn adj_member ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int)) bool (decreases k)
  (body (if (or (<= k 0) (or (< u 0) (>= u (len g)))) false
    (if (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u)))
      (or (adj_member g u (- k 1) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v))
      (adj_member g u (- k 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn masksum ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0
    (+ (masksum g f u k (- m 1)) (if (adj_member g u k (- m 1)) (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn w_in ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (if (vis p v) (get_flow f u v) 0)))
(ghost-fn rw ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (rw f p u (- b 1)) (w_in f p u (- b 1))))))
(ghost-fn cl ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (a int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (cl f p v (- a 1)) (w_in f p (- a 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn dr ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (dr f p (- a 1) b) (rw f p (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn dc ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (dc f p a (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) a)))))
(ghost-fn asum ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (asum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (rowsum f (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn bsum ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (bsum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (colsum f (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn wt ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (- (if (vis p u) (get_flow f u v) 0) (w_in f p u v))))
(ghost-fn rowt ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (rowt f p u (- b 1)) (wt f p u (- b 1))))))
(ghost-fn tott ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (tott f p (- a 1) n) (rowt f p (- a 1) n)))))
(ghost-fn cut_hyp ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int)) bool
  (body (and (and (wf_g g) (cap_rel g cap))
    (and (and (mat_ok cap f (len g)) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
        (and (!= s t) (and (vis p s) (and (not (vis p t)) (closed cap f p (len g))))))))))

(lemma cnt_le (params (p (seq int)) (m int)) (requires (>= m 0)) (ensures (<= (cnt p m) m)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call cnt_le p (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma cnt_zero (params (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((u int)) (not (vis p u))))
  (ensures (== (cnt p m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call cnt_zero p (- m 1)) (assert (not (vis p (- m 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma cnt_mark (params (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (not (vis p1 x)) (vis p2 x) (forall ((u int)) (=> (!= u x) (== (vis p2 u) (vis p1 u)))))
  (ensures (== (cnt p2 m) (+ (cnt p1 m) (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x m)) 1 0)))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call cnt_mark p1 p2 x (- m 1))
      (if (!= (- m 1) x) (assert (== (vis p2 (- m 1)) (vis p1 (- m 1)))) (block)))
    (block))))

(lemma scan_skip (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (scanned cap f p u v) (or (vis p v) (not (res cap f u v))))
  (ensures (scanned cap f p u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma scan_grow (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (scanned cap f p1 u v) (forall ((b int)) (=> (vis p1 b) (vis p2 b))) (vis p2 v))
  (ensures (scanned cap f p2 u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma core_inj (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (bfs_core cap f pos par queue s n) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (== (idx queue k) u))
  (ensures (forall ((a int)) (=> (and (vis pos a) (== (idx pos a) k)) (== a u))))
  (body))
(lemma close_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (proc_closed cap f p k n) (scanned cap f p u n)
    (forall ((a int)) (=> (and (vis p a) (== (idx p a) k)) (== a u))))
  (ensures (proc_closed cap f p (+ k 1) n))
  (body))

(lemma hc_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma cap_get (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (rows_done g cap (len g)) (has_capacity g x y z))
  (ensures (== (get_flow cap x y) z))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) z))))
    (assert (== (get_flow cap x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))

(lemma member_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (< i (- k 1)) (call member_intro g u i (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma member_absent (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v))))
  (ensures (not (adj_member g u k v))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call member_absent g u (- k 1) v) (block))))
(lemma fresh_target (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (not (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (body
    (assert (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
      (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)))))
    (call member_absent g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
(lemma edge_member (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (call member_intro g u i (len (idx g u)))))
(lemma masksum_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0)) (ensures (== (masksum g f u 0 m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call masksum_zero g f u (- m 1)) (assert (not (adj_member g u 0 (- m 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma masksum_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0)
    (not (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (ensures (== (masksum g f u (+ k 1) m)
    (+ (masksum g f u k m)
       (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) m))
         (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call masksum_step g f u k (- m 1))
      (assert (== (adj_member g u (+ k 1) (- m 1))
        (or (adj_member g u k (- m 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (- m 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma sum_mask (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) (masksum g f u k (len g)))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call sum_mask g f u (- k 1))
      (call fresh_target g u (- k 1))
      (call masksum_step g f u (- k 1) (len g))
      (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g))))
      (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)
        (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))))
    (call masksum_zero g f u (len g)))))
(lemma mask_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g)))
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
      (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (masksum g f u (len (idx g u)) m) (rowsum f u m))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call mask_row g f u (- m 1))
      (assert (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1)) (== (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma edge_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))
  (body (if (> (get_flow f u v) 0)
    (block
      (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))))
      (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
      (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
      (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))
      (call edge_member g u v c))
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
(lemma in_col (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k) (colsum f u k))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call in_col g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma net_e (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures
    (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rowsum f u (len g)))
    (== (total_flow_in g f u) (colsum f u (len g)))
    (== (- (total_flow_out g f u) (total_flow_in g f u)) (net f u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call edge_zero g f u v))
    (call mask_row g f u (len g))
    (call sum_mask g f u (len (idx g u)))
    (call in_col g f u (len g))))

(lemma dc_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0)) (ensures (== (dc f p 0 b) 0)) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (call dc_zero f p (- b 1)) (assert (== (cl f p (- b 1) 0) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma dc_step (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f p (+ a 1) b) (+ (dc f p a b) (rw f p a b)))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call dc_step f p a (- b 1))
      (assert (== (dc f p (+ a 1) b) (+ (dc f p (+ a 1) (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) (+ a 1)))))
      (assert (== (cl f p (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (cl f p (- b 1) a) (w_in f p a (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (rw f p a b) (+ (rw f p a (- b 1)) (w_in f p a (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (dc f p a b) (+ (dc f p a (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) a)))))
    (block))))
(lemma swap_sum (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dr f p a b) (dc f p a b))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call swap_sum f p (- a 1) b)
      (call dc_step f p (- a 1) b)
      (assert (== (dr f p a b) (+ (dr f p (- a 1) b) (rw f p (- a 1) b)))))
    (call dc_zero f p b))))
(lemma cl_col (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (cl f p v a) (if (vis p v) (colsum f v a) 0))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call cl_col f p v (- a 1))
      (assert (== (w_in f p (- a 1) v) (if (vis p v) (get_flow f (- a 1) v) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma dc_bsum (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (b int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f p n b) (bsum f p b n))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (call dc_bsum f p n (- b 1)) (call cl_col f p (- b 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma rowt_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt f p u b) (- (if (vis p u) (rowsum f u b) 0) (rw f p u b)))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_eq f p u (- b 1))
      (assert (== (wt f p u (- b 1))
        (- (if (vis p u) (get_flow f u (- b 1)) 0) (w_in f p u (- b 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma tott_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tott f p a n) (- (asum f p a n) (dr f p a n)))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call tott_eq f p (- a 1) n) (call rowt_eq f p (- a 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma total_identity (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tott f p n n) (- (asum f p n n) (bsum f p n n))))
  (body (call tott_eq f p n n) (call swap_sum f p n n) (call dc_bsum f p n n)))
(lemma ab_net (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (mat_cons f s t n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (!= s t) (vis p s) (not (vis p t)))
  (ensures (== (- (asum f p a n) (bsum f p a n)) (if (< s a) (net f s n) 0))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call ab_net f p s t n (- a 1))
      (assert (== (asum f p a n) (+ (asum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (rowsum f (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (bsum f p a n) (+ (bsum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (colsum f (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (net f s n) (- (rowsum f s n) (colsum f s n))))
      (if (and (!= (- a 1) s) (!= (- a 1) t))
        (assert (== (net f (- a 1) n) 0))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma val_tw (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
    (!= s t) (vis p s) (not (vis p t)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (tott h p (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (nonneg_f h))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (forall ((u int)) (call net_e g h u))
    (assert (mat_cons h s t (len g)))
    (call net_e g h s)
    (call ab_net h p s t (len g) (len g))

           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) z))))
    (assert (== (get_flow cap x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))

(lemma member_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (< i (- k 1)) (call member_intro g u i (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma member_absent (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v))))
  (ensures (not (adj_member g u k v))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call member_absent g u (- k 1) v) (block))))
(lemma fresh_target (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (not (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (body
    (assert (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
      (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)))))
    (call member_absent g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
(lemma edge_member (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (call member_intro g u i (len (idx g u)))))
(lemma masksum_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0)) (ensures (== (masksum g f u 0 m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call masksum_zero g f u (- m 1)) (assert (not (adj_member g u 0 (- m 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma masksum_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0)
    (not (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (ensures (== (masksum g f u (+ k 1) m)
    (+ (masksum g f u k m)
       (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) m))
         (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call masksum_step g f u k (- m 1))
      (assert (== (adj_member g u (+ k 1) (- m 1))
        (or (adj_member g u k (- m 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (- m 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma sum_mask (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) (masksum g f u k (len g)))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call sum_mask g f u (- k 1))
      (call fresh_target g u (- k 1))
      (call masksum_step g f u (- k 1) (len g))
      (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g))))
      (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)
        (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))))
    (call masksum_zero g f u (len g)))))
(lemma mask_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g)))
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
      (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (masksum g f u (len (idx g u)) m) (rowsum f u m))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call mask_row g f u (- m 1))
      (assert (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1)) (== (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma edge_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))
  (body (if (> (get_flow f u v) 0)
    (block
      (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))))
      (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
      (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
      (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))
      (call edge_member g u v c))
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
(lemma in_col (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k) (colsum f u k))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call in_col g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma net_e (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures
    (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rowsum f u (len g)))
    (== (total_flow_in g f u) (colsum f u (len g)))
    (== (- (total_flow_out g f u) (total_flow_in g f u)) (net f u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call edge_zero g f u v))
    (call mask_row g f u (len g))
    (call sum_mask g f u (len (idx g u)))
    (call in_col g f u (len g))))

(lemma dc_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0)) (ensures (== (dc f p 0 b) 0)) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (call dc_zero f p (- b 1)) (assert (== (cl f p (- b 1) 0) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma dc_step (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f p (+ a 1) b) (+ (dc f p a b) (rw f p a b)))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call dc_step f p a (- b 1))
      (assert (== (dc f p (+ a 1) b) (+ (dc f p (+ a 1) (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) (+ a 1)))))
      (assert (== (cl f p (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (cl f p (- b 1) a) (w_in f p a (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (rw f p a b) (+ (rw f p a (- b 1)) (w_in f p a (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (dc f p a b) (+ (dc f p a (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) a)))))
    (block))))
(lemma swap_sum (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dr f p a b) (dc f p a b))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call swap_sum f p (- a 1) b)
      (call dc_step f p (- a 1) b)
      (assert (== (dr f p a b) (+ (dr f p (- a 1) b) (rw f p (- a 1) b)))))
    (call dc_zero f p b))))
(lemma cl_col (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (cl f p v a) (if (vis p v) (colsum f v a) 0))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call cl_col f p v (- a 1))
      (assert (== (w_in f p (- a 1) v) (if (vis p v) (get_flow f (- a 1) v) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma dc_bsum (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (b int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f p n b) (bsum f p b n))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (call dc_bsum f p n (- b 1)) (call cl_col f p (- b 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma rowt_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt f p u b) (- (if (vis p u) (rowsum f u b) 0) (rw f p u b)))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_eq f p u (- b 1))
      (assert (== (wt f p u (- b 1))
        (- (if (vis p u) (get_flow f u (- b 1)) 0) (w_in f p u (- b 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma tott_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tott f p a n) (- (asum f p a n) (dr f p a n)))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call tott_eq f p (- a 1) n) (call rowt_eq f p (- a 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma total_identity (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tott f p n n) (- (asum f p n n) (bsum f p n n))))
  (body (call tott_eq f p n n) (call swap_sum f p n n) (call dc_bsum f p n n)))
(lemma ab_net (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (mat_cons f s t n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (!= s t) (vis p s) (not (vis p t)))
  (ensures (== (- (asum f p a n) (bsum f p a n)) (if (< s a) (net f s n) 0))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call ab_net f p s t n (- a 1))
      (assert (== (asum f p a n) (+ (asum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (rowsum f (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (bsum f p a n) (+ (bsum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (colsum f (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (net f s n) (- (rowsum f s n) (colsum f s n))))
      (if (and (!= (- a 1) s) (!= (- a 1) t))
        (assert (== (net f (- a 1) n) 0))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma val_tw (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
    (!= s t) (vis p s) (not (vis p t)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (tott h p (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (nonneg_f h))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (forall ((u int)) (call net_e g h u))
    (assert (mat_cons h s t (len g)))
    (call net_e g h s)
    (call ab_net h p s t (len g) (len g))
    (call total_identity h p (len g))
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (net h s (len g))))))
(lemma rowt_mono (params (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0) (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v b)) (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))))
  (ensures (<= (rowt h p u b) (rowt f p u b))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_mono f h p u (- b 1))
      (assert (<= (wt h p u (- b 1)) (wt f p u (- b 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma tott_mono (params (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0)
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u a)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))))
  (ensures (<= (tott h p a n) (tott f p a n))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call tott_mono f h p (- a 1) n) (call rowt_mono f h p (- a 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma wt_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cut_hyp g cap f p s t) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_f h)
    (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))))
  (ensures (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))
  (body
    (assert (>= (get_flow h u v) 0))
    (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) 0))
    (if (and (vis p u) (not (vis p v)))
      (block
        (assert (not (res cap f u v)))
        (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
          (block
            (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))))
            (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u)))))
            (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))
            (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
            (assert (== (get_flow cap u v) c)))
          (block)))
      (if (and (not (vis p u)) (vis p v))
        (assert (not (res cap f v u)))
        (block)))))
(lemma le_other (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cut_hyp g cap f p s t) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g h s)))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (nonneg_f h))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call wt_mono g cap f h p s t u v))
    (call tott_mono f h p (len g) (len g))
    (call val_tw g f p s t)
    (call val_tw g h p s t)))
(lemma final_max (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (cut_hyp g cap f p s t))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (forall ((h (seq (seq int)))) (call le_other g cap f p s t h))
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))
(lemma resp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cap_rel g cap) (mat_ok cap f (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
    (and (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow cap u v)))))
  (body (if (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
    (block
      (assert (== (get_flow cap u v) (idx (idx cap u) v)))
      (assert (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (idx (idx cap u) v)))
      (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v))))
    (block))))
(lemma resp_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
        (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
            (and (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow cap u v)))))))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body))
(lemma resp_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cap_rel g cap) (mat_ok cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call resp_at g cap f u v))
    (call resp_wit g cap f)))
(lemma mat_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (cap_rel g cap) (mat_ok cap f (len g)) (mat_cons f s t (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (net f s (len g))))
  (body
    (call resp_ok g cap f)
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (assert (nonneg_f f))
    (forall ((u int)) (call net_e g f u))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))
    (call net_e g f s)))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (total int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (cap_rel g cap) (mat_ok cap f (len g)) (mat_cons f s t (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))) (!= s t)
    (vis p s) (not (vis p t)) (closed cap f p (len g)) (== total (net f s (len g))))
  (ensures (exists ((w (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g w s t) (== (flow_val g w s) total))))
  (body
    (call mat_valid g cap f s t)
    (assert (cut_hyp g cap f p s t))
    (call final_max g cap f p s t)
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) total))))

(lemma row_bump (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (gf_rel f1 f2 a b d) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rowsum f2 u m) (+ (rowsum f1 u m) (if (and (== u a) (and (<= 0 b) (< b m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call row_bump f1 f2 a b d u (- m 1))
      (assert (== (get_flow f2 u (- m 1))
        (+ (get_flow f1 u (- m 1)) (if (and (== u a) (== (- m 1) b)) d 0)))))
    (block))))
(lemma col_bump (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (gf_rel f1 f2 a b d) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (colsum f2 v m) (+ (colsum f1 v m) (if (and (== v b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call col_bump f1 f2 a b d v (- m 1))
      (assert (== (get_flow f2 (- m 1) v)
        (+ (get_flow f1 (- m 1) v) (if (and (== (- m 1) a) (== v b)) d 0)))))
    (block))))
(lemma net_bump (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (gf_rel f1 f2 a b d) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (== (net f2 u n) (+ (net f1 u n) (- (if (== u a) d 0) (if (== u b) d 0)))))
  (body (call row_bump f1 f2 a b d u n) (call col_bump f1 f2 a b d u n)))
(lemma gf_delta (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (delta f1 f2 a b d n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (== (get_flow f2 x y) (+ (get_flow f1 x y) (if (and (== x a) (== y b)) d 0))))
  (body (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
    (assert (== (idx (idx f2 x) y) (+ (idx (idx f1 x) y) (if (and (== x a) (== y b)) d 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma bump_net (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int))
  (requires (delta f1 f2 a b d n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (forall ((u int)) (== (net f2 u n) (+ (net f1 u n) (- (if (== u a) d 0) (if (== u b) d 0))))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call gf_delta f1 f2 a b d n x y))
    (assert (gf_rel f1 f2 a b d))
    (forall ((u int)) (call net_bump f1 f2 a b d n u))))
(lemma row_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (zero_f f) (>= m 0)) (ensures (== (rowsum f u m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call row_zero f u (- m 1)) (assert (== (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma col_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (zero_f f) (>= m 0)) (ensures (== (colsum f v m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call col_zero f v (- m 1)) (assert (== (get_flow f (- m 1) v) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma zero_net (params (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (x int))
  (requires (zero_f f) (>= n 0)) (ensures (== (net f x n) 0))
  (body (call row_zero f x n) (call col_zero f x n)))
(lemma init_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (square cap n) (square f n) (cap_bnd cap) (zero_f f)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx (idx f x) y)) (<= (idx (idx f x) y) (idx (idx cap x) y))))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow cap x y) (idx (idx cap x) y)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f x y) (idx (idx f x) y)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f x y) 0))
    (assert (<= 0 (get_flow cap x y)))))
(lemma gf_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (mat_ok cap f n) (cap_bnd cap))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow f x y)) (<= (get_flow f x y) 100000)))
  (body (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
    (block

(ghost-fn rowt ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (rowt f p u (- b 1)) (wt f p u (- b 1))))))
(ghost-fn tott ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (tott f p (- a 1) n) (rowt f p (- a 1) n)))))
(ghost-fn cut_hyp ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int)) bool
  (body (and (and (wf_g g) (cap_rel g cap))
    (and (and (mat_ok cap f (len g)) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
        (and (!= s t) (and (vis p s) (and (not (vis p t)) (closed cap f p (len g))))))))))

(lemma cnt_le (params (p (seq int)) (m int)) (requires (>= m 0)) (ensures (<= (cnt p m) m)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call cnt_le p (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma cnt_zero (params (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((u int)) (not (vis p u))))
  (ensures (== (cnt p m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call cnt_zero p (- m 1)) (assert (not (vis p (- m 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma cnt_mark (params (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (not (vis p1 x)) (vis p2 x) (forall ((u int)) (=> (!= u x) (== (vis p2 u) (vis p1 u)))))
  (ensures (== (cnt p2 m) (+ (cnt p1 m) (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x m)) 1 0)))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call cnt_mark p1 p2 x (- m 1))
      (if (!= (- m 1) x) (assert (== (vis p2 (- m 1)) (vis p1 (- m 1)))) (block)))
    (block))))

(lemma scan_skip (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (scanned cap f p u v) (or (vis p v) (not (res cap f u v))))
  (ensures (scanned cap f p u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma scan_grow (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (scanned cap f p1 u v) (forall ((b int)) (=> (vis p1 b) (vis p2 b))) (vis p2 v))
  (ensures (scanned cap f p2 u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma core_inj (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (bfs_core cap f pos par queue s n) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (== (idx queue k) u))
  (ensures (forall ((a int)) (=> (and (vis pos a) (== (idx pos a) k)) (== a u))))
  (body))
(lemma close_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (proc_closed cap f p k n) (scanned cap f p u n)
    (forall ((a int)) (=> (and (vis p a) (== (idx p a) k)) (== a u))))
  (ensures (proc_closed cap f p (+ k 1) n))
  (body))
(lemma step_queue (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos1 (seq int)) (par1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (pos2 (seq int)) (par2 (seq int)) (q2 (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (u int) (v int) (i int))
  (requires (bfs_core cap f pos1 par1 q1 s n) (bfs_step pos1 par1 q1 pos2 par2 q2 u v n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len q2))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx q2 i)) (< (idx q2 i) n)) (== (idx pos2 (idx q2 i)) i)))
  (body (if (< i (len q1))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx q2 i) (idx q1 i)))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 (idx q1 i)) (< (idx q1 i) n)) (== (idx pos1 (idx q1 i)) i)))
      (assert (!= (idx q1 i) v))
      (assert (== (idx pos2 (idx q1 i)) (idx pos1 (idx q1 i)))))
    (block
      (assert (== i (len q1)))
      (assert (== (idx q2 i) v))))))
(lemma step_pos (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos1 (seq int)) (par1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (pos2 (seq int)) (par2 (seq int)) (q2 (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (u int) (v int) (a int))
  (requires (bfs_core cap f pos1 par1 q1 s n) (bfs_step pos1 par1 q1 pos2 par2 q2 u v n)
    (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (>= (idx pos2 a) 0)))
  (ensures (and (< (idx pos2 a) (len q2)) (== (idx q2 (idx pos2 a)) a)))
  (body (if (== a v)
    (block
      (assert (== (idx pos2 a) (len q1)))
      (assert (== (idx q2 (len q1)) v)))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx pos2 a) (idx pos1 a)))
      (assert (and (< (idx pos1 a) (len q1)) (== (idx q1 (idx pos1 a)) a)))
      (assert (== (idx q2 (idx pos1 a)) (idx q1 (idx pos1 a))))))))
(lemma step_par (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos1 (seq int)) (par1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (pos2 (seq int)) (par2 (seq int)) (q2 (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (bfs_core cap f pos1 par1 q1 s n) (bfs_step pos1 par1 q1 pos2 par2 q2 u v n) (res cap f u v)
    (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (> (idx pos2 w) 0)))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx par2 w)) (< (idx par2 w) n))
    (and (>= (idx pos2 (idx par2 w)) 0)
      (and (< (idx pos2 (idx par2 w)) (idx pos2 w))
        (res cap f (idx par2 w) w)))))
  (body (if (== w v)
    (block
      (assert (== (idx par2 w) u))
      (assert (!= u v))
      (assert (== (idx pos2 u) (idx pos1 u)))
      (assert (< (idx pos1 u) (len q1)))
      (assert (== (idx pos2 w) (len q1))))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx pos2 w) (idx pos1 w)))
      (assert (== (idx par2 w) (idx par1 w)))
      (assert (> (idx pos1 w) 0))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 (idx par1 w)) (< (idx par1 w) n))
        (and (>= (idx pos1 (idx par1 w)) 0)
          (and (< (idx pos1 (idx par1 w)) (idx pos1 w))
            (res cap f (idx par1 w) w)))))
      (assert (!= (idx par1 w) v))
      (assert (== (idx pos2 (idx par1 w)) (idx pos1 (idx par1 w))))))))
(lemma core_extend (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos1 (seq int)) (par1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (pos2 (seq int)) (par2 (seq int)) (q2 (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (bfs_core cap f pos1 par1 q1 s n) (bfs_step pos1 par1 q1 pos2 par2 q2 u v n) (res cap f u v))
  (ensures (bfs_core cap f pos2 par2 q2 s n))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call step_queue cap f pos1 par1 q1 pos2 par2 q2 s n u v i))
    (forall ((a int)) (call step_pos cap f pos1 par1 q1 pos2 par2 q2 s n u v a))
    (forall ((w int)) (call step_par cap f pos1 par1 q1 pos2 par2 q2 s n u v w))
    (assert (> (len q1) 0))
    (assert (== (idx q2 0) (idx q1 0)))
    (assert (== (idx q2 0) s))
    (assert (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len q2)))
          (and (and (<= 0 (idx q2 i)) (< (idx q2 i) n)) (== (idx pos2 (idx q2 i)) i)))))
    (assert (forall ((a int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (>= (idx pos2 a) 0))
          (and (< (idx pos2 a) (len q2)) (== (idx q2 (idx pos2 a)) a)))))
    (assert (forall ((w int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (> (idx pos2 w) 0))
          (and (and (<= 0 (idx par2 w)) (< (idx par2 w) n))
            (and (>= (idx pos2 (idx par2 w)) 0)
              (and (< (idx pos2 (idx par2 w)) (idx pos2 w))
                (res cap f (idx par2 w) w)))))))))

(lemma hc_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma cap_get (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (rows_done g cap (len g)) (has_capacity g x y z))
  (ensures (== (get_flow cap x y) z))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) z))))
    (assert (== (get_flow cap x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))

(lemma member_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (< i (- k 1)) (call member_intro g u i (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma member_absent (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v))))
  (ensures (not (adj_member g u k v))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call member_absent g u (- k 1) v) (block))))
(lemma fresh_target (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (not (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (body
    (assert (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j k))
      (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)))))
    (call member_absent g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
(lemma edge_member (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (call member_intro g u i (len (idx g u)))))
(lemma masksum_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0)) (ensures (== (masksum g f u 0 m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call masksum_zero g f u (- m 1)) (assert (not (adj_member g u 0 (- m 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma masksum_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0)
    (not (adj_member g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (ensures (== (masksum g f u (+ k 1) m)
    (+ (masksum g f u k m)
       (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) m))
         (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call masksum_step g f u k (- m 1))
      (assert (== (adj_member g u (+ k 1) (- m 1))
        (or (adj_member g u k (- m 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (- m 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma sum_mask (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) (masksum g f u k (len g)))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call sum_mask g f u (- k 1))
      (call fresh_target g u (- k 1))
      (call masksum_step g f u (- k 1) (len g))
      (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g))))
      (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)
        (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))))
    (call masksum_zero g f u (len g)))))
(lemma mask_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g)))
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
      (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (masksum g f u (len (idx g u)) m) (rowsum f u m))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call mask_row g f u (- m 1))
      (assert (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1)) (== (get_flow f u (- m 1)) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma edge_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (or (adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))
  (body (if (> (get_flow f u v) 0)
    (block
      (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))))
      (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
      (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
      (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))
      (call edge_member g u v c))
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
(lemma in_col (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k) (colsum f u k))) (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call in_col g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma net_e (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures
    (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rowsum f u (len g)))
    (== (total_flow_in g f u) (colsum f u (len g)))
    (== (- (total_flow_out g f u) (total_flow_in g f u)) (net f u (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call edge_zero g f u v))
    (call mask_row g f u (len g))
    (call sum_mask g f u (len (idx g u)))
    (call in_col g f u (len g))))

(lemma dc_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0)) (ensures (== (dc f p 0 b) 0)) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (call dc_zero f p (- b 1)) (assert (== (cl f p (- b 1) 0) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma dc_step (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f p (+ a 1) b) (+ (dc f p a b) (rw f p a b)))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call dc_step f p a (- b 1))
      (assert (== (dc f p (+ a 1) b) (+ (dc f p (+ a 1) (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) (+ a 1)))))
      (assert (== (cl f p (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (cl f p (- b 1) a) (w_in f p a (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (rw f p a b) (+ (rw f p a (- b 1)) (w_in f p a (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (dc f p a b) (+ (dc f p a (- b 1)) (cl f p (- b 1) a)))))
    (block))))
(lemma swap_sum (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dr f p a b) (dc f p a b))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call swap_sum f p (- a 1) b)
      (call dc_step f p (- a 1) b)
      (assert (== (dr f p a b) (+ (dr f p (- a 1) b) (rw f p (- a 1) b)))))
    (call dc_zero f p b))))
(lemma cl_col (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (cl f p v a) (if (vis p v) (colsum f v a) 0))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call cl_col f p v (- a 1))
      (assert (== (w_in f p (- a 1) v) (if (vis p v) (get_flow f (- a 1) v) 0))))
    (block))))
(lemma dc_bsum (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (b int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f p n b) (bsum f p b n))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (call dc_bsum f p n (- b 1)) (call cl_col f p (- b 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma rowt_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt f p u b) (- (if (vis p u) (rowsum f u b) 0) (rw f p u b)))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_eq f p u (- b 1))
      (assert (== (wt f p u (- b 1))
        (- (if (vis p u) (get_flow f u (- b 1)) 0) (w_in f p u (- b 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma tott_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tott f p a n) (- (asum f p a n) (dr f p a n)))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call tott_eq f p (- a 1) n) (call rowt_eq f p (- a 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma total_identity (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tott f p n n) (- (asum f p n n) (bsum f p n n))))
  (body (call tott_eq f p n n) (call swap_sum f p n n) (call dc_bsum f p n n)))
(lemma ab_net (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (mat_cons f s t n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (!= s t) (vis p s) (not (vis p t)))
  (ensures (== (- (asum f p a n) (bsum f p a n)) (if (< s a) (net f s n) 0))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call ab_net f p s t n (- a 1))
      (assert (== (asum f p a n) (+ (asum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (rowsum f (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (bsum f p a n) (+ (bsum f p (- a 1) n) (if (vis p (- a 1)) (colsum f (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (net f s n) (- (rowsum f s n) (colsum f s n))))
      (if (and (!= (- a 1) s) (!= (- a 1) t))
        (assert (== (net f (- a 1) n) 0))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma val_tw (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
    (!= s t) (vis p s) (not (vis p t)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (tott h p (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (nonneg_f h))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (forall ((u int)) (call net_e g h u))
    (assert (mat_cons h s t (len g)))
    (call net_e g h s)
    (call ab_net h p s t (len g) (len g))
    (call total_identity h p (len g))
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (net h s (len g))))))
(lemma rowt_mono (params (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0) (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v b)) (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))))
  (ensures (<= (rowt h p u b) (rowt f p u b))) (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call rowt_mono f h p u (- b 1))
      (assert (<= (wt h p u (- b 1)) (wt f p u (- b 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma tott_mono (params (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0)
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u a)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))))
  (ensures (<= (tott h p a n) (tott f p a n))) (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block (call tott_mono f h p (- a 1) n) (call rowt_mono f h p (- a 1) n))
    (block))))
(lemma wt_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cut_hyp g cap f p s t) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_f h)
    (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))))
  (ensures (<= (wt h p u v) (wt f p u v)))
  (body
    (assert (>= (get_flow h u v) 0))
    (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) 0))
    (if (and (vis p u) (not (vis p v)))
      (block
        (assert (not (res cap f u v)))
        (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
          (block
            (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))))
            (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u)))))
            (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))

    (forall ((x int) (y int) (z int)) (=> (has_capacity g x y z) (<= z (get_flow m x y)))))))
(ghost-fn cap_limit ((c (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (and (<= 0 (get_flow c x y)) (<= (get_flow c x y) 100000)))))
(ghost-fn cap_bounds ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (and (<= 0 (get_flow f x y)) (<= (get_flow f x y) (get_flow c x y))))))
(ghost-fn all_zero ((f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (== (get_flow f x y) 0))))
(lemma cap_limit_of (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cap_ok g c))
  (ensures (cap_limit c))
  (body (assert (cap_limit c))))

(ghost-fn rs ((h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (rs h u (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1))))))
(ghost-fn cs ((h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (cs h u (- m 1)) (get_flow h (- m 1) u)))))
(ghost-fn excess ((h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (n int)) int
  (body (- (cs h u n) (rs h u n))))
(ghost-fn balance ((h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
                              (== (excess h u n) (if (== u x) -1 0))))))
(lemma in_cs (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u m) (cs h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call in_cs g h u (- m 1)))))

(ghost-fn hit ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int)) bool (decreases k)
  (body (if (or (<= k 0) (or (< u 0) (>= u (len g)))) false
          (if (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u)))
            (or (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v) (hit g u (- k 1) v))
            (hit g u (- k 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn pr ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0
          (+ (pr g h u k (- m 1)) (if (hit g u k (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(lemma miss (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (j int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k j)) (< j (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (not (hit g u k (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (targets_ok (idx g u) (len g)))
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))
        (call miss g u (- k 1) j)))))
(lemma hit_of (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (hit g u k (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (== i (- k 1)) (block) (call hit_of g u (- k 1) i))))
(lemma pr_none (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (<= k 0))
  (ensures (== (pr g h u k m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call pr_none g h u k (- m 1)))))
(lemma pr_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (w int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u))))
            (== w (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) (not (hit g u k w)))
  (ensures (== (pr g h u (+ k 1) m) (+ (pr g h u k m) (if (and (<= 0 w) (< w m)) (get_flow h u w) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (<= m 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call pr_step g h u k w (- m 1))
        (assert (== (hit g u (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (or (== w (- m 1)) (hit g u k (- m 1)))))))))
(lemma sout_pr (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (pr g h u k (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (call pr_none g h u 0 (len g))
      (block
        (call sout_pr g h u (- k 1))
        (call targets_at g u (- k 1))
        (call miss g u (- k 1) (- k 1))
        (call pr_step g h u (- k 1) (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g))))))
(lemma pr_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (forall ((vb int)) (=> (not (hit g u (len (idx g u)) vb)) (== (get_flow h u vb) 0))))
  (ensures (== (pr g h u (len (idx g u)) m) (rs h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call pr_full g h u (- m 1)))))
(ghost-fn flow_pt ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int)) bool
  (body (and (>= (get_flow h x y) 0)
             (=> (> (get_flow h x y) 0)
                 (exists ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g x y cc) (<= (get_flow h x y) cc)))))))
(ghost-fn flow_like ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (flow_pt g h x y))))
(lemma cap_hit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (has_capacity g x y z))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (hit g x (len (idx g x)) y)))
  (body
    (obtain ((ie int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 ie) (< ie (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) ie) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) ie) 1) z))))
    (call hit_of g x (len (idx g x)) ie)))
(lemma nohit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_like g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (=> (not (hit g u (len (idx g u)) v)) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (flow_pt g h u v))
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cc) (<= (get_flow h u v) cc)))
        (call cap_hit g u v cc))
      (block))))
(lemma out_rs (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (flow_like g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (rs h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call sout_pr g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (forall ((vb int)) (call nohit g h u vb))
    (call pr_full g h u (len g))
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g h u) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (len (idx g u)))))))
(lemma exc_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (flow_like g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_in g h u) (total_flow_out g h u)) (excess h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call out_rs g h u)
    (call in_cs g h u (len g))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (len g))))))
(lemma cons_pt1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (flow_like g h) (is_conserved g h s t))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t))) (== (excess h u (len g)) 0)))
  (body (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (call exc_eq g h u) (block))))
(lemma cons_pt2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (flow_like g h) (balance h s t s (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
               (== (total_flow_in g h u) (total_flow_out g h u))))
  (body (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (call exc_eq g h u) (block))))
(lemma bal_of (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (flow_like g h) (is_conserved g h s t))
  (ensures (balance h s t s (len g)))
  (body
    (forall ((ub int)) (call cons_pt1 g h s t ub))
    (assert (balance h s t s (len g)))))

(ghost-fn wt ((b (seq bool)) (u int) (v int) (a int)) int
  (body (if (mem b u) (if (mem b v) 0 a) (if (mem b v) (- 0 a) 0))))
(ghost-fn rd ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (rd h b u (- m 1)) (wt b u (- m 1) (get_flow h u (- m 1)))))))
(ghost-fn tot ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (tot h b (- a 1) n) (rd h b (- a 1) n)))))
(ghost-fn ri ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (ri h b u (- m 1)) (if (mem b (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn rr ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (q int) (a int)) int (decreases q)
  (body (if (<= q 0) 0 (+ (rr h b (- q 1) a) (ri h b (- q 1) a)))))
(ghost-fn cc ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (q int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (cc h b (- a 1) q) (if (mem b (- a 1)) (cs h (- a 1) q) 0)))))
(ghost-fn sx ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (sx h b (- a 1) n) (if (mem b (- a 1)) (- 0 (excess h (- a 1) n)) 0)))))
(lemma rd_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (m int))
  (ensures (== (rd h b u m) (- (if (mem b u) (rs h u m) 0) (ri h b u m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call rd_split h b u (- m 1)))))
(lemma rr_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (q int))
  (ensures (== (rr h b q 0) 0))
  (decreases q)
  (body (if (<= q 0) (block) (call rr_zero h b (- q 1)))))
(lemma rr_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (q int) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (rr h b q (+ a 1)) (+ (rr h b q a) (if (mem b a) (cs h a q) 0))))
  (decreases q)
  (body (if (<= q 0) (block) (call rr_step h b (- q 1) a))))
(lemma swap (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (q int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (cc h b a q) (rr h b q a)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (== a 0)
      (call rr_zero h b q)
      (block
        (call swap h b (- a 1) q)
        (call rr_step h b q (- a 1))))))
(lemma sx_tot (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (n int))
  (ensures (== (sx h b a n) (- (+ (tot h b a n) (rr h b a n)) (cc h b a n))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call sx_tot h b (- a 1) n)
        (call rd_split h b (- a 1) n)))))
(lemma sx_val (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (balance h s t s n) (mem b s) (not (mem b t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (<= a n))
  (ensures (== (sx h b a n) (if (< s a) (- 0 (excess h s n)) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) (block) (call sx_val h b s t n (- a 1)))))
(lemma val_tot (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (balance h s t s n) (mem b s) (not (mem b t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (tot h b n n) (- 0 (excess h s n))))
  (body
    (call sx_val h b s t n n)
    (call sx_tot h b n n)
    (call swap h b n n)))
(ghost-fn dom ((h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
        (<= (wt b u v (get_flow h u v)) (wt b u v (get_flow f u v)))))))
(lemma rd_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (dom h f b n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= m n))
  (ensures (<= (rd h b u m) (rd f b u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call rd_mono h f b n u (- m 1)))))
(lemma tot_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (dom h f b n) (<= a n))
  (ensures (<= (tot h b a n) (tot f b a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call tot_mono h f b n (- a 1))
        (call rd_mono h f b n (- a 1) n)))))

(ghost-fn res ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (or (< (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)) (> (get_flow f v u) 0))))
(ghost-fn clo_pt ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (mem b u) (res c f u v)) (mem b v))))
(ghost-fn row_scan ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y v)) (clo_pt c f b u y)))))
(ghost-fn scanned ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x u)) (row_scan c f b x n)))))
(lemma flow_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_pt g h u v) (cap_ok g c))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v)))
  (body
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((cc1 int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cc1) (<= (get_flow h u v) cc1)))
        (assert (<= cc1 (get_flow c u v))))
      (assert (>= (get_flow c u v) 0)))))
(lemma dom_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int)))
                      (b (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_like g h) (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f) (scanned c f b n n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (<= (wt b u v (get_flow h u v)) (wt b u v (get_flow f u v))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_pt g h u v))
    (call flow_le g c h u v)
    (assert (row_scan c f b u n))
    (assert (clo_pt c f b u v))
    (assert (row_scan c f b v n))
    (assert (clo_pt c f b v u))
    (assert (== (res c f u v) (or (< (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)) (> (get_flow f v u) 0))))
    (assert (== (res c f v u) (or (< (get_flow f v u) (get_flow c v u)) (> (get_flow f u v) 0))))))
(lemma flow_pt_of (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (flow_pt g h x y))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len h))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx h x)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow h x y) (idx (idx h x) y)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx h x) y) 0))
        (assert (=> (> (idx (idx h x) y) 0)
                    (exists ((cc1 int)) (and (has_capacity g x y cc1) (<= (idx (idx h x) y) cc1))))))
      (assert (== (get_flow h x y) 0)))))
(lemma fl_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f))
  (ensures (flow_pt g f x y))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f x y)) (<= (get_flow f x y) (get_flow c x y))))
    (if (> (get_flow f x y) 0)
      (block
        (assert (has_capacity g x y (get_flow c x y)))
        (assert (and (has_capacity g x y (get_flow c x y)) (<= (get_flow f x y) (get_flow c x y)))))
      (block))))
(lemma val_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x)))))
               (and (>= (idx (idx f x) y) 0)
                    (=> (> (idx (idx f x) y) 0)
                        (exists ((cc1 int)) (and (has_capacity g x y cc1) (<= (idx (idx f x) y) cc1)))))))
  (body
    (call fl_pt g c f x y)
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x)))))
      (assert (== (get_flow f x y) (idx (idx f x) y)))
      (block))))
(lemma valid_of (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f) (balance f s t s (len g)))
  (ensures (flow_like g f) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (forall ((xb int) (yb int)) (call fl_pt g c f xb yb))
    (assert (flow_like g f))
    (forall ((xb int) (yb int)) (call val_pt g c f xb yb))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (forall ((ub int)) (call cons_pt2 g f s t ub))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))
(lemma upper (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool))
                     (s int) (t int) (n int) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f) (flow_like g f) (balance f s t s n)
            (mem b s) (not (mem b t)) (scanned c f b n n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g h s)))
  (body
    (forall ((xb int) (yb int)) (call flow_pt_of g h s t xb yb))
    (assert (flow_like g h))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (call bal_of g h s t)
    (forall ((ub int) (vb int)) (call dom_at g c f h b n ub vb))
    (assert (dom h f b n))
    (call val_tot h b s t n)
    (call val_tot f b s t n)
    (call tot_mono h f b n n)
    (call exc_eq g h s)
    (call exc_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- 0 (excess h s n))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) (- 0 (excess f s n))))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool))
                      (s int) (t int) (n int) (total int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f) (balance f s t s n)
            (== (excess f s n) (- 0 total)) (mem b s) (not (mem b t)) (scanned c f b n n)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures (exists ((m (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g m s t) (== (flow_val g m s) total))))
  (body
    (call valid_of g c f s t)
    (forall ((h (seq (seq int)))) (call upper g c f b s t n h))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))
    (call exc_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) total))
    (assert (and (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) total)))))

(lemma sums_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (all_zero f))
  (ensures (== (rs f u m) 0) (== (cs f u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call sums_zero f u (- m 1)))))
(lemma zero_start (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_limit c) (all_zero f))
  (ensures (cap_bounds c f) (balance f s t s n) (== (excess f s n) 0))
  (body
    (forall ((ub int)) (call sums_zero f ub n))
    (assert (cap_bounds c f))
    (assert (balance f s t s n))
    (assert (== (excess f s n) 0))))
(lemma sums_bd (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (cap_limit c) (cap_bounds c f) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (<= (rs f u m) (* 100000 m)) (>= (cs f u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (== m 0) (block) (call sums_bd c f u (- m 1)))))
(lemma flow_bound (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_limit c) (cap_bounds c f) (and (<= 0 n) (<= n 1000)))
  (ensures (<= (- 0 (excess f s n)) 100000000))
