    (assert (is_walk es p x y))
    (call conn_intro es p x y)))
(lemma rev_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (r (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (is_rev p r) (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx r k) (idx r (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let m0 int (- (- (- (len p) 1) k) 1))
    (call follows_at es p m0)
    (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p (+ m0 1))))
    (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p m0)))
    (call edge_sym es (idx p m0) (idx p (+ m0 1)))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected es y x))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (seq-build (len p) (fn (m) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) m)))))
    (assert (is_rev p r))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rev_step es p r k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es r))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) y))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) x))
    (assert (is_walk es r y x))
    (call conn_intro es r y x)))
(lemma trans_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (y int) (r (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (trans_ctx es p q y r) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len r) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx r k) (idx r (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len r) (+ (len p) (- (len q) 1))))
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (call follows_at es p k)
        (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== (+ k 1) (len p))
        (block
          (call follows_at es q 0)
          (assert (== (idx r k) (idx q 0)))
          (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx q 1))))
        (block
          (call follows_at es q (+ (- k (len p)) 1))
          (assert (== (idx r k) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 1))))
          (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ (+ (- k (len p)) 1) 1)))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y) (edges_connected es y z))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x z))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) y) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges es q)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat p (drop q 1)))
    (assert (trans_ctx es p q y r))
    (forall ((k int)) (call trans_step es p q y r k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es r))
    (assert (== (len r) (+ (len p) (- (len q) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) x))
    (if (== (len q) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== y z))
        (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) z)))
      (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1)))))
    (assert (is_walk es r x z))
    (call conn_intro es r x z)))
(lemma chain (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (w (seq int)) (lo int) (hi int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi)) (< hi (len w))) (chain_ok es w lo hi))
  (ensures (edges_connected es (idx w lo) (idx w hi)))
  (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body
    (if (== lo hi)
      (call conn_refl es (idx w lo))
      (block
        (assert (chain_ok es w lo (- hi 1)))
        (call chain es w lo (- hi 1))
        (assert (edges_connected es (idx w (- hi 1)) (idx w (+ (- hi 1) 1))))
        (call conn_trans es (idx w lo) (idx w (- hi 1)) (idx w hi))))))
(lemma transfer_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (w (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (embeds a b) (path_follows_edges a w) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len w) 1))))
  (ensures (edges_connected b (idx w k) (idx w (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (call follows_at a w k)
    (assert (embeds a b))))
(lemma conn_transfer (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (embeds a b) (edges_connected a x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected b x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((w (seq int))) (and (and (> (len w) 0) (and (== (idx w 0) x) (== (idx w (- (len w) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges a w)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call transfer_step a b w k))
    (assert (chain_ok b w 0 (- (len w) 1)))
    (call chain b w 0 (- (len w) 1))))
(lemma span_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (embeds a b) (is_spanning g a) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))))
  (ensures (edges_connected b x y))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected a x y))
    (call conn_transfer a b x y)))
(lemma span_transfer (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (embeds a b) (is_spanning g a))
  (ensures (is_spanning g b))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call span_one g a b x y))))

(lemma cut_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (r (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (cut_ctx es p i j r) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len r) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx r k) (idx r (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len r) (+ i (- (len p) j))))
    (if (< (+ k 1) i)
      (block
        (call follows_at es p k)
        (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== (+ k 1) i)
        (block
          (call follows_at es p k)
          (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p k)))
          (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p j)))
          (assert (== (idx p j) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
        (block
          (call follows_at es p (+ (- k i) j))
          (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p (+ (- k i) j))))
          (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ (+ (- k i) j) 1)))))))))
(lemma simple_walk (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_walk es p x y))
  (ensures (exists ((q (seq int))) (and (is_walk es q x y) (distinct_walk q))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (distinct_walk p)
      (assert (and (is_walk es p x y) (distinct_walk p)))
      (block
        (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat (take p i) (drop p j)))
        (assert (cut_ctx es p i j r))
        (forall ((k int)) (call cut_step es p i j r k))
        (assert (path_follows_edges es r))
        (assert (== (len r) (+ i (- (len p) j))))
        (assert (== (idx r 0) x))
        (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) y))
        (assert (is_walk es r x y))
        (call simple_walk es r x y)))))
(lemma distinct_eq (params (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (distinct_walk q) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len q))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len q))) (== (idx q i) (idx q j)))
  (ensures (== i j))
  (body (assert (distinct_walk q))))
(lemma find_cross (params (s (seq bool)) (q (seq int)) (lo int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 lo) (< lo (len q))) (!= (ins s (idx q lo)) (ins s (idx q (- (len q) 1)))))
  (ensures (exists ((k int)) (and (and (<= lo k) (< k (- (len q) 1))) (!= (ins s (idx q k)) (ins s (idx q (+ k 1)))))))
  (decreases (- (len q) lo))
  (body
    (assert (< lo (- (len q) 1)))
    (if (!= (ins s (idx q lo)) (ins s (idx q (+ lo 1))))
      (assert (and (and (<= lo lo) (< lo (- (len q) 1))) (!= (ins s (idx q lo)) (ins s (idx q (+ lo 1))))))
      (call find_cross s q (+ lo 1)))))

(lemma total_concat (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat a b)) (+ (total_weight a) (total_weight b))))
  (decreases (len a))
  (body
    (if (== (len a) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (concat a b) b))
        (assert (== (total_weight a) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (== (drop (concat a b) 1) (concat (drop a 1) b)))
        (call total_concat (drop a 1) b)
        (assert (== (idx (concat a b) 0) (idx a 0)))
        (assert (== (total_weight a) (+ (get (idx a 0) 2) (total_weight (drop a 1)))))
        (assert (== (total_weight (concat a b)) (+ (get (idx (concat a b) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (concat a b) 1)))))))))
(lemma total_unit (params (f (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (seq-lit f)) (get f 2)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (seq-lit f)) 1))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit f) 0) f))
    (assert (== (len (drop (seq-lit f) 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight (drop (seq-lit f) 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight (seq-lit f)) (+ (get (idx (seq-lit f) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (seq-lit f) 1)))))))
(lemma swapped_len (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest))))
  (ensures (== (len (swapped t rest e j)) (+ (len t) (len rest))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat t (seq-lit e))) (+ (len t) 1)))
    (assert (== (len (take rest j)) j))
    (assert (== (len (drop rest (+ j 1))) (- (len rest) (+ j 1))))
    (assert (== (len (concat (take rest j) (drop rest (+ j 1)))) (- (len rest) 1)))))
(lemma swapped_at (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len t) (len rest)))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (swapped t rest e j)) (+ (len t) (len rest)))
    (=> (< k (len t)) (== (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) (idx t k)))
    (=> (== k (len t)) (== (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) e))
    (=> (and (< (len t) k) (<= k (+ (len t) j))) (== (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) (idx rest (- (- k (len t)) 1))))
    (=> (< (+ (len t) j) k) (== (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) (idx rest (- k (len t))))))
  (body
    (call swapped_len t rest e j)
    (ghost-let a0 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat t (seq-lit e)))
    (ghost-let r0 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat (take rest j) (drop rest (+ j 1))))
    (assert (== (swapped t rest e j) (concat a0 r0)))
    (assert (== (len a0) (+ (len t) 1)))
    (assert (== (len r0) (- (len rest) 1)))
    (if (< k (len t))
      (assert (== (idx a0 k) (idx t k)))
      (if (== k (len t))
        (assert (== (idx a0 k) e))
        (if (<= k (+ (len t) j))
          (assert (== (idx r0 (- (- k (len t)) 1)) (idx rest (- (- k (len t)) 1))))
          (assert (== (idx r0 (- (- k (len t)) 1)) (idx rest (- k (len t))))))))))
(lemma keep_edge (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (k int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest))) (!= k (+ (len t) j)) (pair_at (concat t rest) k x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (swapped t rest e j) x y))
  (body
    (call swapped_len t rest e j)
    (ghost-let m int (if (and (<= (len t) k) (< k (+ (len t) j))) (+ k 1) k))
    (call swapped_at t rest e j m)
    (assert (== (idx (swapped t rest e j) m) (idx (concat t rest) k)))
    (assert (pair_at (swapped t rest e j) m x y))
    (call edge_intro (swapped t rest e j) m x y)))
(lemma keep_pair (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (a int) (b int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (pair_at (concat t rest) (+ (len t) j) a b)
    (edge_in_set (concat t rest) x y)
    (not (or (and (== x a) (== y b)) (and (== x b) (== y a)))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (swapped t rest e j) x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len (concat t rest))))
                           (or (and (== (get (idx (concat t rest) c) 0) x) (== (get (idx (concat t rest) c) 1) y))
                               (and (== (get (idx (concat t rest) c) 0) y) (== (get (idx (concat t rest) c) 1) x)))))
    (assert (pair_at (concat t rest) c x y))
    (assert (!= c (+ (len t) j)))
    (call keep_edge t rest e j c x y)))
(lemma embed_one (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (a int) (b int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (pair_at (concat t rest) (+ (len t) j) a b)
    (edges_connected (swapped t rest e j) a b)
    (edge_in_set (concat t rest) x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped t rest e j) x y))
  (body
    (if (and (== x a) (== y b))
      (block)
      (if (and (== x b) (== y a))
        (call conn_sym (swapped t rest e j) a b)
        (block
          (call keep_pair t rest e j a b x y)
          (call conn_step (swapped t rest e j) x y))))))
(lemma embed_all (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (pair_at (concat t rest) (+ (len t) j) a b)
    (edges_connected (swapped t rest e j) a b))
  (ensures (embeds (concat t rest) (swapped t rest e j)))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call embed_one t rest e j a b x y))))
(lemma walk_step_nt (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (q (seq int)) (k0 int) (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (walk_ctx t rest j q k0)
    (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (len q) 1))) (!= i k0)))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped t rest e j) (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call follows_at (concat t rest) q i)
    (if (== (idx q i) (idx q k0)) (call distinct_eq q i k0) (block))
    (if (and (== (idx q i) (idx q (+ k0 1))) (== (idx q (+ i 1)) (idx q k0)))
      (block
        (call distinct_eq q i (+ k0 1))
        (call distinct_eq q (+ i 1) k0))
      (block))
    (call keep_pair t rest e j (idx q k0) (idx q (+ k0 1)) (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1)))
    (call conn_step (swapped t rest e j) (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1)))))
(lemma ab_connected (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (q (seq int)) (k0 int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (walk_ctx t rest j q k0)
    (== (idx q 0) (get e 0))
    (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (get e 1)))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped t rest e j) (idx q k0) (idx q (+ k0 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call walk_step_nt t rest e j q k0 i))
    (assert (chain_ok (swapped t rest e j) q 0 k0))
    (call chain (swapped t rest e j) q 0 k0)
    (assert (chain_ok (swapped t rest e j) q (+ k0 1) (- (len q) 1)))
    (call chain (swapped t rest e j) q (+ k0 1) (- (len q) 1))
    (call swapped_len t rest e j)
    (call swapped_at t rest e j (len t))
    (assert (pair_at (swapped t rest e j) (len t) (get e 0) (get e 1)))
    (call edge_intro (swapped t rest e j) (len t) (get e 0) (get e 1))
    (call conn_step (swapped t rest e j) (get e 0) (get e 1))
    (call conn_sym (swapped t rest e j) (idx q 0) (idx q k0))
    (call conn_trans (swapped t rest e j) (idx q k0) (get e 0) (get e 1))
    (call conn_sym (swapped t rest e j) (idx q (+ k0 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1)))
    (call conn_trans (swapped t rest e j) (idx q k0) (get e 1) (idx q (+ k0 1)))))
(lemma valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len es))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx es m) 0) (get (idx es m) 1) (get (idx es m) 2)))
  (body (assert (are_valid_edges g es))))
(lemma valid_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (are_valid_edges g (concat t rest))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (swapped t rest e j)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) 0) (get (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) 1) (get (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call swapped_len t rest e j)
    (call swapped_at t rest e j k)
    (if (== k (len t))
      (block)
      (block
        (ghost-let m int (if (and (< (len t) k) (<= k (+ (len t) j))) (- k 1) k))
        (assert (== (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) (idx (concat t rest) m)))
        (call valid_at g (concat t rest) m)))))
(lemma valid_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (are_valid_edges g (concat t rest))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (swapped t rest e j)))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_step g t rest e j k))))
(lemma swap_weight (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (swapped t rest e j)) (+ (- (total_weight (concat t rest)) (get (idx rest j) 2)) (get e 2))))
  (body
    (ghost-let r1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (take rest j))
    (ghost-let r2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop rest (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let f (tuple int int int) (idx rest j))
    (assert (== rest (concat r1 (concat (seq-lit f) r2))))
    (call total_concat t rest)
    (call total_concat r1 (concat (seq-lit f) r2))
    (call total_concat (seq-lit f) r2)
    (call total_unit f)
    (call total_concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) (concat r1 r2))
    (call total_concat t (seq-lit e))
    (call total_unit e)
    (call total_concat r1 r2)
    (assert (== (swapped t rest e j) (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) (concat r1 r2))))))
(lemma cross_outside (params (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (c int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (inside s t) (pair_at (concat t rest) c a b) (!= (ins s a) (ins s b)))
  (ensures (>= c (len t)))
  (body
    (if (< c (len t))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat t rest) c) (idx t c)))
        (assert (and (ins s (get (idx t c) 0)) (ins s (get (idx t c) 1)))))
      (block))))
(lemma exchange_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (q (seq int)) (k0 int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (is_spanning_tree g (concat t rest))
    (walk_ctx t rest j q k0)
    (== (idx q 0) (get e 0))
    (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (get e 1))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (!= (ins s (idx q k0)) (ins s (idx q (+ k0 1))))
    (min_cross g s (get e 2)))
  (ensures
    (is_spanning_tree g (swapped t rest e j))
    (<= (total_weight (swapped t rest e j)) (total_weight (concat t rest))))
  (body
    (ghost-let ot (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat t rest))
    (ghost-let nt (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped t rest e j))
    (call swapped_len t rest e j)
    (call ab_connected t rest e j q k0)
    (call embed_all t rest e j (idx q k0) (idx q (+ k0 1)))
    (call span_transfer g ot nt)
    (call valid_all g t rest e j)
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g nt))
    (ghost-let f (tuple int int int) (idx ot (+ (len t) j)))
    (assert (== f (idx rest j)))
    (call valid_at g ot (+ (len t) j))
    (assert (!= (ins s (get f 0)) (ins s (get f 1))))
    (assert (<= (get e 2) (get f 2)))
    (call swap_weight t rest e j)))
(lemma exchange (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires
    (is_spanning_tree g (concat t rest))
    (inside s t)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (!= (ins s (get e 0)) (ins s (get e 1)))
    (min_cross g s (get e 2))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 (get e 1)) (< (get e 1) (len g)))))
  (ensures (exists ((r2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) r2))
         (<= (total_weight (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) r2)) (total_weight (concat t rest))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let ot (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat t rest))
    (assert (is_spanning g ot))
    (assert (edges_connected ot (get e 0) (get e 1)))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) (get e 0)) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (get e 1)))) (path_follows_edges ot p)))

(ghost-fn walk_ctx ((t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (q (seq int)) (k0 int)) bool
  (body (and (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest))) (distinct_walk q))
             (and (and (path_follows_edges (concat t rest) q) (and (<= 0 k0) (< k0 (- (len q) 1))))
                  (pair_at (concat t rest) (+ (len t) j) (idx q k0) (idx q (+ k0 1)))))))
(ghost-fn inside ((s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t))) (and (ins s (get (idx t k) 0)) (ins s (get (idx t k) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn tree_conn ((s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (ins s x) (edges_connected t 0 x)))))
(ghost-fn min_cross ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (w int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int) (c int))
    (=> (and (has_edge g a b c) (!= (ins s a) (ins s b))) (<= w c)))))
(ghost-fn good ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (exists ((r (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat t r)) (<= (total_weight (concat t r)) (total_weight other))))))
(ghost-fn safe ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (=> (is_spanning_tree g other) (good g t other)))))
(ghost-fn scanned ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (x int) (j int) (found bool) (bw int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
             (and (or (< a x) (and (== a x) (< i j)))
                  (!= (ins s a) (ins s (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0)))))
        (and found (<= bw (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn best ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (found bool) (a int) (b int) (c int)) bool
  (body (=> found
    (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
         (and (has_edge g a b c) (!= (ins s a) (ins s b)))))))
(ghost-fn all_false ((s (seq bool))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))) (not (idx s k))))))
(ghost-fn upd ((s (seq bool)) (s2 (seq bool)) (y int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s2) (len s)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len s))))
             (and (and (not (idx s y)) (idx s2 y))
                  (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))) (!= k y)) (== (idx s2 k) (idx s k))))))))
(ghost-fn cut_edge ((e (tuple int int int)) (z int) (y int)) bool
  (body (or (and (== (get e 0) z) (== (get e 1) y)) (and (== (get e 0) y) (== (get e 1) z)))))
(ghost-fn ct ((s (seq bool))) int (decreases (len s))
  (body (if (== (len s) 0) 0 (+ (ct (take s (- (len s) 1))) (if (last s) 1 0)))))

(lemma ct_zero (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (all_false s))
  (ensures (== (ct s) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (all_false (take s (- (len s) 1))))
        (call ct_zero (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (assert (not (last s)))))))
(lemma ct_update (params (s (seq bool)) (s2 (seq bool)) (y int))
  (requires (upd s s2 y))
  (ensures (== (ct s2) (+ (ct s) 1)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (ghost-let n1 int (- (len s) 1))
    (ghost-let h (seq bool) (take s n1))
    (ghost-let h2 (seq bool) (take s2 n1))
    (if (== y n1)
      (block
        (assert (== h2 h))
        (assert (not (last s)))
        (assert (last s2))
        (assert (== (ct s2) (+ (ct h2) 1)))
        (assert (== (ct s) (ct h))))
      (block
        (assert (upd h h2 y))
        (call ct_update h h2 y)
        (assert (== (last s2) (last s)))
        (assert (== (ct s2) (+ (ct h2) (if (last s2) 1 0))))
        (assert (== (ct s) (+ (ct h) (if (last s) 1 0))))))))
(lemma ct_le (params (s (seq bool)))
  (ensures (<= (ct s) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
      (block)
      (call ct_le (take s (- (len s) 1))))))
(lemma ct_false (params (s (seq bool)) (y int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len s))) (not (idx s y)))
  (ensures (<= (ct s) (- (len s) 1)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== y (- (len s) 1))
      (block
        (call ct_le (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (assert (not (last s))))
      (block
        (assert (not (idx (take s (- (len s) 1)) y)))
        (call ct_false (take s (- (len s) 1)) y)))))
(lemma ct_exists (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (< (ct s) (len s)))
  (ensures (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))) (not (idx s i)))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (not (last s))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- (len s) 1)) (< (- (len s) 1) (len s))) (not (idx s (- (len s) 1)))))
      (block
        (call ct_exists (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (obtain ((i1 int)) (and (and (<= 0 i1) (< i1 (len (take s (- (len s) 1))))) (not (idx (take s (- (len s) 1)) i1))))
        (assert (not (idx s i1)))
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 i1) (< i1 (len s))) (not (idx s i1))))))))
(lemma ct_full (params (s (seq bool)) (x int))
  (requires (== (ct s) (len s)) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len s))))
  (ensures (idx s x))
  (body (if (idx s x) (block) (call ct_false s x))))
(lemma ins_new (params (s (seq bool)) (s2 (seq bool)) (y int) (x int))
  (requires (upd s s2 y))
  (ensures (== (ins s2 x) (or (ins s x) (== x y))))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len s)))
      (if (== x y) (block) (assert (== (idx s2 x) (idx s x))))
      (block))))

(lemma edge_intro (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (c int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (pair_at es c x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es x y))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len es)))
                 (or (and (== (get (idx es c) 0) x) (== (get (idx es c) 1) y))
                     (and (== (get (idx es c) 0) y) (== (get (idx es c) 1) x)))))))
(lemma edge_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es y x))
  (body
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len es)))
                           (or (and (== (get (idx es c) 0) x) (== (get (idx es c) 1) y))
                               (and (== (get (idx es c) 0) y) (== (get (idx es c) 1) x)))))
    (call edge_intro es c y x)))
(lemma follows_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body (assert (path_follows_edges es p))))
(lemma conn_intro (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_walk es p x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x y))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))))
(lemma conn_refl (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x x))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit x))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) x))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (assert (is_walk es p x x))
    (call conn_intro es p x x)))
(lemma conn_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x y))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit x y))
    (assert (== (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) x))
    (assert (== (idx p 1) y))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (assert (is_walk es p x y))
    (call conn_intro es p x y)))
(lemma rev_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (r (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (is_rev p r) (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx r k) (idx r (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let m0 int (- (- (- (len p) 1) k) 1))
    (call follows_at es p m0)
    (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p (+ m0 1))))
    (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p m0)))
    (call edge_sym es (idx p m0) (idx p (+ m0 1)))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected es y x))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (seq-build (len p) (fn (m) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) m)))))
    (assert (is_rev p r))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rev_step es p r k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es r))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) y))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) x))
    (assert (is_walk es r y x))
    (call conn_intro es r y x)))
(lemma trans_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (y int) (r (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (trans_ctx es p q y r) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len r) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx r k) (idx r (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len r) (+ (len p) (- (len q) 1))))
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (call follows_at es p k)
        (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== (+ k 1) (len p))
        (block
          (call follows_at es q 0)
          (assert (== (idx r k) (idx q 0)))
          (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx q 1))))
        (block
          (call follows_at es q (+ (- k (len p)) 1))
          (assert (== (idx r k) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 1))))
          (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ (+ (- k (len p)) 1) 1)))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y) (edges_connected es y z))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x z))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) y) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges es q)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat p (drop q 1)))
    (assert (trans_ctx es p q y r))
    (forall ((k int)) (call trans_step es p q y r k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es r))
    (assert (== (len r) (+ (len p) (- (len q) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) x))
    (if (== (len q) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== y z))
        (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) z)))
      (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1)))))
    (assert (is_walk es r x z))
    (call conn_intro es r x z)))
(lemma chain (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (w (seq int)) (lo int) (hi int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi)) (< hi (len w))) (chain_ok es w lo hi))
  (ensures (edges_connected es (idx w lo) (idx w hi)))
  (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body
    (if (== lo hi)
      (call conn_refl es (idx w lo))
      (block
        (assert (chain_ok es w lo (- hi 1)))
        (call chain es w lo (- hi 1))
        (assert (edges_connected es (idx w (- hi 1)) (idx w (+ (- hi 1) 1))))
        (call conn_trans es (idx w lo) (idx w (- hi 1)) (idx w hi))))))
(lemma transfer_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (w (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (embeds a b) (path_follows_edges a w) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len w) 1))))
  (ensures (edges_connected b (idx w k) (idx w (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (call follows_at a w k)
    (assert (embeds a b))))
(lemma conn_transfer (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (embeds a b) (edges_connected a x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected b x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((w (seq int))) (and (and (> (len w) 0) (and (== (idx w 0) x) (== (idx w (- (len w) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges a w)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call transfer_step a b w k))
    (assert (chain_ok b w 0 (- (len w) 1)))
    (call chain b w 0 (- (len w) 1))))
(lemma span_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (embeds a b) (is_spanning g a) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))))
  (ensures (edges_connected b x y))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected a x y))
    (call conn_transfer a b x y)))
(lemma span_transfer (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (embeds a b) (is_spanning g a))
  (ensures (is_spanning g b))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call span_one g a b x y))))

(lemma cut_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (r (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (cut_ctx es p i j r) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len r) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx r k) (idx r (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len r) (+ i (- (len p) j))))
    (if (< (+ k 1) i)
      (block
        (call follows_at es p k)
        (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== (+ k 1) i)
        (block
          (call follows_at es p k)
          (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p k)))
          (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p j)))
          (assert (== (idx p j) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
        (block
          (call follows_at es p (+ (- k i) j))
          (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p (+ (- k i) j))))
          (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ (+ (- k i) j) 1)))))))))
(lemma simple_walk (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_walk es p x y))
  (ensures (exists ((q (seq int))) (and (is_walk es q x y) (distinct_walk q))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (distinct_walk p)
      (assert (and (is_walk es p x y) (distinct_walk p)))
      (block
        (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat (take p i) (drop p j)))
        (assert (cut_ctx es p i j r))
        (forall ((k int)) (call cut_step es p i j r k))
        (assert (path_follows_edges es r))
        (assert (== (len r) (+ i (- (len p) j))))
        (assert (== (idx r 0) x))
        (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) y))
        (assert (is_walk es r x y))
        (call simple_walk es r x y)))))
(lemma distinct_eq (params (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (distinct_walk q) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len q))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len q))) (== (idx q i) (idx q j)))
  (ensures (== i j))
  (body (assert (distinct_walk q))))
(lemma find_cross (params (s (seq bool)) (q (seq int)) (lo int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 lo) (< lo (len q))) (!= (ins s (idx q lo)) (ins s (idx q (- (len q) 1)))))
  (ensures (exists ((k int)) (and (and (<= lo k) (< k (- (len q) 1))) (!= (ins s (idx q k)) (ins s (idx q (+ k 1)))))))
  (decreases (- (len q) lo))
  (body
    (assert (< lo (- (len q) 1)))
    (if (!= (ins s (idx q lo)) (ins s (idx q (+ lo 1))))
      (assert (and (and (<= lo lo) (< lo (- (len q) 1))) (!= (ins s (idx q lo)) (ins s (idx q (+ lo 1))))))
      (call find_cross s q (+ lo 1)))))

(lemma total_concat (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat a b)) (+ (total_weight a) (total_weight b))))
  (decreases (len a))
  (body
    (if (== (len a) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (concat a b) b))
        (assert (== (total_weight a) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (== (drop (concat a b) 1) (concat (drop a 1) b)))
        (call total_concat (drop a 1) b)
        (assert (== (idx (concat a b) 0) (idx a 0)))
        (assert (== (total_weight a) (+ (get (idx a 0) 2) (total_weight (drop a 1)))))
        (assert (== (total_weight (concat a b)) (+ (get (idx (concat a b) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (concat a b) 1)))))))))
(lemma total_unit (params (f (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (seq-lit f)) (get f 2)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (seq-lit f)) 1))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit f) 0) f))
    (assert (== (len (drop (seq-lit f) 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight (drop (seq-lit f) 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight (seq-lit f)) (+ (get (idx (seq-lit f) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (seq-lit f) 1)))))))
(lemma swapped_len (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest))))
  (ensures (== (len (swapped t rest e j)) (+ (len t) (len rest))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat t (seq-lit e))) (+ (len t) 1)))
    (assert (== (len (take rest j)) j))
    (assert (== (len (drop rest (+ j 1))) (- (len rest) (+ j 1))))
    (assert (== (len (concat (take rest j) (drop rest (+ j 1)))) (- (len rest) 1)))))
(lemma swapped_at (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len t) (len rest)))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (swapped t rest e j)) (+ (len t) (len rest)))
    (=> (< k (len t)) (== (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) (idx t k)))
    (=> (== k (len t)) (== (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) e))
    (=> (and (< (len t) k) (<= k (+ (len t) j))) (== (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) (idx rest (- (- k (len t)) 1))))
    (=> (< (+ (len t) j) k) (== (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) (idx rest (- k (len t))))))
  (body
    (call swapped_len t rest e j)
    (ghost-let a0 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat t (seq-lit e)))
    (ghost-let r0 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat (take rest j) (drop rest (+ j 1))))
    (assert (== (swapped t rest e j) (concat a0 r0)))
    (assert (== (len a0) (+ (len t) 1)))
    (assert (== (len r0) (- (len rest) 1)))
    (if (< k (len t))
      (assert (== (idx a0 k) (idx t k)))
      (if (== k (len t))
        (assert (== (idx a0 k) e))
        (if (<= k (+ (len t) j))
          (assert (== (idx r0 (- (- k (len t)) 1)) (idx rest (- (- k (len t)) 1))))
          (assert (== (idx r0 (- (- k (len t)) 1)) (idx rest (- k (len t))))))))))
(lemma keep_edge (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (k int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest))) (!= k (+ (len t) j)) (pair_at (concat t rest) k x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (swapped t rest e j) x y))
  (body
    (call swapped_len t rest e j)
    (ghost-let m int (if (and (<= (len t) k) (< k (+ (len t) j))) (+ k 1) k))
    (call swapped_at t rest e j m)
    (assert (== (idx (swapped t rest e j) m) (idx (concat t rest) k)))
    (assert (pair_at (swapped t rest e j) m x y))
    (call edge_intro (swapped t rest e j) m x y)))
(lemma keep_pair (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (a int) (b int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (pair_at (concat t rest) (+ (len t) j) a b)
    (edge_in_set (concat t rest) x y)
    (not (or (and (== x a) (== y b)) (and (== x b) (== y a)))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (swapped t rest e j) x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len (concat t rest))))
                           (or (and (== (get (idx (concat t rest) c) 0) x) (== (get (idx (concat t rest) c) 1) y))
                               (and (== (get (idx (concat t rest) c) 0) y) (== (get (idx (concat t rest) c) 1) x)))))
    (assert (pair_at (concat t rest) c x y))
    (assert (!= c (+ (len t) j)))
    (call keep_edge t rest e j c x y)))
(lemma embed_one (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (a int) (b int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (pair_at (concat t rest) (+ (len t) j) a b)
    (edges_connected (swapped t rest e j) a b)
    (edge_in_set (concat t rest) x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped t rest e j) x y))
  (body
    (if (and (== x a) (== y b))
      (block)
      (if (and (== x b) (== y a))
        (call conn_sym (swapped t rest e j) a b)
        (block
          (call keep_pair t rest e j a b x y)
          (call conn_step (swapped t rest e j) x y))))))
(lemma embed_all (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (pair_at (concat t rest) (+ (len t) j) a b)
    (edges_connected (swapped t rest e j) a b))
  (ensures (embeds (concat t rest) (swapped t rest e j)))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call embed_one t rest e j a b x y))))
(lemma walk_step_nt (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (q (seq int)) (k0 int) (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (walk_ctx t rest j q k0)
    (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (len q) 1))) (!= i k0)))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped t rest e j) (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call follows_at (concat t rest) q i)
    (if (== (idx q i) (idx q k0)) (call distinct_eq q i k0) (block))
    (if (and (== (idx q i) (idx q (+ k0 1))) (== (idx q (+ i 1)) (idx q k0)))
      (block
        (call distinct_eq q i (+ k0 1))
        (call distinct_eq q (+ i 1) k0))
      (block))
    (call keep_pair t rest e j (idx q k0) (idx q (+ k0 1)) (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1)))
    (call conn_step (swapped t rest e j) (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1)))))
(lemma ab_connected (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (q (seq int)) (k0 int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (walk_ctx t rest j q k0)
    (== (idx q 0) (get e 0))
    (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (get e 1)))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped t rest e j) (idx q k0) (idx q (+ k0 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call walk_step_nt t rest e j q k0 i))
    (assert (chain_ok (swapped t rest e j) q 0 k0))
    (call chain (swapped t rest e j) q 0 k0)
    (assert (chain_ok (swapped t rest e j) q (+ k0 1) (- (len q) 1)))
    (call chain (swapped t rest e j) q (+ k0 1) (- (len q) 1))
    (call swapped_len t rest e j)
    (call swapped_at t rest e j (len t))
    (assert (pair_at (swapped t rest e j) (len t) (get e 0) (get e 1)))
    (call edge_intro (swapped t rest e j) (len t) (get e 0) (get e 1))
    (call conn_step (swapped t rest e j) (get e 0) (get e 1))
    (call conn_sym (swapped t rest e j) (idx q 0) (idx q k0))
    (call conn_trans (swapped t rest e j) (idx q k0) (get e 0) (get e 1))
    (call conn_sym (swapped t rest e j) (idx q (+ k0 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1)))
    (call conn_trans (swapped t rest e j) (idx q k0) (get e 1) (idx q (+ k0 1)))))
(lemma valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len es))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx es m) 0) (get (idx es m) 1) (get (idx es m) 2)))
  (body (assert (are_valid_edges g es))))
(lemma valid_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (are_valid_edges g (concat t rest))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (swapped t rest e j)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) 0) (get (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) 1) (get (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call swapped_len t rest e j)
    (call swapped_at t rest e j k)
    (if (== k (len t))
      (block)
      (block
        (ghost-let m int (if (and (< (len t) k) (<= k (+ (len t) j))) (- k 1) k))
        (assert (== (idx (swapped t rest e j) k) (idx (concat t rest) m)))
        (call valid_at g (concat t rest) m)))))
(lemma valid_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (are_valid_edges g (concat t rest))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (swapped t rest e j)))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_step g t rest e j k))))
(lemma swap_weight (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (swapped t rest e j)) (+ (- (total_weight (concat t rest)) (get (idx rest j) 2)) (get e 2))))
  (body
    (ghost-let r1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (take rest j))
    (ghost-let r2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop rest (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let f (tuple int int int) (idx rest j))
    (assert (== rest (concat r1 (concat (seq-lit f) r2))))
    (call total_concat t rest)
    (call total_concat r1 (concat (seq-lit f) r2))
    (call total_concat (seq-lit f) r2)
    (call total_unit f)
    (call total_concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) (concat r1 r2))
    (call total_concat t (seq-lit e))
    (call total_unit e)
    (call total_concat r1 r2)
    (assert (== (swapped t rest e j) (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) (concat r1 r2))))))
(lemma cross_outside (params (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (c int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (inside s t) (pair_at (concat t rest) c a b) (!= (ins s a) (ins s b)))
  (ensures (>= c (len t)))
  (body
    (if (< c (len t))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat t rest) c) (idx t c)))
        (assert (and (ins s (get (idx t c) 0)) (ins s (get (idx t c) 1)))))
      (block))))
(lemma exchange_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (q (seq int)) (k0 int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest)))
    (is_spanning_tree g (concat t rest))
    (walk_ctx t rest j q k0)
    (== (idx q 0) (get e 0))
    (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (get e 1))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (!= (ins s (idx q k0)) (ins s (idx q (+ k0 1))))
    (min_cross g s (get e 2)))
  (ensures
    (is_spanning_tree g (swapped t rest e j))
    (<= (total_weight (swapped t rest e j)) (total_weight (concat t rest))))
  (body
    (ghost-let ot (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat t rest))
    (ghost-let nt (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped t rest e j))
    (call swapped_len t rest e j)
    (call ab_connected t rest e j q k0)
    (call embed_all t rest e j (idx q k0) (idx q (+ k0 1)))
    (call span_transfer g ot nt)
    (call valid_all g t rest e j)
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g nt))
    (ghost-let f (tuple int int int) (idx ot (+ (len t) j)))
    (assert (== f (idx rest j)))
    (call valid_at g ot (+ (len t) j))
    (assert (!= (ins s (get f 0)) (ins s (get f 1))))
    (assert (<= (get e 2) (get f 2)))
    (call swap_weight t rest e j)))
(lemma exchange (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires
    (is_spanning_tree g (concat t rest))
    (inside s t)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (!= (ins s (get e 0)) (ins s (get e 1)))
    (min_cross g s (get e 2))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 (get e 1)) (< (get e 1) (len g)))))
  (ensures (exists ((r2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) r2))
         (<= (total_weight (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) r2)) (total_weight (concat t rest))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let ot (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat t rest))
    (assert (is_spanning g ot))
    (assert (edges_connected ot (get e 0) (get e 1)))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) (get e 0)) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (get e 1)))) (path_follows_edges ot p)))
    (assert (is_walk ot p (get e 0) (get e 1)))
    (call simple_walk ot p (get e 0) (get e 1))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (is_walk ot q (get e 0) (get e 1)) (distinct_walk q)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges ot q))
    (assert (> (len q) 0))
    (call find_cross s q 0)
    (obtain ((k0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 k0) (< k0 (- (len q) 1))) (!= (ins s (idx q k0)) (ins s (idx q (+ k0 1))))))
    (call follows_at ot q k0)
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len ot)))
                           (or (and (== (get (idx ot c) 0) (idx q k0)) (== (get (idx ot c) 1) (idx q (+ k0 1))))
                               (and (== (get (idx ot c) 0) (idx q (+ k0 1))) (== (get (idx ot c) 1) (idx q k0))))))
    (assert (pair_at ot c (idx q k0) (idx q (+ k0 1))))
    (call cross_outside s t rest c (idx q k0) (idx q (+ k0 1)))
    (ghost-let j int (- c (len t)))
    (assert (== (+ (len t) j) c))
    (assert (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len rest))))
    (assert (walk_ctx t rest j q k0))
    (call exchange_at g s t rest e j q k0)
    (ghost-let nr (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat (take rest j) (drop rest (+ j 1))))
    (assert (== (swapped t rest e j) (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) nr)))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) nr))
                 (<= (total_weight (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) nr)) (total_weight (concat t rest)))))))
(lemma extend_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (safe g t)
    (inside s t)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (!= (ins s (get e 0)) (ins s (get e 1)))
    (min_cross g s (get e 2))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 (get e 1)) (< (get e 1) (len g))))
    (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (good g (concat t (seq-lit e)) other))
  (body
    (assert (good g t other))
    (obtain ((r (seq (tuple int int int)))) (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat t r)) (<= (total_weight (concat t r)) (total_weight other))))
    (call exchange g s t r e)
    (obtain ((r3 (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) r3))
           (<= (total_weight (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) r3)) (total_weight (concat t r)))))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) r3))
                 (<= (total_weight (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) r3)) (total_weight other))))))
(lemma extend_safe (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires
    (safe g t)
    (inside s t)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (!= (ins s (get e 0)) (ins s (get e 1)))
    (min_cross g s (get e 2))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 (get e 1)) (< (get e 1) (len g)))))
  (ensures (safe g (concat t (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call extend_one g s t e o))))
(lemma safe_empty_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len t) 0) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (good g t other))
  (body
    (assert (== (concat t other) other))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat t other)) (<= (total_weight (concat t other)) (total_weight other))))))
(lemma safe_empty (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len t) 0))
  (ensures (safe g t))
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call safe_empty_one g t o))))
(lemma final_min_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (safe g t) (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight t) (total_weight other)))
  (body
    (assert (good g t other))
    (obtain ((r (seq (tuple int int int)))) (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat t r)) (<= (total_weight (concat t r)) (total_weight other))))
    (assert (== (len (concat t r)) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (== (len r) 0))
    (assert (== (concat t r) t))))
(lemma span_pair (params (s (seq bool)) (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires
    (== (ct s) (len s))
    (== (len s) (len g))
    (tree_conn s t)
    (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t x y))
  (body
    (call ct_full s x)
    (call ct_full s y)
    (assert (ins s x))
    (assert (ins s y))
    (assert (edges_connected t 0 x))
    (assert (edges_connected t 0 y))
    (call conn_sym t 0 x)
    (call conn_trans t x 0 y)))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (== (ct s) (len s))
    (== (len s) (len g))
    (tree_conn s t)
    (are_valid_edges g t)
    (== (len t) (- (len g) 1))
    (safe g t))
  (ensures (is_mst g t))
  (body
    (forall ((u1 int) (v1 int)) (call span_pair s g t u1 v1))
    (assert (is_spanning g t))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g t))
    (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call final_min_one g t o))
    (assert (is_mst g t))))

(lemma mono_one (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set t x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat t (seq-lit e)) x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len t)))
                           (or (and (== (get (idx t c) 0) x) (== (get (idx t c) 1) y))
                               (and (== (get (idx t c) 0) y) (== (get (idx t c) 1) x)))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) c) (idx t c)))
    (assert (pair_at (concat t (seq-lit e)) c x y))
    (call edge_intro (concat t (seq-lit e)) c x y)
    (call conn_step (concat t (seq-lit e)) x y)))
(lemma mono_all (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (embeds t (concat t (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call mono_one t e x y))))
(lemma conn_one (params (s (seq bool)) (s2 (seq bool)) (y int) (z int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int))
  (requires (upd s s2 y) (ins s z) (cut_edge e z y) (tree_conn s t) (ins s2 x))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat t (seq-lit e)) 0 x))
  (body
    (call ins_new s s2 y x)
    (call mono_all t e)
    (if (== x y)
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected t 0 z))
        (call conn_transfer t (concat t (seq-lit e)) 0 z)
        (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) (len t)) e))
        (assert (pair_at (concat t (seq-lit e)) (len t) z y))
        (call edge_intro (concat t (seq-lit e)) (len t) z y)
        (call conn_step (concat t (seq-lit e)) z y)
        (call conn_trans (concat t (seq-lit e)) 0 z y))
      (block
        (assert (ins s x))
        (assert (edges_connected t 0 x))
        (call conn_transfer t (concat t (seq-lit e)) 0 x)))))
(lemma extend_conn (params (s (seq bool)) (s2 (seq bool)) (y int) (z int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (upd s s2 y) (ins s z) (cut_edge e z y) (tree_conn s t))
  (ensures (tree_conn s2 (concat t (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call conn_one s s2 y z t e x))))
(lemma ext_inside_one (params (s (seq bool)) (s2 (seq bool)) (y int) (z int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (upd s s2 y) (ins s z) (cut_edge e z y) (inside s t) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (concat t (seq-lit e))))))
  (ensures (and (ins s2 (get (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) 0)) (ins s2 (get (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) 1))))
  (body
    (if (< k (len t))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) (idx t k)))
        (assert (and (ins s (get (idx t k) 0)) (ins s (get (idx t k) 1))))
        (call ins_new s s2 y (get (idx t k) 0))
        (call ins_new s s2 y (get (idx t k) 1)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) e))
        (call ins_new s s2 y z)
        (call ins_new s s2 y y)))))
(lemma extend_inside (params (s (seq bool)) (s2 (seq bool)) (y int) (z int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (upd s s2 y) (ins s z) (cut_edge e z y) (inside s t))
  (ensures (inside s2 (concat t (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call ext_inside_one s s2 y z t e k))))
(lemma ext_valid_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g t) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (concat t (seq-lit e))))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) 0) (get (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) 1) (get (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (< k (len t))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) (idx t k)))
        (call valid_at g t k))
      (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) e)))))
(lemma extend_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g t) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat t (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call ext_valid_one g t e k))))
(lemma base_one (params (s0 (seq bool)) (s (seq bool)) (x int))
  (requires (all_false s0) (upd s0 s 0) (ins s x))
  (ensures (== x 0))
  (body
    (if (== x 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s x) (idx s0 x)))
        (assert (not (idx s0 x)))))))
(lemma base_conn (params (s0 (seq bool)) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (all_false s0) (upd s0 s 0))
  (ensures (tree_conn s t))
  (body
    (call conn_refl t 0)
    (forall ((x int)) (call base_one s0 s x))))

(lemma wf_entry (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (well_formed wg) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (field wg adj)))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field wg adj) u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0) (len (field wg adj)))))

(lemma scan_take (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (x int) (j int) (found bool) (bw int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x))))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1) w)
    (scanned g s x j found bw)
    (!= (ins s x) (ins s v))
    (or (not found) (< w bw)))
  (ensures (scanned g s x (+ j 1) true w) (best g s true x v w))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
                 (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1) w))))
    (assert (has_edge g x v w))
    (assert (scanned g s x j found bw))))
(lemma scan_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (x int) (j int) (found bool) (bw int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x))))
    (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1) w)

(lemma scan_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (x int) (found bool) (bw int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (scanned g s x (len (idx g x)) found bw))

(lemma cross_entry (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (== (len s) (len g)) (ins s 0) (< (ct s) (len s)))
  (ensures (exists ((a int) (i int))
    (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
         (!= (ins s a) (ins s (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0))))))
  (body
    (call ct_exists s)
    (obtain ((y int)) (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len s))) (not (idx s y))))
    (assert (not (ins s y)))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 y))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_graph g p)))

        (assert (== (total_weight (concat a1 b1)) (+ (get (idx (concat a1 b1) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (concat a1 b1) 1)))))
        (assert (== (total_weight a1) (+ (get (idx a1 0) 2) (total_weight (drop a1 1)))))))))
(lemma tw_split (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len o))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight o) (+ (total_weight (take o k)) (total_weight (drop o k)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (concat (take o k) (drop o k)) o))

(lemma tw_unit (params (c (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (seq-lit c)) (get c 2)))

(lemma exch_idx (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (na int) (j int) (c (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 na) (and (<= na j) (< j (len o)))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (exch_seq o na j c)) (len o))
    (== (idx (exch_seq o na j c) k)
        (if (< k na) (idx o k) (if (== k na) c (if (<= k j) (idx o (- k 1)) (idx o k))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (take o na))
    (ghost-let m1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop (take o j) na))
    (ghost-let z1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop o (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let r1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat m1 z1))
    (ghost-let r2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat (seq-lit c) r1))
    (assert (== (exch_seq o na j c) (concat a1 r2)))
    (assert (== (len a1) na))
    (assert (== (len m1) (- j na)))
    (assert (== (len z1) (- (- (len o) j) 1)))
    (assert (== (len r1) (- (- (len o) na) 1)))
    (assert (== (len r2) (- (len o) na)))
    (if (< k na)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat a1 r2) k) (idx a1 k)))
        (assert (== (idx a1 k) (idx o k))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat a1 r2) k) (idx r2 (- k na))))
        (if (== k na)
          (assert (== (idx r2 0) c))
          (block
            (assert (== (idx r2 (- k na)) (idx r1 (- (- k na) 1))))
            (if (<= k j)
              (block
                (assert (== (idx r1 (- (- k na) 1)) (idx m1 (- (- k na) 1))))
                (assert (== (idx m1 (- (- k na) 1)) (idx (take o j) (- k 1))))
                (assert (== (idx (take o j) (- k 1)) (idx o (- k 1)))))
              (block
                (assert (== (idx r1 (- (- k na) 1)) (idx z1 (- (- k j) 1))))
                (assert (== (idx z1 (- (- k j) 1)) (idx o k)))))))))))
(lemma exch_weight (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (na int) (j int) (c (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 na) (and (<= na j) (< j (len o)))))
  (ensures (== (+ (total_weight (exch_seq o na j c)) (get (idx o j) 2))
               (+ (total_weight o) (get c 2))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (take o na))
    (ghost-let pj (seq (tuple int int int)) (take o j))
    (ghost-let m1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop pj na))
    (ghost-let dj (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop o j))
    (ghost-let z1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop o (+ j 1)))
    (call tw_split o j)
    (assert (== (len pj) j))
    (call tw_split pj na)
    (assert (== (take pj na) a1))
    (assert (== (len dj) (- (len o) j)))
    (assert (== (drop dj 1) z1))
    (assert (== (idx dj 0) (idx o j)))
    (assert (== (total_weight dj) (+ (get (idx dj 0) 2) (total_weight (drop dj 1)))))
    (call tw_concat m1 z1)
    (call tw_concat (seq-lit c) (concat m1 z1))
    (call tw_concat a1 (concat (seq-lit c) (concat m1 z1)))
    (call tw_unit c)
    (assert (== (exch_seq o na j c) (concat a1 (concat (seq-lit c) (concat m1 z1)))))))
(lemma exch_keep (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (na int) (j int) (c (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 na) (and (<= na j) (< j (len o))))
            (edge_in_set o x y)

    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o)))

(lemma exch_valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (na int) (j int) (c (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 na) (and (<= na j) (< j (len o))))

            (has_edge g (get c 0) (get c 1) (get c 2))

(lemma exch_prefix_at (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (c (tuple int int int)) (i int))
  (requires (prefix_of a o) (and (<= (len a) j) (< j (len o))) (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len a))))

(lemma suffix_conn (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (na int) (j int) (c (tuple int int int)) (t (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 na) (and (<= na j) (< j (len o))))
            (path_follows_edges o p)

        (assert (not (in_s t (idx p (+ m 1)))))

        (block
          (assert (and (== a1 r) (== b1 s)))

(lemma exch_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)) (c (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g o)
            (prefix_of a o)
            (inside a t)
            (reached a t)
            (has_edge g (get c 0) (get c 1) (get c 2))
            (ends_are c x y)
            (in_s t x)
            (not (in_s t y))
            (== (len t) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))
            (min_cross g t true (get c 2)))
  (ensures (exists ((w3 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g (concat a (seq-lit c)) o w3)))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning g o))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (assert (== (len o) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))))
    (assert (edges_connected o x y))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
    (assert (!= (len p) 1))
    (assert (out_from t p (- (len p) 1)))
    (call last_cross t p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((k int)) (is_last_cross t p k))
    (assert (out_from t p (+ k 1)))
    (ghost-let s int (idx p k))
    (ghost-let r int (idx p (+ k 1)))
    (assert (in_s t s))
    (assert (not (in_s t r)))
    (assert (edge_in_set o s r))
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o j) 0) s) (== (get (idx o j) 1) r))
          (and (== (get (idx o j) 0) r) (== (get (idx o j) 1) s)))))
    (ghost-let na int (len a))
    (if (< j na)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx o j) (idx a j)))
        (assert (and (in_s t (get (idx a j) 0)) (in_s t (get (idx a j) 1))))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (ends_are (idx o j) s r))
    (assert (!= (in_s t (get (idx o j) 0)) (in_s t (get (idx o j) 1))))
    (ghost-let o3 (seq (tuple int int int)) (exch_seq o na j c))
    (call exch_idx o na j c na)
    (assert (== (idx o3 na) c))
    (forall ((i int)) (call exch_prefix_at a o j c i))
    (assert (== (len (concat a (seq-lit c))) (+ na 1)))
    (assert (prefix_of (concat a (seq-lit c)) o3))
    (assert (prefix_of a o3))
    (assert (edges_connected a 0 s))
    (assert (edges_connected a 0 x))
    (call conn_sym a 0 s)
    (call conn_trans a s 0 x)
    (call prefix_embed a o3)
    (call conn_embed a o3 s x)
    (call edge_intro o3 na x y)
    (call conn_step o3 s x y)
    (call suffix_conn o na j c t p (+ k 1))
    (call conn_sym o3 r y)
    (call conn_trans o3 s y r)
    (forall ((a1 int) (b1 int)) (call embed_pair o na j c s r a1 b1))
    (assert (edges_embed o o3))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call conn_embed o o3 u v))
    (assert (is_spanning g o3))
    (forall ((q int)) (call exch_valid_at g o na j c q))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o3))
    (assert (== (len o3) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o3))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1) (get (idx o j) 2)))
    (assert (<= (get c 2) (get (idx o j) 2)))
    (call exch_weight o na j c)
    (assert (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o)))
    (assert (better g (concat a (seq-lit c)) o o3))))
(lemma good_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)) (c (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (good g a)
            (rival g other)
            (inside a t)
            (reached a t)
            (has_edge g (get c 0) (get c 1) (get c 2))
            (ends_are c x y)
            (in_s t x)
            (not (in_s t y))
            (== (len t) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))
            (min_cross g t true (get c 2)))
  (ensures (has_better g (concat a (seq-lit c)) other))
  (body
    (assert (has_better g a other))
    (obtain ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g a other o))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o))
    (assert (prefix_of a o))
    (assert (<= (total_weight o) (total_weight other)))
    (call exch_one g a t c x y o)
    (obtain ((o3 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g (concat a (seq-lit c)) o o3))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o3))
    (assert (prefix_of (concat a (seq-lit c)) o3))
    (assert (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o)))
    (assert (better g (concat a (seq-lit c)) other o3))))
(lemma good_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)) (c (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (good g a)
            (inside a t)

            (ends_are c x y)
            (in_s t x)
            (not (in_s t y))
            (== (len t) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))

  (ensures (good g (concat a (seq-lit c))))
  (body
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call good_one g a t c x y other))))
(lemma good_init_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len a) 0) (rival g other))

(lemma count_le (params (t (seq bool)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len t))))

    (if (== m 0)
      (assert (== (count_true t 0) 0))
      (block
        (call count_le t (- m 1))
        (assert (== (count_true t m) (+ (count_true t (- m 1)) (if (idx t (- m 1)) 1 0))))))))
(lemma count_full (params (t (seq bool)) (m int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len t))) (== (count_true t m) m) (and (<= 0 v) (< v m)))
  (ensures (idx t v))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (call count_le t (- m 1))
    (assert (== (count_true t m) (+ (count_true t (- m 1)) (if (idx t (- m 1)) 1 0))))
    (assert (idx t (- m 1)))

  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len t))) (< (count_true t m) m))

    (if (idx t (- m 1))

        (obtain ((w int)) (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (- m 1))) (not (idx t w))))

(lemma count_zero (params (t (seq bool)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len t)))
