    (forall ((k int)) (call snoc_follows es p c k))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) c))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es q))
    (call conn_intro es q a c)))
(lemma take_follows_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len p))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- m 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (take p m) k) (idx (take p m) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx (take p m) k) (idx p k)))
    (assert (== (idx (take p m) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))))
(lemma take_follows (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len p))))
  (ensures (path_follows_edges es (take p m)))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call take_follows_at es p m k))
    (assert (== (len (take p m)) m))))
(lemma conn_along (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (edges_connected es a (idx p 0)) (path_follows_edges es p))
  (ensures (edges_connected es a (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (assert (== (- (len p) 1) 0))
      (block
        (ghost-let m int (- (len p) 2))
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (+ m 1)))
        (call take_follows es p (+ m 1))
        (assert (== (len q) (+ m 1)))
        (assert (== (idx q 0) (idx p 0)))
        (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call conn_along es a q)
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))
        (assert (== (+ m 1) (- (len p) 1)))
        (call conn_step es a (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (edges_connected es a b) (edges_connected es b c))
  (ensures (edges_connected es a c))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) b) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) c))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (call conn_along es a p)))
(lemma conn_edge (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected es a b))
  (body
    (call conn_refl es a)
    (call conn_step es a a b)))
(lemma path_rev (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (path_follows_edges es p))
  (ensures (edges_connected es (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx p 0)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (- (len p) 1) 0))
        (call conn_refl es (idx p 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let m int (- (len p) 2))
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (+ m 1)))
        (call take_follows es p (+ m 1))
        (assert (== (len q) (+ m 1)))
        (assert (== (idx q 0) (idx p 0)))
        (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call path_rev es q)
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))
        (assert (== (+ m 1) (- (len p) 1)))
        (call edge_sym es (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))
        (call conn_edge es (idx p (+ m 1)) (idx p m))
        (call conn_trans es (idx p (+ m 1)) (idx p m) (idx p 0))))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edges_connected es a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected es b a))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (call path_rev es p)))
(lemma conn_transfer (params (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (path_follows_edges e1 p) (edges_embed e1 e2))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (- (len p) 1) 0))
        (call conn_refl e2 (idx p 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let m int (- (len p) 2))
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (+ m 1)))
        (call take_follows e1 p (+ m 1))
        (assert (== (len q) (+ m 1)))
        (assert (== (idx q 0) (idx p 0)))
        (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call conn_transfer e1 e2 q)
        (assert (edge_in_set e1 (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))
        (assert (edges_connected e2 (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))
        (assert (== (+ m 1) (- (len p) 1)))
        (call conn_trans e2 (idx p 0) (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))))))
(lemma conn_embed (params (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edges_embed e1 e2) (edges_connected e1 a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges e1 p)))
    (call conn_transfer e1 e2 p)))
(lemma prefix_embed_one (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (prefix_of a o) (edge_in_set a x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected o x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len a)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx a i) 0) x) (== (get (idx a i) 1) y))
          (and (== (get (idx a i) 0) y) (== (get (idx a i) 1) x)))))
    (assert (== (idx o i) (idx a i)))
    (call edge_intro o i x y)
    (call conn_edge o x y)))
(lemma prefix_embed (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (prefix_of a o))
  (ensures (edges_embed a o))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call prefix_embed_one a o x y))))
(lemma prefix_snoc (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (prefix_of a (concat a (seq-lit c))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat a (seq-lit c))) (+ (len a) 1)))))

(lemma last_cross (params (t (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (and (< 0 i) (< i (len p))) (in_s t (idx p 0)) (out_from t p i))
  (ensures (exists ((k int)) (is_last_cross t p k)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (assert (not (in_s t (idx p i))))
    (if (in_s t (idx p (- i 1)))
      (block
        (assert (out_from t p (+ (- i 1) 1)))
        (assert (is_last_cross t p (- i 1))))
      (block
        (assert (< 0 (- i 1)))
        (assert (out_from t p (- i 1)))
        (call last_cross t p (- i 1))))))

(lemma tw_concat (params (a1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (b1 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat a1 b1)) (+ (total_weight a1) (total_weight b1))))
  (decreases (len a1))
  (body
    (if (== (len a1) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (concat a1 b1) b1))
        (assert (== (total_weight a1) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (concat a1 b1)) (+ (len a1) (len b1))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat a1 b1) 0) (idx a1 0)))
        (assert (== (drop (concat a1 b1) 1) (concat (drop a1 1) b1)))
        (call tw_concat (drop a1 1) b1)
        (assert (== (total_weight (concat a1 b1)) (+ (get (idx (concat a1 b1) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (concat a1 b1) 1)))))
        (assert (== (total_weight a1) (+ (get (idx a1 0) 2) (total_weight (drop a1 1)))))))))
(lemma tw_split (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len o))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight o) (+ (total_weight (take o k)) (total_weight (drop o k)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (concat (take o k) (drop o k)) o))
    (call tw_concat (take o k) (drop o k))))
(lemma tw_unit (params (c (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (seq-lit c)) (get c 2)))
  (body
    (ghost-let s (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-lit c))
    (assert (== (len s) 1))
    (assert (== (idx s 0) c))
    (assert (== (len (drop s 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight (drop s 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))))

(lemma exch_idx (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (na int) (j int) (c (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 na) (and (<= na j) (< j (len o)))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (exch_seq o na j c)) (len o))
    (== (idx (exch_seq o na j c) k)
        (if (< k na) (idx o k) (if (== k na) c (if (<= k j) (idx o (- k 1)) (idx o k))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (take o na))
    (ghost-let m1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop (take o j) na))
    (ghost-let z1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop o (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let r1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat m1 z1))
    (ghost-let r2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat (seq-lit c) r1))
    (assert (== (exch_seq o na j c) (concat a1 r2)))
    (assert (== (len a1) na))
    (assert (== (len m1) (- j na)))
    (assert (== (len z1) (- (- (len o) j) 1)))
    (assert (== (len r1) (- (- (len o) na) 1)))
    (assert (== (len r2) (- (len o) na)))
    (if (< k na)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat a1 r2) k) (idx a1 k)))
        (assert (== (idx a1 k) (idx o k))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat a1 r2) k) (idx r2 (- k na))))
        (if (== k na)
          (assert (== (idx r2 0) c))
          (block
            (assert (== (idx r2 (- k na)) (idx r1 (- (- k na) 1))))
            (if (<= k j)
              (block
                (assert (== (idx r1 (- (- k na) 1)) (idx m1 (- (- k na) 1))))
                (assert (== (idx m1 (- (- k na) 1)) (idx (take o j) (- k 1))))
                (assert (== (idx (take o j) (- k 1)) (idx o (- k 1)))))
              (block
                (assert (== (idx r1 (- (- k na) 1)) (idx z1 (- (- k j) 1))))
                (assert (== (idx z1 (- (- k j) 1)) (idx o k)))))))))))
(lemma exch_weight (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (na int) (j int) (c (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 na) (and (<= na j) (< j (len o)))))
  (ensures (== (+ (total_weight (exch_seq o na j c)) (get (idx o j) 2))
               (+ (total_weight o) (get c 2))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (take o na))
    (ghost-let pj (seq (tuple int int int)) (take o j))
    (ghost-let m1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop pj na))
    (ghost-let dj (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop o j))
    (ghost-let z1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop o (+ j 1)))
    (call tw_split o j)
    (assert (== (len pj) j))
    (call tw_split pj na)
    (assert (== (take pj na) a1))
    (assert (== (len dj) (- (len o) j)))
    (assert (== (drop dj 1) z1))
    (assert (== (idx dj 0) (idx o j)))
    (assert (== (total_weight dj) (+ (get (idx dj 0) 2) (total_weight (drop dj 1)))))
    (call tw_concat m1 z1)
    (call tw_concat (seq-lit c) (concat m1 z1))
    (call tw_concat a1 (concat (seq-lit c) (concat m1 z1)))
    (call tw_unit c)
    (assert (== (exch_seq o na j c) (concat a1 (concat (seq-lit c) (concat m1 z1)))))))
(lemma exch_keep (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (na int) (j int) (c (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 na) (and (<= na j) (< j (len o))))
            (edge_in_set o x y)
            (not (ends_are (idx o j) x y)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (exch_seq o na j c) x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o i) 0) x) (== (get (idx o i) 1) y))
          (and (== (get (idx o i) 0) y) (== (get (idx o i) 1) x)))))
    (assert (!= i j))
    (ghost-let i2 int (if (and (<= na i) (< i j)) (+ i 1) i))
    (call exch_idx o na j c i2)
    (assert (== (idx (exch_seq o na j c) i2) (idx o i)))
    (call edge_intro (exch_seq o na j c) i2 x y)))
(lemma exch_valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (na int) (j int) (c (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 na) (and (<= na j) (< j (len o))))
            (are_valid_edges g o)
            (has_edge g (get c 0) (get c 1) (get c 2))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (exch_seq o na j c) k) 0) (get (idx (exch_seq o na j c) k) 1) (get (idx (exch_seq o na j c) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call exch_idx o na j c k)
    (if (< k na)
      (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2)))
      (if (== k na)
        (block)
        (if (<= k j)
          (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx o (- k 1)) 1) (get (idx o (- k 1)) 2)))
          (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2))))))))
(lemma exch_prefix_at (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (c (tuple int int int)) (i int))
  (requires (prefix_of a o) (and (<= (len a) j) (< j (len o))) (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len a))))
  (ensures (== (idx (exch_seq o (len a) j c) i) (idx (concat a (seq-lit c)) i)))
  (body
    (call exch_idx o (len a) j c i)
    (assert (== (len (concat a (seq-lit c))) (+ (len a) 1)))
    (if (< i (len a))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx o i) (idx a i)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat a (seq-lit c)) i) (idx a i))))
      (assert (== (idx (concat a (seq-lit c)) i) c)))))
(lemma suffix_conn (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (na int) (j int) (c (tuple int int int)) (t (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 na) (and (<= na j) (< j (len o))))
            (path_follows_edges o p)
            (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p)))
            (out_from t p m)
            (!= (in_s t (get (idx o j) 0)) (in_s t (get (idx o j) 1))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (exch_seq o na j c) (idx p m) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (decreases (- (len p) m))
  (body
    (if (== m (- (len p) 1))
      (call conn_refl (exch_seq o na j c) (idx p m))
      (block
        (assert (out_from t p (+ m 1)))
        (call suffix_conn o na j c t p (+ m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))
        (assert (not (in_s t (idx p m))))
        (assert (not (in_s t (idx p (+ m 1)))))
        (assert (not (ends_are (idx o j) (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))))
        (call exch_keep o na j c (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))
        (call conn_edge (exch_seq o na j c) (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))
        (call conn_trans (exch_seq o na j c) (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))
(lemma embed_pair (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (na int) (j int) (c (tuple int int int)) (s int) (r int) (a1 int) (b1 int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 na) (and (<= na j) (< j (len o))))
            (ends_are (idx o j) s r)
            (edges_connected (exch_seq o na j c) s r)
            (edge_in_set o a1 b1))
  (ensures (edges_connected (exch_seq o na j c) a1 b1))
  (body
    (if (ends_are (idx o j) a1 b1)
      (if (and (== a1 s) (== b1 r))
        (block)
        (block
          (assert (and (== a1 r) (== b1 s)))
          (call conn_sym (exch_seq o na j c) s r)))
      (block
        (call exch_keep o na j c a1 b1)
        (call conn_edge (exch_seq o na j c) a1 b1)))))
(lemma exch_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)) (c (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g o)
            (prefix_of a o)
            (inside a t)
            (reached a t)
            (has_edge g (get c 0) (get c 1) (get c 2))
            (ends_are c x y)
            (in_s t x)
            (not (in_s t y))
            (== (len t) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))
            (min_cross g t true (get c 2)))
  (ensures (exists ((w3 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g (concat a (seq-lit c)) o w3)))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning g o))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (assert (== (len o) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))))
    (assert (edges_connected o x y))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
    (assert (!= (len p) 1))
    (assert (out_from t p (- (len p) 1)))
    (call last_cross t p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((k int)) (is_last_cross t p k))
    (assert (out_from t p (+ k 1)))
    (ghost-let s int (idx p k))
    (ghost-let r int (idx p (+ k 1)))
    (assert (in_s t s))
    (assert (not (in_s t r)))
    (assert (edge_in_set o s r))
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o j) 0) s) (== (get (idx o j) 1) r))
          (and (== (get (idx o j) 0) r) (== (get (idx o j) 1) s)))))
    (ghost-let na int (len a))
    (if (< j na)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx o j) (idx a j)))
        (assert (and (in_s t (get (idx a j) 0)) (in_s t (get (idx a j) 1))))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (ends_are (idx o j) s r))
    (assert (!= (in_s t (get (idx o j) 0)) (in_s t (get (idx o j) 1))))
    (ghost-let o3 (seq (tuple int int int)) (exch_seq o na j c))
    (call exch_idx o na j c na)
    (assert (== (idx o3 na) c))
    (forall ((i int)) (call exch_prefix_at a o j c i))
    (assert (== (len (concat a (seq-lit c))) (+ na 1)))
    (assert (prefix_of (concat a (seq-lit c)) o3))
    (assert (prefix_of a o3))
    (assert (edges_connected a 0 s))
    (assert (edges_connected a 0 x))
    (call conn_sym a 0 s)
    (call conn_trans a s 0 x)
    (call prefix_embed a o3)
    (call conn_embed a o3 s x)
    (call edge_intro o3 na x y)
    (call conn_step o3 s x y)
    (call suffix_conn o na j c t p (+ k 1))
    (call conn_sym o3 r y)
    (call conn_trans o3 s y r)
    (forall ((a1 int) (b1 int)) (call embed_pair o na j c s r a1 b1))
    (assert (edges_embed o o3))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call conn_embed o o3 u v))
    (assert (is_spanning g o3))
    (forall ((q int)) (call exch_valid_at g o na j c q))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o3))
    (assert (== (len o3) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o3))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1) (get (idx o j) 2)))
    (assert (<= (get c 2) (get (idx o j) 2)))
    (call exch_weight o na j c)
    (assert (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o)))
    (assert (better g (concat a (seq-lit c)) o o3))))
(lemma good_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)) (c (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (good g a)
            (rival g other)
            (inside a t)
            (reached a t)
            (has_edge g (get c 0) (get c 1) (get c 2))
            (ends_are c x y)
            (in_s t x)
            (not (in_s t y))
            (== (len t) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))
            (min_cross g t true (get c 2)))
  (ensures (has_better g (concat a (seq-lit c)) other))
  (body
    (assert (has_better g a other))
    (obtain ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g a other o))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o))
    (assert (prefix_of a o))
    (assert (<= (total_weight o) (total_weight other)))
    (call exch_one g a t c x y o)
    (obtain ((o3 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g (concat a (seq-lit c)) o o3))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o3))
    (assert (prefix_of (concat a (seq-lit c)) o3))
    (assert (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o)))
    (assert (better g (concat a (seq-lit c)) other o3))))
(lemma good_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)) (c (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (good g a)
            (inside a t)
            (reached a t)
            (has_edge g (get c 0) (get c 1) (get c 2))
            (ends_are c x y)
            (in_s t x)
            (not (in_s t y))
            (== (len t) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))
            (min_cross g t true (get c 2)))
  (ensures (good g (concat a (seq-lit c))))
  (body
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call good_one g a t c x y other))))
(lemma good_init_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len a) 0) (rival g other))
  (ensures (has_better g a other))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g other))
    (assert (prefix_of a other))
    (assert (better g a other other))))
(lemma good_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len a) 0))
  (ensures (good g a))
  (body
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call good_init_one g a other))))

(lemma count_le (params (t (seq bool)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len t))))
  (ensures (<= (count_true t m) m))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (assert (== (count_true t 0) 0))
      (block
        (call count_le t (- m 1))
        (assert (== (count_true t m) (+ (count_true t (- m 1)) (if (idx t (- m 1)) 1 0))))))))
(lemma count_full (params (t (seq bool)) (m int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len t))) (== (count_true t m) m) (and (<= 0 v) (< v m)))
  (ensures (idx t v))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (call count_le t (- m 1))
    (assert (== (count_true t m) (+ (count_true t (- m 1)) (if (idx t (- m 1)) 1 0))))
    (assert (idx t (- m 1)))
    (if (== v (- m 1))
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (== (count_true t (- m 1)) (- m 1)))
        (call count_full t (- m 1) v)))))
(lemma exists_false (params (t (seq bool)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len t))) (< (count_true t m) m))
  (ensures (exists ((v int)) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v m)) (not (idx t v)))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (!= m 0))
    (assert (== (count_true t m) (+ (count_true t (- m 1)) (if (idx t (- m 1)) 1 0))))
    (if (idx t (- m 1))
      (block
        (assert (< (count_true t (- m 1)) (- m 1)))
        (call exists_false t (- m 1))
        (obtain ((w int)) (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (- m 1))) (not (idx t w))))
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w m)) (not (idx t w)))))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- m 1)) (< (- m 1) m)) (not (idx t (- m 1))))))))
(lemma count_zero (params (t (seq bool)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len t)))
            (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (<= 0 z) (< z m)) (not (idx t z)))))
  (ensures (== (count_true t m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (assert (== (count_true t 0) 0))
      (block
        (assert (not (idx t (- m 1))))
        (call count_zero t (- m 1))
        (assert (== (count_true t m) (+ (count_true t (- m 1)) (if (idx t (- m 1)) 1 0))))))))
(lemma count_set (params (t (seq bool)) (t2 (seq bool)) (y int) (m int))
  (requires (== (len t2) (len t))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len t)))
            (not (idx t y))
            (idx t2 y)
            (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len t))) (!= z y)) (== (idx t2 z) (idx t z))))
            (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len t))))
  (ensures (== (count_true t2 m) (+ (count_true t m) (if (< y m) 1 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (count_true t2 0) 0))
        (assert (== (count_true t 0) 0)))
      (block
        (call count_set t t2 y (- m 1))
        (assert (== (count_true t2 m) (+ (count_true t2 (- m 1)) (if (idx t2 (- m 1)) 1 0))))
        (assert (== (count_true t m) (+ (count_true t (- m 1)) (if (idx t (- m 1)) 1 0))))
        (if (== (- m 1) y)
          (block)
          (assert (== (idx t2 (- m 1)) (idx t (- m 1)))))))))

(lemma adds_intro (params (t (seq bool)) (t2 (seq bool)) (y int))
  (requires (== (len t2) (len t))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len t)))
            (idx t2 y)
            (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len t))) (!= z y)) (== (idx t2 z) (idx t z)))))
  (ensures (adds t t2 y))
  (body))
(lemma inside_at (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)) (t2 (seq bool)) (y int) (c (tuple int int int)) (x int) (i int))
  (requires (inside a t) (adds t t2 y) (in_s t x) (ends_are c x y) (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len a))))
  (ensures (and (in_s t2 (get (idx (concat a (seq-lit c)) i) 0)) (in_s t2 (get (idx (concat a (seq-lit c)) i) 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat a (seq-lit c))) (+ (len a) 1)))
    (if (< i (len a))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat a (seq-lit c)) i) (idx a i)))
        (assert (in_s t (get (idx a i) 0)))
        (assert (in_s t (get (idx a i) 1)))
        (assert (in_s t2 (get (idx a i) 0)))
        (assert (in_s t2 (get (idx a i) 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat a (seq-lit c)) i) c))
        (assert (in_s t2 x))
        (assert (in_s t2 y))))))
(lemma reached_at (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)) (t2 (seq bool)) (y int) (c (tuple int int int)) (x int) (v int))
  (requires (reached a t) (adds t t2 y) (in_s t x) (ends_are c x y) (in_s t2 v))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat a (seq-lit c)) 0 v))
  (body
    (call prefix_snoc a c)
    (call prefix_embed a (concat a (seq-lit c)))
    (assert (edges_connected a 0 x))
    (call conn_embed a (concat a (seq-lit c)) 0 x)
    (if (== v y)
      (block
        (assert (== (len (concat a (seq-lit c))) (+ (len a) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat a (seq-lit c)) (len a)) c))
        (call edge_intro (concat a (seq-lit c)) (len a) x y)
        (call conn_step (concat a (seq-lit c)) 0 x y))
      (block
        (assert (in_s t v))
        (assert (edges_connected a 0 v))
        (call conn_embed a (concat a (seq-lit c)) 0 v)))))
(lemma valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g a) (has_edge g (get c 0) (get c 1) (get c 2)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len a))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (concat a (seq-lit c)) k) 0) (get (idx (concat a (seq-lit c)) k) 1) (get (idx (concat a (seq-lit c)) k) 2)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat a (seq-lit c))) (+ (len a) 1)))
    (if (< k (len a))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat a (seq-lit c)) k) (idx a k)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx a k) 0) (get (idx a k) 1) (get (idx a k) 2))))
      (assert (== (idx (concat a (seq-lit c)) k) c)))))
(lemma advance (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)) (t2 (seq bool)) (c (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (== (len t) (len g))
            (== (len t2) (len t))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len t)))
            (forest_ok g t a)
            (good g a)
            (has_edge g (get c 0) (get c 1) (get c 2))
            (ends_are c x y)
            (in_s t x)
            (not (in_s t y))
            (min_cross g t true (get c 2))
            (idx t2 y)
            (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len t))) (!= z y)) (== (idx t2 z) (idx t z)))))
  (ensures (forest_ok g t2 (concat a (seq-lit c)))
           (good g (concat a (seq-lit c)))
           (== (count_true t2 (len g)) (+ (count_true t (len g)) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (in_s t 0))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g a))
    (assert (inside a t))
    (assert (reached a t))
    (call adds_intro t t2 y)
    (assert (== (len (concat a (seq-lit c))) (+ (len a) 1)))
    (forall ((i int)) (call inside_at a t t2 y c x i))
    (forall ((v int)) (call reached_at a t t2 y c x v))
    (forall ((k int)) (call valid_at g a c k))
    (assert (inside (concat a (seq-lit c)) t2))
    (assert (reached (concat a (seq-lit c)) t2))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g (concat a (seq-lit c))))
    (assert (in_s t2 0))
    (assert (forest_ok g t2 (concat a (seq-lit c))))
    (call good_step g a t c x y)
    (assert (not (idx t y)))
    (call count_set t t2 y (len g))))
(lemma forest_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len a) 0)
            (== (len t) (len g))
            (> (len t) 0)
            (idx t 0)
            (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len t))) (!= z 0)) (not (idx t z)))))
  (ensures (forest_ok g t a))
  (body
    (assert (in_s t 0))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g a))
    (assert (inside a t))
    (call conn_refl a 0)
    (assert (reached a t))
    (assert (forest_ok g t a))))

(lemma must_find (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (fnd bool) (w int) (v int))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g)
            (== (len t) (len g))
            (in_s t 0)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
            (not (in_s t v))
            (min_cross g t fnd w))
  (ensures fnd)
  (body
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 v))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (assert (!= (len p) 1))
    (assert (in_s t (idx p 0)))
    (assert (out_from t p (- (len p) 1)))
    (call last_cross t p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((k int)) (is_last_cross t p k))
    (assert (out_from t p (+ k 1)))
    (assert (in_s t (idx p k)))
    (assert (not (in_s t (idx p (+ k 1)))))
    (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (idx p k)))))) (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p k)) i) 0) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
    (call edge_entry g (idx p k) i)
    (assert (has_edge g (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)) (get (idx (idx g (idx p k)) i) 1)))
    (assert (and fnd (<= w (get (idx (idx g (idx p k)) i) 1))))))
(lemma must_find2 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (fnd bool) (w int))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g)
            (== (len t) (len g))
            (in_s t 0)
            (< (count_true t (len g)) (len g))
            (min_cross g t fnd w))
  (ensures fnd)
  (body
    (call exists_false t (len g))
    (obtain ((v int)) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (not (idx t v))))
    (assert (not (in_s t v)))
    (call must_find g t fnd w v)))

(lemma span_pair (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (reached a t)
            (== (len t) (len g))
            (== (count_true t (len g)) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected a u v))
  (body
    (call count_full t (len g) u)
    (call count_full t (len g) v)
    (assert (in_s t u))
    (assert (in_s t v))
    (assert (edges_connected a 0 u))
    (assert (edges_connected a 0 v))
    (call conn_sym a 0 u)
    (call conn_trans a u 0 v)))
(lemma final_opt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (good g a) (== (len a) (- (len g) 1)) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight a) (total_weight other)))
  (body
    (assert (rival g other))
    (assert (has_better g a other))
    (obtain ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better g a other o))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o))
    (assert (== (len o) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (prefix_of a o))
    (assert (== o a))
    (assert (<= (total_weight o) (total_weight other)))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (forest_ok g t a)
            (good g a)
            (== (len t) (len g))
            (== (len a) (- (len g) 1))
            (== (count_true t (len g)) (len g)))
  (ensures (is_mst g a))
  (body
    (assert (reached a t))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g a))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_pair g a t u v))
    (assert (is_spanning g a))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g a))
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call final_opt g a other))
    (assert (is_mst g a))))

(lemma targets_from_wf (params (wg weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed wg))
  (ensures (targets_ok (view wg)))
  (body
    (assert (== (view wg) (field wg adj)))))
(lemma edge_entry (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma min_upd_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (u int) (i int) (fnd bool) (w int) (a int) (k int))
  (requires (min_upto g t u i fnd w)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (=> fnd (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))
            (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g a)))))
            (or (< a u) (and (== a u) (< k (+ i 1))))
            (!= (in_s t a) (in_s t (get (idx (idx g a) k) 0))))
  (ensures (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) (get (idx (idx g a) k) 1)))
  (body
    (if (and (== a u) (== k i))
      (block)
      (assert (and fnd (<= w (get (idx (idx g a) k) 1)))))))
(lemma min_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (u int) (i int) (fnd bool) (w int))
  (requires (min_upto g t u i fnd w)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (=> fnd (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w)))
  (ensures (min_upto g t u (+ i 1) true (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (k int)) (call min_upd_at g t u i fnd w a k))
    (assert (min_upto g t u (+ i 1) true (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
(lemma min_keep_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (u int) (i int) (fnd bool) (w int) (a int) (k int))
  (requires (min_upto g t u i fnd w)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (=> (!= (in_s t u) (in_s t (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
                (and fnd (<= w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
            (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g a)))))
            (or (< a u) (and (== a u) (< k (+ i 1))))
            (!= (in_s t a) (in_s t (get (idx (idx g a) k) 0))))
  (ensures (and fnd (<= w (get (idx (idx g a) k) 1))))
  (body
    (if (and (== a u) (== k i))
      (block)
      (assert (and fnd (<= w (get (idx (idx g a) k) 1)))))))
(lemma min_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (u int) (i int) (fnd bool) (w int))
  (requires (min_upto g t u i fnd w)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (=> (!= (in_s t u) (in_s t (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
                (and fnd (<= w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
  (ensures (min_upto g t u (+ i 1) fnd w))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (k int)) (call min_keep_at g t u i fnd w a k))
    (assert (min_upto g t u (+ i 1) fnd w))))
(lemma min_next_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (u int) (i int) (fnd bool) (w int) (a int) (k int))
  (requires (min_upto g t u i fnd w)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (== i (len (idx g u)))
            (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g a)))))
            (< a (+ u 1))
            (!= (in_s t a) (in_s t (get (idx (idx g a) k) 0))))
  (ensures (and fnd (<= w (get (idx (idx g a) k) 1))))
  (body
    (assert (or (< a u) (and (== a u) (< k i))))
    (assert (and fnd (<= w (get (idx (idx g a) k) 1))))))
(lemma min_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (u int) (i int) (fnd bool) (w int))
  (requires (min_upto g t u i fnd w)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (== i (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (min_upto g t (+ u 1) 0 fnd w))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (k int)) (call min_next_at g t u i fnd w a k))
    (assert (min_upto g t (+ u 1) 0 fnd w))))
(lemma min_final_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (fnd bool) (w int) (a int) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (min_upto g t (len g) 0 fnd w)
            (has_edge g a b x)
            (!= (in_s t a) (in_s t b)))
  (ensures (and fnd (<= w x)))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g a))))) (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) k) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) k) 1) x))))
    (assert (!= (in_s t a) (in_s t (get (idx (idx g a) k) 0))))
    (assert (and fnd (<= w (get (idx (idx g a) k) 1))))))
(lemma min_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (fnd bool) (w int))
  (requires (min_upto g t (len g) 0 fnd w))
  (ensures (min_cross g t fnd w))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int) (x int)) (call min_final_at g t fnd w a b x))
    (assert (min_cross g t fnd w))))

(spec find_min
  (params (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (t (ref (slice bool))))
  (returns (found bool) (bu i64) (bv i64) (bw i64))
  (requires (== (len t) (len rows)) (targets_ok rows))
  (ensures (cand rows t found bu bv bw) (min_cross rows t found bw))
  (effects))
(def find_min
  (body
    (let-mut fnd bool false)
    (let-mut cu i64 0)
    (let-mut cv i64 0)
    (let-mut cw i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u (len rows))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u (len rows))))
      (invariant (cand rows t fnd cu cv cw))
      (invariant (min_upto rows t u 0 fnd cw))
      (decreases (- (len rows) u))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i (len (idx rows u)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len rows))))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx rows u)))))
        (invariant (cand rows t fnd cu cv cw))
        (invariant (min_upto rows t u i fnd cw))
        (decreases (- (len (idx rows u)) i))
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx rows u) i) 0))
        (let w i64 (get (idx (idx rows u) i) 1))
        (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len rows))))
        (assert (== (in_s t u) (idx t u)))
        (assert (== (in_s t v) (idx t v)))
        (if (and (!= (idx t u) (idx t v)) (or (not fnd) (< w cw)))
          (block
            (call edge_entry rows u i)
            (call min_upd rows t u i fnd cw)
            (assert (cand rows t true u v w))
            (set fnd true)
            (set cu u)
            (set cv v)
            (set cw w))
          (block
            (call min_keep rows t u i fnd cw)))
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (call min_next rows t u i fnd cw)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (call min_final rows t fnd cw)
    (return fnd cu cv cw)))

(def prim_mst
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (call targets_from_wf graph)
    (match graph
      (case (weighted_graph rows)
        (block
          (assert (== (field graph adj) rows))
          (assert (== g rows))
          (assert (targets_ok rows))
          (assert (graph_is_connected g))
          (let n i64 (len rows))
          (assert (> n 0))
          (let-mut in_tree (vec bool) (seq-build n (fn (q) false)))
          (ghost-let t0 (seq bool) in_tree)
          (assert (== (len t0) n))
          (assert (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (<= 0 z) (< z n)) (not (idx t0 z)))))
          (call count_zero t0 n)
          (set-idx in_tree 0 true)
          (call count_set t0 in_tree 0 n)
          (assert (== (count_true in_tree n) 1))
          (let-mut es (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
          (call forest_init g in_tree es)
          (call good_init g es)
          (let-mut k i64 0)
          (while (< (+ k 1) n)
            (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (< k n)))
            (invariant (== (len es) k))
            (invariant (== (len in_tree) n))
            (invariant (== (count_true in_tree n) (+ k 1)))
            (invariant (forest_ok g in_tree es))
            (invariant (good g es))
            (decreases (- n k))
            (ghost-let a0 (seq (tuple int int int)) es)
            (ghost-let t1 (seq bool) in_tree)
            (assert (in_s t1 0))
            (let ((fnd bool) (bu i64) (bv i64) (bw i64)) (call find_min (borrow rows) (borrow in_tree)))
            (call must_find2 g t1 fnd bw)
            (assert fnd)
            (assert (cand g t1 fnd bu bv bw))
            (assert (and (<= 0 bu) (< bu n)))
            (assert (and (<= 0 bv) (< bv n)))

    (call exc_eq g h s)
    (call exc_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- 0 (excess h s n))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) (- 0 (excess f s n))))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool))
                      (s int) (t int) (n int) (total int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f) (balance f s t s n)
            (== (excess f s n) (- 0 total)) (mem b s) (not (mem b t)) (scanned c f b n n)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures (exists ((m (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g m s t) (== (flow_val g m s) total))))
  (body
    (call valid_of g c f s t)
    (forall ((h (seq (seq int)))) (call upper g c f b s t n h))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))
    (call exc_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) total))
    (assert (and (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) total)))))

(lemma sums_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (all_zero f))
  (ensures (== (rs f u m) 0) (== (cs f u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call sums_zero f u (- m 1)))))
(lemma zero_start (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_limit c) (all_zero f))
  (ensures (cap_bounds c f) (balance f s t s n) (== (excess f s n) 0))
  (body
    (forall ((ub int)) (call sums_zero f ub n))
    (assert (cap_bounds c f))
    (assert (balance f s t s n))
    (assert (== (excess f s n) 0))))
(lemma sums_bd (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (cap_limit c) (cap_bounds c f) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (<= (rs f u m) (* 100000 m)) (>= (cs f u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (== m 0) (block) (call sums_bd c f u (- m 1)))))
(lemma flow_bound (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_limit c) (cap_bounds c f) (and (<= 0 n) (<= n 1000)))
  (ensures (<= (- 0 (excess f s n)) 100000000))
  (body (call sums_bd c f s n)))

(ghost-fn same_but ((f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int))) (a int) (w int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (=> (or (!= x a) (!= y w)) (== (get_flow g x y) (get_flow f x y))))))
(lemma rs_upd (params (f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int))) (a int) (w int) (d int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (same_but f g a w) (== (get_flow g a w) (+ (get_flow f a w) d)))
  (ensures (== (rs g u m) (+ (rs f u m) (if (and (== u a) (and (<= 0 w) (< w m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call rs_upd f g a w d u (- m 1)))))
(lemma cs_upd (params (f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int))) (a int) (w int) (d int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (same_but f g a w) (== (get_flow g a w) (+ (get_flow f a w) d)))
  (ensures (== (cs g u m) (+ (cs f u m) (if (and (== u w) (and (<= 0 a) (< a m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call cs_upd f g a w d u (- m 1)))))
(lemma exc_upd (params (f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int))) (a int) (w int) (d int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (same_but f g a w) (== (get_flow g a w) (+ (get_flow f a w) d))
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)))
  (ensures (== (excess g u n) (+ (excess f u n) (- (if (== u w) d 0) (if (== u a) d 0)))))
  (body
    (call rs_upd f g a w d u n)
    (call cs_upd f g a w d u n)))
(ghost-fn keep ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (d int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (=> (and (<= (at o x) d) (<= (at o y) d)) (== (get_flow f x y) (get_flow f0 x y))))))
(ghost-fn walk ((c (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (o (seq int))
                (s int) (t int) (x int) (n int) (e0 int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
        (and (mem b x)
        (and (is_matrix f n)
        (and (cap_bounds c f)
        (and (balance f s t x n)
        (and (== (excess f s n) (if (== x s) (- e0 1) e0))
             (keep f0 f o (at o x))))))))))
(lemma walk_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int)))
                         (b (seq bool)) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int)
                         (a int) (w int) (d int) (n int) (e0 int))
  (requires (walk c f0 f b o s t x n e0) (!= x s)
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (mem b p) (< (at o p) (at o x))
            (or (and (== a p) (and (== w x) (== d 1))) (and (== a x) (and (== w p) (== d -1))))
            (is_matrix g n) (== (get_flow g a w) (+ (get_flow f a w) d)) (same_but f g a w)
            (and (<= 0 (get_flow g a w)) (<= (get_flow g a w) (get_flow c a w))))
  (ensures (walk c f0 g b o s t p n e0))
  (body
    (assert (!= p x))
    (forall ((ub int)) (call exc_upd f g a w d ub n))
    (assert (cap_bounds c g))
    (assert (balance g s t p n))
    (assert (== (excess g s n) (if (== p s) (- e0 1) e0)))
    (assert (keep f0 g o (at o p)))
    (assert (walk c f0 g b o s t p n e0))))

(ghost-fn tree_pt ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int))
                   (s int) (n int) (y int)) bool
  (body (=> (mem b y)
            (and (>= (at o y) 0)
                 (=> (!= y s)
                     (and (and (<= 0 (at p y)) (< (at p y) n))
                          (and (mem b (at p y))
                               (and (res c f (at p y) y) (< (at o (at p y)) (at o y))))))))))
(ghost-fn tree_ok ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int)) (s int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (tree_pt c f b p o s n y))))
(ghost-fn ords_ok ((b (seq bool)) (o (seq int)) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (mem b y) (< (at o y) k)))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((b (seq bool)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (cnt b (- m 1)) (if (mem b (- m 1)) 0 1)))))
(lemma cnt_nonneg (params (b (seq bool)) (m int))
  (ensures (>= (cnt b m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call cnt_nonneg b (- m 1)))))
(lemma cnt_all (params (b (seq bool)) (m int))
  (requires (forall ((y int)) (not (mem b y))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (cnt b m) m))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (== m 0) (block) (call cnt_all b (- m 1)))))
(lemma cnt_mark (params (b (seq bool)) (b2 (seq bool)) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (forall ((y int)) (=> (!= y v) (== (mem b2 y) (mem b y)))) (mem b2 v) (not (mem b v)))
  (ensures (== (cnt b2 m) (- (cnt b m) (if (and (<= 0 v) (< v m)) 1 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call cnt_mark b b2 v (- m 1)))))
(ghost-fn st ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (k int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len b) n) (and (== (len p) n) (== (len o) n)))
        (and (mem b s)
        (and (and (<= 1 k) (<= k n))
        (and (== (+ k (cnt b n)) n)
        (and (ords_ok b o k) (tree_ok c f b p o s n))))))))
(ghost-fn marked ((b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int)) (b2 (seq bool)) (p2 (seq int)) (o2 (seq int))
                  (u int) (v int) (k int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len b2) n) (and (== (len p2) n) (== (len o2) n)))
        (and (mem b2 v)
        (and (== (at p2 v) u)
        (and (== (at o2 v) k)
             (forall ((y int)) (=> (!= y v)
               (and (== (mem b2 y) (mem b y))
                    (and (== (at p2 y) (at p y)) (== (at o2 y) (at o y))))))))))))
(lemma bfs_init (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int)) (s int) (n int))
  (requires (forall ((y int)) (not (mem b0 y))) (mem b s)
            (forall ((y int)) (=> (!= y s) (== (mem b y) (mem b0 y))))
            (== (len b) n) (== (len p) n) (== (len o) n)
            (forall ((y int)) (== (at o y) 0))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (st c f b p o s n 1))
  (body
    (assert (not (mem b0 s)))
    (call cnt_all b0 n)
    (call cnt_mark b0 b s n)
    (assert (ords_ok b o 1))
    (assert (tree_ok c f b p o s n))
    (assert (st c f b p o s n 1))))
(lemma mark_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int))
                       (b2 (seq bool)) (p2 (seq int)) (o2 (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (u int) (v int) (k int) (y int))
  (requires (st c f b p o s n k) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (mem b u) (not (mem b v)) (res c f u v)
            (marked b p o b2 p2 o2 u v k n))
  (ensures (tree_pt c f b2 p2 o2 s n y))
  (body
    (assert (tree_pt c f b p o s n y))
    (assert (!= u v))
    (assert (!= v s))
    (assert (< (at o u) k))
    (assert (mem b2 u))
    (assert (== (at o2 u) (at o u)))
    (if (== y v)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (== (mem b2 y) (mem b y)))
        (assert (== (at p2 y) (at p y)))
        (assert (== (at o2 y) (at o y)))
        (assert (=> (and (mem b y) (!= y s))
                    (and (!= (at p y) v)
                         (and (== (mem b2 (at p y)) (mem b (at p y)))
                              (== (at o2 (at p y)) (at o (at p y)))))))))))
(lemma mark_ok (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int))
                       (b2 (seq bool)) (p2 (seq int)) (o2 (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (u int) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (st c f b p o s n k) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (mem b u) (not (mem b v)) (res c f u v) (marked b p o b2 p2 o2 u v k n))
  (ensures (st c f b2 p2 o2 s n (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((yb int)) (call mark_pt c f b p o b2 p2 o2 s n u v k yb))
    (assert (tree_ok c f b2 p2 o2 s n))
    (assert (ords_ok b2 o2 (+ k 1)))
    (assert (!= v s))
    (assert (mem b2 s))
    (assert (forall ((yb int)) (=> (!= yb v) (== (mem b2 yb) (mem b yb)))))
    (call cnt_mark b b2 v n)
    (call cnt_nonneg b2 n)
    (assert (st c f b2 p2 o2 s n (+ k 1)))))

(spec residual
  (params (c (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (f (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (u i64) (v i64) (n i64))
  (returns (r bool))
  (requires (is_matrix c n) (is_matrix f n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (== r (res c f u v)))
  (effects))
(def residual
  (body
    (assert (== (len (idx c u)) n))
    (assert (== (len (idx f u)) n))
    (assert (== (len (idx f v)) n))
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
    (assert (== (get_flow c u v) (idx (idx c u) v)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f v u) (idx (idx f v) u)))
    (return (or (< (idx (idx f u) v) (idx (idx c u) v)) (> (idx (idx f v) u) 0)))))

(spec bfs
  (params (c (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (f (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (s i64) (n i64))
  (returns (vis (vec bool)) (par (vec i64)) (ord (vec i64)))
  (requires (is_matrix c n) (is_matrix f n) (<= n 1000) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (len vis) n) (== (len par) n) (== (len ord) n) (mem vis s)
           (tree_ok c f vis par ord s n) (scanned c f vis n n))
  (effects alloc))
(def bfs
  (body
    (let-mut vis (vec bool) (seq-build n (fn (ia) false)))
    (let-mut par (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (ib) 0)))
    (let-mut ord (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (ic) 0)))
    (assert (forall ((ya int)) (not (mem vis ya))))
    (assert (forall ((ya int)) (== (at ord ya) 0)))
    (ghost-let vis0 (seq bool) vis)
    (set-idx vis s true)
    (assert (mem vis s))
    (assert (forall ((ya int)) (=> (!= ya s) (== (mem vis ya) (mem vis0 ya)))))
    (call bfs_init c f vis0 vis par ord s n)
    (let-mut next i64 1)
    (while true
      (invariant (st c f vis par ord s n next))
      (decreases (- n next))
      (let start i64 next)
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (st c f vis par ord s n next))
        (invariant (>= next start))
        (invariant (=> (== next start) (scanned c f vis u n)))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (assert (== (mem vis u) (idx vis u)))
        (if (idx vis u)
          (block
            (let-mut v i64 0)
            (while (< v n)
              (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
              (invariant (st c f vis par ord s n next))
              (invariant (mem vis u))
              (invariant (>= next start))
              (invariant (=> (== next start) (scanned c f vis u n)))
              (invariant (=> (== next start) (row_scan c f vis u v)))
              (decreases (- n v))
              (let ((rv bool)) (call residual c f u v n))
              (assert (== (mem vis v) (idx vis v)))
              (if (and (not (idx vis v)) rv)
                (block
                  (ghost-let b0 (seq bool) vis)
                  (ghost-let p0 (seq int) par)
                  (ghost-let o0 (seq int) ord)
                  (set-idx vis v true)
                  (set-idx par v u)
                  (set-idx ord v next)
                  (assert (mem vis v))
                  (assert (== (at par v) u))
                  (assert (== (at ord v) next))
                  (assert (marked b0 p0 o0 vis par ord u v next n))
                  (call mark_ok c f b0 p0 o0 vis par ord s n u v next)
                  (set next (+ next 1)))
                (assert (clo_pt c f vis u v)))
              (set v (+ v 1))))
          (block))
        (assert (=> (== next start) (row_scan c f vis u n)))
        (set u (+ u 1)))
      (if (== next start) (return vis par ord) (block)))
    (return vis par ord)))

(spec put
  (params (f (vec (vec i64))) (a i64) (w i64) (e i64) (n i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (is_matrix f n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)))
  (ensures (is_matrix r n) (== (get_flow r a w) e) (same_but f r a w))
  (effects))
(def put
  (body
    (assert (== (len (idx f a)) n))
    (let-mut m (vec (vec i64)) f)
    (set-idx (idx m a) w e)
    (assert (== (len m) n))
    (assert (== (len (idx m a)) n))
    (assert (== (idx (idx m a) w) e))
    (assert (forall ((ka int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 ka) (< ka n)) (!= ka a)) (== (idx m ka) (idx f ka)))))
    (assert (forall ((ya int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 ya) (< ya n)) (!= ya w)) (== (idx (idx m a) ya) (idx (idx f a) ya)))))
    (assert (== (get_flow m a w) e))
    (assert (is_matrix m n))
    (assert (same_but f m a w))
    (return m)))

(spec augment
  (params (fl (vec (vec i64))) (c (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (vis (ref (slice bool))) (par (ref (slice i64)))
          (ord (ref (slice i64))) (s i64) (t i64) (n i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (is_matrix c n) (is_matrix fl n) (cap_bounds c fl)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
            (== (len par) n) (mem vis t) (tree_ok c fl vis par ord s n) (balance fl s t s n))
  (ensures (is_matrix r n) (cap_bounds c r) (balance r s t s n) (== (excess r s n) (- (excess fl s n) 1)))
  (effects))
(def augment
  (body
    (let-mut f (vec (vec i64)) fl)
    (let-mut x i64 t)
    (ghost-let e0 int (excess fl s n))
    (assert (balance f s t x n))
    (assert (keep fl f ord (at ord x)))
    (assert (walk c fl f vis ord s t x n e0))
    (assert (tree_pt c fl vis par ord s n x))
    (while (!= x s)
      (invariant (walk c fl f vis ord s t x n e0))
      (invariant (tree_pt c fl vis par ord s n x))
      (decreases (at ord x))
      (let p i64 (idx par x))
      (assert (== p (at par x)))
      (assert (mem vis p))
      (assert (res c fl p x))
      (assert (< (at ord p) (at ord x)))
      (assert (== (get_flow f p x) (get_flow fl p x)))
      (assert (== (get_flow f x p) (get_flow fl x p)))
      (assert (== (len (idx f p)) n))
      (assert (== (len (idx f x)) n))
      (assert (== (len (idx c p)) n))
      (let fpx i64 (idx (idx f p) x))
      (let cpx i64 (idx (idx c p) x))
      (assert (== fpx (get_flow f p x)))
      (assert (== cpx (get_flow c p x)))
      (ghost-let f1 (seq (seq int)) f)
      (assert (tree_pt c fl vis par ord s n p))
      (if (< fpx cpx)
        (block
          (let ((f2 (vec (vec i64)))) (call put f p x (+ fpx 1) n))
          (call walk_step c fl f1 f2 vis ord s t x p p x 1 n e0)
          (set f f2))
        (block
          (let fxp i64 (idx (idx f x) p))
          (assert (== fxp (get_flow f x p)))
          (assert (> fxp 0))
          (assert (<= (get_flow f x p) (get_flow c x p)))
          (let ((f3 (vec (vec i64)))) (call put f x p (- fxp 1) n))
          (call walk_step c fl f1 f3 vis ord s t x p x p -1 n e0)
          (set f f3)))
      (set x p))
    (return f)))

(ghost-fn zrow ((r (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len r) n) (forall ((y int)) (== (at r y) 0)))))
(ghost-fn zrows ((m (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len m))) (zrow (idx m x) n)))))
(lemma zero_len (params (m (seq (seq int))) (n int) (x int))
  (requires (zrows m n))
  (ensures (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len m))) (== (len (idx m x)) n)))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len m)))
      (assert (zrow (idx m x) n))
      (block))))
(lemma zero_at (params (m (seq (seq int))) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (zrows m n))
  (ensures (== (get_flow m x y) 0))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len m)))
      (block
        (assert (zrow (idx m x) n))
        (assert (== (get_flow m x y) (at (idx m x) y))))
      (block))))
(lemma zrows_done (params (m (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (== (len m) n) (zrows m n))
  (ensures (is_matrix m n) (all_zero m))
  (body
    (forall ((xb int)) (call zero_len m n xb))
    (assert (is_matrix m n))
    (forall ((xb int) (yb int)) (call zero_at m n xb yb))
    (assert (all_zero m))))
(spec zero_matrix
  (params (n i64))
  (returns (z (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (ensures (is_matrix z n) (all_zero z))
  (effects alloc))
(def zero_matrix
  (body
    (let-mut m (vec (vec i64)) (vec-new))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (assert (== (len m) 0))
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (== (len m) u))
      (invariant (zrows m n))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let row (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j) 0)))
      (assert (zrow row n))
      (ghost-let m0 (seq (seq int)) m)
      (push m row)
      (assert (== (len m) (+ u 1)))
      (assert (== (idx m u) row))
      (assert (forall ((xb int)) (=> (and (<= 0 xb) (< xb u)) (== (idx m xb) (idx m0 xb)))))
      (assert (zrows m n))
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (call zrows_done m n)
    (return m)))

(ghost-fn row_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (r (seq int)) (i int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len r) (len g))
        (and (forall ((ya int)) (and (and (<= 0 (at r ya)) (<= (at r ya) 100000))
                                     (=> (> (at r ya) 0) (has_capacity g u ya (at r ya)))))
             (forall ((ka int))
               (=> (and (and (<= 0 ka) (< ka i)) (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< ka (len (idx g u)))))
                   (== (at r (get (idx (idx g u) ka) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) ka) 1))))))))
(ghost-fn rows_done ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len m) u)
             (forall ((xa int))
               (=> (and (and (<= 0 xa) (< xa u)) (< xa (len g)))
                   (row_ok g xa (idx m xa) (len (idx g xa))))))))
(lemma rows_done_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (== (len m) 0))
  (ensures (rows_done g m 0))
  (body (assert (rows_done g m 0))))
(lemma row_ok_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (r (seq int)))

(ghost-fn tot ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (tot h b (- a 1) n) (rd h b (- a 1) n)))))
(ghost-fn ri ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (ri h b u (- m 1)) (if (mem b (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn rr ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (q int) (a int)) int (decreases q)
  (body (if (<= q 0) 0 (+ (rr h b (- q 1) a) (ri h b (- q 1) a)))))
(ghost-fn csum ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (q int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (csum h b (- a 1) q) (if (mem b (- a 1)) (cs h (- a 1) q) 0)))))
(ghost-fn sx ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (sx h b (- a 1) n) (if (mem b (- a 1)) (- 0 (excess h (- a 1) n)) 0)))))
(lemma rd_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (m int))
  (ensures (== (rd h b u m) (- (if (mem b u) (rs h u m) 0) (ri h b u m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call rd_split h b u (- m 1)))))
(lemma rr_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (q int))
  (ensures (== (rr h b q 0) 0))
  (decreases q)
  (body (if (<= q 0) (block) (call rr_zero h b (- q 1)))))
(lemma rr_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (q int) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (rr h b q (+ a 1)) (+ (rr h b q a) (if (mem b a) (cs h a q) 0))))
  (decreases q)
  (body (if (<= q 0) (block) (call rr_step h b (- q 1) a))))
(lemma swap (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (q int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (csum h b a q) (rr h b q a)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (== a 0)
      (call rr_zero h b q)
      (block
        (call swap h b (- a 1) q)
        (call rr_step h b q (- a 1))))))
(lemma sx_tot (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (n int))
  (ensures (== (sx h b a n) (- (+ (tot h b a n) (rr h b a n)) (csum h b a n))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call sx_tot h b (- a 1) n)
        (call rd_split h b (- a 1) n)))))
(lemma sx_val (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (balance h s t s n) (mem b s) (not (mem b t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (<= a n))
  (ensures (== (sx h b a n) (if (< s a) (- 0 (excess h s n)) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) (block) (call sx_val h b s t n (- a 1)))))
(lemma val_tot (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (balance h s t s n) (mem b s) (not (mem b t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (tot h b n n) (- 0 (excess h s n))))
  (body
    (call sx_val h b s t n n)
    (call sx_tot h b n n)
    (call swap h b n n)))
(ghost-fn dom ((h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
        (<= (wt b u v (get_flow h u v)) (wt b u v (get_flow f u v)))))))
(lemma rd_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (dom h f b n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= m n))
  (ensures (<= (rd h b u m) (rd f b u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call rd_mono h f b n u (- m 1)))))
(lemma tot_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (dom h f b n) (<= a n))
  (ensures (<= (tot h b a n) (tot f b a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call tot_mono h f b n (- a 1))
        (call rd_mono h f b n (- a 1) n)))))

(ghost-fn res ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (or (< (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)) (> (get_flow f v u) 0))))
(ghost-fn clo_pt ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (mem b u) (res c f u v)) (mem b v))))
(ghost-fn row_scan ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y v)) (clo_pt c f b u y)))))
(ghost-fn scanned ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x u)) (row_scan c f b x n)))))
(lemma flow_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_pt g h u v) (cap_ok g c))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v)))
  (body
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((cc1 int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cc1) (<= (get_flow h u v) cc1)))
        (assert (<= cc1 (get_flow c u v))))
      (assert (>= (get_flow c u v) 0)))))
(lemma dom_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int)))
                      (b (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_like g h) (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f) (scanned c f b n n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (<= (wt b u v (get_flow h u v)) (wt b u v (get_flow f u v))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_pt g h u v))
    (call flow_le g c h u v)
    (assert (row_scan c f b u n))
    (assert (clo_pt c f b u v))
    (assert (row_scan c f b v n))
    (assert (clo_pt c f b v u))
    (assert (== (res c f u v) (or (< (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)) (> (get_flow f v u) 0))))
    (assert (== (res c f v u) (or (< (get_flow f v u) (get_flow c v u)) (> (get_flow f u v) 0))))))
(lemma flow_pt_of (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (flow_pt g h x y))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len h))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx h x)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow h x y) (idx (idx h x) y)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx h x) y) 0))
        (assert (=> (> (idx (idx h x) y) 0)
                    (exists ((cc1 int)) (and (has_capacity g x y cc1) (<= (idx (idx h x) y) cc1))))))
      (assert (== (get_flow h x y) 0)))))
(lemma fl_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f))
  (ensures (flow_pt g f x y))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f x y)) (<= (get_flow f x y) (get_flow c x y))))
    (if (> (get_flow f x y) 0)
      (block
        (assert (has_capacity g x y (get_flow c x y)))
        (assert (and (has_capacity g x y (get_flow c x y)) (<= (get_flow f x y) (get_flow c x y)))))
      (block))))
(lemma val_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x)))))
               (and (>= (idx (idx f x) y) 0)
                    (=> (> (idx (idx f x) y) 0)
                        (exists ((cc1 int)) (and (has_capacity g x y cc1) (<= (idx (idx f x) y) cc1)))))))
  (body
    (call fl_pt g c f x y)
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x)))))
      (assert (== (get_flow f x y) (idx (idx f x) y)))
      (block))))
(lemma valid_of (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f) (balance f s t s (len g)))
  (ensures (flow_like g f) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (forall ((xb int) (yb int)) (call fl_pt g c f xb yb))
    (assert (flow_like g f))
    (forall ((xb int) (yb int)) (call val_pt g c f xb yb))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (forall ((ub int)) (call cons_pt2 g f s t ub))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))
(lemma upper (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool))
                     (s int) (t int) (n int) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f) (flow_like g f) (balance f s t s n)
            (mem b s) (not (mem b t)) (scanned c f b n n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g h s)))
  (body
    (forall ((xb int) (yb int)) (call flow_pt_of g h s t xb yb))
    (assert (flow_like g h))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (call bal_of g h s t)
    (forall ((ub int) (vb int)) (call dom_at g c f h b n ub vb))
    (assert (dom h f b n))
    (call val_tot h b s t n)
    (call val_tot f b s t n)
    (call tot_mono h f b n n)
    (call exc_eq g h s)
    (call exc_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- 0 (excess h s n))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) (- 0 (excess f s n))))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool))
                      (s int) (t int) (n int) (total int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f) (balance f s t s n)
            (== (excess f s n) (- 0 total)) (mem b s) (not (mem b t)) (scanned c f b n n)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures (exists ((m (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g m s t) (== (flow_val g m s) total))))
  (body
    (call valid_of g c f s t)
    (forall ((h (seq (seq int)))) (call upper g c f b s t n h))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))
    (call exc_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) total))
    (assert (and (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) total)))))

(lemma sums_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (all_zero f))
  (ensures (== (rs f u m) 0) (== (cs f u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call sums_zero f u (- m 1)))))
(lemma zero_start (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_limit c) (all_zero f))
  (ensures (cap_bounds c f) (balance f s t s n) (== (excess f s n) 0))
  (body
    (forall ((ub int)) (call sums_zero f ub n))
    (assert (cap_bounds c f))
    (assert (balance f s t s n))
    (assert (== (excess f s n) 0))))
(lemma sums_bd (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (cap_limit c) (cap_bounds c f) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (<= (rs f u m) (* 100000 m)) (>= (cs f u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (== m 0) (block) (call sums_bd c f u (- m 1)))))
(lemma flow_bound (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_limit c) (cap_bounds c f) (and (<= 0 n) (<= n 1000)))
  (ensures (<= (- 0 (excess f s n)) 100000000))
  (body (call sums_bd c f s n)))

(ghost-fn same_but ((f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int))) (a int) (w int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (=> (or (!= x a) (!= y w)) (== (get_flow g x y) (get_flow f x y))))))
(lemma rs_upd (params (f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int))) (a int) (w int) (d int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (same_but f g a w) (== (get_flow g a w) (+ (get_flow f a w) d)))
  (ensures (== (rs g u m) (+ (rs f u m) (if (and (== u a) (and (<= 0 w) (< w m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call rs_upd f g a w d u (- m 1)))))
(lemma cs_upd (params (f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int))) (a int) (w int) (d int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (same_but f g a w) (== (get_flow g a w) (+ (get_flow f a w) d)))
  (ensures (== (cs g u m) (+ (cs f u m) (if (and (== u w) (and (<= 0 a) (< a m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call cs_upd f g a w d u (- m 1)))))
(lemma exc_upd (params (f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int))) (a int) (w int) (d int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (same_but f g a w) (== (get_flow g a w) (+ (get_flow f a w) d))
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)))
  (ensures (== (excess g u n) (+ (excess f u n) (- (if (== u w) d 0) (if (== u a) d 0)))))
  (body
    (call rs_upd f g a w d u n)
    (call cs_upd f g a w d u n)))
(ghost-fn keep ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (d int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (=> (and (<= (at o x) d) (<= (at o y) d)) (== (get_flow f x y) (get_flow f0 x y))))))
(ghost-fn walk ((c (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (o (seq int))
                (s int) (t int) (x int) (n int) (e0 int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
        (and (mem b x)
        (and (is_matrix f n)
        (and (cap_bounds c f)
        (and (balance f s t x n)
        (and (== (excess f s n) (if (== x s) (- e0 1) e0))
             (keep f0 f o (at o x))))))))))
(lemma walk_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int)))
                         (b (seq bool)) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int)
                         (a int) (w int) (d int) (n int) (e0 int))
  (requires (walk c f0 f b o s t x n e0) (!= x s)
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (mem b p) (< (at o p) (at o x))
            (or (and (== a p) (and (== w x) (== d 1))) (and (== a x) (and (== w p) (== d -1))))
            (is_matrix g n) (== (get_flow g a w) (+ (get_flow f a w) d)) (same_but f g a w)
            (and (<= 0 (get_flow g a w)) (<= (get_flow g a w) (get_flow c a w))))
  (ensures (walk c f0 g b o s t p n e0))
  (body
    (assert (!= p x))
    (forall ((ub int)) (call exc_upd f g a w d ub n))
    (assert (cap_bounds c g))
    (assert (balance g s t p n))
    (assert (== (excess g s n) (if (== p s) (- e0 1) e0)))
    (assert (keep f0 g o (at o p)))
    (assert (walk c f0 g b o s t p n e0))))

(ghost-fn tree_pt ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int))
                   (s int) (n int) (y int)) bool
  (body (=> (mem b y)
            (and (>= (at o y) 0)
                 (=> (!= y s)
                     (and (and (<= 0 (at p y)) (< (at p y) n))
                          (and (mem b (at p y))
                               (and (res c f (at p y) y) (< (at o (at p y)) (at o y))))))))))
(ghost-fn tree_ok ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int)) (s int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (tree_pt c f b p o s n y))))
(ghost-fn ords_ok ((b (seq bool)) (o (seq int)) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (mem b y) (< (at o y) k)))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((b (seq bool)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (cnt b (- m 1)) (if (mem b (- m 1)) 0 1)))))
(lemma cnt_nonneg (params (b (seq bool)) (m int))
  (ensures (>= (cnt b m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call cnt_nonneg b (- m 1)))))
(lemma cnt_all (params (b (seq bool)) (m int))
  (requires (forall ((y int)) (not (mem b y))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (cnt b m) m))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (== m 0) (block) (call cnt_all b (- m 1)))))
(lemma cnt_mark (params (b (seq bool)) (b2 (seq bool)) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (forall ((y int)) (=> (!= y v) (== (mem b2 y) (mem b y)))) (mem b2 v) (not (mem b v)))
  (ensures (== (cnt b2 m) (- (cnt b m) (if (and (<= 0 v) (< v m)) 1 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call cnt_mark b b2 v (- m 1)))))
(ghost-fn st ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (k int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len b) n) (and (== (len p) n) (== (len o) n)))
        (and (mem b s)
        (and (and (<= 1 k) (<= k n))
        (and (== (+ k (cnt b n)) n)
        (and (ords_ok b o k) (tree_ok c f b p o s n))))))))
(ghost-fn marked ((b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int)) (b2 (seq bool)) (p2 (seq int)) (o2 (seq int))
                  (u int) (v int) (k int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len b2) n) (and (== (len p2) n) (== (len o2) n)))
        (and (mem b2 v)
        (and (== (at p2 v) u)
        (and (== (at o2 v) k)
             (forall ((y int)) (=> (!= y v)
               (and (== (mem b2 y) (mem b y))
                    (and (== (at p2 y) (at p y)) (== (at o2 y) (at o y))))))))))))
(lemma bfs_init (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int)) (s int) (n int))
  (requires (forall ((y int)) (not (mem b0 y))) (mem b s)
            (forall ((y int)) (=> (!= y s) (== (mem b y) (mem b0 y))))
            (== (len b) n) (== (len p) n) (== (len o) n)
            (forall ((y int)) (== (at o y) 0))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (st c f b p o s n 1))
  (body
    (assert (not (mem b0 s)))
    (call cnt_all b0 n)
    (call cnt_mark b0 b s n)
    (assert (ords_ok b o 1))
    (assert (tree_ok c f b p o s n))
    (assert (st c f b p o s n 1))))
(lemma mark_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int))
                       (b2 (seq bool)) (p2 (seq int)) (o2 (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (u int) (v int) (k int) (y int))
  (requires (st c f b p o s n k) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (mem b u) (not (mem b v)) (res c f u v)
            (marked b p o b2 p2 o2 u v k n))
  (ensures (tree_pt c f b2 p2 o2 s n y))
  (body
    (assert (tree_pt c f b p o s n y))
    (assert (!= u v))
    (assert (!= v s))
    (assert (< (at o u) k))
    (assert (mem b2 u))
    (assert (== (at o2 u) (at o u)))
    (if (== y v)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (== (mem b2 y) (mem b y)))
        (assert (== (at p2 y) (at p y)))
        (assert (== (at o2 y) (at o y)))
        (assert (=> (and (mem b y) (!= y s))
                    (and (!= (at p y) v)
                         (and (== (mem b2 (at p y)) (mem b (at p y)))
                              (== (at o2 (at p y)) (at o (at p y)))))))))))
(lemma mark_ok (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int))
                       (b2 (seq bool)) (p2 (seq int)) (o2 (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (u int) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (st c f b p o s n k) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (mem b u) (not (mem b v)) (res c f u v) (marked b p o b2 p2 o2 u v k n))
  (ensures (st c f b2 p2 o2 s n (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((yb int)) (call mark_pt c f b p o b2 p2 o2 s n u v k yb))
    (assert (tree_ok c f b2 p2 o2 s n))
    (assert (ords_ok b2 o2 (+ k 1)))
    (assert (!= v s))
    (assert (mem b2 s))
    (assert (forall ((yb int)) (=> (!= yb v) (== (mem b2 yb) (mem b yb)))))
    (call cnt_mark b b2 v n)
    (call cnt_nonneg b2 n)
    (assert (st c f b2 p2 o2 s n (+ k 1)))))

(spec residual
