  (body (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))))
(lemma conn_refl (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x x))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit x))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) x))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (call conn_intro es p x x)))
(lemma snoc_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (c int) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (> (len p) 0) (edge_in_set es (idx p (- (len p) 1)) c) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (concat p (seq-lit c)) k) (idx (concat p (seq-lit c)) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit c) k)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit c) (+ k 1))
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (call path_step es p k (+ k 1))
      (block
        (assert (== (- (+ k 1) (len p)) 0))
        (assert (== (idx (seq-lit c) 0) c))
        (assert (== (idx p k) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))
(lemma conn_snoc (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (edges_connected es a b) (edge_in_set es b c))
  (ensures (edges_connected es a c))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected es a b))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p (- (len p) 1)) c))
    (forall ((k int)) (call snoc_step es p c k))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit c)))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es q))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit c) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit c) (len p))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit c) 0) c))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) c))
    (call conn_intro es q a c)))
(lemma conn_edge (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x y))
  (body (call conn_refl es x) (call conn_snoc es x x y)))
(ghost-fn is_rev ((p (seq int)) (q (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (== (len q) (len p))
    (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))) (== (idx q i) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) i))))))))
(lemma rev_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (is_rev p q) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (is_rev p q))
    (assert (== (idx q k) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) k))))
    (assert (== (idx q (+ k 1)) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) (+ k 1)))))
    (call path_step es p (- (- (len p) 1) (+ k 1)) (- (- (len p) 1) k))
    (call eis_sym es (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) (+ k 1))) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) k)))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected es y x))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected es x y))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build (len p) (fn (i) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) i)))))
    (assert (is_rev p q))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rev_step es p q k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) 0))))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len p) 1)) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 1)))))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) y))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) x))
    (call conn_intro es q y x)))
(ghost-fn closed ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (iset int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
    (== (contains x (get (idx es k) 0)) (contains x (get (idx es k) 1)))))))
(lemma closed_use (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (iset int)) (m int))
  (requires (closed es x) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len es))))
  (ensures (== (contains x (get (idx es m) 0)) (contains x (get (idx es m) 1))))
  (body (assert (closed es x))))
(lemma closed_path (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (iset int)) (p (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires (closed es x) (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len p))) (contains x (idx p 0)))
  (ensures (contains x (idx p j)))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (== j 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call closed_path es x p (- j 1))
        (call path_step es p (- j 1) j)
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p (- j 1)) (idx p j)))
        (obtain ((m int)) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len es)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx es m) 0) (idx p (- j 1))) (== (get (idx es m) 1) (idx p j)))
              (and (== (get (idx es m) 0) (idx p j)) (== (get (idx es m) 1) (idx p (- j 1)))))))
        (call closed_use es x m)))))
(lemma closed_conn (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (iset int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (closed es x) (contains x a) (edges_connected es a b))
  (ensures (contains x b))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected es a b))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (call closed_path es x p (- (len p) 1))))
(ghost-fn reach_set ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int)) (iset int)
  (body (iset-of ((z int)) (edges_connected es a z))))
(lemma reach_mem (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (z1 int))
  (ensures (== (contains (reach_set es a) z1) (edges_connected es a z1)))
  (body))
(lemma reach_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es))))
  (ensures (== (contains (reach_set es a) (get (idx es k) 0)) (contains (reach_set es a) (get (idx es k) 1))))
  (body
    (call eis_intro es k (get (idx es k) 0) (get (idx es k) 1))
    (call eis_sym es (get (idx es k) 0) (get (idx es k) 1))
    (call reach_mem es a (get (idx es k) 0))
    (call reach_mem es a (get (idx es k) 1))
    (if (edges_connected es a (get (idx es k) 0)) (call conn_snoc es a (get (idx es k) 0) (get (idx es k) 1)) (block))
    (if (edges_connected es a (get (idx es k) 1)) (call conn_snoc es a (get (idx es k) 1) (get (idx es k) 0)) (block))))
(lemma reach_closed (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int))
  (ensures (closed es (reach_set es a)))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call reach_step es a k))
    (assert (closed es (reach_set es a)))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (edges_connected es a b) (edges_connected es b c))
  (ensures (edges_connected es a c))
  (body
    (call reach_closed es a)
    (call reach_mem es a b)
    (call closed_conn es (reach_set es a) b c)
    (call reach_mem es a c)))
(lemma meet (params (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (edges_connected d u c) (edges_connected d v c))
  (ensures (edges_connected d u v))
  (body (call conn_sym d v c) (call conn_trans d u c v)))
(ghost-fn lifts ((a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a)))
    (edges_connected b (get (idx a k) 0) (get (idx a k) 1))))))
(lemma lift_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (lifts a b) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a))))
  (ensures (== (contains (reach_set b x) (get (idx a k) 0)) (contains (reach_set b x) (get (idx a k) 1))))
  (body
    (assert (lifts a b))
    (ghost-let c0 int (get (idx a k) 0))
    (ghost-let c1 int (get (idx a k) 1))
    (assert (edges_connected b c0 c1))
    (call conn_sym b c0 c1)
    (call reach_mem b x c0)
    (call reach_mem b x c1)
    (if (edges_connected b x c0) (call conn_trans b x c0 c1) (block))
    (if (edges_connected b x c1) (call conn_trans b x c1 c0) (block))))
(lemma conn_lift (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (lifts a b) (edges_connected a x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected b x y))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call lift_step a b x k))
    (assert (closed a (reach_set b x)))
    (call conn_refl b x)
    (call reach_mem b x x)
    (call closed_conn a (reach_set b x) x y)
    (call reach_mem b x y)))
(ghost-fn subof ((a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((t (tuple int int int))) (=> (contains a t) (contains b t)))))
(lemma edge_of_contains (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (contains es t))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (get t 0) (get t 1)))
  (body
    (obtain ((m int)) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len es))) (== (idx es m) t)))
    (call eis_intro es m (get t 0) (get t 1))))
(lemma sub_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (subof a b) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a))))
  (ensures (edges_connected b (get (idx a k) 0) (get (idx a k) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (contains a (idx a k)))
    (assert (subof a b))
    (assert (contains b (idx a k)))
    (call edge_of_contains b (idx a k))
    (call conn_edge b (get (idx a k) 0) (get (idx a k) 1))))
(lemma lifts_of_sub (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (subof a b))
  (ensures (lifts a b))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call sub_step a b k))
    (assert (lifts a b))))
(lemma conn_sub (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (subof a b) (edges_connected a x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected b x y))
  (body (call lifts_of_sub a b) (call conn_lift a b x y)))
(lemma es_nil_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (== (len a) 0) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len b))))
  (ensures (== (idx (concat a b) i) (idx b i)))
  (body (assert (== (len (concat a b)) (len b)))))
(lemma es_nil_concat (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len a) 0))
  (ensures (== (concat a b) b))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call es_nil_step a b i))
    (assert (== (len (concat a b)) (len b)))))
(lemma es_cn_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (== (len b) 0) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len a))))
  (ensures (== (idx (concat a b) i) (idx a i)))
  (body (assert (== (len (concat a b)) (len a)))))
(lemma es_concat_nil (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len b) 0))
  (ensures (== (concat a b) a))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call es_cn_step a b i))
    (assert (== (len (concat a b)) (len a)))))
(lemma es_assoc_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (+ (len a) (+ (len b) (len c))))))
  (ensures (== (idx (concat (concat a b) c) i) (idx (concat a (concat b c)) i)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat a b)) (+ (len a) (len b))))
    (assert (== (len (concat b c)) (+ (len b) (len c))))))
(lemma es_assoc (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (concat (concat a b) c) (concat a (concat b c))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call es_assoc_step a b c i))
    (assert (== (len (concat (concat a b) c)) (len (concat a (concat b c)))))))
(lemma head_step (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (> (len r) 0) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r))))
  (ensures (== (idx r i) (idx (concat (seq-lit (idx r 0)) (drop r 1)) i)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (seq-lit (idx r 0))) 1))
    (assert (== (len (drop r 1)) (- (len r) 1)))
    (if (== i 0)
      (assert (== (idx (seq-lit (idx r 0)) 0) (idx r 0)))
      (assert (== (idx (drop r 1) (- i 1)) (idx r i))))))
(lemma es_head (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (> (len r) 0))
  (ensures (== r (concat (seq-lit (idx r 0)) (drop r 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call head_step r i))
    (assert (== (len (concat (seq-lit (idx r 0)) (drop r 1))) (len r)))))
(lemma dc_step (params (x (seq (tuple int int int))) (y (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (> (len x) 0) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (+ (- (len x) 1) (len y)))))
  (ensures (== (idx (drop (concat x y) 1) i) (idx (concat (drop x 1) y) i)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat x y)) (+ (len x) (len y))))
    (assert (== (len (drop x 1)) (- (len x) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (drop (concat x y) 1) i) (idx (concat x y) (+ i 1))))
    (if (< (+ i 1) (len x))
      (assert (== (idx (drop x 1) i) (idx x (+ i 1))))
      (assert (== (- (+ i 1) (len x)) (- i (- (len x) 1)))))))
(lemma drop_concat (params (x (seq (tuple int int int))) (y (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (> (len x) 0))
  (ensures (== (drop (concat x y) 1) (concat (drop x 1) y)))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call dc_step x y i))
    (assert (== (len (drop (concat x y) 1)) (len (concat (drop x 1) y))))))
(lemma tw_concat (params (x (seq (tuple int int int))) (y (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat x y)) (+ (total_weight x) (total_weight y))))
  (decreases (len x))
  (body
    (if (== (len x) 0)
      (block (call es_nil_concat x y) (assert (== (total_weight x) 0)))
      (block
        (call drop_concat x y)
        (call tw_concat (drop x 1) y)
        (assert (== (total_weight x) (+ (get (idx x 0) 2) (total_weight (drop x 1)))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat x y) 0) (idx x 0)))
        (assert (== (total_weight (concat x y)) (+ (get (idx (concat x y) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (concat x y) 1)))))))))
(lemma tw_unit (params (t (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (seq-lit t)) (get t 2)))
  (body
    (ghost-let u0 (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-lit t))
    (assert (== (len u0) 1))
    (assert (== (idx u0 0) t))
    (assert (== (len (drop u0 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight (drop u0 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight u0) (+ (get (idx u0 0) 2) (total_weight (drop u0 1)))))))
(ghost-fn ins ((s (seq bool)) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len s))) (idx s x))))
(ghost-fn crosses ((s (seq bool)) (t (tuple int int int))) bool
  (body (!= (ins s (get t 0)) (ins s (get t 1)))))
(ghost-fn nocross ((s (seq bool)) (k (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len k))) (not (crosses s (idx k j)))))))
(ghost-fn ins_set ((s (seq bool))) (iset int)
  (body (iset-of ((z int)) (ins s z))))
(lemma ins_mem (params (s (seq bool)) (z1 int))
  (ensures (== (contains (ins_set s) z1) (ins s z1)))
  (body))
(lemma ins_step (params (s (seq bool)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (nocross s es) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es))))
  (ensures (== (contains (ins_set s) (get (idx es k) 0)) (contains (ins_set s) (get (idx es k) 1))))
  (body
    (assert (nocross s es))
    (assert (not (crosses s (idx es k))))
    (call ins_mem s (get (idx es k) 0))
    (call ins_mem s (get (idx es k) 1))))
(lemma closed_ins (params (s (seq bool)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (nocross s es))
  (ensures (closed es (ins_set s)))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call ins_step s es k))
    (assert (closed es (ins_set s)))))
(lemma cut_empty (params (s (seq bool)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (nocross s es) (!= (ins s u) (ins s v)) (edges_connected es u v))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (call closed_ins s es)
    (call ins_mem s u)
    (call ins_mem s v)
    (call conn_sym es u v)
    (if (ins s u)
      (call closed_conn es (ins_set s) u v)
      (call closed_conn es (ins_set s) v u))))
(ghost-fn almost ((a (seq (tuple int int int))) (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int))) bool
  (body (forall ((t (tuple int int int))) (=> (contains a t) (or (contains d t) (== t f))))))
(lemma touch_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (almost a d f) (not (edges_connected d u (get f 0))) (not (edges_connected d u (get f 1))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len a))))
  (ensures (== (contains (reach_set d u) (get (idx a j) 0)) (contains (reach_set d u) (get (idx a j) 1))))
  (body
    (assert (contains a (idx a j)))
    (assert (almost a d f))
    (assert (or (contains d (idx a j)) (== (idx a j) f)))
    (call reach_mem d u (get (idx a j) 0))
    (call reach_mem d u (get (idx a j) 1))
    (if (== (idx a j) f)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (contains d (idx a j)))
        (obtain ((m int)) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len d))) (== (idx d m) (idx a j))))
        (call reach_closed d u)
        (call closed_use d (reach_set d u) m)))))
(lemma touch (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (almost a d f) (edges_connected a u v) (not (edges_connected d u v)))
  (ensures (or (edges_connected d u (get f 0)) (edges_connected d u (get f 1))))
  (body
    (if (or (edges_connected d u (get f 0)) (edges_connected d u (get f 1)))
      (return)
      (block
        (forall ((j int)) (call touch_step a d f u j))
        (assert (closed a (reach_set d u)))
        (call conn_refl d u)
        (call reach_mem d u u)
        (call closed_conn a (reach_set d u) u v)
        (call reach_mem d u v)))))
(ghost-fn rejoins ((d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (or (and (edges_connected d u (get f 0)) (edges_connected d v (get f 1)))
            (and (edges_connected d u (get f 1)) (edges_connected d v (get f 0))))))
(lemma rejoin (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (almost a d f) (edges_connected a u v) (not (edges_connected d u v)))
  (ensures (rejoins d f u v))
  (body
    (call touch a d f u v)
    (call conn_sym a u v)
    (if (edges_connected d v u) (call conn_sym d v u) (block))
    (call touch a d f v u)
    (if (and (edges_connected d u (get f 0)) (edges_connected d v (get f 0))) (call meet d u v (get f 0)) (block))
    (if (and (edges_connected d u (get f 1)) (edges_connected d v (get f 1))) (call meet d u v (get f 1)) (block))
    (assert (rejoins d f u v))))
(lemma rejoins_sub (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (subof a b) (rejoins a f u v))
  (ensures (rejoins b f u v))
  (body
    (assert (rejoins a f u v))
    (if (edges_connected a u (get f 0)) (call conn_sub a b u (get f 0)) (block))
    (if (edges_connected a v (get f 1)) (call conn_sub a b v (get f 1)) (block))
    (if (edges_connected a u (get f 1)) (call conn_sub a b u (get f 1)) (block))
    (if (edges_connected a v (get f 0)) (call conn_sub a b v (get f 0)) (block))
    (assert (rejoins b f u v))))
(lemma rejoin_ends (params (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (rejoins d f u v) (edge_in_set d u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected d (get f 0) (get f 1)))
  (body
    (call conn_edge d u v)
    (call conn_sym d u v)
    (assert (rejoins d f u v))
    (if (and (edges_connected d u (get f 0)) (edges_connected d v (get f 1)))
      (block
        (call conn_sym d u (get f 0))
        (call conn_trans d (get f 0) u v)
        (call conn_trans d (get f 0) v (get f 1)))
      (block
        (call conn_sym d v (get f 0))
        (call conn_trans d (get f 0) v u)
        (call conn_trans d (get f 0) u (get f 1))))))
(ghost-fn split_ok ((s (seq bool)) (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int)
                    (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (r2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (and (and (== r (concat r1 (concat (seq-lit f) r2))) (crosses s f))
             (rejoins (concat k (concat r1 r2)) f u v))))
(lemma split_lift (params (s (seq bool)) (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (r0 (tuple int int int))
                          (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (a1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (g1 (tuple int int int))
                          (a2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (d (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== r (concat (seq-lit r0) rest))
            (== rest (concat a1 (concat (seq-lit g1) a2)))
            (crosses s g1)
            (rejoins d g1 u v)
            (subof d (concat k (concat (concat (seq-lit r0) a1) a2))))
  (ensures (split_ok s k r u v (concat (seq-lit r0) a1) g1 a2))
  (body
    (call es_assoc (seq-lit r0) a1 (concat (seq-lit g1) a2))
    (call rejoins_sub d (concat k (concat (concat (seq-lit r0) a1) a2)) g1 u v)
    (assert (split_ok s k r u v (concat (seq-lit r0) a1) g1 a2))))
(lemma split_here (params (s (seq bool)) (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (r0 (tuple int int int))
                          (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (nil (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== r (concat (seq-lit r0) rest))
            (crosses s r0)
            (edges_connected (concat k r) u v)
            (not (edges_connected (concat k rest) u v))
            (== (len nil) 0))
  (ensures (split_ok s k r u v nil r0 rest))
  (body
    (assert (almost (concat k r) (concat k rest) r0))
    (call rejoin (concat k r) (concat k rest) r0 u v)
    (call es_nil_concat nil rest)
    (call es_nil_concat nil (concat (seq-lit r0) rest))
    (assert (split_ok s k r u v nil r0 rest))))
(lemma ncs_step (params (s (seq bool)) (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (r0 (tuple int int int)) (j int))
  (requires (nocross s k) (not (crosses s r0)) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (concat k (seq-lit r0))))))
  (ensures (not (crosses s (idx (concat k (seq-lit r0)) j))))
  (body
    (assert (nocross s k))
    (if (< j (len k))
      (block
        (assert (not (crosses s (idx k j))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat k (seq-lit r0)) j) (idx k j))))
      (block
        (assert (== (- j (len k)) 0))
        (assert (== (idx (seq-lit r0) 0) r0))
        (assert (== (idx (concat k (seq-lit r0)) j) r0))))))
(lemma nocross_snoc (params (s (seq bool)) (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (r0 (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (nocross s k) (not (crosses s r0)))
  (ensures (nocross s (concat k (seq-lit r0))))
  (body
    (forall ((j int)) (call ncs_step s k r0 j))
    (assert (nocross s (concat k (seq-lit r0))))))
(lemma split_cut (params (s (seq bool)) (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (nocross s k) (!= (ins s u) (ins s v)) (edges_connected (concat k r) u v))
  (ensures (exists ((r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (r2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (split_ok s k r u v r1 f r2)))
  (decreases (len r))
  (body
    (if (== (len r) 0)
      (block
        (call es_concat_nil k r)
        (call cut_empty s k u v))
      (block
        (call es_head r)
        (ghost-let r0 (tuple int int int) (idx r 0))
        (ghost-let rest (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop r 1))
        (assert (== r (concat (seq-lit r0) rest)))
        (if (crosses s r0)
          (if (edges_connected (concat k rest) u v)
            (block
              (assert (subof (concat k rest) (concat k r)))
              (call split_cut s k rest u v)
              (obtain ((a1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (g1 (tuple int int int)) (a2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
                (split_ok s k rest u v a1 g1 a2))
              (assert (split_ok s k rest u v a1 g1 a2))
              (assert (subof (concat k (concat a1 a2)) (concat k (concat (concat (seq-lit r0) a1) a2))))
              (call split_lift s k r r0 rest u v a1 g1 a2 (concat k (concat a1 a2))))
            (block
              (ghost-let nil (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-lit))
              (call split_here s k r r0 rest u v nil)))
          (block
            (call nocross_snoc s k r0)
            (assert (subof (concat k r) (concat (concat k (seq-lit r0)) rest)))
            (call conn_sub (concat k r) (concat (concat k (seq-lit r0)) rest) u v)
            (call split_cut s (concat k (seq-lit r0)) rest u v)
            (obtain ((b1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (h1 (tuple int int int)) (b2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
              (split_ok s (concat k (seq-lit r0)) rest u v b1 h1 b2))
            (assert (split_ok s (concat k (seq-lit r0)) rest u v b1 h1 b2))
            (assert (subof (concat (concat k (seq-lit r0)) (concat b1 b2)) (concat k (concat (concat (seq-lit r0) b1) b2))))
            (call split_lift s k r r0 rest u v b1 h1 b2 (concat (concat k (seq-lit r0)) (concat b1 b2)))))))))
(ghost-fn is_light ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (e (tuple int int int))) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int) (c int))
    (=> (and (has_edge g a b c) (!= (ins s a) (ins s b))) (<= (get e 2) c)))))
(lemma light_use (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (e (tuple int int int)) (f (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (is_light g s e) (has_edge g (get f 0) (get f 1) (get f 2)) (crosses s f))
  (ensures (<= (get e 2) (get f 2)))
  (body
    (assert (is_light g s e))
    (assert (crosses s f))))
(lemma valid_mem (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (contains es t))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get t 0) (get t 1) (get t 2)))
  (body
    (assert (are_valid_edges g es))
    (obtain ((m int)) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len es))) (== (idx es m) t)))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx es m) 0) (get (idx es m) 1) (get (idx es m) 2)))))
(lemma valid_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g d) (has_edge g (get f 0) (get f 1) (get f 2)) (almost a d f) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx a k) 0) (get (idx a k) 1) (get (idx a k) 2)))
  (body
    (assert (contains a (idx a k)))
    (assert (almost a d f))
    (if (== (idx a k) f)
      (block)
      (call valid_mem g d (idx a k)))))
(lemma valid_almost (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g d) (has_edge g (get f 0) (get f 1) (get f 2)) (almost a d f))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g a))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call valid_step g a d f k))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g a))))
(lemma la_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (almost a d f) (edges_connected d (get f 0) (get f 1)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a))))
  (ensures (edges_connected d (get (idx a k) 0) (get (idx a k) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (contains a (idx a k)))
    (assert (almost a d f))
    (if (== (idx a k) f)
      (block)
      (block
        (call edge_of_contains d (idx a k))
        (call conn_edge d (get (idx a k) 0) (get (idx a k) 1))))))
(lemma lifts_almost (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (almost a d f) (edges_connected d (get f 0) (get f 1)))
  (ensures (lifts a d))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call la_step a d f k))
    (assert (lifts a d))))
(lemma span_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_spanning g a) (lifts a b) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected b x y))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning g a))
    (assert (edges_connected a x y))
    (call conn_lift a b x y)))
(ghost-fn improves ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat t r)) (<= (total_weight (concat t r)) (total_weight o)))))
(ghost-fn extendable ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (exists ((r (seq (tuple int int int)))) (improves g t r o))))))
(lemma exchange_core (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq bool)) (e (tuple int int int))
                             (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int)))
                             (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (r2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g (concat t r))
            (<= (total_weight (concat t r)) (total_weight o))
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (is_light g s e)
            (split_ok s t r (get e 0) (get e 1) r1 f r2))
  (ensures (improves g (concat t (seq-lit e)) (concat r1 r2) o))
  (body
    (assert (split_ok s t r (get e 0) (get e 1) r1 f r2))
    (ghost-let big (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat t r))
    (ghost-let nxt (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) (concat r1 r2)))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g big))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g big))
    (assert (is_spanning g big))
    (assert (== (len big) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (contains (seq-lit f) f))
    (assert (contains big f))
    (call valid_mem g big f)
    (call light_use g s e f)
    (assert (almost nxt big e))
    (call valid_almost g nxt big e)
    (assert (== (len r) (+ (len r1) (+ 1 (len r2)))))
    (assert (== (len nxt) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (subof (concat t (concat r1 r2)) nxt))
    (call rejoins_sub (concat t (concat r1 r2)) nxt f (get e 0) (get e 1))
    (assert (contains (seq-lit e) e))
    (assert (contains nxt e))
    (call edge_of_contains nxt e)
    (call rejoin_ends nxt f (get e 0) (get e 1))
    (assert (almost big nxt f))
    (call lifts_almost big nxt f)
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call span_step g big nxt x y))
    (assert (is_spanning g nxt))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g nxt))
    (call tw_unit f)
    (call tw_unit e)
    (call tw_concat t r)
    (call tw_concat r1 (concat (seq-lit f) r2))
    (call tw_concat (seq-lit f) r2)
    (call tw_concat (concat t (seq-lit e)) (concat r1 r2))
    (call tw_concat t (seq-lit e))
    (call tw_concat r1 r2)
    (assert (== (total_weight r) (total_weight (concat r1 (concat (seq-lit f) r2)))))
    (assert (<= (total_weight nxt) (total_weight big)))
    (assert (improves g (concat t (seq-lit e)) (concat r1 r2) o))))
(lemma exchange_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq bool)) (e (tuple int int int))
                            (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g (concat t r))
            (<= (total_weight (concat t r)) (total_weight o))
            (nocross s t)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 (get e 1)) (< (get e 1) (len g)))
            (crosses s e)
            (is_light g s e))
  (ensures (exists ((r9 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (improves g (concat t (seq-lit e)) r9 o)))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g (concat t r)))
    (assert (is_spanning g (concat t r)))
    (assert (edges_connected (concat t r) (get e 0) (get e 1)))
    (assert (crosses s e))
    (assert (!= (ins s (get e 0)) (ins s (get e 1))))
    (call split_cut s t r (get e 0) (get e 1))
    (obtain ((r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (r2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (split_ok s t r (get e 0) (get e 1) r1 f r2))
    (call exchange_core g t s e r o r1 f r2)
    (assert (improves g (concat t (seq-lit e)) (concat r1 r2) o))))
(lemma exchange_o (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq bool)) (e (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (extendable g t)
            (is_spanning_tree g o)
            (nocross s t)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 (get e 1)) (< (get e 1) (len g)))
            (crosses s e)
            (is_light g s e))
  (ensures (exists ((r9 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (improves g (concat t (seq-lit e)) r9 o)))
  (body
    (assert (extendable g t))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o))
    (obtain ((r (seq (tuple int int int)))) (improves g t r o))
    (assert (improves g t r o))
    (call exchange_one g t s e r o)))
(lemma exchange_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq bool)) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (extendable g t)
            (nocross s t)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 (get e 1)) (< (get e 1) (len g)))
            (crosses s e)
            (is_light g s e))
  (ensures (extendable g (concat t (seq-lit e))))
  (body
    (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call exchange_o g t s e o))
    (assert (extendable g (concat t (seq-lit e))))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((s (seq bool)) (m int)) int
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len s))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (== m 0) 0 (+ (cnt s (- m 1)) (if (idx s (- m 1)) 1 0)))))
(lemma cnt_le (params (s (seq bool)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len s))))
  (ensures (<= (cnt s m) m))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (== m 0) (block) (call cnt_le s (- m 1)))))
(lemma cnt_true (params (s (seq bool)) (m int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len s))) (== (cnt s m) m) (and (<= 0 j) (< j m)))
  (ensures (idx s j))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (call cnt_le s (- m 1))
    (assert (== (cnt s m) (+ (cnt s (- m 1)) (if (idx s (- m 1)) 1 0))))
    (if (== j (- m 1)) (block) (call cnt_true s (- m 1) j))))
(lemma cnt_gap (params (s (seq bool)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len s))) (< (cnt s m) m))
  (ensures (exists ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x m)) (not (idx s x)))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (assert (== (cnt s 0) 0))
      (block
        (assert (== (cnt s m) (+ (cnt s (- m 1)) (if (idx s (- m 1)) 1 0))))
        (if (idx s (- m 1))
          (call cnt_gap s (- m 1))
          (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- m 1)) (< (- m 1) m)) (not (idx s (- m 1))))))))))
(ghost-fn updated ((s (seq bool)) (s2 (seq bool)) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s2) (len s)) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len s))))
    (and (idx s2 x)
      (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))) (!= i x)) (== (idx s2 i) (idx s i))))))))
(lemma cnt_update (params (s (seq bool)) (s2 (seq bool)) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (updated s s2 x) (not (idx s x)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len s))))
  (ensures (== (cnt s2 m) (+ (cnt s m) (if (< x m) 1 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (updated s s2 x))
    (if (== m 0)
      (assert (and (== (cnt s 0) 0) (== (cnt s2 0) 0)))
      (block
        (call cnt_update s s2 x (- m 1))
        (assert (== (cnt s m) (+ (cnt s (- m 1)) (if (idx s (- m 1)) 1 0))))
        (assert (== (cnt s2 m) (+ (cnt s2 (- m 1)) (if (idx s2 (- m 1)) 1 0))))
        (if (== (- m 1) x)
          (assert (and (idx s2 x) (not (idx s x))))
          (assert (== (idx s2 (- m 1)) (idx s (- m 1)))))))))
(lemma ins_updated (params (s (seq bool)) (s2 (seq bool)) (x int) (z int))
  (requires (updated s s2 x))
  (ensures (== (ins s2 z) (or (ins s z) (== z x))))
  (body
    (assert (updated s s2 x))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len s))) (!= z x))
      (assert (== (idx s2 z) (idx s z)))
      (block))))
(ghost-fn inside ((s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len t)))
    (and (ins s (get (idx t j) 0)) (ins s (get (idx t j) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn all_reached ((s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (ins s x) (edges_connected t 0 x)))))
(ghost-fn state_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s) (len g)) (ins s 0))
    (and (and (== (cnt s (len s)) (+ k 1)) (== (len t) k))
      (and (and (are_valid_edges g t) (inside s t))
        (and (all_reached s t) (extendable g t)))))))
(lemma nc_step (params (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int))
  (requires (inside s t) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len t))))
  (ensures (not (crosses s (idx t j))))
  (body
    (assert (inside s t))
    (assert (and (ins s (get (idx t j) 0)) (ins s (get (idx t j) 1))))
    (assert (not (crosses s (idx t j))))))
(lemma inside_nocross (params (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (inside s t))
  (ensures (nocross s t))
  (body
    (forall ((j int)) (call nc_step s t j))
    (assert (nocross s t))))
(lemma inside_step (params (s (seq bool)) (s2 (seq bool)) (x int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int))
  (requires (inside s t) (updated s s2 x) (ins s2 (get e 0)) (ins s2 (get e 1))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (concat t (seq-lit e))))))
  (ensures (and (ins s2 (get (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) j) 0)) (ins s2 (get (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) j) 1))))
  (body
    (if (< j (len t))
      (block
        (assert (inside s t))
        (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) j) (idx t j)))
        (assert (and (ins s (get (idx t j) 0)) (ins s (get (idx t j) 1))))
        (call ins_updated s s2 x (get (idx t j) 0))
        (call ins_updated s s2 x (get (idx t j) 1)))
      (block
        (assert (== (- j (len t)) 0))
        (assert (== (idx (seq-lit e) 0) e))
        (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) j) e))))))
(lemma all_step (params (s (seq bool)) (s2 (seq bool)) (x int) (y int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (z int))
  (requires (all_reached s t) (updated s s2 x) (subof t t2) (edge_in_set t2 y x) (ins s y) (ins s2 z))
  (ensures (edges_connected t2 0 z))
  (body
    (call ins_updated s s2 x z)
    (assert (all_reached s t))
    (assert (edges_connected t 0 y))
    (call conn_sub t t2 0 y)
    (if (== z x)
      (call conn_snoc t2 0 y x)
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected t 0 z))
        (call conn_sub t t2 0 z)))))
(lemma state_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int)
                          (e (tuple int int int)) (s2 (seq bool)) (x int))
  (requires (state_ok g s t k)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 (get e 1)) (< (get e 1) (len g)))
            (crosses s e)
            (is_light g s e)
            (updated s s2 x)
            (not (ins s x))
            (or (== x (get e 0)) (== x (get e 1))))
  (ensures (state_ok g s2 (concat t (seq-lit e)) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (assert (state_ok g s t k))
    (assert (updated s s2 x))
    (assert (crosses s e))
    (call inside_nocross s t)
    (call exchange_all g t s e)
    (ghost-let t2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat t (seq-lit e)))
    (ghost-let y int (if (== x (get e 0)) (get e 1) (get e 0)))
    (assert (ins s y))
    (assert (not (idx s x)))
    (call cnt_update s s2 x (len s))
    (assert (== (cnt s2 (len s2)) (+ (cnt s (len s)) 1)))
    (call ins_updated s s2 x 0)
    (call ins_updated s s2 x (get e 0))
    (call ins_updated s s2 x (get e 1))
    (assert (almost t2 t e))
    (call valid_almost g t2 t e)
    (forall ((j int)) (call inside_step s s2 x t e j))
    (assert (inside s2 t2))
    (assert (subof t t2))
    (assert (contains (seq-lit e) e))
    (assert (contains t2 e))
    (call edge_of_contains t2 e)
    (call eis_sym t2 (get e 0) (get e 1))
    (assert (edge_in_set t2 y x))
    (forall ((z int)) (call all_step s s2 x y t t2 z))
    (assert (all_reached s2 t2))
    (assert (== (len t2) (+ k 1)))
    (assert (state_ok g s2 t2 (+ k 1)))))
(ghost-fn root_only ((s (seq bool))) bool
  (body (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))) (== (idx s i) (== i 0))))))
(lemma root_cnt (params (s (seq bool)) (m int))
  (requires (root_only s) (and (<= 1 m) (<= m (len s))))
  (ensures (== (cnt s m) 1))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (root_only s))
    (assert (== (cnt s m) (+ (cnt s (- m 1)) (if (idx s (- m 1)) 1 0))))
    (if (== m 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (cnt s 0) 0))
        (assert (idx s 0)))
      (block
        (call root_cnt s (- m 1))
        (assert (not (idx s (- m 1))))))))
(lemma reached_root (params (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int))
  (requires (root_only s) (ins s x))
  (ensures (edges_connected t 0 x))
  (body
    (assert (root_only s))
    (assert (ins s x))
    (assert (== x 0))

    (forall ((k int)) (call reach_step es a k))
    (assert (closed es (reach_set es a)))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (edges_connected es a b) (edges_connected es b c))
  (ensures (edges_connected es a c))
  (body
    (call reach_closed es a)
    (call reach_mem es a b)
    (call closed_conn es (reach_set es a) b c)
    (call reach_mem es a c)))
(lemma meet (params (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (edges_connected d u c) (edges_connected d v c))
  (ensures (edges_connected d u v))
  (body (call conn_sym d v c) (call conn_trans d u c v)))
(ghost-fn lifts ((a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a)))
    (edges_connected b (get (idx a k) 0) (get (idx a k) 1))))))
(lemma lift_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (k int))

    (assert (lifts a b))
    (ghost-let c0 int (get (idx a k) 0))
    (ghost-let c1 int (get (idx a k) 1))
    (assert (edges_connected b c0 c1))
    (call conn_sym b c0 c1)
    (call reach_mem b x c0)
    (call reach_mem b x c1)
    (if (edges_connected b x c0) (call conn_trans b x c0 c1) (block))
    (if (edges_connected b x c1) (call conn_trans b x c1 c0) (block))))
(lemma conn_lift (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (lifts a b) (edges_connected a x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected b x y))

    (forall ((k int)) (call lift_step a b x k))
    (assert (closed a (reach_set b x)))
    (call conn_refl b x)
    (call reach_mem b x x)
    (call closed_conn a (reach_set b x) x y)
    (call reach_mem b x y)))
(ghost-fn subof ((a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool

(lemma edge_of_contains (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)))

(lemma sub_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))

    (assert (subof a b))
    (assert (contains b (idx a k)))

(lemma lifts_of_sub (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))

(lemma conn_sub (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))

(lemma es_nil_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))

(lemma es_cn_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (== (len b) 0) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len a))))

  (body (assert (== (len (concat a b)) (len a)))))
(lemma es_concat_nil (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))

(lemma es_assoc_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))

(lemma es_assoc (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (seq (tuple int int int))))

(lemma head_step (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))

    (assert (== (len (seq-lit (idx r 0))) 1))
    (assert (== (len (drop r 1)) (- (len r) 1)))
    (if (== i 0)

      (assert (== (idx (drop r 1) (- i 1)) (idx r i))))))
(lemma es_head (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (> (len r) 0))
  (ensures (== r (concat (seq-lit (idx r 0)) (drop r 1))))

    (assert (== (len (concat (seq-lit (idx r 0)) (drop r 1))) (len r)))))
(lemma dc_step (params (x (seq (tuple int int int))) (y (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (> (len x) 0) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (+ (- (len x) 1) (len y)))))
  (ensures (== (idx (drop (concat x y) 1) i) (idx (concat (drop x 1) y) i)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat x y)) (+ (len x) (len y))))
    (assert (== (len (drop x 1)) (- (len x) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (drop (concat x y) 1) i) (idx (concat x y) (+ i 1))))
    (if (< (+ i 1) (len x))
      (assert (== (idx (drop x 1) i) (idx x (+ i 1))))
      (assert (== (- (+ i 1) (len x)) (- i (- (len x) 1)))))))
(lemma drop_concat (params (x (seq (tuple int int int))) (y (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (> (len x) 0))
  (ensures (== (drop (concat x y) 1) (concat (drop x 1) y)))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call dc_step x y i))
    (assert (== (len (drop (concat x y) 1)) (len (concat (drop x 1) y))))))
(lemma tw_concat (params (x (seq (tuple int int int))) (y (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat x y)) (+ (total_weight x) (total_weight y))))
  (decreases (len x))
  (body
    (if (== (len x) 0)
      (block (call es_nil_concat x y) (assert (== (total_weight x) 0)))
      (block
        (call drop_concat x y)
        (call tw_concat (drop x 1) y)
        (assert (== (total_weight x) (+ (get (idx x 0) 2) (total_weight (drop x 1)))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat x y) 0) (idx x 0)))
        (assert (== (total_weight (concat x y)) (+ (get (idx (concat x y) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (concat x y) 1)))))))))
(lemma tw_unit (params (t (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (seq-lit t)) (get t 2)))

    (ghost-let u0 (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-lit t))
    (assert (== (len u0) 1))
    (assert (== (idx u0 0) t))
    (assert (== (len (drop u0 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight (drop u0 1)) 0))

(ghost-fn crosses ((s (seq bool)) (t (tuple int int int))) bool

(lemma ins_step (params (s (seq bool)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))

  (requires (nocross s es) (!= (ins s u) (ins s v)) (edges_connected es u v))
  (ensures false)

    (call closed_ins s es)
    (call ins_mem s u)
    (call ins_mem s v)
    (call conn_sym es u v)
    (if (ins s u)

(ghost-fn almost ((a (seq (tuple int int int))) (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int))) bool

(lemma touch_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (almost a d f) (not (edges_connected d u (get f 0))) (not (edges_connected d u (get f 1))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len a))))
  (ensures (== (contains (reach_set d u) (get (idx a j) 0)) (contains (reach_set d u) (get (idx a j) 1))))

    (assert (contains a (idx a j)))
    (assert (almost a d f))
    (assert (or (contains d (idx a j)) (== (idx a j) f)))
    (call reach_mem d u (get (idx a j) 0))
    (call reach_mem d u (get (idx a j) 1))
    (if (== (idx a j) f)

        (assert (contains d (idx a j)))

  (ensures (or (edges_connected d u (get f 0)) (edges_connected d u (get f 1))))
  (body
    (if (or (edges_connected d u (get f 0)) (edges_connected d u (get f 1)))
      (return)
      (block
        (forall ((j int)) (call touch_step a d f u j))
        (assert (closed a (reach_set d u)))
        (call conn_refl d u)
        (call reach_mem d u u)
        (call closed_conn a (reach_set d u) u v)

(ghost-fn rejoins ((d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (or (and (edges_connected d u (get f 0)) (edges_connected d v (get f 1)))

(lemma rejoin (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (almost a d f) (edges_connected a u v) (not (edges_connected d u v)))
  (ensures (rejoins d f u v))
  (body
    (call touch a d f u v)
    (call conn_sym a u v)
    (if (edges_connected d v u) (call conn_sym d v u) (block))
    (call touch a d f v u)
    (if (and (edges_connected d u (get f 0)) (edges_connected d v (get f 0))) (call meet d u v (get f 0)) (block))
    (if (and (edges_connected d u (get f 1)) (edges_connected d v (get f 1))) (call meet d u v (get f 1)) (block))
    (assert (rejoins d f u v))))
(lemma rejoins_sub (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (subof a b) (rejoins a f u v))
  (ensures (rejoins b f u v))
  (body
    (assert (rejoins a f u v))
    (if (edges_connected a u (get f 0)) (call conn_sub a b u (get f 0)) (block))
    (if (edges_connected a v (get f 1)) (call conn_sub a b v (get f 1)) (block))
    (if (edges_connected a u (get f 1)) (call conn_sub a b u (get f 1)) (block))
    (if (edges_connected a v (get f 0)) (call conn_sub a b v (get f 0)) (block))

(lemma rejoin_ends (params (d (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (rejoins d f u v) (edge_in_set d u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected d (get f 0) (get f 1)))
  (body
    (call conn_edge d u v)
    (call conn_sym d u v)
    (assert (rejoins d f u v))
    (if (and (edges_connected d u (get f 0)) (edges_connected d v (get f 1)))
      (block
        (call conn_sym d u (get f 0))
        (call conn_trans d (get f 0) u v)
        (call conn_trans d (get f 0) v (get f 1)))
      (block
        (call conn_sym d v (get f 0))
        (call conn_trans d (get f 0) v u)

(lemma split_lift (params (s (seq bool)) (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (r0 (tuple int int int))
                          (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (a1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (g1 (tuple int int int))
                          (a2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (d (seq (tuple int int int))))

            (== rest (concat a1 (concat (seq-lit g1) a2)))
            (crosses s g1)
            (rejoins d g1 u v)
            (subof d (concat k (concat (concat (seq-lit r0) a1) a2))))

  (body
    (call es_assoc (seq-lit r0) a1 (concat (seq-lit g1) a2))
    (call rejoins_sub d (concat k (concat (concat (seq-lit r0) a1) a2)) g1 u v)

(lemma split_here (params (s (seq bool)) (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (r0 (tuple int int int))
                          (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (nil (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== r (concat (seq-lit r0) rest))
            (crosses s r0)
            (edges_connected (concat k r) u v)
            (not (edges_connected (concat k rest) u v))
            (== (len nil) 0))
  (ensures (split_ok s k r u v nil r0 rest))
  (body
    (assert (almost (concat k r) (concat k rest) r0))
    (call rejoin (concat k r) (concat k rest) r0 u v)
    (call es_nil_concat nil rest)
    (call es_nil_concat nil (concat (seq-lit r0) rest))

  (ensures (not (crosses s (idx (concat k (seq-lit r0)) j))))
  (body
    (assert (nocross s k))
    (if (< j (len k))
      (block
        (assert (not (crosses s (idx k j))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat k (seq-lit r0)) j) (idx k j))))
      (block
        (assert (== (- j (len k)) 0))
        (assert (== (idx (seq-lit r0) 0) r0))
        (assert (== (idx (concat k (seq-lit r0)) j) r0))))))

  (ensures (nocross s (concat k (seq-lit r0))))
  (body
    (forall ((j int)) (call ncs_step s k r0 j))
    (assert (nocross s (concat k (seq-lit r0))))))
(lemma split_cut (params (s (seq bool)) (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (nocross s k) (!= (ins s u) (ins s v)) (edges_connected (concat k r) u v))
  (ensures (exists ((r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f (tuple int int int)) (r2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (split_ok s k r u v r1 f r2)))

    (if (== (len r) 0)

        (call es_concat_nil k r)
        (call cut_empty s k u v))

        (call es_head r)

        (ghost-let rest (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop r 1))
        (assert (== r (concat (seq-lit r0) rest)))

          (if (edges_connected (concat k rest) u v)
            (block
              (assert (subof (concat k rest) (concat k r)))
              (call split_cut s k rest u v)
              (obtain ((a1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (g1 (tuple int int int)) (a2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
                (split_ok s k rest u v a1 g1 a2))
              (assert (split_ok s k rest u v a1 g1 a2))

            (call nocross_snoc s k r0)

            (obtain ((b1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (h1 (tuple int int int)) (b2 (seq (tuple int int int))))

            (assert (split_ok s (concat k (seq-lit r0)) rest u v b1 h1 b2))
            (assert (subof (concat (concat k (seq-lit r0)) (concat b1 b2)) (concat k (concat (concat (seq-lit r0) b1) b2))))
            (call split_lift s k r r0 rest u v b1 h1 b2 (concat (concat k (seq-lit r0)) (concat b1 b2)))))))))

  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
               (== (total_flow_in g h u) (total_flow_out g h u))))
  (body (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (call exc_eq g h u) (block))))
(lemma bal_of (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (flow_like g h) (is_conserved g h s t))
  (ensures (balance h s t s (len g)))
  (body
    (forall ((ub int)) (call cons_pt1 g h s t ub))
    (assert (balance h s t s (len g)))))

(ghost-fn wt ((b (seq bool)) (u int) (v int) (a int)) int
  (body (if (mem b u) (if (mem b v) 0 a) (if (mem b v) (- 0 a) 0))))
(ghost-fn rd ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (rd h b u (- m 1)) (wt b u (- m 1) (get_flow h u (- m 1)))))))
(ghost-fn tot ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (tot h b (- a 1) n) (rd h b (- a 1) n)))))
(ghost-fn ri ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (ri h b u (- m 1)) (if (mem b (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn rr ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (q int) (a int)) int (decreases q)
  (body (if (<= q 0) 0 (+ (rr h b (- q 1) a) (ri h b (- q 1) a)))))
(ghost-fn csum ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (q int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (csum h b (- a 1) q) (if (mem b (- a 1)) (cs h (- a 1) q) 0)))))
(ghost-fn sx ((h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (sx h b (- a 1) n) (if (mem b (- a 1)) (- 0 (excess h (- a 1) n)) 0)))))
(lemma rd_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (m int))
  (ensures (== (rd h b u m) (- (if (mem b u) (rs h u m) 0) (ri h b u m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call rd_split h b u (- m 1)))))
(lemma rr_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (q int))
  (ensures (== (rr h b q 0) 0))
  (decreases q)
  (body (if (<= q 0) (block) (call rr_zero h b (- q 1)))))
(lemma rr_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (q int) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (rr h b q (+ a 1)) (+ (rr h b q a) (if (mem b a) (cs h a q) 0))))
  (decreases q)
  (body (if (<= q 0) (block) (call rr_step h b (- q 1) a))))
(lemma swap (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (q int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (csum h b a q) (rr h b q a)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (== a 0)
      (call rr_zero h b q)
      (block
        (call swap h b (- a 1) q)
        (call rr_step h b q (- a 1))))))
(lemma sx_tot (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (a int) (n int))
  (ensures (== (sx h b a n) (- (+ (tot h b a n) (rr h b a n)) (csum h b a n))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call sx_tot h b (- a 1) n)
        (call rd_split h b (- a 1) n)))))
(lemma sx_val (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (balance h s t s n) (mem b s) (not (mem b t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (<= a n))
  (ensures (== (sx h b a n) (if (< s a) (- 0 (excess h s n)) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) (block) (call sx_val h b s t n (- a 1)))))
(lemma val_tot (params (h (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (balance h s t s n) (mem b s) (not (mem b t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (tot h b n n) (- 0 (excess h s n))))
  (body
    (call sx_val h b s t n n)
    (call sx_tot h b n n)
    (call swap h b n n)))
(ghost-fn dom ((h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
        (<= (wt b u v (get_flow h u v)) (wt b u v (get_flow f u v)))))))
(lemma rd_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (dom h f b n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= m n))
  (ensures (<= (rd h b u m) (rd f b u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call rd_mono h f b n u (- m 1)))))
(lemma tot_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (dom h f b n) (<= a n))
  (ensures (<= (tot h b a n) (tot f b a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call tot_mono h f b n (- a 1))
        (call rd_mono h f b n (- a 1) n)))))

(ghost-fn res ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (or (< (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)) (> (get_flow f v u) 0))))
(ghost-fn clo_pt ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (mem b u) (res c f u v)) (mem b v))))
(ghost-fn row_scan ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y v)) (clo_pt c f b u y)))))
(ghost-fn scanned ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x u)) (row_scan c f b x n)))))
(lemma flow_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_pt g h u v) (cap_ok g c))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v)))
  (body
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((cc1 int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cc1) (<= (get_flow h u v) cc1)))
        (assert (<= cc1 (get_flow c u v))))
      (assert (>= (get_flow c u v) 0)))))
(lemma dom_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int)))
                      (b (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_like g h) (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f) (scanned c f b n n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (<= (wt b u v (get_flow h u v)) (wt b u v (get_flow f u v))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_pt g h u v))
    (call flow_le g c h u v)
    (assert (row_scan c f b u n))
    (assert (clo_pt c f b u v))
    (assert (row_scan c f b v n))
    (assert (clo_pt c f b v u))
    (assert (== (res c f u v) (or (< (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)) (> (get_flow f v u) 0))))
    (assert (== (res c f v u) (or (< (get_flow f v u) (get_flow c v u)) (> (get_flow f u v) 0))))))
(lemma flow_pt_of (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (flow_pt g h x y))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len h))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx h x)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow h x y) (idx (idx h x) y)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx h x) y) 0))
        (assert (=> (> (idx (idx h x) y) 0)
                    (exists ((cc1 int)) (and (has_capacity g x y cc1) (<= (idx (idx h x) y) cc1))))))
      (assert (== (get_flow h x y) 0)))))
(lemma fl_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f))
  (ensures (flow_pt g f x y))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f x y)) (<= (get_flow f x y) (get_flow c x y))))
    (if (> (get_flow f x y) 0)
      (block
        (assert (has_capacity g x y (get_flow c x y)))
        (assert (and (has_capacity g x y (get_flow c x y)) (<= (get_flow f x y) (get_flow c x y)))))
      (block))))
(lemma val_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (flow_like g f))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x)))))
               (and (>= (idx (idx f x) y) 0)
                    (=> (> (idx (idx f x) y) 0)
                        (exists ((cc1 int)) (and (has_capacity g x y cc1) (<= (idx (idx f x) y) cc1)))))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_pt g f x y))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x)))))
      (assert (== (get_flow f x y) (idx (idx f x) y)))
      (block))))
(lemma resp_of (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (flow_like g f))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f)
           (forall ((xa int) (ya int))
             (=> (and (and (<= 0 xa) (< xa (len f))) (and (<= 0 ya) (< ya (len (idx f xa)))))
                 (>= (idx (idx f xa) ya) 0))))
  (body
    (forall ((xb int) (yb int)) (call val_pt g f xb yb))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))))
(lemma valid_of (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f) (balance f s t s (len g)))
  (ensures (flow_like g f) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (forall ((xb int) (yb int)) (call fl_pt g c f xb yb))
    (assert (flow_like g f))
    (call resp_of g f)
    (forall ((ub int)) (call cons_pt2 g f s t ub))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))
(lemma upper (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool))
                     (s int) (t int) (n int) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f) (flow_like g f) (balance f s t s n)
            (mem b s) (not (mem b t)) (scanned c f b n n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g h s)))
  (body
    (forall ((xb int) (yb int)) (call flow_pt_of g h s t xb yb))
    (assert (flow_like g h))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (call bal_of g h s t)
    (forall ((ub int) (vb int)) (call dom_at g c f h b n ub vb))
    (assert (dom h f b n))
    (call val_tot h b s t n)
    (call val_tot f b s t n)
    (call tot_mono h f b n n)
    (call exc_eq g h s)
    (call exc_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- 0 (excess h s n))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) (- 0 (excess f s n))))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool))
                      (s int) (t int) (n int) (total int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_ok g c) (cap_bounds c f) (balance f s t s n)
            (== (excess f s n) (- 0 total)) (mem b s) (not (mem b t)) (scanned c f b n n)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures (exists ((m (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g m s t) (== (flow_val g m s) total))))
  (body
    (call valid_of g c f s t)
    (forall ((h (seq (seq int)))) (call upper g c f b s t n h))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))
    (call exc_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) total))
    (assert (and (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) total)))))

(lemma sums_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (all_zero f))
  (ensures (== (rs f u m) 0) (== (cs f u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call sums_zero f u (- m 1)))))
(lemma zero_start (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_limit c) (all_zero f))
  (ensures (cap_bounds c f) (balance f s t s n) (== (excess f s n) 0))
  (body
    (forall ((ub int)) (call sums_zero f ub n))
    (assert (cap_bounds c f))
    (assert (balance f s t s n))
    (assert (== (excess f s n) 0))))
(lemma sums_bd (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (cap_limit c) (cap_bounds c f) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (<= (rs f u m) (* 100000 m)) (>= (cs f u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (== m 0) (block) (call sums_bd c f u (- m 1)))))
(lemma flow_bound (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_limit c) (cap_bounds c f) (and (<= 0 n) (<= n 1000)))
  (ensures (<= (- 0 (excess f s n)) 100000000))
  (body (call sums_bd c f s n)))

(ghost-fn same_but ((f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int))) (a int) (w int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (=> (or (!= x a) (!= y w)) (== (get_flow g x y) (get_flow f x y))))))
(lemma rs_upd (params (f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int))) (a int) (w int) (d int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (same_but f g a w) (== (get_flow g a w) (+ (get_flow f a w) d)))
  (ensures (== (rs g u m) (+ (rs f u m) (if (and (== u a) (and (<= 0 w) (< w m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call rs_upd f g a w d u (- m 1)))))
(lemma cs_upd (params (f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int))) (a int) (w int) (d int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (same_but f g a w) (== (get_flow g a w) (+ (get_flow f a w) d)))
  (ensures (== (cs g u m) (+ (cs f u m) (if (and (== u w) (and (<= 0 a) (< a m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call cs_upd f g a w d u (- m 1)))))
(lemma exc_upd (params (f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int))) (a int) (w int) (d int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (same_but f g a w) (== (get_flow g a w) (+ (get_flow f a w) d))
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)))
  (ensures (== (excess g u n) (+ (excess f u n) (- (if (== u w) d 0) (if (== u a) d 0)))))
  (body
    (call rs_upd f g a w d u n)
    (call cs_upd f g a w d u n)))
(ghost-fn keep ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (d int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (=> (and (<= (at o x) d) (<= (at o y) d)) (== (get_flow f x y) (get_flow f0 x y))))))
(ghost-fn walk ((c (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (o (seq int))
                (s int) (t int) (x int) (n int) (e0 int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
        (and (mem b x)
        (and (is_matrix f n)
        (and (cap_bounds c f)
        (and (balance f s t x n)
        (and (== (excess f s n) (if (== x s) (- e0 1) e0))
             (keep f0 f o (at o x))))))))))
(lemma walk_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq int)))
                         (b (seq bool)) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int)
                         (a int) (w int) (d int) (n int) (e0 int))
  (requires (walk c f0 f b o s t x n e0) (!= x s)
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (mem b p) (< (at o p) (at o x))
            (or (and (== a p) (and (== w x) (== d 1))) (and (== a x) (and (== w p) (== d -1))))
            (is_matrix g n) (== (get_flow g a w) (+ (get_flow f a w) d)) (same_but f g a w)
            (and (<= 0 (get_flow g a w)) (<= (get_flow g a w) (get_flow c a w))))
  (ensures (walk c f0 g b o s t p n e0))
  (body
    (assert (!= p x))
    (forall ((ub int)) (call exc_upd f g a w d ub n))
    (assert (cap_bounds c g))
    (assert (balance g s t p n))
    (assert (== (excess g s n) (if (== p s) (- e0 1) e0)))
    (assert (keep f0 g o (at o p)))
    (assert (walk c f0 g b o s t p n e0))))

(ghost-fn tree_pt ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int))
                   (s int) (n int) (y int)) bool
  (body (=> (mem b y)
            (and (>= (at o y) 0)
                 (=> (!= y s)
                     (and (and (<= 0 (at p y)) (< (at p y) n))
                          (and (mem b (at p y))
                               (and (res c f (at p y) y) (< (at o (at p y)) (at o y))))))))))
(ghost-fn tree_ok ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int)) (s int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (tree_pt c f b p o s n y))))
(ghost-fn ords_ok ((b (seq bool)) (o (seq int)) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (mem b y) (< (at o y) k)))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((b (seq bool)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (cnt b (- m 1)) (if (mem b (- m 1)) 0 1)))))
(lemma cnt_nonneg (params (b (seq bool)) (m int))
  (ensures (>= (cnt b m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call cnt_nonneg b (- m 1)))))
(lemma cnt_all (params (b (seq bool)) (m int))
  (requires (forall ((y int)) (not (mem b y))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (cnt b m) m))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (== m 0) (block) (call cnt_all b (- m 1)))))
(lemma cnt_mark (params (b (seq bool)) (b2 (seq bool)) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (forall ((y int)) (=> (!= y v) (== (mem b2 y) (mem b y)))) (mem b2 v) (not (mem b v)))
  (ensures (== (cnt b2 m) (- (cnt b m) (if (and (<= 0 v) (< v m)) 1 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) (block) (call cnt_mark b b2 v (- m 1)))))
(ghost-fn st ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (k int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len b) n) (and (== (len p) n) (== (len o) n)))
        (and (mem b s)
        (and (and (<= 1 k) (<= k n))
        (and (== (+ k (cnt b n)) n)
        (and (ords_ok b o k) (tree_ok c f b p o s n))))))))
(ghost-fn marked ((b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int)) (b2 (seq bool)) (p2 (seq int)) (o2 (seq int))
                  (u int) (v int) (k int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len b2) n) (and (== (len p2) n) (== (len o2) n)))
        (and (mem b2 v)
        (and (== (at p2 v) u)
        (and (== (at o2 v) k)
             (forall ((y int)) (=> (!= y v)
               (and (== (mem b2 y) (mem b y))
                    (and (== (at p2 y) (at p y)) (== (at o2 y) (at o y))))))))))))
(lemma bfs_init (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int)) (s int) (n int))
  (requires (forall ((y int)) (not (mem b0 y))) (mem b s)
            (forall ((y int)) (=> (!= y s) (== (mem b y) (mem b0 y))))
            (== (len b) n) (== (len p) n) (== (len o) n)
            (forall ((y int)) (== (at o y) 0))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (st c f b p o s n 1))
  (body
    (assert (not (mem b0 s)))
    (call cnt_all b0 n)
    (call cnt_mark b0 b s n)
    (assert (ords_ok b o 1))
    (assert (tree_ok c f b p o s n))
    (assert (st c f b p o s n 1))))
(lemma mark_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (b (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (o (seq int))
                       (b2 (seq bool)) (p2 (seq int)) (o2 (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (u int) (v int) (k int) (y int))
  (requires (st c f b p o s n k) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (mem b u) (not (mem b v)) (res c f u v)
            (marked b p o b2 p2 o2 u v k n))
  (ensures (tree_pt c f b2 p2 o2 s n y))
  (body
    (assert (tree_pt c f b p o s n y))
    (assert (!= u v))
    (assert (!= v s))
    (assert (< (at o u) k))
    (assert (mem b2 u))
    (assert (== (at o2 u) (at o u)))
    (if (== y v)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (== (mem b2 y) (mem b y)))
        (assert (== (at p2 y) (at p y)))
        (assert (== (at o2 y) (at o y)))
