             (and (and (== (lv lb2 v) st) (and (== (lpar lb2 v) u) (== (lpe lb2 v) e)))
                  (forall ((y int)) (=> (!= y v) (same_lab lb lb2 y)))))))
(ghost-fn grown ((lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (and (== (len lb2) (len lb)) (forall ((y int)) (=> (vis lb y) (same_lab lb lb2 y))))))

(lemma grown_refl (params (lb (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (grown lb lb))
  (body))
(lemma grown_trans_at (params (a1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (y int))
  (requires (grown a1 a2) (grown a2 a3))
  (ensures (=> (vis a1 y) (same_lab a1 a3 y)))
  (body
    (if (vis a1 y)
      (block (assert (same_lab a1 a2 y)) (assert (vis a2 y)) (assert (same_lab a2 a3 y)))
      (block))))
(lemma grown_trans (params (a1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a3 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (grown a1 a2) (grown a2 a3))
  (ensures (grown a1 a3))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call grown_trans_at a1 a2 a3 y))))
(lemma mark_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (v int) (u int) (e int) (st int) (y int))
  (requires (lab_state g m lb s (+ st 1)) (marked lb lb2 v u e st) (vis lb u) (< (lv lb u) st)
            (not (vis lb v)) (link g m u v e) (>= st 1))
  (ensures (and (forest_at lb2 s y) (and (all_at g m lb2 s y) (below_at lb2 (+ st 1) y)))
           (=> (vis lb y) (same_lab lb lb2 y)))
  (body
    (assert (forest_at lb s y))
    (assert (all_at g m lb s y))
    (assert (below_at lb (+ st 1) y))
    (assert (!= u v))
    (assert (vis lb s))
    (assert (!= s v))
    (assert (same_lab lb lb2 u))
    (if (== y v)
      (block
        (assert (vis lb2 v))
        (assert (vis lb2 u))
        (assert (== (lv lb2 u) (lv lb u)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len lb)))))
      (block
        (assert (same_lab lb lb2 y))
        (if (and (vis lb y) (!= y s))
          (block
            (assert (!= (lpar lb y) v))
            (assert (same_lab lb lb2 (lpar lb y))))
          (block))))))
(lemma mark_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (v int) (u int) (e int) (st int))
  (requires (lab_state g m lb s (+ st 1)) (marked lb lb2 v u e st) (vis lb u) (< (lv lb u) st)
            (not (vis lb v)) (link g m u v e) (>= st 1))
  (ensures (lab_state g m lb2 s (+ st 1)) (grown lb lb2))
  (body
    (forall ((y int)) (call mark_at g m lb lb2 s v u e st y))
    (assert (vis lb s))
    (assert (!= s v))
    (assert (same_lab lb lb2 s))
    (assert (vis lb2 s))
    (assert (forest lb2 s))
    (assert (links_all g m lb2 s))
    (assert (below lb2 (+ st 1)))))
(lemma below_up_at (params (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (st int) (y int))
  (requires (below lb st))
  (ensures (below_at lb (+ st 1) y))
  (body (assert (below_at lb st y))))
(lemma below_up (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (st int))
  (requires (lab_state g m lb s st))
  (ensures (lab_state g m lb s (+ st 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((y int)) (call below_up_at lb st y))
    (assert (below lb (+ st 1)))))
(lemma init_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (y int))
  (requires (== (lv lb s) 0) (forall ((z int)) (=> (!= z s) (< (lv lb z) 0))))
  (ensures (and (forest_at lb s y) (and (all_at g m lb s y) (below_at lb 1 y))))
  (body (if (== y s) (block) (assert (< (lv lb y) 0)))))
(lemma init_state (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int))
  (requires (== (len lb) (len g)) (== (lv lb s) 0) (forall ((z int)) (=> (!= z s) (< (lv lb z) 0))))
  (ensures (lab_state g m lb s 1))
  (body
    (forall ((y int)) (call init_at g m lb s y))
    (assert (vis lb s))
    (assert (forest lb s))
    (assert (links_all g m lb s))
    (assert (below lb 1))))
(lemma links_restrict_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (lim int) (y int))
  (requires (links_all g m lb s))
  (ensures (link_at g m lb s lim y))
  (body (assert (all_at g m lb s y))))
(lemma links_restrict (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (lim int))
  (requires (links_all g m lb s))
  (ensures (links_lim g m lb s lim))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call links_restrict_at g m lb s lim y))))

(ghost-fn out_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (in_edge g u k) (not (vis lb (tgt g u k)))) (>= (get_flow m u (tgt g u k)) (cpc g u k)))))
(ghost-fn out_upto ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k i)) (out_at g m lb u k)))))
(ghost-fn closed_out ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (out_at g m lb u k))))
(ghost-fn in_at ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (w int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len lb))) (not (vis lb w))) (<= (get_flow m w u) 0))))
(ghost-fn in_upto ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k i)) (in_at m lb u k)))))
(ghost-fn closed_in ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (in_at m lb u k))))
(ghost-fn cut_closed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (vis lb y) (and (closed_out g m lb y) (closed_in m lb y))))))

(lemma vis_grow (params (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (y int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (vis lb y))
  (ensures (vis lb2 y))
  (body (assert (same_lab lb lb2 y))))
(lemma out_at_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (out_at g m lb u k))
  (ensures (out_at g m lb2 u k))
  (body (if (vis lb (tgt g u k)) (call vis_grow lb lb2 (tgt g u k)) (block))))
(lemma in_at_mono (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (in_at m lb u k))
  (ensures (in_at m lb2 u k))
  (body (if (vis lb k) (call vis_grow lb lb2 k) (block))))
(lemma out_upto_nil (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (ensures (out_upto g m lb u 0))
  (body))
(lemma in_upto_nil (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (ensures (in_upto m lb u 0))
  (body))
(lemma out_upto_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (out_upto g m lb u i))
  (ensures (out_upto g m lb2 u i))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call out_at_mono g m lb lb2 u k))))
(lemma in_upto_mono (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (in_upto m lb u i))
  (ensures (in_upto m lb2 u i))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call in_at_mono m lb lb2 u k))))
(lemma out_upto_ext (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (out_upto g m lb u i) (out_at g m lb u i))
  (ensures (out_upto g m lb u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma in_upto_ext (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (in_upto m lb u i) (in_at m lb u i))
  (ensures (in_upto m lb u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma out_close_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (out_upto g m lb u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (out_at g m lb u k))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u))))
      (assert (out_at g m lb u k))
      (assert (not (in_edge g u k))))))
(lemma out_close (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (out_upto g m lb u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (closed_out g m lb u))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call out_close_at g m lb u k))))
(lemma in_close_at (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (in_upto m lb u (len lb)))
  (ensures (in_at m lb u k))
  (body (if (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len lb))) (assert (in_at m lb u k)) (block))))
(lemma in_close (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (requires (in_upto m lb u (len lb)))
  (ensures (closed_in m lb u))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call in_close_at m lb u k))))
(lemma closed_out_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (closed_out g m lb u))
  (ensures (closed_out g m lb2 u))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call out_at_mono g m lb lb2 u k))))
(lemma closed_in_mono (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (closed_in m lb u))
  (ensures (closed_in m lb2 u))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call in_at_mono m lb lb2 u k))))

(ghost-fn bget ((b (seq bool)) (i int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len b))) (idx b i))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((b (seq bool)) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (cnt b (- k 1)) (if (bget b (- k 1)) 0 1)))))
(ghost-fn flipped ((b (seq bool)) (b2 (seq bool)) (u int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len b2) (len b)) (and (bget b2 u) (not (bget b u))))
             (forall ((i int)) (=> (!= i u) (== (bget b2 i) (bget b i)))))))
(ghost-fn all_closed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq bool))) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (bget b y) (and (closed_out g m lb y) (closed_in m lb y))))))
(lemma cnt_nn (params (b (seq bool)) (k int))
  (ensures (>= (cnt b k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (cnt b k) 0))
      (block
        (call cnt_nn b (- k 1))
        (assert (== (cnt b k) (+ (cnt b (- k 1)) (if (bget b (- k 1)) 0 1))))))))
(lemma cnt_full (params (b (seq bool)) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((i int)) (not (bget b i))) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (cnt b k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (cnt b k) 0))
      (block
        (call cnt_full b (- k 1))
        (assert (not (bget b (- k 1))))
        (assert (== (cnt b k) (+ (cnt b (- k 1)) (if (bget b (- k 1)) 0 1))))))))
(lemma cnt_flip (params (b (seq bool)) (b2 (seq bool)) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flipped b b2 u))
  (ensures (== (cnt b2 k) (- (cnt b k) (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u k)) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block (assert (== (cnt b2 k) 0)) (assert (== (cnt b k) 0)))
      (block
        (call cnt_flip b b2 u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (cnt b2 k) (+ (cnt b2 (- k 1)) (if (bget b2 (- k 1)) 0 1))))
        (assert (== (cnt b k) (+ (cnt b (- k 1)) (if (bget b (- k 1)) 0 1))))
        (if (== (- k 1) u)
          (block (assert (bget b2 (- k 1))) (assert (not (bget b (- k 1)))))
          (assert (== (bget b2 (- k 1)) (bget b (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma closed_step_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq bool)) (b2 (seq bool)) (u int) (y int))
  (requires (all_closed g m lb b) (grown lb lb2) (closed_out g m lb2 u) (closed_in m lb2 u) (flipped b b2 u))
  (ensures (=> (bget b2 y) (and (closed_out g m lb2 y) (closed_in m lb2 y))))
  (body
    (if (and (bget b2 y) (!= y u))
      (block
        (assert (== (bget b2 y) (bget b y)))
        (assert (and (closed_out g m lb y) (closed_in m lb y)))
        (call closed_out_mono g m lb lb2 y)
        (call closed_in_mono m lb lb2 y))
      (block))))
(lemma all_closed_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq bool)) (b2 (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires (all_closed g m lb b) (grown lb lb2) (closed_out g m lb2 u) (closed_in m lb2 u) (flipped b b2 u))
  (ensures (all_closed g m lb2 b2))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call closed_step_at g m lb lb2 b b2 u y))))
(lemma finish_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq bool)) (y int))
  (requires (all_closed g m lb b) (forall ((z int)) (=> (vis lb z) (bget b z))))
  (ensures (=> (vis lb y) (and (closed_out g m lb y) (closed_in m lb y))))
  (body (if (vis lb y) (assert (bget b y)) (block))))
(lemma finish_closed (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq bool)))
  (requires (all_closed g m lb b) (forall ((z int)) (=> (vis lb z) (bget b z))))
  (ensures (cut_closed g m lb))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call finish_at g m lb b y))))

(lemma links_step_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (x int) (p int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (y int))
  (requires (forest lb s) (links_lim g m lb s (lv lb x)) (diff_at m m2 a b d)
            (or (and (== a p) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b p)))
            (< (lv lb p) (lv lb x)))
  (ensures (link_at g m2 lb s (lv lb p) y))
  (body
    (if (and (vis lb y) (and (!= y s) (<= (lv lb y) (lv lb p))))
      (block
        (assert (forest_at lb s y))
        (assert (link_at g m lb s (lv lb x) y))
        (assert (!= y x))
        (assert (!= (lpar lb y) x))
        (assert (same_at m m2 (lpar lb y) y))
        (assert (same_at m m2 y (lpar lb y))))
      (block))))
(lemma step_common (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int) (val int) (a int) (b int) (e int) (d int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (diff_at m m2 a b d) (in_edge g a e) (== (tgt g a e) b)
            (or (and (== a p) (and (== b x) (== d 1))) (and (== a x) (and (== b p) (== d -1))))
            (!= x p) (!= x s) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (walk_bal g m s t x val) (forest lb s) (links_lim g m lb s (lv lb x)) (< (lv lb p) (lv lb x)))
  (ensures (walk_bal g m2 s t p val) (links_lim g m2 lb s (lv lb p)))
  (body
    (call bal_step g m m2 s t x p val a b e d)
    (forall ((y int)) (call links_step_at g m m2 lb s x p a b d y))))
(lemma step_fwd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int) (val int) (e int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (diff_at m m2 p x 1) (link g m p x e) (>= e 0)
            (!= x p) (!= x s) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (walk_bal g m s t x val) (forest lb s) (links_lim g m lb s (lv lb x)) (< (lv lb p) (lv lb x)))
  (ensures (flow_core g m2) (walk_bal g m2 s t p val) (links_lim g m2 lb s (lv lb p)))
  (body
    (call core_step_fwd g m m2 p x e)
    (call step_common g m m2 lb s t x p val p x e 1)))
(lemma step_bwd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int) (val int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (diff_at m m2 x p -1) (> (get_flow m x p) 0)
            (!= x p) (!= x s) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (walk_bal g m s t x val) (forest lb s) (links_lim g m lb s (lv lb x)) (< (lv lb p) (lv lb x)))
  (ensures (flow_core g m2) (walk_bal g m2 s t p val) (links_lim g m2 lb s (lv lb p)))
  (body
    (call core_step_bwd g m m2 x p)
    (call rc_edge g m x p)
    (obtain ((e1 int)) (and (in_edge g x e1) (== (tgt g x e1) p)))
    (call step_common g m m2 lb s t x p val x p e1 -1)))

(ghost-fn is_zero ((m (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (== (get_flow m u v) 0))))
(lemma zero_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (is_zero m))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) 0))
      (block
        (call zero_in g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow m (- k 1) u) 0))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m (- k 1) u))))))))
(lemma zero_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (is_zero m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u k) 0))
      (block
        (call zero_out g m u (- k 1))
        (call out_unfold g m u k)
        (assert (== (get_flow m u (tgt g u (- k 1))) 0))))))
(lemma zero_total (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (is_zero m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g m u) 0) (== (total_flow_in g m u) 0))
  (body
    (call zero_out g m u (len (idx g u)))
    (call zero_in g m u (len g))))
(lemma zero_core_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_zero m))
  (ensures (and (rc_at g m u v) (nn_at m u v)))
  (body (assert (== (get_flow m u v) 0))))
(lemma zero_bal_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (is_zero m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (bal_at g m t t u))
  (body (call zero_total g m u)))
(lemma zero_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_zero m) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (!= s t))
  (ensures (flow_core g m) (walk_bal g m s t t 0))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call zero_core_at g m u v))
    (forall ((u int)) (call zero_bal_at g m t u))
    (call zero_total g m s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g m s) (- (total_flow_out g m s) (total_flow_in g m s))))))

(ghost-fn row_sum ((m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (row_sum m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1))))))
(ghost-fn prefix_has ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (j int) (v int)) bool (decreases j)
  (body (if (<= j 0) false (or (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) v) (prefix_has g u (- j 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn filt ((m (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (j int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0
    (+ (filt m g u j (- k 1)) (if (prefix_has g u j (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0)))))
(lemma filt_nil (params (m (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (filt m g u 0 k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (filt m g u 0 k) 0))
      (block
        (call filt_nil m g u (- k 1))
        (assert (not (prefix_has g u 0 (- k 1))))
        (assert (== (filt m g u 0 k) (+ (filt m g u 0 (- k 1)) (if (prefix_has g u 0 (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma not_has (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (jj int) (j int) (x int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (in_edge g u jj) (== (tgt g u jj) x) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j jj)))
  (ensures (not (prefix_has g u j x)))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (== j 0)
      (assert (not (prefix_has g u j x)))
      (block
        (call not_has g u jj (- j 1) x)
        (assert (in_edge g u (- j 1)))
        (assert (!= (tgt g u (- j 1)) (tgt g u jj)))
        (assert (== (prefix_has g u j x) (or (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) x) (prefix_has g u (- j 1) x))))))))
(lemma has_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)))
  (ensures (prefix_has g u j (tgt g u i)))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (assert (== (prefix_has g u j (tgt g u i)) (or (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) (tgt g u i)) (prefix_has g u (- j 1) (tgt g u i)))))
    (if (== i (- j 1))
      (assert (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) (tgt g u i)))
      (call has_intro g u i (- j 1)))))
(lemma filt_step (params (m (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (in_edge g u (- j 1)))
  (ensures (== (filt m g u j k)
               (+ (filt m g u (- j 1) k)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (tgt g u (- j 1))) (< (tgt g u (- j 1)) k)) (get_flow m u (tgt g u (- j 1))) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block (assert (== (filt m g u j k) 0)) (assert (== (filt m g u (- j 1) k) 0)))
      (block
        (call filt_step m g u j (- k 1))
        (assert (== (filt m g u j k) (+ (filt m g u j (- k 1)) (if (prefix_has g u j (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (filt m g u (- j 1) k) (+ (filt m g u (- j 1) (- k 1)) (if (prefix_has g u (- j 1) (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (prefix_has g u j (- k 1)) (or (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) (- k 1)) (prefix_has g u (- j 1) (- k 1)))))
        (if (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) (- k 1))
          (call not_has g u (- j 1) (- j 1) (- k 1))
          (block))))))
(lemma out_eq_filt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u j) (filt m g u j (len g))))
  (decreases j)
  (body

        (call filt_nil m g u (len g)))
      (block
        (call out_eq_filt g m u (- j 1))
        (call out_unfold g m u j)
        (assert (in_edge g u (- j 1)))
        (call tgt_range g u (- j 1))
        (call filt_step m g u j (len g))))))
(lemma entry_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_core g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (or (prefix_has g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow m u v) 0)))
  (body

    (if (> (get_flow m u v) 0)
      (block

        (obtain ((e2 int)) (and (in_edge g u e2) (== (tgt g u e2) v)))

(lemma filt_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_core g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))

      (block
        (call filt_full g m u (- k 1))
        (call entry_zero g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (filt m g u (len (idx g u)) k)
                    (+ (filt m g u (len (idx g u)) (- k 1))
                       (if (prefix_has g u (len (idx g u)) (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0))))

(lemma row_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))

(lemma cap_entry (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))

  (requires (flow_core g m) (capacities_bounded g) (>= k 0))

  (decreases k)

        (call cap_entry g m u (- k 1))

(lemma in_nn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_core g m))

  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) 0))
      (block
        (call in_nn g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (nn_at m (- k 1) u))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m (- k 1) u))))))))
(lemma flow_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (!= s t) (walk_bal g m s t t val))
  (ensures (<= val 100000000))
  (body
    (call row_out g m s)
    (call row_bound g m s (len g))
    (call in_nn g m s (len g))
    (assert (== (flow_val g m s) val))
    (assert (== (flow_val g m s) (- (total_flow_out g m s) (total_flow_in g m s))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g m s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g m s (len g))))
    (assert (<= (len g) 1000))))

(ghost-fn cross ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (- (if (vis lb u) (get_flow m u v) 0) (if (vis lb v) (get_flow m u v) 0))))
(ghost-fn cross_row ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)

(ghost-fn net ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (q int)) int (decreases p)

(ghost-fn mask_row ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)

  (body (if (<= p 0) 0 (+ (a_total m lb (- p 1) q) (mask_row m lb (- p 1) q)))))
(ghost-fn b_total ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (q int)) int (decreases q)
  (body (if (<= q 0) 0

(ghost-fn v_total ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int)) int (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) 0
    (+ (v_total g m lb (- p 1))
       (if (vis lb (- p 1)) (- (total_flow_out g m (- p 1)) (total_flow_in g m (- p 1))) 0)))))
(lemma cross_row_eq (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (q int))
  (ensures (== (cross_row m lb u q) (- (if (vis lb u) (row_sum m u q) 0) (mask_row m lb u q))))

      (block

        (assert (== (row_sum m u q) (+ (row_sum m u (- q 1)) (get_flow m u (- q 1)))))

        (assert (== (cross m lb u (- q 1)) (- (if (vis lb u) (get_flow m u (- q 1)) 0) (if (vis lb (- q 1)) (get_flow m u (- q 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma net_eq (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (q int))

        (assert (== (mask_row m lb (- p 1) k)
                    (+ (mask_row m lb (- p 1) (- k 1)) (if (vis lb (- k 1)) (get_flow m (- p 1) (- k 1)) 0))))

  (body

(lemma r_b_v (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (len g))))
  (ensures (== (- (r_total m lb p (len g)) (b_total g m lb (len g) p)) (v_total g m lb p)))

                    (+ (b_total g m lb (len g) (- p 1)) (if (vis lb (- p 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g m (- p 1) (len g)) 0))))

                    (+ (v_total g m lb (- p 1))
                       (if (vis lb (- p 1)) (- (total_flow_out g m (- p 1)) (total_flow_in g m (- p 1))) 0))))
        (assert (== (total_flow_in g m (- p 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g m (- p 1) (len g))))))))
(lemma v_val (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (t int) (p int))
  (requires (is_conserved g m s t) (vis lb s) (not (vis lb t)) (<= p (len g)))
  (ensures (== (v_total g m lb p) (if (and (<= 0 s) (< s p)) (flow_val g m s) 0)))
  (decreases p)

                    (+ (v_total g m lb (- p 1))
                       (if (vis lb (- p 1)) (- (total_flow_out g m (- p 1)) (total_flow_in g m (- p 1))) 0))))
        (assert (== (flow_val g m s) (- (total_flow_out g m s) (total_flow_in g m s))))
        (if (and (vis lb (- p 1)) (!= (- p 1) s))
          (block
            (assert (!= (- p 1) t))
            (assert (== (total_flow_in g m (- p 1)) (total_flow_out g m (- p 1)))))

(lemma net_val (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (is_conserved g m s t) (vis lb s) (not (vis lb t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (== (net m lb (len g) (len g)) (flow_val g m s)))
  (body

(ghost-fn dom ((o (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (<= (cross o lb u v) (cross m lb u v))))))
(lemma cross_row_mono (params (o (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (dom o m lb n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (<= (cross_row o lb u k) (cross_row m lb u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (block (assert (== (cross_row o lb u k) 0)) (assert (== (cross_row m lb u k) 0)))
      (block
        (call cross_row_mono o m lb n u (- k 1))
        (assert (<= (cross o lb u (- k 1)) (cross m lb u (- k 1))))
        (assert (== (cross_row o lb u k) (+ (cross_row o lb u (- k 1)) (cross o lb u (- k 1)))))
        (assert (== (cross_row m lb u k) (+ (cross_row m lb u (- k 1)) (cross m lb u (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma net_mono (params (o (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (n int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (dom o m lb n) (and (<= 0 p) (<= p n)) (and (<= 0 q) (<= q n)))
  (ensures (<= (net o lb p q) (net m lb p q)))
  (decreases p)
  (body
    (if (== p 0)
      (block (assert (== (net o lb p q) 0)) (assert (== (net m lb p q) 0)))
      (block
        (call net_mono o m lb n (- p 1) q)
        (call cross_row_mono o m lb n (- p 1) q)
        (assert (== (net o lb p q) (+ (net o lb (- p 1) q) (cross_row o lb (- p 1) q))))
        (assert (== (net m lb p q) (+ (net m lb (- p 1) q) (cross_row m lb (- p 1) q))))))))
(lemma dom_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_core g o) (flow_core g m) (cut_closed g m lb) (== (len lb) (len g))
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))))
  (ensures (<= (cross o lb u v) (cross m lb u v)))
  (body
    (assert (and (rc_at g o u v) (nn_at o u v)))
    (assert (nn_at m u v))
    (if (and (vis lb u) (not (vis lb v)))
      (if (> (get_flow o u v) 0)
        (block
          (obtain ((c0 int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c0) (<= (get_flow o u v) c0)))
          (assert (has_capacity g u v c0))
          (obtain ((i0 int))
            (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g u)))))
                 (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 1) c0))))
          (assert (in_edge g u i0))
          (assert (== (tgt g u i0) v))
          (assert (== (cpc g u i0) c0))
          (assert (closed_out g m lb u))
          (assert (out_at g m lb u i0)))
        (block))
      (if (and (not (vis lb u)) (vis lb v))
        (block
          (assert (closed_in m lb v))
          (assert (in_at m lb v u)))
        (block)))))
(lemma cut_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (t int) (other (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (is_conserved g m s t) (is_valid_flow g other s t)
            (== (len lb) (len g)) (cut_closed g m lb) (vis lb s) (not (vis lb t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g m s) (flow_val g other s)))
  (body
    (call core_from_valid g other s t)
    (assert (is_conserved g other s t))
    (call net_val g other lb s t)
    (call net_val g m lb s t)
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call dom_at g other m lb u v))
    (assert (dom other m lb (len g)))
    (call net_mono other m lb (len g) (len g) (len g))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (walk_bal g m s t t val) (== (len lb) (len g)) (forest lb s)
            (cut_closed g m lb) (not (vis lb t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (!= s t))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g m s t) (== (flow_val g m s) val))
  (body
    (call conserved_intro g m s t val)
    (call valid_intro g m s t)
    (assert (vis lb s))
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int)))) (call cut_bound g m lb s t other))))

(spec next_node
  (params (lab (ref (slice (tuple i64 i64 i64)))) (scn (ref (slice bool))))
  (returns (u i64))
  (requires (== (len scn) (len lab)))
  (ensures (=> (>= u 0) (and (and (< u (len lab)) (vis lab u)) (not (bget scn u))))
           (=> (< u 0) (forall ((y int)) (=> (vis lab y) (bget scn y)))))
  (effects))
(def next_node
  (body
    (let-mut i i64 0)
    (while (< i (len lab))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len lab))))
      (invariant (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y i)) (=> (vis lab y) (bget scn y)))))
      (decreases (- (len lab) i))
      (assert (== (get (idx lab i) 2) (lv lab i)))
      (assert (== (idx scn i) (bget scn i)))
      (if (and (>= (get (idx lab i) 2) 0) (not (idx scn i))) (return i) (block))
      (set i (+ i 1)))

(lemma fwd_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (fwd_upto g f o u i)
            (or (vis o (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                (>= (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (fwd_upto g f o u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma bwd_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int) (w int))
  (requires (bwd_upto g f o u w)
            (or (vis o w) (<= (get_flow f w u) 0)))
  (ensures (bwd_upto g f o u (+ w 1)))
  (body))
(lemma closed_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int))
  (requires (closed_upto g f o u) (=> (vis o u) (closed_at g f o u)))
  (ensures (closed_upto g f o (+ u 1)))
  (body))

(spec visit
  (params (a (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (f (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (s i64) (u i64)
          (ord (vec i64)) (par (vec i64)) (kind (vec i64)) (cnt i64))
  (returns (o2 (vec i64)) (p2 (vec i64)) (k2 (vec i64)) (c2 i64))
  (requires (st_ok a f s ord par kind cnt)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len a)))
            (>= (idx ord u) 0)
            (square f (len a))
            (targets_ok a)
            (<= (len a) 1000))
  (ensures (st_ok a f s o2 p2 k2 c2)
           (>= c2 cnt)
           (=> (== c2 cnt) (and (== o2 ord) (closed_at a f o2 u))))
  (effects))
(def visit
  (body
    (let n i64 (len a))
    (let d i64 (len (idx a u)))
    (let-mut ob (vec i64) ord)
    (let-mut pb (vec i64) par)
    (let-mut kb (vec i64) kind)
    (let-mut cb i64 cnt)
    (let-mut i i64 0)
    (while (< i d)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i d)))
      (invariant (st_ok a f s ob pb kb cb))
      (invariant (>= cb cnt))
      (invariant (>= (idx ob u) 0))
      (invariant (=> (== cb cnt) (and (== ob ord) (fwd_upto a f ob u i))))
      (decreases (- d i))
      (let v i64 (get (idx (idx a u) i) 0))
      (let c i64 (get (idx (idx a u) i) 1))
      (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
      (if (and (< (idx ob v) 0) (< (idx (idx f u) v) c))
        (block
          (assert (arc_ok a f u i v))
          (ghost-let o1 (seq int) ob)
          (ghost-let p1 (seq int) pb)
          (ghost-let k1 (seq int) kb)
          (set-idx ob v cb)
          (set-idx pb v u)
          (set-idx kb v i)
          (call st_mark a f s o1 p1 k1 cb ob pb kb u v i)
          (set cb (+ cb 1)))
        (if (== cb cnt) (call fwd_step a f ob u i) (block)))
      (set i (+ i 1)))
    (let-mut w i64 0)
    (while (< w n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 w) (<= w n)))
      (invariant (st_ok a f s ob pb kb cb))
      (invariant (>= cb cnt))
      (invariant (>= (idx ob u) 0))
      (invariant (=> (== cb cnt) (and (== ob ord) (and (fwd_upto a f ob u d) (bwd_upto a f ob u w)))))
      (decreases (- n w))
      (assert (== (get_flow f w u) (idx (idx f w) u)))
      (if (and (< (idx ob w) 0) (> (idx (idx f w) u) 0))
        (block
          (assert (arc_ok a f u -1 w))
          (ghost-let o4 (seq int) ob)
          (ghost-let p4 (seq int) pb)
          (ghost-let k4 (seq int) kb)
          (set-idx ob w cb)
          (set-idx pb w u)
          (set-idx kb w -1)
          (call st_mark a f s o4 p4 k4 cb ob pb kb u w -1)
          (set cb (+ cb 1)))
        (if (== cb cnt) (call bwd_step a f ob u w) (block)))
      (set w (+ w 1)))
    (return ob pb kb cb)))

(spec search
  (params (a (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (f (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (s i64))
  (returns (ord (vec i64)) (par (vec i64)) (kind (vec i64)) (cnt i64))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len a)))
            (square f (len a))
            (targets_ok a)
            (<= (len a) 1000))
  (ensures (st_ok a f s ord par kind cnt)
           (closed_upto a f ord (len a)))
  (effects alloc))
(def search
  (body
    (let n i64 (len a))
    (let-mut ob (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (i) -1)))
    (let-mut pb (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (i) 0)))
    (let-mut kb (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (i) 0)))
    (ghost-let o0 (seq int) ob)
    (set-idx ob s 0)
    (call st_init a f s o0 ob pb kb)
    (let-mut cb i64 1)
    (while true
      (invariant (st_ok a f s ob pb kb cb))
      (invariant (and (<= 1 cb) (<= cb n)))
      (decreases (- n cb))
      (ghost-let cstart int cb)
      (ghost-let ostart (seq int) ob)
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (let-mut changed bool false)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (st_ok a f s ob pb kb cb))
        (invariant (and (<= 1 cb) (<= cb n)))
        (invariant (>= cb cstart))
        (invariant (=> changed (> cb cstart)))
        (invariant (=> (not changed) (and (== ob ostart) (closed_upto a f ostart u))))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (if (>= (idx ob u) 0)
          (block
            (let ((o3 (vec i64)) (p3 (vec i64)) (k3 (vec i64)) (c3 i64)) (call visit a f s u ob pb kb cb))
            (if (or changed (!= c3 cb))
              (set changed true)
              (call closed_step a f ostart u))
            (set ob o3)
            (set pb p3)
            (set kb k3)
            (set cb c3))
          (if changed (block) (call closed_step a f ostart u)))
        (set u (+ u 1)))
      (if changed (block) (return ob pb kb cb)))
    (return ob pb kb cb)))

(ghost-fn flow_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (and (square f (len g)) (and (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg f)))))
(ghost-fn ex_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
        (== (+ (total_flow_in g f u) (if (== u x) 1 0)) (total_flow_out g f u))))))
(ghost-fn diff_at ((f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int)) bool
  (body (and (== (get_flow f2 a b) (+ (get_flow f a b) d))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (=> (or (!= u a) (!= v b)) (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v)))))))
(ghost-fn push_rel ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a))))
    (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b) (diff_at f f2 a b d))))))
(ghost-fn flow_new ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int)) bool
  (body (and (>= (get_flow f2 a b) 0)
    (=> (> (get_flow f2 a b) 0)
        (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (get_flow f2 a b) c)))))))
(lemma diff_intro (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int))
  (requires (square f n)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
            (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (== (len f2) n)
            (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (!= u a)) (== (idx f2 u) (idx f u))))
            (== (len (idx f2 a)) n)
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (!= v b)) (== (idx (idx f2 a) v) (idx (idx f a) v))))
            (== (idx (idx f2 a) b) (+ (idx (idx f a) b) d)))
  (ensures (diff_at f f2 a b d) (square f2 n))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f a b) (idx (idx f a) b)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 a b) (idx (idx f2 a) b)))))

(lemma out_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((v int)) (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f2 u k) (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call out_same g f f2 u (- k 1)))))
(lemma out_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (k int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b)
            (diff_at f f2 a b d)
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g a)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f2 a k) (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g f a k) (if (> k i0) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block)
    (block
      (call out_at g f f2 a b d i0 (- k 1))
      (if (== (- k 1) i0) (block)
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g a) (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0))))))))
(lemma in_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((j int)) (== (get_flow f2 j u) (get_flow f j u))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f2 u k) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call in_same g f f2 u (- k 1)))))
(lemma in_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (k int))
  (requires (<= 0 a) (diff_at f f2 a b d))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f2 b k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f b k) (if (> k a) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call in_at g f f2 a b d (- k 1)))))
(lemma diff_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (u int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f2 u) (+ (total_flow_out g f u) (if (== u a) d 0))))
  (body
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (if (== u a)
      (call out_at g f f2 a b d i0 (len (idx g a)))
      (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (call out_same g f f2 u (len (idx g u)))
        (block)))))
(lemma diff_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (u int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f2 u) (+ (total_flow_in g f u) (if (== u b) d 0))))
  (body
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (if (== u b)
      (call in_at g f f2 a b d (len g))
      (call in_same g f f2 u (len g)))))
(lemma ex_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int)
                       (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0)
            (or (and (== a p) (and (== b x) (== d 1))) (and (== a x) (and (== b p) (== d -1))))
            (!= x p)
            (!= x s)
            (ex_ok g f s t x))
  (ensures (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call diff_out g f f2 a b d i0 u))
    (forall ((u int)) (call diff_in g f f2 a b d i0 u))
    (assert (ex_ok g f s t x))))

(lemma has_cap_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g k (get (idx (idx g k) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g k) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma flow_push_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_ok g f) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f2))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f2 u))))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0)
           (=> (> (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f2 u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (square f2 (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (idx (idx f2 u) v)))
    (if (and (== u a) (== v b))
      (assert (flow_new g f2 a b))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (respects_capacity g f))
        (assert (nonneg f))))))
(lemma flow_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (flow_ok g f) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call flow_push_at g f f2 a b d u v))))
(lemma push_forward (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int) (k int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (flow_ok g f) (ex_ok g f s t x) (!= x p) (!= x s)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g p))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g p) k) 0) x)
            (< (get_flow f p x) (get (idx (idx g p) k) 1))
            (square f2 (len g))
            (diff_at f f2 p x 1))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2) (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (nonneg f))
    (assert (== (get_flow f p x) (idx (idx f p) x)))
    (call has_cap_intro g p k)
    (assert (has_capacity g p x (get (idx (idx g p) k) 1)))
    (assert (flow_new g f2 p x))
    (call flow_push g f f2 p x 1)
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 p x 1 k))
    (call ex_step g f f2 s t x p p x 1 k)))
(lemma push_backward (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (flow_ok g f) (ex_ok g f s t x) (!= x p) (!= x s)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g)))
            (> (get_flow f x p) 0)
            (square f2 (len g))
            (diff_at f f2 x p -1))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2) (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f x p) (idx (idx f x) p)))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x p c) (<= (get_flow f x p) c)))
    (assert (has_capacity g x p c))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) p) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (flow_new g f2 x p))
    (call flow_push g f f2 x p -1)
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 x p -1 i))
    (call ex_step g f f2 s t x p x p -1 i)))

(ghost-fn arcs_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
             (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) lim)))
        (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y)))))
(lemma arcs_init_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (lim int) (y int))
  (requires (st_ok g f s o p e cnt)
            (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
                 (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) lim))))
  (ensures (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
  (body
    (assert (st_ok g f s o p e cnt))
    (assert (node_ok g f s o p e y))))
(lemma arcs_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (lim int))
  (requires (st_ok g f s o p e cnt))
  (ensures (arcs_ok g f s o p e lim))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call arcs_init_at g f s o p e cnt lim y))))
(lemma arcs_step_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int)
                            (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (x int) (px int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (y int))
  (requires (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (node_ok g f0 s o p e x)
            (!= x s)
            (>= (idx o x) 0)
            (== px (idx p x))
            (arcs_ok g f s o p e (idx o x))
            (or (and (== a px) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b px)))
            (diff_at f f2 a b d)
            (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
                 (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) (idx o px)))))
  (ensures (arc_ok g f2 (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
  (body
    (assert (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt))
    (assert (node_ok g f0 s o p e x))
    (assert (node_ok g f0 s o p e y))
    (assert (!= y x))
    (assert (!= (idx p y) x))
    (assert (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 (idx p y) y) (get_flow f (idx p y) y)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 y (idx p y)) (get_flow f y (idx p y))))))
(lemma arcs_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int)
                         (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (x int) (px int) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (node_ok g f0 s o p e x)
            (!= x s)
            (>= (idx o x) 0)
            (== px (idx p x))
            (arcs_ok g f s o p e (idx o x))
            (or (and (== a px) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b px)))
            (diff_at f f2 a b d))
  (ensures (arcs_ok g f2 s o p e (idx o px)))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call arcs_step_at g f0 f f2 s o p e cnt x px a b d y))))

(spec augment
  (params (a (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (fm (vec (vec i64))) (s i64) (t i64)
          (ord (ref (slice i64))) (par (ref (slice i64))) (kind (ref (slice i64))) (cnt i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (st_ok a fm s ord par kind cnt)
            (flow_ok a fm)
            (ex_ok a fm s t t)
            (distinct_ok a)
            (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len a)))
            (!= s t)
            (>= (idx ord t) 0))
  (ensures (flow_ok a r)
           (ex_ok a r s t s)
           (== (flow_val a r s) (+ (flow_val a fm s) 1)))
  (effects))
(def augment
  (body
    (let-mut w (vec (vec i64)) fm)
    (let-mut x i64 t)
    (call arcs_init a fm s ord par kind cnt (idx ord t))
    (while (!= x s)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))))
      (invariant (>= (idx ord x) 0))
      (invariant (flow_ok a w))
      (invariant (ex_ok a w s t x))
      (invariant (arcs_ok a w s ord par kind (idx ord x)))
      (invariant (== (flow_val a w s) (+ (flow_val a fm s) (if (== x s) 1 0))))
      (decreases (idx ord x))
      (assert (node_ok a fm s ord par kind x))
      (assert (arc_ok a w (idx par x) (idx kind x) x))
      (let p i64 (idx par x))
      (let k i64 (idx kind x))
      (ghost-let w0 (seq (seq int)) w)
      (assert (square w0 (len a)))
      (if (>= k 0)
        (block
          (let c i64 (get (idx (idx a p) k) 1))
          (call law_i64_range c)

  (body (and (== (get_flow f2 a b) (+ (get_flow f a b) d))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (=> (or (!= u a) (!= v b)) (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v)))))))
(ghost-fn push_rel ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a))))
    (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b) (diff_at f f2 a b d))))))
(ghost-fn flow_new ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int)) bool
  (body (and (>= (get_flow f2 a b) 0)
    (=> (> (get_flow f2 a b) 0)
        (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (get_flow f2 a b) c)))))))
(lemma diff_intro (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int))
  (requires (square f n)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
            (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (== (len f2) n)
            (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (!= u a)) (== (idx f2 u) (idx f u))))
            (== (len (idx f2 a)) n)
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (!= v b)) (== (idx (idx f2 a) v) (idx (idx f a) v))))
            (== (idx (idx f2 a) b) (+ (idx (idx f a) b) d)))
  (ensures (diff_at f f2 a b d) (square f2 n))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f a b) (idx (idx f a) b)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 a b) (idx (idx f2 a) b)))))

(lemma out_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((v int)) (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f2 u k) (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call out_same g f f2 u (- k 1)))))
(lemma out_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (k int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b)
            (diff_at f f2 a b d)
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g a)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f2 a k) (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g f a k) (if (> k i0) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block)
    (block
      (call out_at g f f2 a b d i0 (- k 1))
      (if (== (- k 1) i0) (block)
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g a) (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0))))))))
(lemma in_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((j int)) (== (get_flow f2 j u) (get_flow f j u))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f2 u k) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call in_same g f f2 u (- k 1)))))
(lemma in_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (k int))
  (requires (<= 0 a) (diff_at f f2 a b d))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f2 b k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f b k) (if (> k a) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call in_at g f f2 a b d (- k 1)))))
(lemma diff_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (u int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f2 u) (+ (total_flow_out g f u) (if (== u a) d 0))))
  (body
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (if (== u a)
      (call out_at g f f2 a b d i0 (len (idx g a)))
      (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (call out_same g f f2 u (len (idx g u)))
        (block)))))
(lemma diff_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (u int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f2 u) (+ (total_flow_in g f u) (if (== u b) d 0))))
  (body
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (if (== u b)
      (call in_at g f f2 a b d (len g))
      (call in_same g f f2 u (len g)))))
(lemma ex_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int)
                       (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0)
            (or (and (== a p) (and (== b x) (== d 1))) (and (== a x) (and (== b p) (== d -1))))
            (!= x p)
            (!= x s)
            (ex_ok g f s t x))
  (ensures (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call diff_out g f f2 a b d i0 u))
    (forall ((u int)) (call diff_in g f f2 a b d i0 u))
    (assert (ex_ok g f s t x))))

(lemma has_cap_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g k (get (idx (idx g k) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g k) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma flow_push_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_ok g f) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f2))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f2 u))))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0)
           (=> (> (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f2 u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (square f2 (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (idx (idx f2 u) v)))
    (if (and (== u a) (== v b))
      (assert (flow_new g f2 a b))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (respects_capacity g f))
        (assert (nonneg f))))))
(lemma flow_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (flow_ok g f) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call flow_push_at g f f2 a b d u v))))
(lemma push_forward (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int) (k int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (flow_ok g f) (ex_ok g f s t x) (!= x p) (!= x s)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g p))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g p) k) 0) x)
            (< (get_flow f p x) (get (idx (idx g p) k) 1))
            (square f2 (len g))
            (diff_at f f2 p x 1))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2) (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (nonneg f))
    (assert (== (get_flow f p x) (idx (idx f p) x)))
    (call has_cap_intro g p k)
    (assert (has_capacity g p x (get (idx (idx g p) k) 1)))
    (assert (flow_new g f2 p x))
    (call flow_push g f f2 p x 1)
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 p x 1 k))
    (call ex_step g f f2 s t x p p x 1 k)))
(lemma push_backward (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (flow_ok g f) (ex_ok g f s t x) (!= x p) (!= x s)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g)))
            (> (get_flow f x p) 0)
            (square f2 (len g))
            (diff_at f f2 x p -1))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2) (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f x p) (idx (idx f x) p)))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x p c) (<= (get_flow f x p) c)))
    (assert (has_capacity g x p c))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) p) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (flow_new g f2 x p))
    (call flow_push g f f2 x p -1)
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 x p -1 i))
    (call ex_step g f f2 s t x p x p -1 i)))

(ghost-fn arcs_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
             (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) lim)))
        (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y)))))
(lemma arcs_init_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (lim int) (y int))
  (requires (st_ok g f s o p e cnt)
            (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
                 (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) lim))))
  (ensures (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
  (body
    (assert (st_ok g f s o p e cnt))
    (assert (node_ok g f s o p e y))))
(lemma arcs_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (lim int))
  (requires (st_ok g f s o p e cnt))
  (ensures (arcs_ok g f s o p e lim))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call arcs_init_at g f s o p e cnt lim y))))
(lemma arcs_step_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int)
                            (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (x int) (px int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (y int))
  (requires (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (node_ok g f0 s o p e x)
            (!= x s)
            (>= (idx o x) 0)
            (== px (idx p x))
            (arcs_ok g f s o p e (idx o x))
            (or (and (== a px) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b px)))
            (diff_at f f2 a b d)
            (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
                 (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) (idx o px)))))
  (ensures (arc_ok g f2 (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
  (body
    (assert (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt))
    (assert (node_ok g f0 s o p e x))
    (assert (node_ok g f0 s o p e y))
    (assert (!= y x))
    (assert (!= (idx p y) x))
    (assert (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 (idx p y) y) (get_flow f (idx p y) y)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 y (idx p y)) (get_flow f y (idx p y))))))
(lemma arcs_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int)
                         (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (x int) (px int) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (node_ok g f0 s o p e x)
            (!= x s)
            (>= (idx o x) 0)
            (== px (idx p x))
            (arcs_ok g f s o p e (idx o x))
            (or (and (== a px) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b px)))
            (diff_at f f2 a b d))
  (ensures (arcs_ok g f2 s o p e (idx o px)))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call arcs_step_at g f0 f f2 s o p e cnt x px a b d y))))

(spec augment
  (params (a (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (fm (vec (vec i64))) (s i64) (t i64)
          (ord (ref (slice i64))) (par (ref (slice i64))) (kind (ref (slice i64))) (cnt i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (st_ok a fm s ord par kind cnt)
            (flow_ok a fm)
            (ex_ok a fm s t t)
            (distinct_ok a)
            (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len a)))
            (!= s t)
            (>= (idx ord t) 0))
  (ensures (flow_ok a r)
           (ex_ok a r s t s)
           (== (flow_val a r s) (+ (flow_val a fm s) 1)))
  (effects))
(def augment
  (body
    (let-mut w (vec (vec i64)) fm)
    (let-mut x i64 t)
    (call arcs_init a fm s ord par kind cnt (idx ord t))
    (while (!= x s)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))))
      (invariant (>= (idx ord x) 0))
      (invariant (flow_ok a w))
      (invariant (ex_ok a w s t x))
      (invariant (arcs_ok a w s ord par kind (idx ord x)))
      (invariant (== (flow_val a w s) (+ (flow_val a fm s) (if (== x s) 1 0))))
      (decreases (idx ord x))
      (assert (node_ok a fm s ord par kind x))
      (assert (arc_ok a w (idx par x) (idx kind x) x))
      (let p i64 (idx par x))
      (let k i64 (idx kind x))
      (ghost-let w0 (seq (seq int)) w)
      (assert (square w0 (len a)))
      (if (>= k 0)
        (block
          (let c i64 (get (idx (idx a p) k) 1))
          (call law_i64_range c)
          (assert (== (get_flow w p x) (idx (idx w p) x)))
          (let e i64 (+ (idx (idx w p) x) 1))
          (set-idx (idx w p) x e)
          (call diff_intro w0 w p x 1 (len a))
          (call push_forward a w0 w s t x p k)
          (call arcs_step a fm w0 w s ord par kind cnt x p p x 1))
        (block
          (assert (== (get_flow w x p) (idx (idx w x) p)))
          (let e2 i64 (- (idx (idx w x) p) 1))
          (set-idx (idx w x) p e2)
          (call diff_intro w0 w x p -1 (len a))
          (call push_backward a w0 w s t x p)
          (call arcs_step a fm w0 w s ord par kind cnt x p x p -1)))
      (set x p))
    (return w)))

(ghost-fn mcount ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k int) (v int) (d int)) int (decreases d)
  (body (if (or (<= d 0) (or (< k 0) (or (>= k (len g)) (> d (len (idx g k)))))) 0
    (+ (mcount g k v (- d 1)) (if (== (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0) v) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn aless ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (p int) (d int)) int (decreases d)
  (body (if (or (<= d 0) (or (< k 0) (or (>= k (len g)) (> d (len (idx g k)))))) 0
    (+ (aless g f o k p (- d 1))
       (if (and (< (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0) p) (vis o (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)))
           (get_flow f k (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0))
           0)))))
(ghost-fn adjout ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (d int)) int (decreases d)
  (body (if (or (<= d 0) (or (< k 0) (or (>= k (len g)) (> d (len (idx g k)))))) 0
    (+ (adjout g f o k (- d 1))
       (if (vis o (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)) 0 (get_flow f k (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn capout ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (d int)) int (decreases d)
  (body (if (or (<= d 0) (or (< k 0) (or (>= k (len g)) (> d (len (idx g k)))))) 0
    (+ (capout g o k (- d 1))
       (if (vis o (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)) 0 (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 1))))))
(ghost-fn rowchi ((f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (p int)) int (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) 0
    (+ (rowchi f o k (- p 1)) (if (vis o (- p 1)) (get_flow f k (- p 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn rowval ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int)) int
  (body (- (if (vis o k) (total_flow_out g f k) 0) (rowchi f o k (len g)))))
(ghost-fn rc ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq int)) (k int)) int
  (body (if (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g))) (vis o k)) (capout g o k (len (idx g k))) 0)))
(ghost-fn wsum ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (p int) (m int)) int (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) 0
    (+ (wsum g f o (- p 1) m) (if (vis o (- p 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f (- p 1) m) 0)))))
(ghost-fn outs ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0
    (+ (outs g f o (- m 1)) (if (vis o (- m 1)) (total_flow_out g f (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn cut_cap ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq int)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (cut_cap g o (- m 1)) (rc g o (- m 1))))))

(lemma mcount_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k int) (v int) (j int) (istar int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (<= j istar))
            (< istar (len (idx g k)))
            (== (get (idx (idx g k) istar) 0) v))
  (ensures (== (mcount g k v j) 0))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (<= j 0) (block)
    (block
      (call mcount_zero g k v (- j 1) istar)
      (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g k) (- j 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g k) istar) 0)))))))
(lemma mcount_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k int) (v int) (i0 int) (d int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 d))
            (<= d (len (idx g k)))
            (== (get (idx (idx g k) i0) 0) v))
  (ensures (== (mcount g k v d) 1))
  (decreases d)
  (body (if (== (- d 1) i0)
    (call mcount_zero g k v i0 i0)
    (block
      (call mcount_one g k v i0 (- d 1))
      (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g k) i0) 0)))))))
(lemma aless_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (p int) (d int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (>= p 1)
            (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (== (aless g f o k p d)
               (+ (aless g f o k (- p 1) d)
                  (if (and (vis o (- p 1)) (== (mcount g k (- p 1) d) 1)) (get_flow f k (- p 1)) 0))))
  (decreases d)
  (body (if (<= d 0) (block)
    (block
      (call aless_step g f o k p (- d 1))
      (if (== (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0) (- p 1))
        (call mcount_zero g k (- p 1) (- d 1) (- d 1))
        (block))))))
(lemma aless_base (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (d int))
  (requires (targets_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (== (aless g f o k 0 d) 0))
  (decreases d)
  (body (if (<= d 0) (block)
    (block
      (call aless_base g f o k (- d 1))
      (assert (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)))))))

(lemma flow_pos (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (get_flow h k v) 0)
           (=> (> (get_flow h k v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g k v c) (<= (get_flow h k v) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (is_valid_flow g h s t))
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
