(ghost-fn is_zero ((m (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (== (get_flow m u v) 0))))
(lemma zero_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (is_zero m))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) 0))
      (block
        (call zero_in g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow m (- k 1) u) 0))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m (- k 1) u))))))))
(lemma zero_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (is_zero m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u k) 0))
      (block
        (call zero_out g m u (- k 1))
        (call out_unfold g m u k)
        (assert (== (get_flow m u (tgt g u (- k 1))) 0))))))
(lemma zero_total (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (is_zero m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g m u) 0) (== (total_flow_in g m u) 0))
  (body
    (call zero_out g m u (len (idx g u)))
    (call zero_in g m u (len g))))
(lemma zero_core_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_zero m))
  (ensures (and (rc_at g m u v) (nn_at m u v)))
  (body (assert (== (get_flow m u v) 0))))
(lemma zero_bal_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (is_zero m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (bal_at g m t t u))
  (body (call zero_total g m u)))
(lemma zero_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_zero m) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (!= s t))
  (ensures (flow_core g m) (walk_bal g m s t t 0))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call zero_core_at g m u v))
    (forall ((u int)) (call zero_bal_at g m t u))
    (call zero_total g m s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g m s) (- (total_flow_out g m s) (total_flow_in g m s))))))

(ghost-fn row_sum ((m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (row_sum m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1))))))
(ghost-fn prefix_has ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (j int) (v int)) bool (decreases j)
  (body (if (<= j 0) false (or (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) v) (prefix_has g u (- j 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn filt ((m (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (j int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0
    (+ (filt m g u j (- k 1)) (if (prefix_has g u j (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0)))))
(lemma filt_nil (params (m (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (filt m g u 0 k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (filt m g u 0 k) 0))
      (block
        (call filt_nil m g u (- k 1))
        (assert (not (prefix_has g u 0 (- k 1))))
        (assert (== (filt m g u 0 k) (+ (filt m g u 0 (- k 1)) (if (prefix_has g u 0 (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma not_has (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (jj int) (j int) (x int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (in_edge g u jj) (== (tgt g u jj) x) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j jj)))
  (ensures (not (prefix_has g u j x)))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (== j 0)
      (assert (not (prefix_has g u j x)))
      (block
        (call not_has g u jj (- j 1) x)
        (assert (in_edge g u (- j 1)))
        (assert (!= (tgt g u (- j 1)) (tgt g u jj)))
        (assert (== (prefix_has g u j x) (or (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) x) (prefix_has g u (- j 1) x))))))))
(lemma has_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)))
  (ensures (prefix_has g u j (tgt g u i)))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (assert (== (prefix_has g u j (tgt g u i)) (or (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) (tgt g u i)) (prefix_has g u (- j 1) (tgt g u i)))))
    (if (== i (- j 1))
      (assert (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) (tgt g u i)))
      (call has_intro g u i (- j 1)))))
(lemma filt_step (params (m (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (in_edge g u (- j 1)))
  (ensures (== (filt m g u j k)
               (+ (filt m g u (- j 1) k)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (tgt g u (- j 1))) (< (tgt g u (- j 1)) k)) (get_flow m u (tgt g u (- j 1))) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block (assert (== (filt m g u j k) 0)) (assert (== (filt m g u (- j 1) k) 0)))
      (block
        (call filt_step m g u j (- k 1))
        (assert (== (filt m g u j k) (+ (filt m g u j (- k 1)) (if (prefix_has g u j (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (filt m g u (- j 1) k) (+ (filt m g u (- j 1) (- k 1)) (if (prefix_has g u (- j 1) (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (prefix_has g u j (- k 1)) (or (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) (- k 1)) (prefix_has g u (- j 1) (- k 1)))))
        (if (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) (- k 1))
          (call not_has g u (- j 1) (- j 1) (- k 1))
          (block))))))
(lemma out_eq_filt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u j) (filt m g u j (len g))))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (== j 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u j) 0))
        (call filt_nil m g u (len g)))
      (block
        (call out_eq_filt g m u (- j 1))
        (call out_unfold g m u j)
        (assert (in_edge g u (- j 1)))
        (call tgt_range g u (- j 1))
        (call filt_step m g u j (len g))))))
(lemma entry_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_core g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (or (prefix_has g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow m u v) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (nn_at m u v))
    (if (> (get_flow m u v) 0)
      (block
        (call rc_edge g m u v)
        (obtain ((e2 int)) (and (in_edge g u e2) (== (tgt g u e2) v)))
        (call has_intro g u e2 (len (idx g u))))
      (block))))
(lemma filt_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_core g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (filt m g u (len (idx g u)) k) (row_sum m u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block (assert (== (filt m g u (len (idx g u)) k) 0)) (assert (== (row_sum m u k) 0)))
      (block
        (call filt_full g m u (- k 1))
        (call entry_zero g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (filt m g u (len (idx g u)) k)
                    (+ (filt m g u (len (idx g u)) (- k 1))
                       (if (prefix_has g u (len (idx g u)) (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (row_sum m u k) (+ (row_sum m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma row_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g m u) (row_sum m u (len g))))
  (body
    (call out_eq_filt g m u (len (idx g u)))
    (call filt_full g m u (len g))))

(lemma cap_entry (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_core g m) (capacities_bounded g))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow m u v) 100000))
  (body
    (assert (rc_at g m u v))
    (if (> (get_flow m u v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c0 int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c0) (<= (get_flow m u v) c0)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v c0))
        (assert (<= c0 100000)))
      (block))))
(lemma row_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_core g m) (capacities_bounded g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (<= (row_sum m u k) (* k 100000)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (row_sum m u k) 0))
      (block
        (call row_bound g m u (- k 1))
        (call cap_entry g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (row_sum m u k) (+ (row_sum m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma in_nn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_core g m))
  (ensures (>= (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) 0))
      (block
        (call in_nn g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (nn_at m (- k 1) u))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m (- k 1) u))))))))
(lemma flow_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (!= s t) (walk_bal g m s t t val))
  (ensures (<= val 100000000))
  (body
    (call row_out g m s)
    (call row_bound g m s (len g))
    (call in_nn g m s (len g))
    (assert (== (flow_val g m s) val))
    (assert (== (flow_val g m s) (- (total_flow_out g m s) (total_flow_in g m s))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g m s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g m s (len g))))
    (assert (<= (len g) 1000))))

(ghost-fn cross ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int)) int

(ghost-fn cross_row ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)

(ghost-fn net ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (q int)) int (decreases p)

(ghost-fn mask_row ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)

(ghost-fn r_total ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (q int)) int (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) 0 (+ (r_total m lb (- p 1) q) (if (vis lb (- p 1)) (row_sum m (- p 1) q) 0)))))
(ghost-fn a_total ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (q int)) int (decreases p)

(ghost-fn b_total ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (q int)) int (decreases q)

    (+ (v_total g m lb (- p 1))

(lemma cross_row_eq (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (q int))
  (ensures (== (cross_row m lb u q) (- (if (vis lb u) (row_sum m u q) 0) (mask_row m lb u q))))
  (decreases q)
  (body
    (if (<= q 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (cross_row m lb u q) 0))
        (assert (== (row_sum m u q) 0))
        (assert (== (mask_row m lb u q) 0)))
      (block
        (call cross_row_eq m lb u (- q 1))
        (assert (== (cross_row m lb u q) (+ (cross_row m lb u (- q 1)) (cross m lb u (- q 1)))))
        (assert (== (row_sum m u q) (+ (row_sum m u (- q 1)) (get_flow m u (- q 1)))))
        (assert (== (mask_row m lb u q) (+ (mask_row m lb u (- q 1)) (if (vis lb (- q 1)) (get_flow m u (- q 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (cross m lb u (- q 1)) (- (if (vis lb u) (get_flow m u (- q 1)) 0) (if (vis lb (- q 1)) (get_flow m u (- q 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma net_eq (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (q int))
  (ensures (== (net m lb p q) (- (r_total m lb p q) (a_total m lb p q))))
  (decreases p)
  (body
    (if (<= p 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (net m lb p q) 0))
        (assert (== (r_total m lb p q) 0))
        (assert (== (a_total m lb p q) 0)))
      (block
        (call net_eq m lb (- p 1) q)
        (call cross_row_eq m lb (- p 1) q)
        (assert (== (net m lb p q) (+ (net m lb (- p 1) q) (cross_row m lb (- p 1) q))))
        (assert (== (r_total m lb p q) (+ (r_total m lb (- p 1) q) (if (vis lb (- p 1)) (row_sum m (- p 1) q) 0))))
        (assert (== (a_total m lb p q) (+ (a_total m lb (- p 1) q) (mask_row m lb (- p 1) q))))))))
(lemma a_zero (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int))
  (ensures (== (a_total m lb p 0) 0))
  (decreases p)

    (if (<= p 0)

      (block

        (assert (== (mask_row m lb (- p 1) 0) 0))
        (assert (== (a_total m lb p 0) (+ (a_total m lb (- p 1) 0) (mask_row m lb (- p 1) 0))))))))
(lemma a_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (k int))
  (requires (> k 0))
  (ensures (== (a_total m lb p k)
               (+ (a_total m lb p (- k 1)) (if (vis lb (- k 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g m (- k 1) p) 0))))
  (decreases p)
  (body
    (if (<= p 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (a_total m lb p k) 0))
        (assert (== (a_total m lb p (- k 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m (- k 1) p) 0)))
      (block
        (call a_step g m lb (- p 1) k)
        (assert (== (a_total m lb p k) (+ (a_total m lb (- p 1) k) (mask_row m lb (- p 1) k))))
        (assert (== (a_total m lb p (- k 1)) (+ (a_total m lb (- p 1) (- k 1)) (mask_row m lb (- p 1) (- k 1)))))
        (assert (== (mask_row m lb (- p 1) k)
                    (+ (mask_row m lb (- p 1) (- k 1)) (if (vis lb (- k 1)) (get_flow m (- p 1) (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m (- k 1) p)
                    (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g m (- k 1) (- p 1)) (get_flow m (- p 1) (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma a_eq_b (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (>= q 0))
  (ensures (== (a_total m lb p q) (b_total g m lb p q)))
  (decreases q)
  (body
    (if (== q 0)
      (block
        (call a_zero m lb p)
        (assert (== (b_total g m lb p q) 0)))
      (block
        (call a_eq_b g m lb p (- q 1))
        (call a_step g m lb p q)
        (assert (== (b_total g m lb p q)
                    (+ (b_total g m lb p (- q 1)) (if (vis lb (- q 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g m (- q 1) p) 0))))))))
(lemma r_b_v (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (len g))))
  (ensures (== (- (r_total m lb p (len g)) (b_total g m lb (len g) p)) (v_total g m lb p)))

  (body

        (call r_b_v g m lb (- p 1))

        (assert (== (r_total m lb p (len g))
                    (+ (r_total m lb (- p 1) (len g)) (if (vis lb (- p 1)) (row_sum m (- p 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (b_total g m lb (len g) p)
                    (+ (b_total g m lb (len g) (- p 1)) (if (vis lb (- p 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g m (- p 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (v_total g m lb p)
                    (+ (v_total g m lb (- p 1))
                       (if (vis lb (- p 1)) (- (total_flow_out g m (- p 1)) (total_flow_in g m (- p 1))) 0))))
        (assert (== (total_flow_in g m (- p 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g m (- p 1) (len g))))))))
(lemma v_val (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (t int) (p int))
  (requires (is_conserved g m s t) (vis lb s) (not (vis lb t)) (<= p (len g)))
  (ensures (== (v_total g m lb p) (if (and (<= 0 s) (< s p)) (flow_val g m s) 0)))
  (decreases p)
  (body
    (if (<= p 0)
      (assert (== (v_total g m lb p) 0))
      (block
        (call v_val g m lb s t (- p 1))
        (assert (== (v_total g m lb p)
                    (+ (v_total g m lb (- p 1))
                       (if (vis lb (- p 1)) (- (total_flow_out g m (- p 1)) (total_flow_in g m (- p 1))) 0))))
        (assert (== (flow_val g m s) (- (total_flow_out g m s) (total_flow_in g m s))))
        (if (and (vis lb (- p 1)) (!= (- p 1) s))
          (block
            (assert (!= (- p 1) t))
            (assert (== (total_flow_in g m (- p 1)) (total_flow_out g m (- p 1)))))
          (block))))))
(lemma net_val (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (is_conserved g m s t) (vis lb s) (not (vis lb t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (== (net m lb (len g) (len g)) (flow_val g m s)))
  (body
    (call net_eq m lb (len g) (len g))
    (call a_eq_b g m lb (len g) (len g))
    (call r_b_v g m lb (len g))
    (call v_val g m lb s t (len g))))

(ghost-fn dom ((o (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (n int)) bool

  (ensures (and (rc_at g m2 u v) (nn_at m2 u v)))
  (body
    (assert (and (rc_at g m u v) (nn_at m u v)))
    (if (and (== u a) (== v b))
      (block
        (assert (rc_at g m a b))
        (obtain ((c0 int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c0) (<= (get_flow m a b) c0)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v c0))
        (assert (<= (get_flow m2 u v) c0)))
      (assert (same_at m m2 u v)))))
(lemma core_step_bwd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (flow_core g m) (diff_at m m2 a b -1) (> (get_flow m a b) 0))
  (ensures (flow_core g m2))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call core_bwd_at g m m2 a b u v))))
(lemma rc_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (flow_core g m) (> (get_flow m a b) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((e int)) (and (in_edge g a e) (== (tgt g a e) b))))
  (body
    (assert (rc_at g m a b))
    (obtain ((c0 int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c0) (<= (get_flow m a b) c0)))
    (assert (has_capacity g a b c0))
    (obtain ((e0 int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 e0) (< e0 (len (idx g a)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) e0) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) e0) 1) c0))))
    (assert (in_edge g a e0))
    (assert (== (tgt g a e0) b))))

(lemma in_change (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (diff_at m m2 a b d))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m2 u k)
               (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) (if (and (== u b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a k))) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m2 u k) 0))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) 0)))
      (block
        (call in_change g m m2 a b d u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m2 u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g m2 u (- k 1)) (get_flow m2 (- k 1) u))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m (- k 1) u))))
        (if (and (== (- k 1) a) (== u b))
          (assert (== (get_flow m2 (- k 1) u) (+ (get_flow m (- k 1) u) d)))
          (assert (same_at m m2 (- k 1) u)))))))
(lemma out_unfold (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (< 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u k)
               (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (tgt g u (- k 1))))))
  (body
    (assert (in_edge g u (- k 1)))
    (assert (== (tgt g u (- k 1)) (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)))))
(lemma out_change (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int) (d int) (w int) (k int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (diff_at m m2 a b d) (in_edge g a e) (== (tgt g a e) b)
            (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g w)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m2 w k)
               (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g m w k) (if (and (== w a) (< e k)) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m2 w k) 0))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m w k) 0)))
      (block
        (call out_change g m m2 a b e d w (- k 1))
        (call out_unfold g m w k)
        (call out_unfold g m2 w k)
        (assert (in_edge g w (- k 1)))
        (if (and (== w a) (== (- k 1) e))
          (block
            (assert (== (tgt g w (- k 1)) b))
            (assert (== (get_flow m2 w (tgt g w (- k 1))) (+ (get_flow m w (tgt g w (- k 1))) d))))
          (block
            (if (== w a) (assert (!= (tgt g w (- k 1)) (tgt g a e))) (block))
            (assert (same_at m m2 w (tgt g w (- k 1))))))))))
(lemma total_change (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int) (d int) (w int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (diff_at m m2 a b d) (in_edge g a e) (== (tgt g a e) b) (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g m2 w) (+ (total_flow_out g m w) (if (== w a) d 0)))
           (== (total_flow_in g m2 w) (+ (total_flow_in g m w) (if (== w b) d 0))))
  (body
    (call out_change g m m2 a b e d w (len (idx g w)))
    (call in_change g m m2 a b d w (len g))
    (assert (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))))
    (if (== w a) (assert (< e (len (idx g w)))) (block))))

(ghost-fn bal_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (t int) (x int) (u int)) bool
  (body (== (- (total_flow_in g m u) (total_flow_out g m u)) (if (and (== u x) (!= x t)) -1 0))))
(ghost-fn walk_bal ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (val int)) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t))) (bal_at g m t x u)))
    (== (flow_val g m s) (if (== x s) (+ val 1) val)))))
(lemma bal_step_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int) (val int) (a int) (b int) (e int) (d int) (u int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (walk_bal g m s t x val) (diff_at m m2 a b d) (in_edge g a e) (== (tgt g a e) b)
            (or (and (== a p) (and (== b x) (== d 1))) (and (== a x) (and (== b p) (== d -1))))
            (!= x p) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (bal_at g m2 t p u))
  (body
    (assert (bal_at g m t x u))
    (call total_change g m m2 a b e d u)))
(lemma bal_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int) (val int) (a int) (b int) (e int) (d int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (walk_bal g m s t x val) (diff_at m m2 a b d) (in_edge g a e) (== (tgt g a e) b)
            (or (and (== a p) (and (== b x) (== d 1))) (and (== a x) (and (== b p) (== d -1))))
            (!= x p) (!= x s) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (walk_bal g m2 s t p val))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call bal_step_at g m m2 s t x p val a b e d u))
    (call total_change g m m2 a b e d s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g m s) val))
    (assert (== (flow_val g m2 s) (- (total_flow_out g m2 s) (total_flow_in g m2 s))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g m s) (- (total_flow_out g m s) (total_flow_in g m s))))))
(lemma bal_final_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (val int) (u int))
  (requires (walk_bal g m s t s val) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (bal_at g m t t u))
  (body (assert (bal_at g m t s u))))
(lemma bal_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (walk_bal g m s t s val) (!= s t))
  (ensures (walk_bal g m s t t (+ val 1)))
  (body (forall ((u int)) (call bal_final_at g m s t val u))))
(lemma cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (val int) (u int))
  (requires (walk_bal g m s t t val) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g m u) (total_flow_out g m u)))
  (body (assert (bal_at g m t t u))))
(lemma conserved_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (walk_bal g m s t t val))
  (ensures (is_conserved g m s t))
  (body (forall ((u int)) (call cons_at g m s t val u))))

(ghost-fn lv ((lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (y int)) int
  (body (if (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len lb))) (get (idx lb y) 2) -1)))
(ghost-fn lpar ((lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (y int)) int
  (body (if (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len lb))) (get (idx lb y) 0) 0)))
(ghost-fn lpe ((lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (y int)) int
  (body (if (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len lb))) (get (idx lb y) 1) 0)))
(ghost-fn vis ((lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (y int)) bool
  (body (>= (lv lb y) 0)))
(ghost-fn link ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (p int) (y int) (e int)) bool
  (body (if (>= e 0)
    (and (and (in_edge g p e) (== (tgt g p e) y)) (< (get_flow m p y) (cpc g p e)))
    (> (get_flow m y p) 0))))
(ghost-fn forest_at ((lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (y int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (vis lb y) (!= y s))
            (and (and (<= 0 (lpar lb y)) (< (lpar lb y) (len lb)))
                 (and (vis lb (lpar lb y)) (< (lv lb (lpar lb y)) (lv lb y)))))))
(ghost-fn forest ((lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int)) bool
  (body (and (vis lb s) (forall ((y int)) (forest_at lb s y)))))
(ghost-fn all_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (y int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (vis lb y) (!= y s)) (link g m (lpar lb y) y (lpe lb y)))))
(ghost-fn links_all ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (all_at g m lb s y))))
(ghost-fn link_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (lim int) (y int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (vis lb y) (and (!= y s) (<= (lv lb y) lim))) (link g m (lpar lb y) y (lpe lb y)))))
(ghost-fn links_lim ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (link_at g m lb s lim y))))
(ghost-fn below_at ((lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (st int) (y int)) bool
  (body (=> (vis lb y) (< (lv lb y) st))))
(ghost-fn below ((lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (st int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (below_at lb st y))))
(ghost-fn lab_state ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (st int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len lb) (len g)) (forest lb s)) (and (links_all g m lb s) (below lb st)))))
(ghost-fn same_lab ((lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (y int)) bool
  (body (and (== (lv lb2 y) (lv lb y)) (and (== (lpar lb2 y) (lpar lb y)) (== (lpe lb2 y) (lpe lb y))))))
(ghost-fn marked ((lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (v int) (u int) (e int) (st int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len lb2) (len lb)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len lb))))
             (and (and (== (lv lb2 v) st) (and (== (lpar lb2 v) u) (== (lpe lb2 v) e)))
                  (forall ((y int)) (=> (!= y v) (same_lab lb lb2 y)))))))
(ghost-fn grown ((lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (and (== (len lb2) (len lb)) (forall ((y int)) (=> (vis lb y) (same_lab lb lb2 y))))))

(lemma grown_refl (params (lb (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (grown lb lb))
  (body))
(lemma grown_trans_at (params (a1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (y int))
  (requires (grown a1 a2) (grown a2 a3))
  (ensures (=> (vis a1 y) (same_lab a1 a3 y)))
  (body
    (if (vis a1 y)
      (block (assert (same_lab a1 a2 y)) (assert (vis a2 y)) (assert (same_lab a2 a3 y)))
      (block))))
(lemma grown_trans (params (a1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a3 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (grown a1 a2) (grown a2 a3))
  (ensures (grown a1 a3))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call grown_trans_at a1 a2 a3 y))))
(lemma mark_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (v int) (u int) (e int) (st int) (y int))
  (requires (lab_state g m lb s (+ st 1)) (marked lb lb2 v u e st) (vis lb u) (< (lv lb u) st)
            (not (vis lb v)) (link g m u v e) (>= st 1))
  (ensures (and (forest_at lb2 s y) (and (all_at g m lb2 s y) (below_at lb2 (+ st 1) y)))
           (=> (vis lb y) (same_lab lb lb2 y)))
  (body
    (assert (forest_at lb s y))
    (assert (all_at g m lb s y))
    (assert (below_at lb (+ st 1) y))
    (assert (!= u v))
    (assert (vis lb s))
    (assert (!= s v))
    (assert (same_lab lb lb2 u))
    (if (== y v)
      (block
        (assert (vis lb2 v))
        (assert (vis lb2 u))
        (assert (== (lv lb2 u) (lv lb u)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len lb)))))
      (block
        (assert (same_lab lb lb2 y))
        (if (and (vis lb y) (!= y s))
          (block
            (assert (!= (lpar lb y) v))
            (assert (same_lab lb lb2 (lpar lb y))))
          (block))))))
(lemma mark_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (v int) (u int) (e int) (st int))
  (requires (lab_state g m lb s (+ st 1)) (marked lb lb2 v u e st) (vis lb u) (< (lv lb u) st)
            (not (vis lb v)) (link g m u v e) (>= st 1))
  (ensures (lab_state g m lb2 s (+ st 1)) (grown lb lb2))
  (body
    (forall ((y int)) (call mark_at g m lb lb2 s v u e st y))
    (assert (vis lb s))
    (assert (!= s v))
    (assert (same_lab lb lb2 s))
    (assert (vis lb2 s))
    (assert (forest lb2 s))
    (assert (links_all g m lb2 s))
    (assert (below lb2 (+ st 1)))))
(lemma below_up_at (params (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (st int) (y int))
  (requires (below lb st))
  (ensures (below_at lb (+ st 1) y))
  (body (assert (below_at lb st y))))
(lemma below_up (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (st int))
  (requires (lab_state g m lb s st))
  (ensures (lab_state g m lb s (+ st 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((y int)) (call below_up_at lb st y))
    (assert (below lb (+ st 1)))))
(lemma init_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (y int))
  (requires (== (lv lb s) 0) (forall ((z int)) (=> (!= z s) (< (lv lb z) 0))))
  (ensures (and (forest_at lb s y) (and (all_at g m lb s y) (below_at lb 1 y))))
  (body (if (== y s) (block) (assert (< (lv lb y) 0)))))
(lemma init_state (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int))
  (requires (== (len lb) (len g)) (== (lv lb s) 0) (forall ((z int)) (=> (!= z s) (< (lv lb z) 0))))
  (ensures (lab_state g m lb s 1))
  (body
    (forall ((y int)) (call init_at g m lb s y))
    (assert (vis lb s))
    (assert (forest lb s))
    (assert (links_all g m lb s))
    (assert (below lb 1))))
(lemma links_restrict_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (lim int) (y int))
  (requires (links_all g m lb s))
  (ensures (link_at g m lb s lim y))
  (body (assert (all_at g m lb s y))))
(lemma links_restrict (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (lim int))
  (requires (links_all g m lb s))
  (ensures (links_lim g m lb s lim))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call links_restrict_at g m lb s lim y))))

(ghost-fn out_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (in_edge g u k) (not (vis lb (tgt g u k)))) (>= (get_flow m u (tgt g u k)) (cpc g u k)))))
(ghost-fn out_upto ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k i)) (out_at g m lb u k)))))
(ghost-fn closed_out ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (out_at g m lb u k))))
(ghost-fn in_at ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (w int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len lb))) (not (vis lb w))) (<= (get_flow m w u) 0))))
(ghost-fn in_upto ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k i)) (in_at m lb u k)))))
(ghost-fn closed_in ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (in_at m lb u k))))
(ghost-fn cut_closed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (vis lb y) (and (closed_out g m lb y) (closed_in m lb y))))))

(lemma vis_grow (params (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (y int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (vis lb y))
  (ensures (vis lb2 y))
  (body (assert (same_lab lb lb2 y))))
(lemma out_at_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (out_at g m lb u k))
  (ensures (out_at g m lb2 u k))
  (body (if (vis lb (tgt g u k)) (call vis_grow lb lb2 (tgt g u k)) (block))))
(lemma in_at_mono (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (in_at m lb u k))
  (ensures (in_at m lb2 u k))
  (body (if (vis lb k) (call vis_grow lb lb2 k) (block))))
(lemma out_upto_nil (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (ensures (out_upto g m lb u 0))
  (body))
(lemma in_upto_nil (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (ensures (in_upto m lb u 0))
  (body))
(lemma out_upto_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (out_upto g m lb u i))
  (ensures (out_upto g m lb2 u i))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call out_at_mono g m lb lb2 u k))))
(lemma in_upto_mono (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (in_upto m lb u i))
  (ensures (in_upto m lb2 u i))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call in_at_mono m lb lb2 u k))))
(lemma out_upto_ext (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (out_upto g m lb u i) (out_at g m lb u i))
  (ensures (out_upto g m lb u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma in_upto_ext (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (in_upto m lb u i) (in_at m lb u i))
  (ensures (in_upto m lb u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma out_close_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (out_upto g m lb u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (out_at g m lb u k))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u))))
      (assert (out_at g m lb u k))
      (assert (not (in_edge g u k))))))
(lemma out_close (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (out_upto g m lb u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (closed_out g m lb u))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call out_close_at g m lb u k))))
(lemma in_close_at (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (in_upto m lb u (len lb)))
  (ensures (in_at m lb u k))
  (body (if (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len lb))) (assert (in_at m lb u k)) (block))))
(lemma in_close (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (requires (in_upto m lb u (len lb)))
  (ensures (closed_in m lb u))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call in_close_at m lb u k))))
(lemma closed_out_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (closed_out g m lb u))
  (ensures (closed_out g m lb2 u))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call out_at_mono g m lb lb2 u k))))
(lemma closed_in_mono (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (requires (grown lb lb2) (closed_in m lb u))
  (ensures (closed_in m lb2 u))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call in_at_mono m lb lb2 u k))))

(ghost-fn bget ((b (seq bool)) (i int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len b))) (idx b i))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((b (seq bool)) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (cnt b (- k 1)) (if (bget b (- k 1)) 0 1)))))
(ghost-fn flipped ((b (seq bool)) (b2 (seq bool)) (u int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len b2) (len b)) (and (bget b2 u) (not (bget b u))))
             (forall ((i int)) (=> (!= i u) (== (bget b2 i) (bget b i)))))))
(ghost-fn all_closed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq bool))) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (bget b y) (and (closed_out g m lb y) (closed_in m lb y))))))
(lemma cnt_nn (params (b (seq bool)) (k int))
  (ensures (>= (cnt b k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (cnt b k) 0))
      (block
        (call cnt_nn b (- k 1))
        (assert (== (cnt b k) (+ (cnt b (- k 1)) (if (bget b (- k 1)) 0 1))))))))
(lemma cnt_full (params (b (seq bool)) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((i int)) (not (bget b i))) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (cnt b k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (cnt b k) 0))
      (block
        (call cnt_full b (- k 1))
        (assert (not (bget b (- k 1))))
        (assert (== (cnt b k) (+ (cnt b (- k 1)) (if (bget b (- k 1)) 0 1))))))))
(lemma cnt_flip (params (b (seq bool)) (b2 (seq bool)) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flipped b b2 u))
  (ensures (== (cnt b2 k) (- (cnt b k) (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u k)) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block (assert (== (cnt b2 k) 0)) (assert (== (cnt b k) 0)))
      (block
        (call cnt_flip b b2 u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (cnt b2 k) (+ (cnt b2 (- k 1)) (if (bget b2 (- k 1)) 0 1))))
        (assert (== (cnt b k) (+ (cnt b (- k 1)) (if (bget b (- k 1)) 0 1))))
        (if (== (- k 1) u)
          (block (assert (bget b2 (- k 1))) (assert (not (bget b (- k 1)))))
          (assert (== (bget b2 (- k 1)) (bget b (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma closed_step_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq bool)) (b2 (seq bool)) (u int) (y int))
  (requires (all_closed g m lb b) (grown lb lb2) (closed_out g m lb2 u) (closed_in m lb2 u) (flipped b b2 u))
  (ensures (=> (bget b2 y) (and (closed_out g m lb2 y) (closed_in m lb2 y))))
  (body
    (if (and (bget b2 y) (!= y u))
      (block
        (assert (== (bget b2 y) (bget b y)))
        (assert (and (closed_out g m lb y) (closed_in m lb y)))
        (call closed_out_mono g m lb lb2 y)
        (call closed_in_mono m lb lb2 y))
      (block))))
(lemma all_closed_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (lb2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq bool)) (b2 (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires (all_closed g m lb b) (grown lb lb2) (closed_out g m lb2 u) (closed_in m lb2 u) (flipped b b2 u))
  (ensures (all_closed g m lb2 b2))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call closed_step_at g m lb lb2 b b2 u y))))
(lemma finish_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq bool)) (y int))
  (requires (all_closed g m lb b) (forall ((z int)) (=> (vis lb z) (bget b z))))
  (ensures (=> (vis lb y) (and (closed_out g m lb y) (closed_in m lb y))))
  (body (if (vis lb y) (assert (bget b y)) (block))))
(lemma finish_closed (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq bool)))
  (requires (all_closed g m lb b) (forall ((z int)) (=> (vis lb z) (bget b z))))
  (ensures (cut_closed g m lb))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call finish_at g m lb b y))))

(lemma links_step_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (x int) (p int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (y int))
  (requires (forest lb s) (links_lim g m lb s (lv lb x)) (diff_at m m2 a b d)
            (or (and (== a p) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b p)))
            (< (lv lb p) (lv lb x)))
  (ensures (link_at g m2 lb s (lv lb p) y))
  (body
    (if (and (vis lb y) (and (!= y s) (<= (lv lb y) (lv lb p))))
      (block
        (assert (forest_at lb s y))
        (assert (link_at g m lb s (lv lb x) y))
        (assert (!= y x))
        (assert (!= (lpar lb y) x))
        (assert (same_at m m2 (lpar lb y) y))
        (assert (same_at m m2 y (lpar lb y))))
      (block))))
(lemma step_common (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int) (val int) (a int) (b int) (e int) (d int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (diff_at m m2 a b d) (in_edge g a e) (== (tgt g a e) b)
            (or (and (== a p) (and (== b x) (== d 1))) (and (== a x) (and (== b p) (== d -1))))
            (!= x p) (!= x s) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (walk_bal g m s t x val) (forest lb s) (links_lim g m lb s (lv lb x)) (< (lv lb p) (lv lb x)))
  (ensures (walk_bal g m2 s t p val) (links_lim g m2 lb s (lv lb p)))
  (body
    (call bal_step g m m2 s t x p val a b e d)
    (forall ((y int)) (call links_step_at g m m2 lb s x p a b d y))))
(lemma step_fwd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int) (val int) (e int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (diff_at m m2 p x 1) (link g m p x e) (>= e 0)
            (!= x p) (!= x s) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (walk_bal g m s t x val) (forest lb s) (links_lim g m lb s (lv lb x)) (< (lv lb p) (lv lb x)))
  (ensures (flow_core g m2) (walk_bal g m2 s t p val) (links_lim g m2 lb s (lv lb p)))
  (body
    (call core_step_fwd g m m2 p x e)
    (call step_common g m m2 lb s t x p val p x e 1)))
(lemma step_bwd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int) (val int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (diff_at m m2 x p -1) (> (get_flow m x p) 0)
            (!= x p) (!= x s) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (walk_bal g m s t x val) (forest lb s) (links_lim g m lb s (lv lb x)) (< (lv lb p) (lv lb x)))
  (ensures (flow_core g m2) (walk_bal g m2 s t p val) (links_lim g m2 lb s (lv lb p)))
  (body
    (call core_step_bwd g m m2 x p)
    (call rc_edge g m x p)
    (obtain ((e1 int)) (and (in_edge g x e1) (== (tgt g x e1) p)))
    (call step_common g m m2 lb s t x p val x p e1 -1)))

(ghost-fn is_zero ((m (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (== (get_flow m u v) 0))))
(lemma zero_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (is_zero m))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) 0))
      (block
        (call zero_in g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow m (- k 1) u) 0))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m (- k 1) u))))))))
(lemma zero_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (is_zero m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u k) 0))
      (block
        (call zero_out g m u (- k 1))
        (call out_unfold g m u k)
        (assert (== (get_flow m u (tgt g u (- k 1))) 0))))))
(lemma zero_total (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (is_zero m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g m u) 0) (== (total_flow_in g m u) 0))
  (body
    (call zero_out g m u (len (idx g u)))
    (call zero_in g m u (len g))))
(lemma zero_core_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_zero m))
  (ensures (and (rc_at g m u v) (nn_at m u v)))
  (body (assert (== (get_flow m u v) 0))))
(lemma zero_bal_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (is_zero m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (bal_at g m t t u))
  (body (call zero_total g m u)))
(lemma zero_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_zero m) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (!= s t))
  (ensures (flow_core g m) (walk_bal g m s t t 0))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call zero_core_at g m u v))
    (forall ((u int)) (call zero_bal_at g m t u))
    (call zero_total g m s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g m s) (- (total_flow_out g m s) (total_flow_in g m s))))))

(ghost-fn row_sum ((m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (row_sum m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1))))))
(ghost-fn prefix_has ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (j int) (v int)) bool (decreases j)
  (body (if (<= j 0) false (or (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) v) (prefix_has g u (- j 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn filt ((m (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (j int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0
    (+ (filt m g u j (- k 1)) (if (prefix_has g u j (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0)))))
(lemma filt_nil (params (m (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (filt m g u 0 k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (filt m g u 0 k) 0))
      (block
        (call filt_nil m g u (- k 1))
        (assert (not (prefix_has g u 0 (- k 1))))
        (assert (== (filt m g u 0 k) (+ (filt m g u 0 (- k 1)) (if (prefix_has g u 0 (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma not_has (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (jj int) (j int) (x int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (in_edge g u jj) (== (tgt g u jj) x) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j jj)))
  (ensures (not (prefix_has g u j x)))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (== j 0)
      (assert (not (prefix_has g u j x)))
      (block
        (call not_has g u jj (- j 1) x)
        (assert (in_edge g u (- j 1)))
        (assert (!= (tgt g u (- j 1)) (tgt g u jj)))
        (assert (== (prefix_has g u j x) (or (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) x) (prefix_has g u (- j 1) x))))))))
(lemma has_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)))
  (ensures (prefix_has g u j (tgt g u i)))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (assert (== (prefix_has g u j (tgt g u i)) (or (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) (tgt g u i)) (prefix_has g u (- j 1) (tgt g u i)))))
    (if (== i (- j 1))
      (assert (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) (tgt g u i)))
      (call has_intro g u i (- j 1)))))
(lemma filt_step (params (m (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (in_edge g u (- j 1)))
  (ensures (== (filt m g u j k)
               (+ (filt m g u (- j 1) k)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (tgt g u (- j 1))) (< (tgt g u (- j 1)) k)) (get_flow m u (tgt g u (- j 1))) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block (assert (== (filt m g u j k) 0)) (assert (== (filt m g u (- j 1) k) 0)))
      (block
        (call filt_step m g u j (- k 1))
        (assert (== (filt m g u j k) (+ (filt m g u j (- k 1)) (if (prefix_has g u j (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (filt m g u (- j 1) k) (+ (filt m g u (- j 1) (- k 1)) (if (prefix_has g u (- j 1) (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (prefix_has g u j (- k 1)) (or (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) (- k 1)) (prefix_has g u (- j 1) (- k 1)))))
        (if (== (tgt g u (- j 1)) (- k 1))
          (call not_has g u (- j 1) (- j 1) (- k 1))
          (block))))))
(lemma out_eq_filt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u j) (filt m g u j (len g))))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (== j 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u j) 0))
        (call filt_nil m g u (len g)))
      (block
        (call out_eq_filt g m u (- j 1))
        (call out_unfold g m u j)
        (assert (in_edge g u (- j 1)))
        (call tgt_range g u (- j 1))
        (call filt_step m g u j (len g))))))
(lemma entry_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_core g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (or (prefix_has g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow m u v) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (nn_at m u v))
    (if (> (get_flow m u v) 0)
      (block
        (call rc_edge g m u v)
        (obtain ((e2 int)) (and (in_edge g u e2) (== (tgt g u e2) v)))
        (call has_intro g u e2 (len (idx g u))))
      (block))))
(lemma filt_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_core g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (filt m g u (len (idx g u)) k) (row_sum m u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block (assert (== (filt m g u (len (idx g u)) k) 0)) (assert (== (row_sum m u k) 0)))
      (block
        (call filt_full g m u (- k 1))
        (call entry_zero g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (filt m g u (len (idx g u)) k)
                    (+ (filt m g u (len (idx g u)) (- k 1))
                       (if (prefix_has g u (len (idx g u)) (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (row_sum m u k) (+ (row_sum m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma row_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g m u) (row_sum m u (len g))))
  (body
    (call out_eq_filt g m u (len (idx g u)))
    (call filt_full g m u (len g))))

(lemma cap_entry (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_core g m) (capacities_bounded g))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow m u v) 100000))
  (body
    (assert (rc_at g m u v))
    (if (> (get_flow m u v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c0 int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c0) (<= (get_flow m u v) c0)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v c0))
        (assert (<= c0 100000)))
      (block))))
(lemma row_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_core g m) (capacities_bounded g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (<= (row_sum m u k) (* k 100000)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (row_sum m u k) 0))
      (block
        (call row_bound g m u (- k 1))
        (call cap_entry g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (row_sum m u k) (+ (row_sum m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma in_nn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_core g m))
  (ensures (>= (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) 0))
      (block
        (call in_nn g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (nn_at m (- k 1) u))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m (- k 1) u))))))))
(lemma flow_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (flow_core g m) (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (!= s t) (walk_bal g m s t t val))
  (ensures (<= val 100000000))
  (body
    (call row_out g m s)
    (call row_bound g m s (len g))
    (call in_nn g m s (len g))
    (assert (== (flow_val g m s) val))
    (assert (== (flow_val g m s) (- (total_flow_out g m s) (total_flow_in g m s))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g m s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g m s (len g))))
    (assert (<= (len g) 1000))))

(ghost-fn cross ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (- (if (vis lb u) (get_flow m u v) 0) (if (vis lb v) (get_flow m u v) 0))))
(ghost-fn cross_row ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (cross_row m lb u (- k 1)) (cross m lb u (- k 1))))))
(ghost-fn net ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (q int)) int (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) 0 (+ (net m lb (- p 1) q) (cross_row m lb (- p 1) q)))))
(ghost-fn mask_row ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (mask_row m lb u (- k 1)) (if (vis lb (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn r_total ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (q int)) int (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) 0 (+ (r_total m lb (- p 1) q) (if (vis lb (- p 1)) (row_sum m (- p 1) q) 0)))))
(ghost-fn a_total ((m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (q int)) int (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) 0 (+ (a_total m lb (- p 1) q) (mask_row m lb (- p 1) q)))))
(ghost-fn b_total ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int) (q int)) int (decreases q)
  (body (if (<= q 0) 0
    (+ (b_total g m lb p (- q 1)) (if (vis lb (- q 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g m (- q 1) p) 0)))))
(ghost-fn v_total ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (p int)) int (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) 0
    (+ (v_total g m lb (- p 1))
       (if (vis lb (- p 1)) (- (total_flow_out g m (- p 1)) (total_flow_in g m (- p 1))) 0)))))
(lemma cross_row_eq (params (m (seq (seq int))) (lb (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (q int))
  (ensures (== (cross_row m lb u q) (- (if (vis lb u) (row_sum m u q) 0) (mask_row m lb u q))))
  (decreases q)
  (body
    (if (<= q 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (cross_row m lb u q) 0))
        (assert (== (row_sum m u q) 0))
        (assert (== (mask_row m lb u q) 0)))
      (block
        (call cross_row_eq m lb u (- q 1))
        (assert (== (cross_row m lb u q) (+ (cross_row m lb u (- q 1)) (cross m lb u (- q 1)))))
        (assert (== (row_sum m u q) (+ (row_sum m u (- q 1)) (get_flow m u (- q 1)))))
        (assert (== (mask_row m lb u q) (+ (mask_row m lb u (- q 1)) (if (vis lb (- q 1)) (get_flow m u (- q 1)) 0))))

    (< (at_int ord p) (at_int ord cur)))
  (ensures (flow_caps c fm n) (walk_net fm f0 s t p n) (frozen fm f0 ord p n))
  (body
    (forall ((a int)) (call net_upd fb fm x y d a n))))

(lemma rsum_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (zero_all f))
  (ensures (== (rsum f u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block (call rsum_zero f u (- k 1)) (assert (== (get_flow f u (- k 1)) 0))))))
(lemma csum_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (zero_all f))
  (ensures (== (csum f v k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block (call csum_zero f v (- k 1)) (assert (== (get_flow f (- k 1) v) 0))))))
(lemma net_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (zero_all f))
  (ensures (== (net f a n) 0))
  (body (call rsum_zero f a n) (call csum_zero f a n)))
(lemma zero_flow
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_matrix g c n) (square f n) (zero_all f))
  (ensures (mflow c f s t n 0))
  (body
    (forall ((a int)) (call net_zero f a n))
    (assert (balanced f s t n))
    (assert (flow_caps c f n))
    (assert (== (net f s n) 0))))
(lemma mflow_step
  (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (val int))
  (requires (mflow c f s t n val) (square h n) (flow_caps c h n)
    (== (net h s n) (+ (net f s n) 1))
    (forall ((a int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (!= a s) (!= a t))) (== (net h a n) (net f a n)))))
  (ensures (mflow c h s t n (+ val 1)))
  (body (assert (balanced h s t n))))
(lemma rsum_le
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_matrix g c n) (flow_caps c f n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (>= k 0) (<= k n))
  (ensures (<= (rsum f a k) (* 100000 k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call rsum_le g c f a (- k 1) n)
        (assert (<= (get_flow f a (- k 1)) (get_flow c a (- k 1))))
        (assert (<= (get_flow c a (- k 1)) 100000))))))
(lemma csum_nonneg (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (flow_caps c f n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (<= k n))
  (ensures (>= (csum f a k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call csum_nonneg c f a (- k 1) n)
        (assert (>= (get_flow f (- k 1) a) 0))))))
(lemma val_bound
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_matrix g c n) (flow_caps c f n) (<= n 1000) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)))
  (ensures (<= (net f a n) 100000000))
  (body
    (call rsum_le g c f a n n)
    (call csum_nonneg c f a n n)))

(lemma pref_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (<= k (deg g u)))
  (ensures (== (pref g h u (len g) k) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call pref_out g h u (- k 1))
        (assert (eix g u (- k 1)))
        (assert (< (tgt g u (- k 1)) (len g)))
        (assert (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))))
        (assert (== (tgt g u (- k 1)) (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)))))))
(lemma pref_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (<= k (deg g u)))
  (ensures (== (pref g h u 0 k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call pref_zero g h u (- k 1))
        (assert (eix g u (- k 1)))
        (assert (<= 0 (tgt g u (- k 1))))))))
(lemma pref_hit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (k int) (i0 int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (eix g u i0) (== (tgt g u i0) m) (<= k (deg g u)))
  (ensures (== (pref g h u (+ m 1) k) (+ (pref g h u m k) (if (< i0 k) (get_flow h u m) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (<= 0 i0))
      (block
        (call pref_hit g h u m (- k 1) i0)
        (assert (eix g u (- k 1)))
        (assert (=> (!= (- k 1) i0) (!= (tgt g u (- k 1)) (tgt g u i0))))))))
(lemma pref_miss (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (not (has_target g u m)) (<= k (deg g u)))
  (ensures (== (pref g h u (+ m 1) k) (pref g h u m k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call pref_miss g h u m (- k 1))
        (assert (eix g u (- k 1)))
        (assert (!= (tgt g u (- k 1)) m))))))
(lemma pref_rsum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (off_zero g h u (len g)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))
  (ensures (== (pref g h u m (deg g u)) (rsum h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (call pref_zero g h u (deg g u))
      (block
        (call pref_rsum g h u (- m 1))
        (if (has_target g u (- m 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (eix g u i0) (== (tgt g u i0) (- m 1))))
            (call pref_hit g h u (- m 1) (deg g u) i0)
            (assert (< i0 (deg g u))))
          (block
            (call pref_miss g h u (- m 1) (deg g u))
            (assert (== (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma out_eq_rsum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (off_zero g h u (len g)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (rsum h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call pref_out g h u (deg g u))
    (call pref_rsum g h u (len g))
    (assert (== (deg g u) (len (idx g u))))))
(lemma in_eq_csum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (csum h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call in_eq_csum g h u (- k 1)))))
(lemma flow_out_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (off_zero g h u (len g)))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_out g h u) (total_flow_in g h u)) (net h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call out_eq_rsum g h u)
    (call in_eq_csum g h u (len g))))

(lemma row_id (params (h (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (a int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (- (if (mem_vis vis a) (rsum h a k) 0) (bsum h vis a k)) (wrow h vis a k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call row_id h vis a (- k 1))
        (assert (== (term_at h vis a (- k 1)) (term_at h vis a (- k 1))))))))
(lemma all_id (params (h (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (m int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (- (sout h vis m k) (sin_all h vis m k)) (wall h vis m k)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (<= m 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call all_id h vis (- m 1) k)
        (call row_id h vis (- m 1) k)))))
(lemma swap_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sin_all h vis m (+ k 1))
               (+ (sin_all h vis m k) (if (mem_vis vis k) (csum h k m) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (<= m 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call swap_step h vis (- m 1) k)
        (assert (== (bsum h vis (- m 1) (+ k 1))
                    (+ (bsum h vis (- m 1) k) (if (mem_vis vis k) (get_flow h (- m 1) k) 0))))
        (assert (== (csum h k m) (+ (csum h k (- m 1)) (get_flow h (- m 1) k))))))))
(lemma sin_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (<= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sin_all h vis m k) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (<= m 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call sin_zero h vis (- m 1) k)
        (assert (== (bsum h vis (- m 1) k) 0))))))
(lemma swap_all (params (h (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (m int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sin_all h vis m k) (cins h vis m k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (call sin_zero h vis m k)
      (block
        (call swap_all h vis m (- k 1))
        (call swap_step h vis m (- k 1))))))
(lemma nets_id (params (h (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (m int) (n int))
  (ensures (== (nets h vis m n) (- (sout h vis m n) (cins h vis n m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (<= m 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call nets_id h vis (- m 1) n)
        (assert (== (net h (- m 1) n) (- (rsum h (- m 1) n) (csum h (- m 1) n))))))))
(lemma nets_val (params (h (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (m int) (n int))
  (requires (mem_vis vis s) (not (mem_vis vis t)) (!= s t) (<= 0 s) (<= 0 t) (balanced h s t n) (<= m n))
  (ensures (== (nets h vis m n) (if (< s m) (net h s n) 0)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (<= m 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call nets_val h vis s t (- m 1) n)
        (assert (=> (and (!= (- m 1) s) (!= (- m 1) t)) (== (net h (- m 1) n) 0)))))))
(lemma cut_val (params (h (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (mem_vis vis s) (not (mem_vis vis t)) (!= s t)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (balanced h s t n))
  (ensures (== (net h s n) (wall h vis n n)))
  (body
    (call nets_val h vis s t n n)
    (call nets_id h vis n n)
    (call all_id h vis n n)
    (call swap_all h vis n n)))
(lemma wrow_mono (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (a int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (cross_le h1 h2 vis n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (<= k n))
  (ensures (<= (wrow h1 vis a k) (wrow h2 vis a k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call wrow_mono h1 h2 vis a (- k 1) n)
        (assert (<= (term_at h1 vis a (- k 1)) (term_at h2 vis a (- k 1))))))))
(lemma wall_mono (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (m int) (n int))
  (requires (cross_le h1 h2 vis n) (<= m n))
  (ensures (<= (wall h1 vis m n) (wall h2 vis m n)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (<= m 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call wall_mono h1 h2 vis (- m 1) n)
        (call wrow_mono h1 h2 vis (- m 1) n n)))))

(lemma other_cap
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (other (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures (and (>= (get_flow other a b) 0)
    (=> (> (get_flow other a b) 0)
        (exists ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g a b cc) (<= (get_flow other a b) cc))))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len other))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx other a)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow other a b) (idx (idx other a) b)))
        (assert (respects_capacity g other))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx other a) b) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma other_off_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (other (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures (=> (not (has_target g a b)) (== (get_flow other a b) 0)))
  (body
    (call other_cap g other s t a b)
    (if (> (get_flow other a b) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g a b cc) (<= (get_flow other a b) cc)))
        (call cap_target g a b cc))
      (block))))
(lemma other_net_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (other (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (== (len g) n) (is_valid_flow g other s t) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_out g other a) (total_flow_in g other a)) (net other a n)))
  (body
    (forall ((b int)) (call other_off_at g other s t a b))
    (assert (off_zero g other a n))
    (call flow_out_in g other a)))
(lemma f_off_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_matrix g c n) (flow_caps c f n) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))))
  (ensures (=> (not (has_target g a b)) (== (get_flow f a b) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (>= (get_flow f a b) 0))
    (if (> (get_flow f a b) 0)
      (block
        (assert (> (get_flow c a b) 0))
        (assert (has_capacity g a b (get_flow c a b)))
        (call cap_target g a b (get_flow c a b)))
      (block))))
(lemma f_net_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (== (len g) n) (cap_matrix g c n) (flow_caps c f n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_out g f a) (total_flow_in g f a)) (net f a n)))
  (body
    (forall ((b int)) (call f_off_at g c f a b n))
    (assert (off_zero g f a n))
    (call flow_out_in g f a)))
(lemma respect_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_matrix g c n) (flow_caps c f n) (square f n)
    (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f a))))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f a) b) 0)
    (exists ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g a b cc) (<= (idx (idx f a) b) cc)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (idx f a)) n))
    (assert (== (get_flow f a b) (idx (idx f a) b)))
    (if (> (idx (idx f a) b) 0)
      (block
        (assert (<= (get_flow f a b) (get_flow c a b)))
        (assert (> (get_flow c a b) 0))
        (assert (has_capacity g a b (get_flow c a b)))
        (assert (<= (idx (idx f a) b) (get_flow c a b))))
      (block))))
(lemma nonneg_at (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires (flow_caps c f n) (square f n)
    (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f a))))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f a) b) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (idx f a)) n))
    (assert (== (get_flow f a b) (idx (idx f a) b)))
    (assert (>= (get_flow f a b) 0))))
(lemma f_resp
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (cap_matrix g c n) (flow_caps c f n) (square f n))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call respect_at g c f a b n))))
(lemma f_nonneg
  (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (flow_caps c f n) (square f n))
  (ensures (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f a))))) (>= (idx (idx f a) b) 0))))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call nonneg_at c f a b n))))
(lemma f_cons
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (val int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (== (len g) n) (cap_matrix g c n) (mflow c f s t n val))
  (ensures (is_conserved g f s t))
  (body
    (forall ((a int)) (call f_net_at g c f a n))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))))
(lemma f_valid
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (val int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (== (len g) n) (cap_matrix g c n) (mflow c f s t n val))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (assert (square f n))
    (assert (flow_caps c f n))
    (call f_resp g c f n)
    (call f_nonneg c f n)
    (call f_cons g c f s t n val)))
(lemma cross_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (other (seq (seq int)))
          (s int) (t int) (vis (seq bool)) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (cap_matrix g c n) (flow_caps c f n) (scanned c f vis n n) (is_valid_flow g other s t)
    (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))))
  (ensures (<= (term_at other vis a b) (term_at f vis a b)))
  (body
    (call other_cap g other s t a b)
    (assert (>= (get_flow f a b) 0))
    (if (and (mem_vis vis a) (not (mem_vis vis b)))
      (block
        (assert (not (can_push c f a b)))
        (assert (>= (get_flow f a b) (get_flow c a b)))
        (assert (>= (get_flow c a b) 0))
        (if (> (get_flow other a b) 0)
          (block
            (obtain ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g a b cc) (<= (get_flow other a b) cc)))
            (assert (== cc (get_flow c a b))))
          (block)))
      (if (and (not (mem_vis vis a)) (mem_vis vis b))
        (block
          (assert (not (can_push c f b a)))
          (assert (<= (get_flow f a b) 0)))
        (block)))))
(lemma beats
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (val int)
          (vis (seq bool)) (other (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (g_wf g) (== (len g) n) (cap_matrix g c n) (mflow c f s t n val)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
    (mem_vis vis s) (not (mem_vis vis t)) (scanned c f vis n n)
    (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g other s)))
  (body
    (forall ((a int)) (call other_net_at g other s t a n))
    (assert (balanced other s t n))
    (assert (== (flow_val g other s) (net other s n)))
    (call f_net_at g c f s n)
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) (net f s n)))
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call cross_at g c f other s t vis n a b))
    (assert (cross_le other f vis n))
    (call cut_val other vis s t n)
    (call cut_val f vis s t n)
    (call wall_mono other f vis n n)))
(lemma conclude
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (val int)
          (vis (seq bool)) (n int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (== (len g) n) (cap_matrix g c n) (mflow c f s t n val)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
    (mem_vis vis s) (not (mem_vis vis t)) (scanned c f vis n n))
  (ensures (exists ((w (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g w s t) (== (flow_val g w s) val))))
  (body
    (call f_valid g c f s t n val)
    (call f_net_at g c f s n)
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int)))) (call beats g c f s t n val vis other))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) val))))

(spec find_edge
  (params (c (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (f (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (vis (ref (slice bool))))
  (returns (x i64) (y i64))
  (requires (square c (len c)) (square f (len c)) (== (len vis) (len c)))
  (ensures
    (=> (>= x 0)
        (and (and (< x (len c)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len c))))
             (and (mem_vis vis x) (and (not (mem_vis vis y)) (can_push c f x y)))))
    (=> (< x 0) (scanned c f vis (len c) (len c))))
  (effects))
(def find_edge
  (body
    (let n i64 (len c))
    (let-mut i i64 0)
    (while (< i n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i n)))
      (invariant (scanned c f vis i n))
      (decreases (- n i))
      (if (idx vis i)
        (block
          (let-mut j i64 0)
          (while (< j n)
            (invariant (and (<= 0 j) (<= j n)))
            (invariant (forall ((b int))
              (=> (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b j)) (not (mem_vis vis b))) (not (can_push c f i b)))))
            (decreases (- n j))
            (if (and (not (idx vis j))
                     (or (< (idx (idx f i) j) (idx (idx c i) j)) (> (idx (idx f j) i) 0)))

  (decreases k)

(lemma tree_step_at
  (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (vis0 (seq bool)) (par0 (seq int)) (ord0 (seq int))
          (vis (seq bool)) (par (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (n int) (x int) (y int) (cnt int) (a int))

(lemma tree_step
  (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (vis0 (seq bool)) (par0 (seq int)) (ord0 (seq int))
          (vis (seq bool)) (par (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (n int) (x int) (y int) (cnt int))

(lemma walk_keep
  (params (c (seq (seq int))) (fb (seq (seq int))) (fm (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int))

  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (k int) (n int))

(lemma pref_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (<= k (deg g u)))
  (ensures (== (pref g h u (len g) k) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body

      (block)

        (assert (eix g u (- k 1)))
        (assert (< (tgt g u (- k 1)) (len g)))
        (assert (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))))
        (assert (== (tgt g u (- k 1)) (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)))))))
(lemma pref_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))

(lemma pref_hit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (k int) (i0 int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (eix g u i0) (== (tgt g u i0) m) (<= k (deg g u)))
  (ensures (== (pref g h u (+ m 1) k) (+ (pref g h u m k) (if (< i0 k) (get_flow h u m) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (<= 0 i0))
      (block
        (call pref_hit g h u m (- k 1) i0)
        (assert (eix g u (- k 1)))
        (assert (=> (!= (- k 1) i0) (!= (tgt g u (- k 1)) (tgt g u i0))))))))
(lemma pref_miss (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (not (has_target g u m)) (<= k (deg g u)))
  (ensures (== (pref g h u (+ m 1) k) (pref g h u m k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body

(lemma pref_rsum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (off_zero g h u (len g)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))
  (ensures (== (pref g h u m (deg g u)) (rsum h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (call pref_zero g h u (deg g u))
      (block
        (call pref_rsum g h u (- m 1))
        (if (has_target g u (- m 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (eix g u i0) (== (tgt g u i0) (- m 1))))
            (call pref_hit g h u (- m 1) (deg g u) i0)
            (assert (< i0 (deg g u))))
          (block
            (call pref_miss g h u (- m 1) (deg g u))
            (assert (== (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma out_eq_rsum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (off_zero g h u (len g)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (rsum h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call pref_out g h u (deg g u))
    (call pref_rsum g h u (len g))
    (assert (== (deg g u) (len (idx g u))))))
(lemma in_eq_csum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (csum h u k)))

(lemma flow_out_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (off_zero g h u (len g)))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_out g h u) (total_flow_in g h u)) (net h u (len g))))
  (body

    (call in_eq_csum g h u (len g))))

(lemma row_id (params (h (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (a int) (k int))

(lemma sin_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (m int) (k int))

(lemma nets_id (params (h (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (m int) (n int))
  (ensures (== (nets h vis m n) (- (sout h vis m n) (cins h vis n m))))

(lemma nets_val (params (h (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (m int) (n int))
  (requires (mem_vis vis s) (not (mem_vis vis t)) (!= s t) (<= 0 s) (<= 0 t) (balanced h s t n) (<= m n))

(lemma cut_val (params (h (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (mem_vis vis s) (not (mem_vis vis t)) (!= s t)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (balanced h s t n))

  (body

(lemma wrow_mono (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (vis (seq bool)) (a int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (cross_le h1 h2 vis n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (<= k n))

  (decreases k)

(lemma other_cap

    (=> (> (get_flow other a b) 0)

  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len other))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx other a)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow other a b) (idx (idx other a) b)))
        (assert (respects_capacity g other))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx other a) b) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma other_off_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (other (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (a int) (b int))

  (body
    (call other_cap g other s t a b)

      (block
        (obtain ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g a b cc) (<= (get_flow other a b) cc)))
        (call cap_target g a b cc))

(lemma other_net_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (other (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (g_wf g) (== (len g) n) (is_valid_flow g other s t) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)))

  (body

(lemma f_off_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (n int))

  (ensures (=> (not (has_target g a b)) (== (get_flow f a b) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (>= (get_flow f a b) 0))
    (if (> (get_flow f a b) 0)
      (block
        (assert (> (get_flow c a b) 0))

  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (n int))

    (call flow_out_in g f a)))
(lemma respect_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires (cap_matrix g c n) (flow_caps c f n) (square f n)
    (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f a))))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f a) b) 0)
    (exists ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g a b cc) (<= (idx (idx f a) b) cc)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (idx f a)) n))
    (assert (== (get_flow f a b) (idx (idx f a) b)))
    (if (> (idx (idx f a) b) 0)
      (block
        (assert (<= (get_flow f a b) (get_flow c a b)))
        (assert (> (get_flow c a b) 0))
        (assert (has_capacity g a b (get_flow c a b)))
        (assert (<= (idx (idx f a) b) (get_flow c a b))))
      (block))))
(lemma nonneg_at (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires (flow_caps c f n) (square f n)
