            (fwd_upto g f o u i)
            (or (vis o (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                (>= (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (fwd_upto g f o u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma bwd_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int) (w int))
  (requires (bwd_upto g f o u w)
            (or (vis o w) (<= (get_flow f w u) 0)))
  (ensures (bwd_upto g f o u (+ w 1)))
  (body))
(lemma closed_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int))
  (requires (closed_upto g f o u) (=> (vis o u) (closed_at g f o u)))
  (ensures (closed_upto g f o (+ u 1)))
  (body))

(spec visit
  (params (a (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (f (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (s i64) (u i64)
          (ord (vec i64)) (par (vec i64)) (kind (vec i64)) (cnt i64))
  (returns (o2 (vec i64)) (p2 (vec i64)) (k2 (vec i64)) (c2 i64))
  (requires (st_ok a f s ord par kind cnt)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len a)))
            (>= (idx ord u) 0)
            (square f (len a))
            (targets_ok a)
            (<= (len a) 1000))
  (ensures (st_ok a f s o2 p2 k2 c2)
           (>= c2 cnt)
           (=> (== c2 cnt) (and (== o2 ord) (closed_at a f o2 u))))
  (effects))
(def visit
  (body
    (let n i64 (len a))
    (let d i64 (len (idx a u)))
    (let-mut ob (vec i64) ord)
    (let-mut pb (vec i64) par)
    (let-mut kb (vec i64) kind)
    (let-mut cb i64 cnt)
    (let-mut i i64 0)
    (while (< i d)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i d)))
      (invariant (st_ok a f s ob pb kb cb))
      (invariant (>= cb cnt))
      (invariant (>= (idx ob u) 0))
      (invariant (=> (== cb cnt) (and (== ob ord) (fwd_upto a f ob u i))))
      (decreases (- d i))
      (let v i64 (get (idx (idx a u) i) 0))
      (let c i64 (get (idx (idx a u) i) 1))
      (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
      (if (and (< (idx ob v) 0) (< (idx (idx f u) v) c))
        (block
          (assert (arc_ok a f u i v))
          (ghost-let o1 (seq int) ob)
          (ghost-let p1 (seq int) pb)
          (ghost-let k1 (seq int) kb)
          (set-idx ob v cb)
          (set-idx pb v u)
          (set-idx kb v i)
          (call st_mark a f s o1 p1 k1 cb ob pb kb u v i)
          (set cb (+ cb 1)))
        (if (== cb cnt) (call fwd_step a f ob u i) (block)))
      (set i (+ i 1)))
    (let-mut w i64 0)
    (while (< w n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 w) (<= w n)))
      (invariant (st_ok a f s ob pb kb cb))
      (invariant (>= cb cnt))
      (invariant (>= (idx ob u) 0))
      (invariant (=> (== cb cnt) (and (== ob ord) (and (fwd_upto a f ob u d) (bwd_upto a f ob u w)))))
      (decreases (- n w))
      (assert (== (get_flow f w u) (idx (idx f w) u)))
      (if (and (< (idx ob w) 0) (> (idx (idx f w) u) 0))
        (block
          (assert (arc_ok a f u -1 w))
          (ghost-let o4 (seq int) ob)
          (ghost-let p4 (seq int) pb)
          (ghost-let k4 (seq int) kb)
          (set-idx ob w cb)
          (set-idx pb w u)
          (set-idx kb w -1)
          (call st_mark a f s o4 p4 k4 cb ob pb kb u w -1)
          (set cb (+ cb 1)))
        (if (== cb cnt) (call bwd_step a f ob u w) (block)))
      (set w (+ w 1)))
    (return ob pb kb cb)))

(spec search
  (params (a (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (f (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (s i64))
  (returns (ord (vec i64)) (par (vec i64)) (kind (vec i64)) (cnt i64))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len a)))
            (square f (len a))
            (targets_ok a)
            (<= (len a) 1000))
  (ensures (st_ok a f s ord par kind cnt)
           (closed_upto a f ord (len a)))
  (effects alloc))
(def search
  (body
    (let n i64 (len a))
    (let-mut ob (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (i) -1)))
    (let-mut pb (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (i) 0)))
    (let-mut kb (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (i) 0)))
    (ghost-let o0 (seq int) ob)
    (set-idx ob s 0)
    (call st_init a f s o0 ob pb kb)
    (let-mut cb i64 1)
    (while true
      (invariant (st_ok a f s ob pb kb cb))
      (invariant (and (<= 1 cb) (<= cb n)))
      (decreases (- n cb))
      (ghost-let cstart int cb)
      (ghost-let ostart (seq int) ob)
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (let-mut changed bool false)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (st_ok a f s ob pb kb cb))
        (invariant (and (<= 1 cb) (<= cb n)))
        (invariant (>= cb cstart))
        (invariant (=> changed (> cb cstart)))
        (invariant (=> (not changed) (and (== ob ostart) (closed_upto a f ostart u))))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (if (>= (idx ob u) 0)
          (block
            (let ((o3 (vec i64)) (p3 (vec i64)) (k3 (vec i64)) (c3 i64)) (call visit a f s u ob pb kb cb))
            (if (or changed (!= c3 cb))
              (set changed true)
              (call closed_step a f ostart u))
            (set ob o3)
            (set pb p3)
            (set kb k3)
            (set cb c3))
          (if changed (block) (call closed_step a f ostart u)))
        (set u (+ u 1)))
      (if changed (block) (return ob pb kb cb)))
    (return ob pb kb cb)))

(ghost-fn flow_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (and (square f (len g)) (and (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg f)))))
(ghost-fn ex_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
        (== (+ (total_flow_in g f u) (if (== u x) 1 0)) (total_flow_out g f u))))))
(ghost-fn diff_at ((f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int)) bool
  (body (and (== (get_flow f2 a b) (+ (get_flow f a b) d))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (=> (or (!= u a) (!= v b)) (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v)))))))
(ghost-fn push_rel ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a))))
    (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b) (diff_at f f2 a b d))))))
(ghost-fn flow_new ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int)) bool
  (body (and (>= (get_flow f2 a b) 0)
    (=> (> (get_flow f2 a b) 0)
        (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (get_flow f2 a b) c)))))))
(lemma diff_intro (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int))
  (requires (square f n)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
            (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (== (len f2) n)
            (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (!= u a)) (== (idx f2 u) (idx f u))))
            (== (len (idx f2 a)) n)
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (!= v b)) (== (idx (idx f2 a) v) (idx (idx f a) v))))
            (== (idx (idx f2 a) b) (+ (idx (idx f a) b) d)))
  (ensures (diff_at f f2 a b d) (square f2 n))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f a b) (idx (idx f a) b)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 a b) (idx (idx f2 a) b)))))

(lemma out_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((v int)) (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f2 u k) (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call out_same g f f2 u (- k 1)))))
(lemma out_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (k int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b)
            (diff_at f f2 a b d)
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g a)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f2 a k) (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g f a k) (if (> k i0) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block)
    (block
      (call out_at g f f2 a b d i0 (- k 1))
      (if (== (- k 1) i0) (block)
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g a) (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0))))))))
(lemma in_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((j int)) (== (get_flow f2 j u) (get_flow f j u))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f2 u k) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call in_same g f f2 u (- k 1)))))
(lemma in_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (k int))
  (requires (<= 0 a) (diff_at f f2 a b d))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f2 b k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f b k) (if (> k a) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call in_at g f f2 a b d (- k 1)))))
(lemma diff_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (u int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f2 u) (+ (total_flow_out g f u) (if (== u a) d 0))))
  (body
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (if (== u a)
      (call out_at g f f2 a b d i0 (len (idx g a)))
      (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (call out_same g f f2 u (len (idx g u)))
        (block)))))
(lemma diff_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (u int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f2 u) (+ (total_flow_in g f u) (if (== u b) d 0))))
  (body
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (if (== u b)
      (call in_at g f f2 a b d (len g))
      (call in_same g f f2 u (len g)))))
(lemma ex_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int)
                       (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0)
            (or (and (== a p) (and (== b x) (== d 1))) (and (== a x) (and (== b p) (== d -1))))
            (!= x p)
            (!= x s)
            (ex_ok g f s t x))
  (ensures (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call diff_out g f f2 a b d i0 u))
    (forall ((u int)) (call diff_in g f f2 a b d i0 u))
    (assert (ex_ok g f s t x))))

(lemma has_cap_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g k (get (idx (idx g k) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g k) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma nn_push_at (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (nonneg f) (square f n) (square f2 n) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (>= (get_flow f2 a b) 0)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f2))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f2 u))))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (square f n))
    (assert (square f2 n))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (idx (idx f2 u) v)))
    (if (and (== u a) (== v b))
      (assert (>= (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (nonneg f))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0))))))
(lemma nn_push (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (nonneg f) (square f n) (square f2 n) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (>= (get_flow f2 a b) 0))
  (ensures (nonneg f2))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nn_push_at f f2 n a b d u v))))
(lemma rc_push_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (square f (len g)) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f2))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f2 u))))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f2 u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (square f2 (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (idx (idx f2 u) v)))
    (if (and (== u a) (== v b))
      (assert (flow_new g f2 a b))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (respects_capacity g f))))))
(ghost-fn rc_cell ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
            (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
                (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))))
(ghost-fn rc_cells ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (rc_cell g f x y))))
(lemma rc_open (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (rc_cells g f)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (rc_cells g f))
    (assert (rc_cell g f u v))))
(lemma rc_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (rc_cells g f))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call rc_open g f u v))))
(lemma rc_cell_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (square f (len g)) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b))
  (ensures (rc_cell g f2 u v))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f2))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f2 u)))))
      (call rc_push_at g f f2 a b d u v)
      (block))))
(lemma rc_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (square f (len g)) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f2))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call rc_cell_at g f f2 a b d u v))
    (assert (rc_cells g f2))
    (call rc_intro g f2)))
(lemma flow_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (flow_ok g f) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (flow_new g f2 a b))
    (call nn_push f f2 (len g) a b d)
    (call rc_push g f f2 a b d)))
(lemma push_forward (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int) (k int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (flow_ok g f) (ex_ok g f s t x) (!= x p) (!= x s)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g p))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g p) k) 0) x)
            (< (get_flow f p x) (get (idx (idx g p) k) 1))
            (square f2 (len g))
            (diff_at f f2 p x 1))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2) (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (nonneg f))
    (assert (== (get_flow f p x) (idx (idx f p) x)))
    (call has_cap_intro g p k)
    (assert (has_capacity g p x (get (idx (idx g p) k) 1)))
    (assert (flow_new g f2 p x))
    (call flow_push g f f2 p x 1)
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 p x 1 k))
    (call ex_step g f f2 s t x p p x 1 k)))
(lemma push_backward (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (flow_ok g f) (ex_ok g f s t x) (!= x p) (!= x s)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g)))
            (> (get_flow f x p) 0)
            (square f2 (len g))
            (diff_at f f2 x p -1))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2) (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f x p) (idx (idx f x) p)))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x p c) (<= (get_flow f x p) c)))
    (assert (has_capacity g x p c))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) p) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (flow_new g f2 x p))
    (call flow_push g f f2 x p -1)
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 x p -1 i))
    (call ex_step g f f2 s t x p x p -1 i)))

(ghost-fn arcs_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
             (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) lim)))
        (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y)))))
(lemma arcs_init_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (lim int) (y int))
  (requires (st_ok g f s o p e cnt)
            (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
                 (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) lim))))
  (ensures (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
  (body
    (assert (st_ok g f s o p e cnt))
    (assert (node_ok g f s o p e y))))
(lemma arcs_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (lim int))
  (requires (st_ok g f s o p e cnt))
  (ensures (arcs_ok g f s o p e lim))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call arcs_init_at g f s o p e cnt lim y))))
(lemma arcs_step_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int)
                            (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (x int) (px int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (y int))
  (requires (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (node_ok g f0 s o p e x)
            (!= x s)
            (>= (idx o x) 0)
            (== px (idx p x))
            (arcs_ok g f s o p e (idx o x))
            (or (and (== a px) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b px)))
            (diff_at f f2 a b d)
            (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
                 (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) (idx o px)))))
  (ensures (arc_ok g f2 (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
  (body
    (assert (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt))
    (assert (node_ok g f0 s o p e x))
    (assert (node_ok g f0 s o p e y))
    (assert (!= y x))
    (assert (!= (idx p y) x))
    (assert (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 (idx p y) y) (get_flow f (idx p y) y)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 y (idx p y)) (get_flow f y (idx p y))))))
(lemma arcs_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int)
                         (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (x int) (px int) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (node_ok g f0 s o p e x)
            (!= x s)
            (>= (idx o x) 0)
            (== px (idx p x))
            (arcs_ok g f s o p e (idx o x))
            (or (and (== a px) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b px)))
            (diff_at f f2 a b d))
  (ensures (arcs_ok g f2 s o p e (idx o px)))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call arcs_step_at g f0 f f2 s o p e cnt x px a b d y))))

(spec augment
  (params (a (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (fm (vec (vec i64))) (s i64) (t i64)
          (ord (ref (slice i64))) (par (ref (slice i64))) (kind (ref (slice i64))) (cnt i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (st_ok a fm s ord par kind cnt)
            (flow_ok a fm)
            (ex_ok a fm s t t)
            (distinct_ok a)
            (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len a)))
            (!= s t)
            (>= (idx ord t) 0))
  (ensures (flow_ok a r)
           (ex_ok a r s t s)
           (== (flow_val a r s) (+ (flow_val a fm s) 1)))
  (effects))
(def augment
  (body
    (let-mut w (vec (vec i64)) fm)
    (let-mut x i64 t)
    (call arcs_init a fm s ord par kind cnt (idx ord t))
    (while (!= x s)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))))
      (invariant (>= (idx ord x) 0))
      (invariant (flow_ok a w))
      (invariant (ex_ok a w s t x))
      (invariant (arcs_ok a w s ord par kind (idx ord x)))
      (invariant (== (flow_val a w s) (+ (flow_val a fm s) (if (== x s) 1 0))))
      (decreases (idx ord x))
      (assert (node_ok a fm s ord par kind x))
      (assert (arc_ok a w (idx par x) (idx kind x) x))
      (let p i64 (idx par x))
      (let k i64 (idx kind x))
      (ghost-let w0 (seq (seq int)) w)
      (assert (square w0 (len a)))
      (if (>= k 0)
        (block
          (let c i64 (get (idx (idx a p) k) 1))
          (call law_i64_range c)
          (assert (== (get_flow w p x) (idx (idx w p) x)))
          (let e i64 (+ (idx (idx w p) x) 1))
          (set-idx (idx w p) x e)
          (call diff_intro w0 w p x 1 (len a))
          (call push_forward a w0 w s t x p k)
          (call arcs_step a fm w0 w s ord par kind cnt x p p x 1))
        (block
          (assert (== (get_flow w x p) (idx (idx w x) p)))
          (let e2 i64 (- (idx (idx w x) p) 1))
          (set-idx (idx w x) p e2)
          (call diff_intro w0 w x p -1 (len a))
          (call push_backward a w0 w s t x p)
          (call arcs_step a fm w0 w s ord par kind cnt x p x p -1)))
      (set x p))
    (return w)))

(ghost-fn mcount ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k int) (v int) (d int)) int (decreases d)
  (body (if (or (<= d 0) (or (< k 0) (or (>= k (len g)) (> d (len (idx g k)))))) 0
    (+ (mcount g k v (- d 1)) (if (== (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0) v) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn aless ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (p int) (d int)) int (decreases d)
  (body (if (or (<= d 0) (or (< k 0) (or (>= k (len g)) (> d (len (idx g k)))))) 0
    (+ (aless g f o k p (- d 1))
       (if (and (< (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0) p) (vis o (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)))
           (get_flow f k (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0))
           0)))))
(ghost-fn adjout ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (d int)) int (decreases d)
  (body (if (or (<= d 0) (or (< k 0) (or (>= k (len g)) (> d (len (idx g k)))))) 0
    (+ (adjout g f o k (- d 1))
       (if (vis o (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)) 0 (get_flow f k (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn capout ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (d int)) int (decreases d)
  (body (if (or (<= d 0) (or (< k 0) (or (>= k (len g)) (> d (len (idx g k)))))) 0
    (+ (capout g o k (- d 1))
       (if (vis o (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)) 0 (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 1))))))
(ghost-fn rowchi ((f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (p int)) int (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) 0
    (+ (rowchi f o k (- p 1)) (if (vis o (- p 1)) (get_flow f k (- p 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn rowval ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int)) int
  (body (- (if (vis o k) (total_flow_out g f k) 0) (rowchi f o k (len g)))))
(ghost-fn rc ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq int)) (k int)) int
  (body (if (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g))) (vis o k)) (capout g o k (len (idx g k))) 0)))
(ghost-fn wsum ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (p int) (m int)) int (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) 0
    (+ (wsum g f o (- p 1) m) (if (vis o (- p 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f (- p 1) m) 0)))))
(ghost-fn outs ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0
    (+ (outs g f o (- m 1)) (if (vis o (- m 1)) (total_flow_out g f (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn cut_cap ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq int)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (cut_cap g o (- m 1)) (rc g o (- m 1))))))

(lemma mcount_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k int) (v int) (j int) (istar int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (<= j istar))
            (< istar (len (idx g k)))
            (== (get (idx (idx g k) istar) 0) v))
  (ensures (== (mcount g k v j) 0))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (<= j 0) (block)
    (block
      (call mcount_zero g k v (- j 1) istar)
      (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g k) (- j 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g k) istar) 0)))))))
(lemma mcount_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k int) (v int) (i0 int) (d int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 d))
            (<= d (len (idx g k)))
            (== (get (idx (idx g k) i0) 0) v))
  (ensures (== (mcount g k v d) 1))
  (decreases d)
  (body (if (== (- d 1) i0)
    (call mcount_zero g k v i0 i0)
    (block
      (call mcount_one g k v i0 (- d 1))
      (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g k) i0) 0)))))))
(lemma aless_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (p int) (d int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (>= p 1)
            (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (== (aless g f o k p d)
               (+ (aless g f o k (- p 1) d)
                  (if (and (vis o (- p 1)) (== (mcount g k (- p 1) d) 1)) (get_flow f k (- p 1)) 0))))
  (decreases d)
  (body (if (<= d 0) (block)
    (block
      (call aless_step g f o k p (- d 1))
      (if (== (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0) (- p 1))
        (call mcount_zero g k (- p 1) (- d 1) (- d 1))
        (block))))))
(lemma aless_base (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (d int))
  (requires (targets_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (== (aless g f o k 0 d) 0))
  (decreases d)
  (body (if (<= d 0) (block)
    (block
      (call aless_base g f o k (- d 1))
      (assert (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)))))))

(lemma flow_pos (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (get_flow h k v) 0)
           (=> (> (get_flow h k v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g k v c) (<= (get_flow h k v) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (is_valid_flow g h s t))
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h k)))))
      (assert (== (get_flow h k v) (idx (idx h k) v)))
      (assert (== (get_flow h k v) 0)))))
(lemma flow_support (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (distinct_ok g) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g))))
  (ensures (=> (> (get_flow h k v) 0) (== (mcount g k v (len (idx g k))) 1)))
  (body
    (call flow_pos g h s t k v)
    (if (> (get_flow h k v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g k v c) (<= (get_flow h k v) c)))
        (assert (has_capacity g k v c))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g k)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g k) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g k) i) 1) c))))
        (call mcount_one g k v i (len (idx g k))))
      (block))))
(lemma flow_le_cap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (distinct_ok g) (capacities_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow h k (get (idx (idx g k) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g k) i) 1)))
  (body
    (call has_cap_intro g k i)
    (assert (capacities_bounded g))
    (assert (>= (get (idx (idx g k) i) 1) 0))
    (call flow_pos g h s t k (get (idx (idx g k) i) 0))
    (if (> (get_flow h k (get (idx (idx g k) i) 0)) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g k (get (idx (idx g k) i) 0) c)
                               (<= (get_flow h k (get (idx (idx g k) i) 0)) c)))
        (assert (has_capacity g k (get (idx (idx g k) i) 0) c))
        (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g k)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g k) j) 0) (get (idx (idx g k) i) 0))
                                    (== (get (idx (idx g k) j) 1) c))))
        (assert (== j i))
        (assert (== c (get (idx (idx g k) i) 1))))
      (block))))
(lemma flow_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (capacities_bounded g))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow h k v) 100000))
  (body
    (call flow_pos g h s t k v)
    (assert (capacities_bounded g))
    (if (> (get_flow h k v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g k v c) (<= (get_flow h k v) c)))
        (assert (has_capacity g k v c))
        (assert (<= c 100000)))
      (block))))

(lemma reindex (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (k int) (p int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (distinct_ok g) (targets_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (>= p 0))
  (ensures (== (rowchi h o k p) (aless g h o k p (len (idx g k)))))
  (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0)
    (call aless_base g h o k (len (idx g k)))
    (block
      (call reindex g h o s t k (- p 1))
      (call aless_step g h o k p (len (idx g k)))
      (call flow_pos g h s t k (- p 1))
      (call flow_support g h s t k (- p 1))))))
(lemma split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (d int))
  (requires (targets_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f k d) (+ (aless g f o k (len g) d) (adjout g f o k d))))
  (decreases d)
  (body (if (<= d 0) (block)
    (block
      (call split g f o k (- d 1))
      (assert (< (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0) (len g)))))))
(lemma adjout_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (k int) (d int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (distinct_ok g) (capacities_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (<= (adjout g h o k d) (capout g o k d)))
  (decreases d)
  (body (if (<= d 0) (block)
    (block
      (call adjout_le g h o s t k (- d 1))
      (call flow_le_cap g h s t k (- d 1))))))
(lemma aless_nonneg (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (k int) (p int) (d int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (>= (aless g h o k p d) 0))
  (decreases d)
  (body (if (<= d 0) (block)
    (block
      (call aless_nonneg g h o s t k p (- d 1))
      (call flow_pos g h s t k (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0))))))
(lemma adjout_sat (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (k int) (d int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g f s t) (distinct_ok g) (capacities_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (fwd_upto g f o k (len (idx g k)))
            (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (== (adjout g f o k d) (capout g o k d)))
  (decreases d)
  (body (if (<= d 0) (block)
    (block
      (call adjout_sat g f o s t k (- d 1))
      (call flow_le_cap g f s t k (- d 1))
      (assert (or (vis o (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0))
                  (>= (get_flow f k (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)) (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 1))))))))
(lemma back_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (closed_upto g f o (len g))
            (== (len o) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (not (vis o k))
            (vis o v))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow f k v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (closed_at g f o v))
    (assert (bwd_upto g f o v (len g)))
    (assert (or (vis o k) (<= (get_flow f k v) 0)))))
(lemma aless_unvis (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (k int) (p int) (d int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g f s t)
            (closed_upto g f o (len g))
            (== (len o) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
            (not (vis o k))
            (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (== (aless g f o k p d) 0))
  (decreases d)
  (body (if (<= d 0) (block)
    (block
      (call aless_unvis g f o s t k p (- d 1))
      (call flow_pos g f s t k (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0))
      (if (vis o (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0))
        (call back_zero g f o k (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0))
        (block))))))

(lemma row_net (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (distinct_ok g) (targets_ok g) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (rowval g h o k)
               (if (vis o k)
                   (adjout g h o k (len (idx g k)))
                   (- 0 (aless g h o k (len g) (len (idx g k)))))))
  (body
    (call reindex g h o s t k (len g))
    (call split g h o k (len (idx g k)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g h k) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h k (len (idx g k)))))))
(lemma row_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (distinct_ok g) (targets_ok g) (capacities_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (rowval g h o k) (rc g o k)))
  (body
    (call row_net g h o s t k)
    (call adjout_le g h o s t k (len (idx g k)))
    (call aless_nonneg g h o s t k (len g) (len (idx g k)))))
(lemma row_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g f s t) (distinct_ok g) (targets_ok g) (capacities_bounded g)
            (closed_upto g f o (len g))
            (== (len o) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (rowval g f o k) (rc g o k)))
  (body
    (call row_net g f o s t k)
    (if (vis o k)
      (block
        (assert (closed_at g f o k))
        (call adjout_sat g f o s t k (len (idx g k))))
      (call aless_unvis g f o s t k (len g) (len (idx g k))))))

(lemma fubini (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (p int) (k int))
  (requires (> k 0))
  (ensures (== (wsum g f o p k) (+ (wsum g f o p (- k 1)) (rowchi f o (- k 1) p))))
  (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) (block)
    (block
      (call fubini g f o (- p 1) k)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f (- p 1) k)
                  (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f (- p 1) (- k 1)) (get_flow f (- k 1) (- p 1)))))))))
(lemma wsum_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (p int))
  (ensures (== (wsum g f o p 0) 0))
  (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) (block)
    (block
      (call wsum_zero g f o (- p 1))
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f (- p 1) 0) 0))))))
(lemma cut_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (m int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (distinct_ok g) (targets_ok g) (capacities_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (- (outs g h o m) (wsum g h o (len g) m)) (cut_cap g o m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0)
    (call wsum_zero g h o (len g))
    (block
      (call cut_le g h o s t (- m 1))
      (call fubini g h o (len g) m)
      (call row_le g h o s t (- m 1))))))
(lemma cut_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (m int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g f s t) (distinct_ok g) (targets_ok g) (capacities_bounded g)
            (closed_upto g f o (len g))
            (== (len o) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))
  (ensures (== (- (outs g f o m) (wsum g f o (len g) m)) (cut_cap g o m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0)
    (call wsum_zero g f o (len g))
    (block
      (call cut_eq g f o s t (- m 1))
      (call fubini g f o (len g) m)
      (call row_eq g f o s t (- m 1))))))
(lemma value_net (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (p int))
  (requires (is_conserved g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (len g)))
            (vis o s)
            (not (vis o t)))
  (ensures (== (- (outs g h o p) (wsum g h o p (len g))) (if (> p s) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) (block)
    (block
      (call value_net g h o s t (- p 1))
      (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- p 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- p 1) (len g))))
      (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))
      (if (and (vis o (- p 1)) (and (!= (- p 1) s) (!= (- p 1) t)))

          (ghost-let o4 (seq int) ob)
          (ghost-let p4 (seq int) pb)
          (ghost-let k4 (seq int) kb)
          (set-idx ob w cb)
          (set-idx pb w u)
          (set-idx kb w -1)
          (call st_mark a f s o4 p4 k4 cb ob pb kb u w -1)
          (set cb (+ cb 1)))
        (if (== cb cnt) (call bwd_step a f ob u w) (block)))
      (set w (+ w 1)))
    (return ob pb kb cb)))

(spec search
  (params (a (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (f (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (s i64))
  (returns (ord (vec i64)) (par (vec i64)) (kind (vec i64)) (cnt i64))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len a)))
            (square f (len a))
            (targets_ok a)
            (<= (len a) 1000))
  (ensures (st_ok a f s ord par kind cnt)
           (closed_upto a f ord (len a)))
  (effects alloc))
(def search
  (body
    (let n i64 (len a))
    (let-mut ob (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (i) -1)))
    (let-mut pb (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (i) 0)))
    (let-mut kb (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (i) 0)))
    (ghost-let o0 (seq int) ob)
    (set-idx ob s 0)
    (call st_init a f s o0 ob pb kb)
    (let-mut cb i64 1)
    (while true
      (invariant (st_ok a f s ob pb kb cb))
      (invariant (and (<= 1 cb) (<= cb n)))
      (decreases (- n cb))
      (ghost-let cstart int cb)
      (ghost-let ostart (seq int) ob)
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (let-mut changed bool false)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (st_ok a f s ob pb kb cb))
        (invariant (and (<= 1 cb) (<= cb n)))
        (invariant (>= cb cstart))
        (invariant (=> changed (> cb cstart)))
        (invariant (=> (not changed) (and (== ob ostart) (closed_upto a f ostart u))))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (if (>= (idx ob u) 0)
          (block
            (let ((o3 (vec i64)) (p3 (vec i64)) (k3 (vec i64)) (c3 i64)) (call visit a f s u ob pb kb cb))
            (if (or changed (!= c3 cb))
              (set changed true)
              (call closed_step a f ostart u))
            (set ob o3)
            (set pb p3)
            (set kb k3)
            (set cb c3))
          (if changed (block) (call closed_step a f ostart u)))
        (set u (+ u 1)))
      (if changed (block) (return ob pb kb cb)))
    (return ob pb kb cb)))

(ghost-fn flow_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (and (square f (len g)) (and (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg f)))))
(ghost-fn ex_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
        (== (+ (total_flow_in g f u) (if (== u x) 1 0)) (total_flow_out g f u))))))
(ghost-fn diff_at ((f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int)) bool
  (body (and (== (get_flow f2 a b) (+ (get_flow f a b) d))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (=> (or (!= u a) (!= v b)) (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v)))))))
(ghost-fn push_rel ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a))))
    (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b) (diff_at f f2 a b d))))))
(ghost-fn flow_new ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int)) bool
  (body (and (>= (get_flow f2 a b) 0)
    (=> (> (get_flow f2 a b) 0)
        (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (get_flow f2 a b) c)))))))
(lemma diff_intro (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int))
  (requires (square f n)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
            (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (== (len f2) n)
            (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (!= u a)) (== (idx f2 u) (idx f u))))
            (== (len (idx f2 a)) n)
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (!= v b)) (== (idx (idx f2 a) v) (idx (idx f a) v))))
            (== (idx (idx f2 a) b) (+ (idx (idx f a) b) d)))
  (ensures (diff_at f f2 a b d) (square f2 n))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f a b) (idx (idx f a) b)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 a b) (idx (idx f2 a) b)))))

(lemma out_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((v int)) (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f2 u k) (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call out_same g f f2 u (- k 1)))))
(lemma out_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (k int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b)
            (diff_at f f2 a b d)
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g a)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f2 a k) (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g f a k) (if (> k i0) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block)
    (block
      (call out_at g f f2 a b d i0 (- k 1))
      (if (== (- k 1) i0) (block)
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g a) (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0))))))))
(lemma in_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((j int)) (== (get_flow f2 j u) (get_flow f j u))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f2 u k) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call in_same g f f2 u (- k 1)))))
(lemma in_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (k int))
  (requires (<= 0 a) (diff_at f f2 a b d))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f2 b k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f b k) (if (> k a) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call in_at g f f2 a b d (- k 1)))))
(lemma diff_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (u int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f2 u) (+ (total_flow_out g f u) (if (== u a) d 0))))
  (body
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (if (== u a)
      (call out_at g f f2 a b d i0 (len (idx g a)))
      (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (call out_same g f f2 u (len (idx g u)))
        (block)))))
(lemma diff_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (u int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f2 u) (+ (total_flow_in g f u) (if (== u b) d 0))))
  (body
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (if (== u b)
      (call in_at g f f2 a b d (len g))
      (call in_same g f f2 u (len g)))))
(lemma ex_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int)
                       (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0)
            (or (and (== a p) (and (== b x) (== d 1))) (and (== a x) (and (== b p) (== d -1))))
            (!= x p)
            (!= x s)
            (ex_ok g f s t x))
  (ensures (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call diff_out g f f2 a b d i0 u))
    (forall ((u int)) (call diff_in g f f2 a b d i0 u))
    (assert (ex_ok g f s t x))))

(lemma has_cap_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g k (get (idx (idx g k) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g k) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma nn_push_at (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (nonneg f) (square f n) (square f2 n) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (>= (get_flow f2 a b) 0)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f2))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f2 u))))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (square f n))
    (assert (square f2 n))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (idx (idx f2 u) v)))
    (if (and (== u a) (== v b))
      (assert (>= (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (nonneg f))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0))))))
(lemma nn_push (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (nonneg f) (square f n) (square f2 n) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (>= (get_flow f2 a b) 0))
  (ensures (nonneg f2))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nn_push_at f f2 n a b d u v))))
(lemma rc_push_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (square f (len g)) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f2))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f2 u))))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f2 u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (square f2 (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (idx (idx f2 u) v)))
    (if (and (== u a) (== v b))
      (assert (flow_new g f2 a b))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (respects_capacity g f))))))
(ghost-fn rc_cell ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
            (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
                (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))))
(ghost-fn rc_cells ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (rc_cell g f x y))))
(lemma rc_open (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (rc_cells g f)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (rc_cells g f))
    (assert (rc_cell g f u v))))
(lemma rc_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (rc_cells g f))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call rc_open g f u v))))
(lemma rc_cell_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (square f (len g)) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b))
  (ensures (rc_cell g f2 u v))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f2))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f2 u)))))
      (call rc_push_at g f f2 a b d u v)
      (block))))
(lemma rc_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (square f (len g)) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f2))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call rc_cell_at g f f2 a b d u v))
    (assert (rc_cells g f2))
    (call rc_intro g f2)))
(lemma flow_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (flow_ok g f) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (flow_new g f2 a b))
    (call nn_push f f2 (len g) a b d)
    (call rc_push g f f2 a b d)))
(lemma push_forward (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int) (k int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (flow_ok g f) (ex_ok g f s t x) (!= x p) (!= x s)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g p))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g p) k) 0) x)
            (< (get_flow f p x) (get (idx (idx g p) k) 1))
            (square f2 (len g))
            (diff_at f f2 p x 1))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2) (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (nonneg f))
    (assert (== (get_flow f p x) (idx (idx f p) x)))
    (call has_cap_intro g p k)
    (assert (has_capacity g p x (get (idx (idx g p) k) 1)))
    (assert (flow_new g f2 p x))
    (call flow_push g f f2 p x 1)
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 p x 1 k))
    (call ex_step g f f2 s t x p p x 1 k)))
(lemma push_backward (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (flow_ok g f) (ex_ok g f s t x) (!= x p) (!= x s)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g)))
            (> (get_flow f x p) 0)
            (square f2 (len g))
            (diff_at f f2 x p -1))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2) (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f x p) (idx (idx f x) p)))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x p c) (<= (get_flow f x p) c)))
    (assert (has_capacity g x p c))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) p) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (flow_new g f2 x p))
    (call flow_push g f f2 x p -1)
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 x p -1 i))
    (call ex_step g f f2 s t x p x p -1 i)))

(ghost-fn arcs_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
             (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) lim)))
        (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y)))))
(lemma arcs_init_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (lim int) (y int))
  (requires (st_ok g f s o p e cnt)
            (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
                 (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) lim))))
  (ensures (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
  (body
    (assert (st_ok g f s o p e cnt))
    (assert (node_ok g f s o p e y))))
(lemma arcs_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (lim int))
  (requires (st_ok g f s o p e cnt))
  (ensures (arcs_ok g f s o p e lim))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call arcs_init_at g f s o p e cnt lim y))))
(lemma arcs_step_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int)
                            (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (x int) (px int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (y int))
  (requires (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (node_ok g f0 s o p e x)
            (!= x s)
            (>= (idx o x) 0)
            (== px (idx p x))
            (arcs_ok g f s o p e (idx o x))
            (or (and (== a px) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b px)))
            (diff_at f f2 a b d)
            (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
                 (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) (idx o px)))))
  (ensures (arc_ok g f2 (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
  (body
    (assert (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt))
    (assert (node_ok g f0 s o p e x))
    (assert (node_ok g f0 s o p e y))
    (assert (!= y x))
    (assert (!= (idx p y) x))
    (assert (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 (idx p y) y) (get_flow f (idx p y) y)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 y (idx p y)) (get_flow f y (idx p y))))))
(lemma arcs_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int)
                         (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (x int) (px int) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (node_ok g f0 s o p e x)
            (!= x s)
            (>= (idx o x) 0)
            (== px (idx p x))
            (arcs_ok g f s o p e (idx o x))
            (or (and (== a px) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b px)))
            (diff_at f f2 a b d))
  (ensures (arcs_ok g f2 s o p e (idx o px)))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call arcs_step_at g f0 f f2 s o p e cnt x px a b d y))))

(spec augment
  (params (a (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (fm (vec (vec i64))) (s i64) (t i64)
          (ord (ref (slice i64))) (par (ref (slice i64))) (kind (ref (slice i64))) (cnt i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (st_ok a fm s ord par kind cnt)
            (flow_ok a fm)
            (ex_ok a fm s t t)
            (distinct_ok a)
            (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len a)))
            (!= s t)
            (>= (idx ord t) 0))
  (ensures (flow_ok a r)
           (ex_ok a r s t s)
           (== (flow_val a r s) (+ (flow_val a fm s) 1)))
  (effects))
(def augment
  (body
    (let-mut w (vec (vec i64)) fm)
    (let-mut x i64 t)
    (call arcs_init a fm s ord par kind cnt (idx ord t))
    (while (!= x s)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))))
      (invariant (>= (idx ord x) 0))
      (invariant (flow_ok a w))
      (invariant (ex_ok a w s t x))
      (invariant (arcs_ok a w s ord par kind (idx ord x)))
      (invariant (== (flow_val a w s) (+ (flow_val a fm s) (if (== x s) 1 0))))
      (decreases (idx ord x))
      (assert (node_ok a fm s ord par kind x))
      (assert (arc_ok a w (idx par x) (idx kind x) x))
      (let p i64 (idx par x))
      (let k i64 (idx kind x))
      (ghost-let w0 (seq (seq int)) w)
      (assert (square w0 (len a)))
      (if (>= k 0)
        (block
          (let c i64 (get (idx (idx a p) k) 1))
          (call law_i64_range c)
          (assert (== (get_flow w p x) (idx (idx w p) x)))
          (let e i64 (+ (idx (idx w p) x) 1))
          (set-idx (idx w p) x e)
          (call diff_intro w0 w p x 1 (len a))
          (call push_forward a w0 w s t x p k)
          (call arcs_step a fm w0 w s ord par kind cnt x p p x 1))
        (block

(ghost-fn push_rel ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a))))
    (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b) (diff_at f f2 a b d))))))
(ghost-fn flow_new ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int)) bool
  (body (and (>= (get_flow f2 a b) 0)
    (=> (> (get_flow f2 a b) 0)
        (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (get_flow f2 a b) c)))))))
(lemma diff_intro (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int))
  (requires (square f n)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
            (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (== (len f2) n)
            (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (!= u a)) (== (idx f2 u) (idx f u))))
            (== (len (idx f2 a)) n)
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (!= v b)) (== (idx (idx f2 a) v) (idx (idx f a) v))))
            (== (idx (idx f2 a) b) (+ (idx (idx f a) b) d)))
  (ensures (diff_at f f2 a b d) (square f2 n))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f a b) (idx (idx f a) b)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 a b) (idx (idx f2 a) b)))))

(lemma out_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((v int)) (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f2 u k) (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call out_same g f f2 u (- k 1)))))
(lemma out_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (k int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g a))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0) b)
            (diff_at f f2 a b d)
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g a)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f2 a k) (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g f a k) (if (> k i0) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block)
    (block
      (call out_at g f f2 a b d i0 (- k 1))
      (if (== (- k 1) i0) (block)
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g a) (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g a) i0) 0))))))))
(lemma in_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((j int)) (== (get_flow f2 j u) (get_flow f j u))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f2 u k) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call in_same g f f2 u (- k 1)))))
(lemma in_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (k int))
  (requires (<= 0 a) (diff_at f f2 a b d))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f2 b k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f b k) (if (> k a) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) (block) (call in_at g f f2 a b d (- k 1)))))
(lemma diff_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (u int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f2 u) (+ (total_flow_out g f u) (if (== u a) d 0))))
  (body
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (if (== u a)
      (call out_at g f f2 a b d i0 (len (idx g a)))
      (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (call out_same g f f2 u (len (idx g u)))
        (block)))))
(lemma diff_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int) (u int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f2 u) (+ (total_flow_in g f u) (if (== u b) d 0))))
  (body
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (if (== u b)
      (call in_at g f f2 a b d (len g))
      (call in_same g f f2 u (len g)))))
(lemma ex_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int)
                       (a int) (b int) (d int) (i0 int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g)
            (push_rel g f f2 a b d i0)
            (or (and (== a p) (and (== b x) (== d 1))) (and (== a x) (and (== b p) (== d -1))))
            (!= x p)
            (!= x s)
            (ex_ok g f s t x))
  (ensures (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call diff_out g f f2 a b d i0 u))
    (forall ((u int)) (call diff_in g f f2 a b d i0 u))
    (assert (ex_ok g f s t x))))

(lemma has_cap_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g k)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g k (get (idx (idx g k) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g k) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma nn_push_at (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (nonneg f) (square f n) (square f2 n) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (>= (get_flow f2 a b) 0)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f2))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f2 u))))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (square f n))
    (assert (square f2 n))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (idx (idx f2 u) v)))
    (if (and (== u a) (== v b))
      (assert (>= (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (nonneg f))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0))))))
(lemma nn_push (params (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (nonneg f) (square f n) (square f2 n) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (>= (get_flow f2 a b) 0))
  (ensures (nonneg f2))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nn_push_at f f2 n a b d u v))))
(lemma rc_push_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (square f (len g)) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f2))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f2 u))))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f2 u) v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f2 u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (square f2 (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (idx (idx f2 u) v)))
    (if (and (== u a) (== v b))
      (assert (flow_new g f2 a b))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow f2 u v) (get_flow f u v)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (respects_capacity g f))))))
(ghost-fn rc_cell ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
            (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
                (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))))
(ghost-fn rc_cells ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (rc_cell g f x y))))
(lemma rc_open (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (rc_cells g f)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (rc_cells g f))
    (assert (rc_cell g f u v))))
(lemma rc_witness (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (not (respects_capacity g f)))
  (ensures (exists ((u int)) (exists ((w int))
    (not (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len (idx f u)))))
             (=> (> (idx (idx f u) w) 0)
                 (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u w c) (<= (idx (idx f u) w) c)))))))))
  (body (assert (not (respects_capacity g f)))))
(lemma rc_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (rc_cells g f))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body
    (if (respects_capacity g f)
      (block)
      (block
        (call rc_witness g f)
        (obtain ((u int)) (exists ((w int))
          (not (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len (idx f u)))))
                   (=> (> (idx (idx f u) w) 0)
                       (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u w c) (<= (idx (idx f u) w) c))))))))
        (obtain ((v int))
          (not (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
                   (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
                       (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))))
        (call rc_open g f u v)
        (assert false)))))
(lemma rc_cell_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (square f (len g)) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b))
  (ensures (rc_cell g f2 u v))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f2))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f2 u)))))
      (call rc_push_at g f f2 a b d u v)
      (block))))
(lemma rc_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (square f (len g)) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f2))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call rc_cell_at g f f2 a b d u v))
    (assert (rc_cells g f2))
    (call rc_intro g f2)))
(lemma flow_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (flow_ok g f) (square f2 (len g)) (diff_at f f2 a b d) (flow_new g f2 a b))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (flow_new g f2 a b))
    (call nn_push f f2 (len g) a b d)
    (call rc_push g f f2 a b d)))
(lemma push_forward (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int) (k int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (flow_ok g f) (ex_ok g f s t x) (!= x p) (!= x s)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g p))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g p) k) 0) x)
            (< (get_flow f p x) (get (idx (idx g p) k) 1))
            (square f2 (len g))
            (diff_at f f2 p x 1))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2) (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (nonneg f))
    (assert (== (get_flow f p x) (idx (idx f p) x)))
    (call has_cap_intro g p k)
    (assert (has_capacity g p x (get (idx (idx g p) k) 1)))
    (assert (flow_new g f2 p x))
    (call flow_push g f f2 p x 1)
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 p x 1 k))
    (call ex_step g f f2 s t x p p x 1 k)))
(lemma push_backward (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (p int))
  (requires (distinct_ok g) (flow_ok g f) (ex_ok g f s t x) (!= x p) (!= x s)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g)))
            (> (get_flow f x p) 0)
            (square f2 (len g))
            (diff_at f f2 x p -1))
  (ensures (flow_ok g f2) (ex_ok g f2 s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f2 s) (+ (flow_val g f s) (if (== s p) 1 0))))
  (body
    (assert (flow_ok g f))
    (assert (square f (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f x p) (idx (idx f x) p)))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x p c) (<= (get_flow f x p) c)))
    (assert (has_capacity g x p c))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) p) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (flow_new g f2 x p))
    (call flow_push g f f2 x p -1)
    (assert (push_rel g f f2 x p -1 i))
    (call ex_step g f f2 s t x p x p -1 i)))

(ghost-fn arcs_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
             (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) lim)))
        (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y)))))
(lemma arcs_init_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (lim int) (y int))
  (requires (st_ok g f s o p e cnt)
            (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
                 (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) lim))))
  (ensures (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
  (body
    (assert (st_ok g f s o p e cnt))
    (assert (node_ok g f s o p e y))))
(lemma arcs_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (lim int))
  (requires (st_ok g f s o p e cnt))
  (ensures (arcs_ok g f s o p e lim))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call arcs_init_at g f s o p e cnt lim y))))
(lemma arcs_step_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int)
                            (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (x int) (px int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (y int))
  (requires (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (node_ok g f0 s o p e x)
            (!= x s)
            (>= (idx o x) 0)
            (== px (idx p x))
            (arcs_ok g f s o p e (idx o x))
            (or (and (== a px) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b px)))
            (diff_at f f2 a b d)
            (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))) (and (< y (len p)) (< y (len e))))
                 (and (and (>= (idx o y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx o y) (idx o px)))))
  (ensures (arc_ok g f2 (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
  (body
    (assert (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt))
    (assert (node_ok g f0 s o p e x))
    (assert (node_ok g f0 s o p e y))
    (assert (!= y x))
    (assert (!= (idx p y) x))
    (assert (arc_ok g f (idx p y) (idx e y) y))
    (assert (diff_at f f2 a b d))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 (idx p y) y) (get_flow f (idx p y) y)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f2 y (idx p y)) (get_flow f y (idx p y))))))
(lemma arcs_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (s int)
                         (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (e (seq int)) (cnt int) (x int) (px int) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (st_ok g f0 s o p e cnt)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (node_ok g f0 s o p e x)
            (!= x s)
            (>= (idx o x) 0)
            (== px (idx p x))
            (arcs_ok g f s o p e (idx o x))
            (or (and (== a px) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b px)))
            (diff_at f f2 a b d))
  (ensures (arcs_ok g f2 s o p e (idx o px)))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call arcs_step_at g f0 f f2 s o p e cnt x px a b d y))))

(spec augment
  (params (a (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (fm (vec (vec i64))) (s i64) (t i64)
          (ord (ref (slice i64))) (par (ref (slice i64))) (kind (ref (slice i64))) (cnt i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (st_ok a fm s ord par kind cnt)
            (flow_ok a fm)
            (ex_ok a fm s t t)
            (distinct_ok a)
            (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len a)))
            (!= s t)
            (>= (idx ord t) 0))
  (ensures (flow_ok a r)
           (ex_ok a r s t s)
           (== (flow_val a r s) (+ (flow_val a fm s) 1)))
  (effects))
(def augment
  (body
    (let-mut w (vec (vec i64)) fm)
    (let-mut x i64 t)
    (call arcs_init a fm s ord par kind cnt (idx ord t))
    (while (!= x s)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))))
      (invariant (>= (idx ord x) 0))
      (invariant (flow_ok a w))
      (invariant (ex_ok a w s t x))
      (invariant (arcs_ok a w s ord par kind (idx ord x)))
      (invariant (== (flow_val a w s) (+ (flow_val a fm s) (if (== x s) 1 0))))
      (decreases (idx ord x))
      (assert (node_ok a fm s ord par kind x))
      (assert (arc_ok a w (idx par x) (idx kind x) x))
      (let p i64 (idx par x))
      (let k i64 (idx kind x))
      (ghost-let w0 (seq (seq int)) w)
      (assert (square w0 (len a)))
      (if (>= k 0)
        (block
          (let c i64 (get (idx (idx a p) k) 1))
          (call law_i64_range c)
          (assert (== (get_flow w p x) (idx (idx w p) x)))
          (let e i64 (+ (idx (idx w p) x) 1))
          (set-idx (idx w p) x e)
          (call diff_intro w0 w p x 1 (len a))
          (call push_forward a w0 w s t x p k)
          (call arcs_step a fm w0 w s ord par kind cnt x p p x 1))
        (block
          (assert (== (get_flow w x p) (idx (idx w x) p)))
          (let e2 i64 (- (idx (idx w x) p) 1))
          (set-idx (idx w x) p e2)
          (call diff_intro w0 w x p -1 (len a))
          (call push_backward a w0 w s t x p)
          (call arcs_step a fm w0 w s ord par kind cnt x p x p -1)))
      (set x p))
    (return w)))

(ghost-fn mcount ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k int) (v int) (d int)) int (decreases d)
  (body (if (or (<= d 0) (or (< k 0) (or (>= k (len g)) (> d (len (idx g k)))))) 0
    (+ (mcount g k v (- d 1)) (if (== (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0) v) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn aless ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (p int) (d int)) int (decreases d)
  (body (if (or (<= d 0) (or (< k 0) (or (>= k (len g)) (> d (len (idx g k)))))) 0
    (+ (aless g f o k p (- d 1))
       (if (and (< (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0) p) (vis o (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)))
           (get_flow f k (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0))
           0)))))
(ghost-fn adjout ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (d int)) int (decreases d)
  (body (if (or (<= d 0) (or (< k 0) (or (>= k (len g)) (> d (len (idx g k)))))) 0
    (+ (adjout g f o k (- d 1))
       (if (vis o (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)) 0 (get_flow f k (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn capout ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (d int)) int (decreases d)
  (body (if (or (<= d 0) (or (< k 0) (or (>= k (len g)) (> d (len (idx g k)))))) 0
    (+ (capout g o k (- d 1))
       (if (vis o (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 0)) 0 (get (idx (idx g k) (- d 1)) 1))))))
(ghost-fn rowchi ((f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (k int) (p int)) int (decreases p)
  (body (if (<= p 0) 0
    (+ (rowchi f o k (- p 1)) (if (vis o (- p 1)) (get_flow f k (- p 1)) 0)))))
